'phan yu/ la gyi gnas sna sto da dzomatshang tshorig tshoganas kyi bang mdzod/17239 jingus ba/khukhug(17560tab 'kho60tsho medangu 8snangam sgrig pa/ bawe/da nams ce)sa dar/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang /
༷ shu 'asgo/rmetrore / ra da riX — 15 3 — dzad/snyok+ṣidul r+sha ri / ge wa ljaX —— ———༷la rdo ngaX sde /rte /nyu4ste ga 1 —rjoXthu/ tsa sa// darmeX/ /kā sdor+sha 5khe / /——1 rnyeswāhāXrdochi/ / 9 /
klu kha stod kyi sku rgyab/ po to dgon/tre 7 76 1347 —— —pa lha) sdu shegiḥ 1 3 4 /༷ —— — 4phu chung ri khrod/ lo dgon pa/
byer+shar+sha༄1dzi/ r+shadzi — —14— —— poXgeXlar+shaX / sdo/———13 ba rnya na nga pa tsho

dpe skrun gsal bshad/deb 'di'i rtsom pa po bsod nams chos dar lags ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong slob 'bring du bod yig dge rgan gyi phyag las gnang bzhin yod cing / de sngon 'di ga nged dpe skrun khang nas bton pa'i khong gi brtsams chos (lha sa khul gyi gnyen sgrig lam srol 'jig rten dga' ba'i gtam〉 dang / (slob grwa chung 'bring gi slob ma'i rtsom yig sbyong ba'i myur lam〉 lo chung gzhon nu'i kun spyod slob gso'i blta deb〉 bcas la mkhas pa tsho'i gdeng 'jog dang / rgya che'i klog pa po tsho'i dga' bsu chen po thob yod/da res kyi brtsams chos 'di'i nang 'phan yul byams pa spun gsum ste/ rgyal lug la lha khang dang / klu kha stod byams pa ra ma byams khang / de bzhin 'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad de/ po to dgon dang / phu chung ri khrod/ lo dgon pa/ kha lung dgon pa/ sne'u zur dgon pa/ glang thang dgon pa/ gang shar dag 1

snang dgon / lcags ri dgon bcas kyi gnas yul dang / de dag phyag 'debs pa po'i rnam thar snying bsdus re/ snga deng gi gzhi khyon dang / rgyun chos cho ga phyag len/ dge 'dun gyi zhal grangs sogs cung zhib tshags pos ngo sprod kha gsal gnang yod/gzhan yang rtsom pa pos sa yul dngos la bskyod de skya ser rgan rabs myong ba can rnams la bcar 'dri dang / sa cha dngos la brtag dpyad zhib 'jug legs par gnang ste sngar lo rgyus smra ba phan tshun dbar bzhed pa mi mthun pa dang 'grel brjod dka' ba'i sa ming dang dgon ming dper na/ klu kha stod/ rgyal lug la gser gyi lha khang /rwa ma byams khang / yā sga mo sogs kyi ming thogs stangs la dpyad brjod kyis rang lugs rgyu mtshan khungs lung gtam brgyud dang bcas pa kha gsal go bder brjod nas dogs bsel nges gtan rnyed pa gnang yod la/ da dung 'phan yul gyi dmangs gzhas/'phan po lhun grub rdzong de// sku dbang btsan rang drags nas// ri bong ri la sdod mkhan// dar po che la btags bzhag/ ces pa de'i 'byung khungs shod srol gtam brgyud dang / 'phan po shar dus chen gyi 'byung khungs/ rgya lcags ri ba'i ma phra men ma yin pa'i gtam

brgyud snyan po zhig gi khungs lung ngo sprod dang sbrags rgya lcags ri ba chung dus khyi lus yin pa nas mi lus su bsgyur ba'i gsung tshul mi 'dra ba'i dogs gcod zhib tshags gnang 'dugabartsams chos 'dis da bar 'di lta bu'i 'phan gnas ngo sprod kyi dpe deb ma byung ba de'i stong cha kha skong du gyur nas rgya che'i dad ldan pa tsho'i gnas mjal gyi lam ston sgron me dang / yul skor spro gseng gnang mkhan tsho'i sne shan pa/ zhib 'jug rgyus lon gnang mkhan tsho'i dpyad yig khungs ldan zhig tu gyur nas 'phan po khul gyi dmangs srol dang / gna' shul/ chos lugs/ rig gnas sogs la rgyus lon dang zhib 'jug gzigs skor/ srung skyong bcas gnang rgyur phan pa shin tu nas che bar snang /rtsom sgrig 'gan 'khur pas/

dkar chagadang po/ 'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/ (1)gcig rgyal lug la lha khang dang de'i phyag 'debs pa po zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug (1)gnyis/ klu kha stod byams pa dang de'i phyag 'debs pa po zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug (31)gsum/ rwa ma byams khang dang de'i phyag 'debs pa po zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug (39)nyis pa/ 'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyud dang/ de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyug (51)gcig bka' gdams spyi'i byung ba mdo tsam brjodapa/ (51)gnyis/ po to dgon dang de'i phyag 'debs mkhan po to ba rin chen gsal/ (39)gsum/ ༅chung ri khrod dngasachubabagazhon nu rgyalamatshan/ (khu)1

bzhi/ lo dgon pa dang de'i phyag 'debs pa ngo spyan snga pa ṭaḥzung khri34sa 'bar (90)lnga/ kha lung dgon dang de'i phyag 'debs pa po kha lung pa sgang shākya yon tan/ (132)drug sne'u zur dgon dang de'i phyag 'debs pa po sne'u zur pa ye shes 'bar/ (141)bdun/ glang thang dgon dang de'i phyag 'debs pa po glang ri thang pa rdo rje seng ge (162)brgyad/ gang shar dag snang dgon dang de'i phyag 'debs pa po sha ra ba yon tan grags/ (195)dgu/ lcags ri dgon dang de'i phyag 'debs pa po rgya lcags ri ba byang chub dpal/ (230)gsum pa/ mjug bsdu'i gtam/ (243):drog 'grel/ (260)

'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/dang po/ 'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/gcig rgyal lug la lha khang dang de'i phyag 'debs pa po zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyuga'ago brjod/bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa bka' drin can//de yis legs mdzad dam chos gaṅga'i rgyun/dbus gtsang yul 'dir slar yang dar mdzad pa'i//gangs can mkhas pa rnams la phyag bgyi'o/zhes mchod par brjod pa'i dar dkar yug gcig sngon du btang ste gang gleng bar bya ba la 'phan yul rig pa'i 'byung gnas 'di nyid stod smad bar gsum du phye ba'i 'phan yul stod kyi sa'i char chags pa rgyal lha khang dgon 'di ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong mtsho stod shang lha khang grong tshor chags shing / lam bar du slob dpon shākya mchog ldan gyis phyag btab pa'i grub brgya dgon dang / lo tsā ba pa tshab nyi ma grags pas phyag btab pa'i pa tshab dgon sogs rim par mjal te mtsho stod shang

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/brgyud gnas der 'byor gyi yod/ gnas de ni sngon zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug la mgon pos lung bstan pa ltar yul gyi gnas sa ngo mtshar can zhig yod pa ni shar ri stag skya bo dang /lho ri g.yu 'brag sngon mo/ nub ri bya dmar po/ byang ri rus sbal rgya bo sorgos ri chen bzhi yis dgon pa'i mtha' nas bskor ba'i dbus su gtsug lag khang rten dang brten par bcas pa nyams dga' bar gnas shing / ri chen de dag la char drag rlung 'tshub sogs rang byang gi gnod pa rnams ched du ldog pa lta bu'i khyad chos dmigs pasal can zhig yod pa ni sku nyid gnas der dngos su phebs na mkhyen/ dgon pa 'di ni bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'gor 'dul ba'i bstan pa dbus gtsang du thog mar dar skabs gsar du bzhengs pa'i dgon gnas dang po'i gras yin zhing / dgon pa phyag btab nas spyi lo 2008bar lo 996tsam song ba'i 'phan yul gyi dgon pa rnying shos da lta dngos su mjal rgyu yod pa gcig pu de rang yin/ dgon pa 'di'i bsdus ming la rgyal lha khang dang / mtshan cha tshang la rgyal lug la gser gyi lha khang zhes brjod cing mtshan de ltar thogs pa'i lo rgyus cung zad tsam zhus na/rgyal zhes pa ni sngar spyi lo'i dus rabs brgyad pa'i nang bod kyi btsan po khri thog so brgyad pa khri srong lde btsan gyis bod spyi la dbang sgyur ba'i skabs slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyis klu kha stod kyi rgyab ngos stod lung khul gyi mon zhes pa'i sa der mon

'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/gyi kha rag sprel lo zhes pa'i dus mchod kyi cho ga zhig gsar gtod gnang ba na/ lo de'i bod zla 5tshes 10nyin gyi sprel lo'i dus mchod la chos rgyal khri srong lde btsan yang phebs pas khong gis mon gyi mdun ri'i nub ngos zangs mdog dpal ri nas zhal shar la phyogs te da lta rgyal po bla ri zhes 'bod pa'i ri der gzigs pa na/ ri de ni tshes brgyad zla ba'i dbyibs dang 'dra zhing gnas brtan bcu drug gi rang byon mngon sum du gzigs pa'i khyad chos dmigs bsal can zhig tu snang bas ri de khong gi bla rir ngos 'dzin zhus/ des na da lta stag mgo chu mdzod nas klu kha stod bar gyi yul grong de dag rgyal po'i bla ri dang ri rgyud gcig gi nang du chags pas dus de nas bzung dgon pa chags sa'i brgyud kyi yul spyi'i ming la rgyal gyi nang zhes brjod pa ltar yul ming dgon par thogs te rgyal lha khang zhes dang / lha khang ni lha rnams bzhugs sa'i khang pa yin pas ming spyi'i 'gro stangs ltar ro/ lug la gser gyi lha khang zhes pa ni sngon zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gis deng gi rgyal stod dgon te rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang bya grags lha khang yang zer/ phyag btab nas 'gro don bskyangs te bzhugs pa na/ yul der lha khang byang ngos zer ba'i dud khyim zhig yod pa de'i lug rdzi ba de nyin ltar lug 'tsho bar skyod skabs lug ma mo zhig gis dgon pa'i shar phyogs su yod pa'i la nyag der phar 'gro tshur 'ong byed dus rdo pha bong zhig la nyin ltar lu gur 'o ma ster ba ltar byed pa'i tshul de mthong ba na lug rdzi ba de 3

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/ya mtshan chen po byang ste zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug la zhus/zhang gis der ledros te rdo pha bong de bshags gnang bas de'i nang nas gser gyi rgyal ba byams pa khru gang tsam zhig thon pa de nyid gzungs gzhug tu phul te da lta rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang yod sa'i byang shar gyi mtshams der byams khang gsar bzhengs thog rgyal ba byams pa dgung lo bcu gnyis kyi sku tshad byas pa thog brtsegs nyis can zhig gsar bzhengs legs sgrub gnang / dus de nas bzung rgyal lug la gser gyi lha khang zhes pa'i mtshan de thogs par snyam la shar phyogs kyi la nyag der yang de ga'i yul mi rnams kyis sngar nas da bar lu gu la zhes brjod cing lug ma mo de yang rjes su tshe las 'das rjes lug de nyid gzungs gzhug tu phul nas mchod rten zhig bzhengs pa la ma mo chen mo'i mchod rten zhes da lta'ang dngos su mjal rgyu yod/ 'on kyang sngon gyi deb ther khag tu rgyal lug lhas lha khang dang / lug glas lha khang zhes 'bri srol sna tshogs shig 'dug kyang thog ma'i ming gi byang tshul de ltar lags pas slad nga tshos rgyal lug la lha khang zhes spros na cung zad rgyu mtshan dang ldan la dag par snang ngo/(1) dgon 'di thog mar phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus dang ji ltar phyag btab nas dar rgud ji byung gi skor/de yang rang cag kha ba'i ljongs 'dir btsan po lha tho tho ri gnyan btsan gyi dus nas rim pas dar khyab byang ba'i nang pa sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa 'di nyid phyi nang 'gal skyon sna tshogs kyi

'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/rkyen pas bod rgyal zhe gnyis pa glang dar gyis bsnubs te yun ring dam pa'i chos la bar chad chen po zhig byang ba'i dus der dmar g.yo gtsang gsum dang / bla chen dgonges pa rab gsal sogs kyis skabs de'i nyen kha sna tshogs la ma 'dzems par bstan pa'i me ro mdo khams smad nas gso phyir dka' ba brgya phrag khyad du bsad de 'dul ba'i bstan pa rgyun 'dzin dang dar spel gnang /de nas klu mes tshul khrims shes rab sogs dbus gtsang gi mkhas pa mi bcus bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal gyi drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa zhus/ khong tshos sdom rgyun de nyid spel phyir dbus gtsang sogs su phebs te rang rang gi gnas gzhi re bzung nas der lha khang btab ste sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa slar yang dar bar mdzad rjes chen po 'jog gnang mdzad/ de rjes kla mes tshul khrims shes rab kyi slob ma ka ba bzhi'i ya gyal/rje bsdun byams pa'i sprul par grags pa zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug ni rigs rus phul du byang ba sna nam te btsan po khri srong lde btsan gyi sku zhang du song b.rā rgyud du yab sna nam jo sras dang /yum zhang lcam sgrol ma'i sras su rab byang gong gi me pho byi spyi lo 976lor nyams dga' bar 'khrungazlo/ zhang zhes pa'i mtshan thogs pa'i rgyu mtshan ni spur rgyal btsan po'i rgyal rgyud kyis bod spyi la dbang bsgyur mdzad pa'i skabs sna nam rus rgyud kyi bu mo btsan po'i btsun mor bzhes srol chags pa na bu rgyud rnams ni btsan po'i sku zhang du song bas de ltar zhang gi mtshan thob/ rje

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/'di nyid dgung lo gsum bzhes pa sa pho stag spyi lo 978lor 'dul ba'i bstan pa khams nas dbus su byung / dgung lo bco brgyad la phebs skabs ra ba zlum po zhes par klu mes las rab tu byung / de rjes dang por tshags kyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ phyis dgung lo so bdun bzhes pa chu pho byi spyi lo 1012lor rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang bzhengs/ rgyal lha khang ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i rtsa bar gyar ba gzhan las khyad du 'phags pa'i gnas chen po bzhi las dokor nor gyi khyad du 'phags pa de yin/ de yang yul de ga'i dmangs khrod ngag rgyun du rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang phyag ma btab gong zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug byang gnyan chen thang lha'i shel phub tu gtum mo me drod sgom nas sgrub pa skyon skabs thang lha'i gangs ri bzhu 'gro skad/ des na thang lha dngos su phebs nas zhang la 'dir ma bzhugs par phebs par zhu zhes gsungs nas zhu rten du g.yu'i sga srab cha tshang gcig dang seng ge'i 'o ma dkar yol gang phul bas zhang gis phebs par zhal gyis bzhes te sga srab dang bcas pa bsnams nas leb chen la mo brgyud de phebs/(leb chen la mo zhes pa deng skabs klu kha stod kyi nye 'dabs skyid ra'i nang zhes pa der yod// bltas rig zer ba'i sa cha de nas gzigs pas (sa der dmangs khrod du bltab res zer/)'phan yul stod kyi sa de dag dge mtshan khyad du 'phags par gzigs te der dgon pa phyag gdab dgos dgongs/ de nas klu kha stod du (deng skabs klo ba stod zer/)phebs skabs khur tsha'i nang gi rgelha'i sga srab la gsung mol 6

'phan yul byamasapa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/gnang ste yā sga mo nga gnyis ngal gso gsungs nas sa cha der da lta yang ya sga mo zer zhing rgyal po bla ri'i 'dabs su yod/ yud tsam bzhugs pas mnal shor/ g.yu'i srab de bya rog cig gis 'khyer bas mnal sad de thugs dgongs la bya rog mgon po'i bla bya yin pas g.yu'i srab de gang du 'khyer ba'i gnas der dgon pa bzhengs dgos dgongs nas phebs pas g.yu'i srab de da lta dgon pa yod sa'i gnas der 'khyer ba na dgon pa yang sa de rang du phyag btab par grags la/ da lta dgon pa'i srung ma rdo rje g.yu sgron ma de yang skabs der g.yu'i sga srab la sems chags te bla ma'i rjes su phebs pas bla mas bka' bsgos dam 'dogs byas skad/ zhang gis dgung lo chung dus rgya gar du 'dul ba'i bstan pa 'tshol du byon/ rdo rje gdan pa dang mjal/ rdo rje gdan pas dge tshul gnyis gzhan zhig nas khong la tshur 'dul ba nyan bcug nas de gnyis la 'dul ba bshad zer/ de lta na lo tsā ba yang mkhyen par mngon no/ rje 'di nyid kyis 'brom ston pa la dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa gnang / mtshan rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas su gsol/ jo bo rje spyan 'dren par mang yul du byon nas chos zhus pas/ lhar sangs rgyas bzung / gtso bo lta ba sbyang bya ba'i gdams pa de gsungs/gzhan yang 'dod pa bcu gsum dang / shes par bya ba'i chos brgyad/ mtshon par bya ba'i dpe bzhi/ gtan la dbab pa'i chos bzhi/ snang ba sems su gtan la dbab pa la sogs pa'i gdams pa mang du gnang / khong gis rgyal lha khang gi gdan sa yun ring 7

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/bskyangs pa ma zad klu kha stod byams pa dang / rwa ma'i byams pa yang gsar bzhengs kyis 'phan yul gyi byams pa spun gsum zhes pa'i snyan grags gangs ljongs su khyab par mdzad la 'phan yul stod kyi rgyal po bla ri'i sku pang du chags pa'i se smug dgon de yang khong gis phyag btab pa yin zhing / der rten gyi gtso bo gling gi mgon po gsung byon sogs sku rten mang du yod kyang rig gsar skabs rten dang brten pa bcas tshang ma rtsa gtor du song / rjes su rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa pho 'brug spyi lo 1988lo'i bod zla 5nas dbu tshugs te nyams gso zhus nas rten gyi gtso bo 'jem las grub pa'i gling gi mgon po gsung byon ma dang / jo bo shākya mu ne/ rje yab sras gsum/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong / spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/sman bla/ rje btsun sgrol dkar/ slob dpon mthong sgrol chen mo/zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug spyan ras gzigs kyi rdo sku rnying ma/rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur sogs sku gsung thugs kyi rten gang 'tsham bskyar bzhengs thub ste da lta btsun ma zhal grangs nyi shu lhag tsam yod pa de dag gis ri bo dge lugs pa'i chos rgyun zab mo de dag legs par skyong bzhin yod/ de ltar khong gis bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad nas mthar dgung lo gya lnga pa rab byang dang po'i lcags byi spyi lo 1060lor zhi bar gshegs/ zhadro sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gshegs pa'i lo der rgyal lha khang gi gdan sar glan tshul khrims byang chub phebs shing / rje 'di ni rab byung 8

'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/gong gi shing pho 'brag spyi lo 1004lor yul rgya ri mo can la sku 'khrungs/ dgung sgrongs nga bdun la phebs pa lcags pho byi spyi lo 1060lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo bzhi bcu zhe gnyis bskyangs/ dgung lo go dgu ba rab byang dang po'i chu pho rta spyi lo 1102lor gshegs/ 'di po to ba sdong phu chung ba'i mkhan po yin/ de rjes rgyal lha khang gi gdan rabs gsum pa 'bring ston ni me pho khyi spyi lo 1046lor 'khrungs/ dgung grangs nga bdun pa chu pho khyi spyi lo 1202lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo bcu bdun bskyangs rjes dgung lo don bzhi pa sa mo phag spyi lo 1119 lor gshegs/ gdan rabs bzhi pa rma bya rna ra ni lcags pho byi spyi lo 1060lor 'khrungs/ dgung grangs drug cu pa lcags pho byi spyi lo 1120lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo bcu bskyangs rjes dgung lo bdun cu pa sa mo bya spyi lo 1129lor gshegs/ gdan rabs lnga pa rgyal tsha byang ye ni me mo lug spyi lo 1067lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug cu re bzhi pa lcags pho khyi spyi lo 1130 lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo bcu bskyangs rjes dgung lo don gsum pa sa mo lug spyi lo 1139lor gshegs/ gdan rabs drug pa 'brom ston ni sa pho rta spyi lo 1078lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug cu re gsum lcags pho sprel spyi lo 1140lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo bzhi bskyangs rjes dgung lo drug cu re bzhi chu mo phag spyi lo 1143lor gshegs/ ('brom ston 'di nyid rwa sgreng dgon phyag 'debs mkhan 9

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byung gnas ma yin pa zhar la shes dgos//gdan rabs bdun pa dge bshes ar gyis dbyar gcig gdan sar bzhugs rjes lo dgu gdan sa stongs/ gdan rabs brgyad pa dge bshes tshul 'phags ngan lam ni lcags pho rta spyi lo 1090lor 'khrungs/dgung lo drug cu re bzhi pa chu mo bya spyi blo 1153lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo bdun bskyangs rjes dgung lo bdun cu pa sa mo yos spyi lo 1159lor gshegs/ gdan rabs dgu pa rgyal ba khyung tshang thod dmar pa ni chu mo lug spyi lo 1103lor 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug cu re gnyis pa shing pho sprel spyi lo 1164lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo bdun bskyangs rjes dgung lo don gsum pa shing mo lug spyi lo 1175lor gshegs/me sprel nas sa khyi bar lo gsum gdan sa stongs/gdan rabs bcu pa rgyal ba ye grags sa dmar ni me pho sprel spyi lo 1116lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug cu re bzhi pa sa mo phag spyi lo 1179lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo dgu bskyangs rjes dgung lo bdun cu don gnyis pa me mo lug spyi lo 1187lor gshegs/ de nas lo gcig gdan sa stongs/ gdan rabs bcu gcig pa dge bshes glan ni sa pho sprel spyi lo 1128lor sku 'khrungs/dgung lo drug cu re gnyis pa sa mo bya spyi lo 1189lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo gsum bskyangs rjes dgung lo drug cu re bzhi pa lcags mo phag spyi lo 1191lor gshegs/ gdan rabs bcu gnyis pa dge bshes dril 'dul gyis chu pho byi spyi lo 10

'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/1192lor gdan sa lo gcig bskyangs/ gdan rabs bcu gsum pa skam skam pa dge bshes skyon ston ni sa mo bya spyi lo 1129lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo drug cu re lnga pa chu mo glang spyi lo 1 193lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo brgyad bskyangs rjes dgung lo bdun cu don gnyis pa lcags pho sprel spyi lo 1200 lor gshegs/ gdan rabs bcu bzhi pa dge bshes lcang ri ba ni lcags pho 'brag spyi lo 1 160lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo zhe gnyis pa lcargos mo bya spyi lo 1200lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo bco brgyad bskyangs rjes sa pho stag spyi lo 1218lor sku gshegs/ (khong la dge bshes lcags ri ba'ang zer 'on kyang dge bshes rgya lcags ri ba dang ma nor ba dgos/) gdan rabs bco lnga pa glang ston sher seng gis sa mo yos spyi lo 1219nas shing pho sprel spyi lo 1224bar lo drug gdan sa bskyangs/ gdan rabs bcu drug pa zhang ston 'tshem pa ni shing mo bya spyi lo 1225nas me mo bya spyi lo 1237bar gdan sa lo bcu gsum bskyangs/ de rjes gdan rabs bcu bdun pa so ston gyis lo gsum gdan sa bskyangs rjes lo bco lnga gdan sa stongs/ gdan sa stongs pa'i rgyu rkyen ni sa khyi de nas lo gsum pa lcags pho byi spyi lo 1240lor hor dmag bod du lhags/ rgyal lha khang mer bsregs/ btsun pa so ston gyi thog drangs ser skya lnga brgya tsam bsad/ shangs legs byams par me brgyab kyang me ma bzhes pas hor dor rta 'gyod nas gser bre dngul bre mang po byin te lha khang gso ba'i 11

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/bkod pa byas/ lha khang bar pa zhang lhas gsos/ dar gyi lha khang gso ma thub/ bya grags lha khang gsos pa'i rten gyi gtso bo thub pa bzhengs/ rab gnas legs/ gdan rabs bco brgyad pa dge bshes zhang lha yin zhing khong ni hor dor rtas rgyal lha khang mer bsregs rjes slar yang dgon pa nyams gso zhus te mkhan po dang po gnang mkhan de yin/ gdan rabs bcu dgu pa dge bshes gnas brtan gyis chu mo glang spyi lo 1253nas me pho 'brag spyi lo 1256bar gdan sa lo bzhi bskyangs/ gdan rangs nyi shu pa glang ston seng ge 'bum gyis me mo sbrul spyi lo 1257nas sa mo yos spyi lo 1279bar gdan sa lo nyer gsum bskyangs/ gdan rabs nyer gcig pa mkhan po bar pas lcags pho 'brag spyi lo 1280nas sa pho byi spyi lo 1288bar gdarno sa lo dgu bskyangs/ gdan rabs nyer gnyis pa byang chub sems dpas sa mo glang spyi lo 1289nas me pho rta spyi lo 1306bar gdan sa lo bco brgyad bskyangs/gdan rabs nyer gsum pa kun spangs lha ri bas me mo lug spyi lo 1307 nas shing pho byi spyi lo 1324 bar gdan sa lo bco brgyad bskyangs/ gdan rabs nyer bzhi pa mkhan chen dz+nyānapradz+nyā ni shing pho rta spyi lo 1294lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo so gnyis pa shing mo glang spyi lo 1325lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo nyer bdun bskyangs rjes dgung lo nga dgu pa chu pho 'brug spyi lo 1352lor gshegs/ gdan rabs nyer lnga pa mkhan chen 12

'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/'jam dpal ye shes ni shing pho stag spyi lo 1314 lor sku 'khrungs shing dgung lo bzhi bcu pa chu mo sbrul spyi lo 1353lor gdan sa lo gcig bskyangs rjes dgung lo don bdun pa lcags pho rta spyi lo 1390lor gshegs/ gdan rabs nyer drug pa mkhan po ye shes bsod nams rgya mtsho ni lcags pho rta spyi lo 1330 lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo nyer lnga pa shing pho rta spyi lo 1 354lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo nyer drug bskyangs rjes dgung lo nga gcig pa lcags pho sprel spyi lo 1380lor gshegs/ gdan rabs nyer bdun kun spangs chen po bsod nams rgyal mtshan ni chu pho rta spyi lo 1342lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo so brgyad pa sa mo lug spyi lo 1379lor gdan sar phebs shing gdan sa lo bcu gnyis bskyangs rjes dgung lo drug cu re brgyad pa sa mo glang spyi lo 1409lor gshegs/ gdan rabs nyer brgyad pa spyan snga bsod nams grags pa ni me mo bya spyi lo 1357lor sku 'khrungs/ dgung lo so bzhi pa lcags pho rta spyi lo 1390lor gdan sar phebs shing chu mo sbrul spyi lo 1413bar gdan sa lo nyer gsum bskyangs/gdan rabs nyer dgu pa spyan snga ye shes grags pa bzang pos gdan sa lo gsum bskyangs/ gdan rabs sum cu pa spyan snga kun dga' rgyan mtshan gyis gdan sa lo bcu gsum bskyangs/gdan rabs so gcig pa spyan snga kun dga' rdo rjes gdan sa lo bcu gsum bskyangs/ gdan rabs so ga'ir/ pa spyan snga blo gros 13

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/rgyal mtshan ni chu pho rta spyi lo 1402lor sku 'khrungs shing gdan sa lo gsum bskyangs rjes chu pho 'brug spyi lo 1472 lor gshegs/gdan rabs so gsum pa spyan snga yon tan rgyal mtshan shing mo phag spyi lo 1455lor gdan sar bskos nas/ me pho sprel spyi lo 1476bar lo nyer gnyis gdan sa bskyangs/ rgyal lha khang btab nas me pho sprel bar lo 465song / de rjes gdan rabs so bzhi pa tshal ba grags pa 'od zer dang / gdan rabs so lnga pa skyid thang pa chos dpal bzang / skyid thang pa chos dpal bzang gi rjes su gdan sa 'bras spungs rgyal pa grwa tshang gi bla ma las thog su yin gyis skyong ba dang / gzhis dgon sngags grwa rgyud stod lugs lag len dang / grwa rgyun 'bras spungs blo gsal gling dang se ra smad du 'gro/ grwa grangs brgya dang nyi shu skor yod ces sde srid sangs rgyas rgya mtsho'i dga' ldan chos 'byang nang gsal/ de ltar spyi lo 1959bar mkhan rgyud gdan rarās zam mi chad par byang ngo ku(2) spyi 6 1959lo'i gong gi dgon 'di'i phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rten sogs ji tsam yod pa'i skor/(1)dge ba'i bshes gnyen zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gi sku dus nas bzhengs pa'i bya grags lha khang ngam rgyal stod dgon gyi 'du khang ka ba so drug gi sbug tu rten gyi gtso bo shar li las grub pa'i jo bo shākya mu ne/ bde gsang 'jigs gsum/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / rje 14

'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/yab sras gsum/ tshe dpag med/ jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha/gser zangs las grub pa'i ston pa a tsha ma bcas dang / bstan 'gyar lha khang ka ba gnyis kyi nang gser g.yu dngul gsum las briṅgi pa'i bstan 'gyar dang / yang mgon sku phreng rim byon gyi gsung 'bum/ rgyazlo dbang lnga pa'i 'dra sku bcas bzhugs yod/mgon khang ka ba gnyis kyi nang rten gyi gtso bo sman 'dam las grub pa'i 'jigs byed dang / mgon po/ chos rgyal/ lha mo/rnam sras sogs dang dmigs bsal srung ma rdo rje g.yu sgron gtso 'khor gsum/ yang mgon chos rgyal bcas dang / dri bzang lha khang ka ba bzhi yi nang dkyil du li las grub pa'i byams pa'i sku mi tshad ma dang / g.yas g.yon du sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ yang mgon rin po che sku gong ma'i sku phreng bco brgyad pa/dngul gyi gdung rten/ da dung shar li'i mchod rten thog so gcig tsam zhig yod pa de'i nang bskal ba'i mar me bzhugs par 'dod cing / mchod rten de'i ngos su kong cung zad cig yod pa der dad ldan rnams kyis thod pa gtug skabs nang du me 'bar ba ltar thod par tsha lham mer byed pa da lta'i rgad po rnams kyi gsung rgyun du 'dug bar thog la khyon ka ba drug yod pa las byang ngos bla ma lha khang ka ba gnyis kyi nang gser zangs las grub pa'i yang mgon sku phreng rim byon gyi 'dra sku dang / lho rgyud li ma lha khang ka ba bzhi yi nang shar li'i mchod rten chung ba brgya dang brgyad/ che ba gsum bcas dang / sum thog gi lho rgyud ka ba 15

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/bzhi yi nang rgyal dbang lnga pa'i bzhugs khri/ gser zangs las grub pa'i bde mchog gi lha drug cu re gnyis te gtso bo yab yum gnyis/ snying po rnal 'byor ma bzhi/ dpa' bo nyer bzhi/dpa' mo nyer bzhi/ sgo mtshams ma brgyad bcas bzhugs yod/byang rgyud ka ba gnyis kyi nang gsang ba 'dus pa'i dkyil 'khor gyi lha cha tshang ste rgyal ba rigs lnga yab yum/ sems ma bzhi/rgyal sras brgyad/ khro bo bcu bcas bzhugs su gsol/ de bzhin sum thog gi lhor gzim chung ka ba gnyis yod pa de'i nang gser zangs las grub pa'i rnal 'byor ma'i sku mi tshad ma gcig dang / sku chung ba mi zhung ba zhig yod pa bcas so/ bar thog dang gsum thog gi rtsa che'i sku rten de dag la lo ltar bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes 16nyin chos mjal gtong ba las rgyun du chos mjal gtong srol med/(2) byams khang la khyon ka ba bco brgyad yod cing sbug tu rten gyi gtso bo byams pa span gsum gyi ya gyal shangs legs byams pa dgung lo bcu rgonyis kyi sku tshad nyis thog can dang /gsung rab glegs bam rtsig pa bzhin du glegs shing med par thog la thug thug tu yod/ gtsang khang gi zur zhig na rgya gar gyi bzo lugs 'phrul med kyi rdo sku'i byams pa gtso 'khor gsum pa zhig yod cing byams pa'i phyi'i bzo dbyibs la bltas na rgya gar nas gdan drangs pa min nam snyam pa zhig yod na yang byams pa'i rgyab yol gyi g.yon ngos su/ mchod gnas dam pa byams 16

'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/pa'i sku gzugs 'di//yon bdag dam pa gtsang rdo dkon brtsegs kyis//gnas kyi dam par rgyal mtshan btsugs pa 'dir//'bras bu dam pa byang chub mchog thob shog/ i me ha ra na rtu/zhes gsal ba las rdo sku de ni gnas de rang du rgya bod bzo bo mkhas pa gang rung zhig gis bzhengs pa thag gis chod/ rdo sku 'di nyid da lta gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir mthong dkon pa'i rdo sku rtsa chen zhig yin zhes rigs byed mkhas pa mang pos mgrin dbyangs gcig 'gyar ngang gleng bzhin yod la/ da dung zur zhig na mchod rten bkar po zhig kyang bzhugs pa bcas so/lha khang gi sgor rdo ring gling bzhi ma mi 'greng lhag tsam zhig yod cing / de'i sked pa'i phyogs bzhir rdo rje rin chen pad ma rgya gram gyi ri mo dang / shar ngos su yi ge tshigs phreng bcu bzhi brkos yod pa ni/1 btsugs pa la/ spyir deng sang gi dus su ni/2 dge ba la phyogs gcig pa dang / legs 3 pa la gros mthun pa ni nyung na/ 'o na yang dkon 4 mchog gsum la skyabs su 'gro ba'i myi 5 rnams kyi ni/ lhar sangs rgyas bzung / gros 6 phugs chos la gtad/ gtsor lta ba sbyang / tshig 7 spyod rnal du dbab/ 'tsho ba gtsang mar sgrub da byed dgu chos dang sbyar/ spyi gros gcig tu 9 bzlum/ sgo gnyer so sor blang / ngan gros dgag 17

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/10 tu dbyung / bden gtam dang du blang / 'di ltar 11 byas nas tshe 'di dang phyi ma gnyi gar bde bar 12 'gyar byas/ tshig bcu po 'di yal 13 brjo ma bor zhing gzungs14 su bzung na legs so/rdo ring gi lho ngos su/ 'phan/yul klung skyes ngo mtshar che/ zhes yig 'bra bdun mchis/rdo ring 'di bzhengs mkhan gyi mi sna'i rmotshan dang lo rgyus kyi skor la mkhas dbang dge 'dun chos 'phel gyis ches rnying ma'i yi ge de rnams la gi gu phyir log shad che yong ba 'di la de 'dra yang mi 'dug do ring 'di bla ma'am rgyal po gang gi yin yang mi shes par snang zhing / btsugs pa la zhes pa'i rngam zil dang / sgo gnyer so sor blang / ngan gros dgag tu dbyang / sogs la bltas na rgyal po'i yin mdog kha zhing / de ltarngo na khri dar ma'i tsha bo bkra shis brtsegs dang / de'i sras mnga' bdag 'od lde sogs kyi yin srid pa zhig go zhes dang / yang bod ljongs spyi tshogs tshan rig khang gi rgan pa sangs dbang 'dus nas rdo ring 'di'i yi ge'i 'bri gzugs la dpyad na bstan pa phyi dar gyi 'gor bzhengs par 'dod cing ha lam dgon pa bzhengs pa dang dus mnyam zhes gsungs/(3) nub tu ma mo chen mo'i lha khang nang rten gyi gtso bo gser zangs las grub pa'i rje tshe 'dzin ma dang / mgon po/ chos 18

'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/rgyal/ lha mo/ rnam sras bcas kyi 'dra sku dang / gsung rten du bka' 'gyur zhig kyang bzhugs su gsol yod/(4) sgrol ma lha khang ka ba bzhi yi nang rten gyi gtso bo dzik+ṣa las grub pa'i sgrol ma gsung byon dang / shar li las grub pa'i sgrol ma nyer gcig pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi zhabs rjes/shog nag dngul bris ma'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum bcas bzhugs yod/ (5) chos khang gsar pa ka ba drug gi nang rten gyi gtso bo thub dbang gi sku thog tshad ma gtso 'khor gsum/ sman 'dam ༵/ grub pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug bcas bzhugs su gsol (6)rgyal smad lha khang ka ba bcu drug gi nang sbug tu gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa thog so nyis thog dang /shar li las grub pa'i jo bo shākya mu ne thog so gcig thogagaser zangs las grub pa'i rje yab sras gsum gyi sku 'dra mi tshad che ba tsam/ shar li las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa mi tshad ma bcas dang / mgon khang ka ba lnga yi nang gser zangs las grub pa'i mgon dkar/ mgon po gur/byang rgyud du bka' 'gyar/ lho rgyud mdzod khang ka ba lnga/ thog brtsegs gnyis par gsu shag dang gnyer tshang sogs yin/ thog brtsegs gsum par ka ba bzhi yod pa de dag gzim chung dang /19

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/lho'i mgon khang nang rgyal po sku lnga bzhugs su gsol ba bcas so//(7) na gong du gnas pa'i deng skabs na mo gong zer/thub pa lha khang ka ba bzhi yi nang rten gyi gtso bo gser zangs las grub pa'i thub pa gtso 'khor gsum dang / ldebs ris la ltung bshags cha tshang dang / gnas brtan bcu drug sgrol dkar/ srung ma g.yu sgron ma bcas bzhugs su gsol yod/ thub pa lha khang zhes pa 'di ni sngon zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gis byams pa spun gsum ma bzhengs gong byams pa spun gsum bzheng na legs nyes ji byung gi brtag pa mdzad phyir byams pa spun gsum bzhengs rgyu'i sa phud rdo phud las thub pa lha khang bzhengs skabs thub pa lha khang gi rten dang brten pa bcas pa gegs med lhun grub byung ba na byams pa spun gsum bzhengs rgyu'i thugs thag bcad gnang ba yin/ des na byams pa span gsum mjal rjes thub pa lha khang la gnas mjal nges par ༄du phebs dgos shing der ma phebs na phyu par gong ba med pa ltar yin zhes sngar nas da bar gsung rgyun du chags yod/(8)sngar rgyal lha khang gi phyogs bzhir rnam rgyal mchod rten dang byang chub mchod rten sogs mchod rten sna tshogs kyis brgyan yod pa ni shar phyogs su mchod rten bzhi dang / lho phyogs su mchod rten gnyis/ nub phyogs su ma mo chen mo'i mchod rten sogs mchod rten gsum/ byang phyogs su mchod rten gsum/ de bzhin dgon pa'i rgyal sgo'i mdun du yang mchod 20

'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/rten bzhi yis brgyan pa bcas jo bo bka' gdams pa'i dus kyi dgon pa'i nyams bzang zhig mngon par byas yod/(3) rig gnas gsar brje mjug sgril rjes dgon pa'i rten 〉nga brten pa bcas pa bskyar skrun nyams gso ji ltar zhus pa'i ra/rig gnas gsar brje zhes lo bcu'i dus zing nang bod ljongs spyi dang 'dra bar rgyal lha khang dgon 'di la yang bsam yul las 'das pa'i chag sgo sna tshogs shig byung ba ni rin thang gzhal du dka' ba'i sku gsung thugs rten sogs rig dngos grangs las 'das pa rtsa gtor du song ba dang / 'dul khrims gtsang zhing dge ba'i las la brtson pa'i btsun pa rnams rang shag tu sdod pa'i gnas dang bral ba/ de bzhin lo ngo brgya phrag mang por dkar phyogs dge ba'i las la brtson sa'i mchod khang dang tshogs khang dag ni sha khang dang 'bra khang sogs su gyar zhing dgon pa'i khyams ra ni ra lug ba glang thegs sems carno khri stong mang po'i srog gcod kyi stegs bur gyar nas thos pa tsam gyis skrag snang skye dgos pa'i dus shig mngorno sum du 'char ro 'on kyang sa skya legs bshad las/ chen po re zhig rgud gyar kyang // de la gdung ba bskyed mi dgos//zla ba re zhig gzas zisna kyang //de ma thag tu grol bar gyar// zhes gsungs pa ltar mi bzhi shog khag thal ba'i rdul du rānags rjes chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus khag rim bzhin lag bstar don 'khyol byung ste sngar gyi dgon 21

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/gnas lha khang khag bskyar sgrun nyams gso byed chog pa'i bka' khrol chog mchan phebs pa na/ rab byang bcu drug pa'i shing pho byi spyi lo 1984lor sngar yang mgosna sku phreng bcu dgu pa'i gsol dpon yin pa mi7 thub bstan skal bzang lags dang /sngar rgyal lha khang gi grwa pa yin pa ye shes chos bzang dang / ngag dbang rgya mtsho/ grags pa dpal ldan/ 'jam dpal lung rtogs/ thub bstan stobs 'byor/ tshul khrims chos 'phel bcas kyis 'gan khur gtso bzhes thog rab brtan dang / skyid tshogs/ bsod nams/ rgyal mtshan dbang 'dus/ chab ril sogs kyi kyang 'gan khur mnyam bzhes kyis rang rang gi 'khos dpag la gzhigs pa'i rgyu sbyor yon bdag gnang ste dngos thugs brgyud gsum nas mthun 'gyur rogs ram chen po gnang ba dang / de bzhin klu kha stod kyi sman pa a khu phun tshogs don 'grub lags kyis ma skul dang bas blangs te dgon pa slar gso'i ched du mi dmangs shog sgor khri gcig dang / 'bra khal brgya tham pa/ me shing spa bshags rlangs 'khor gang bcazlo zhal 'debs su phul ba dang / da dung yul phyogs gang sa nas dad ldan pa mang pos thugs che'i rgyab skyor thob pa bcas la brten nas sngar yod rgyal stod dgon pa'i 'du khang sogs gzhigs rul du gyur ba rnams nyams gso bskyar sgrun dang / sku gsung thugs rten gyi mtshon pa'i mchod pa'i rten dang yo byad rnams gang thub ci thub kyis bskyar bzhengs blu sgrub zhus nas da lta'i 22

raphan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/gzhi khyon 'di 'dra zhig tu mngon 'gyar thub pa byung / de rjes me pho stag spyi lo 1986lor se ra theg rān gling gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po seng ge lags dang / shākya lags/ dpal ldan 'bras spungs dgon gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po ngag dbang stobs bcu lags dang / mkhan po dkon mchog bstan 'dzin/ ngag dbang 'od zer sogs mdo sngags gzhung lugs kun la mkhas pa'i phud du gyur ba'i skyes chen dam pa rnams dang /de bzhin rig pa'i gnas la gsar du 'jug bzhin pa'i ser 'bras kyi slob gnyer ba sum cu lhag tsam bcas dgon 'dir dngos su zhabs bcags nas dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas par khrus gsol rab gnas rgya che gnang ba ma zad 'di yod dge 'dun rnams la dam pa'i chos kyi bdud rtsi phangs med du sbyin zhing lha khang grong tsho gtso bor gyar ba'i dad ldan mang tshogs rnams la yang skyes chen dam dro mang po'i zhal mjal gsung thos kyi skal bzang dga' ston gyi nyin mo zhig longs su spyod thub pa byang / de ltar spyi lo 1984lo nas 2008lo bar dgon parā phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rten sogs je tsam bskyar bzhengs thub yod ce na/(1) sngar zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gis thog mar phyag btab pa'i rgyal gyi gtsug lag khang ngam bya grags lha khang deng skabs rgyal stod dgon zhes brjod/gi 'du khang ka ba so drug gi sbug tu rten gyi gtso bo 'jim las grub pa'i jo bo shākya mu ne mi tshad che ba tsam dang /23

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha/ rje yab sras gsum/ thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong / de'i g.yas g.yon du byams pa dang 'jam dbyangs kyi sku chung ba re/ de bzhin gsang ba 'dus pa'i sku dang / bde mchog phyag rdor 'khor chen/ tshe dpag med bcas kyang bzhugs su gsol/mgon khang ka ba gnyis kyi nang 'jim las grub pa'i 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum/ mgon po phyag drug dam chen chos rgyal/ lha mo dmag zor ma/ rnam sras/ srung ma rdo rje g.yu sgron ma che ba gcig dang chung ba gtso 'khor gsum/ yang mgon chos rgyal gyi 'dra gzugs bcas bzhugs yod/dri bzang lha khang ka ba bzhi yi nang rten gtso 'jim las grub pa'i kun rig rnam par snang mdzad/ sman bla bde bshegs brgyad/ zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug dang yang mgon sku phreng bcu dgu ba blo bzang chos 'phel rnam rgyal gnyis kyi 'dra sku bcas bzhugs/bka' 'gyar lha khang ka ba gnyis kyi nang rten gyi gtso bo dkyil du 'jom las grub pa'i rgyal dbang lnga pa'i sku dang /bka' 'gyar cha tshang gnyis/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum brtsos dang / de bzhin sngar gyi ldebs ris rnying pa khag cig kyang da lta ma nyams par bzhugs yod la sngar byams khang sgo 'gram gyi rdo ring de yang dgon pa'i rgyal sgo'i nang gi g.yon phyogs su gnas spo zhus yod cing rdo ring de'i lo rgyus ni gong du 24

'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/gsal bar ltar ro/(2) byams khang ka ba bco brgyad nang rten gyi gtso bo 'jim las grub pa'i shangs legs rgyal ba byams pa dgung lo bcu gnyis kyi sku tshad thog so nyis thog dang / rgya gar gyi bzo lugs 'phral med rdo sku'i byams pa gtso 'khor gsum/ slob dpon gyi 'jom sku mi tshad ma/ nye ba'i sras chen brgyad/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur bcas bzhugs su gsol yod/(3) ma mo chen mo'i lha khang ka ba bzhi yi nang 'jim las grub pa'i rje tshe 'dzin ma dang / bstan 'gyur bcas bzhugs yod/(4) rgyal smad lha khang ka ba bcu drug gi nang rten gyi gtso bo 'jem las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa thog so nyis thog dang /'jim las grub pa'i ston pa dang rje yab sras gsum gyi sku mi tshad ma/ rje rin po che'i 'jim sku khru tshad ma bcu tsam dang / tshe dpag med kyi 'jim sku khru tshad ma bcu tsam/ srang ma 'phrin las rgyal po'i 'jim sku bcas bzhugs pa ma zad tshur gyi ldebs ris rnying pa khag cig kyang ma nyams par bzhugs yod/(5)thub pa lha khang ka ba bzhi yi nang 'jim las grub pa'i thub pa gtso 'khor gsum dang / spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa mi tshad ma/ slob dpon gyi sku mi tshad che ba tsam/ slob dpon gyi sku chung ba stong la nye ba/ yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum cha tshang gnyis/ srung ma g.yu sgron ma bcas bzhugs su gsol/

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/(6) deng skabs dgon pa'i phyogs bzhir sngar ltar mchod rten bzhengs thub med na yang dgon pa'i nub ngos su ma mo che mo'i mchod rten dang / byang chub mchod rten/ khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten sogs bskyar bzhengs legs sgrub thub pa ma zad mchod rten de dag gi gzungs gzhug kyang spyir na sngar gang yod pa de dag rang gnas su 'bul thub pa byung ba bcas so//sogazi/ byes/na pa'i dmigs bsal dus mchod dang cho ga phyag len da yod dgon par grwa grangs bdun cu lhag tsam yod pa de dag gis sngar gyi dgon pa'i dus mchod dang cho ga phyag len gang yod pa rnams spyir na legs par sgrub bzhin pa ni bod zla 1tshes 8nas 15bar kun rig gi sgrub mchod tshugs pa ma zad tshes 15nyin 'phan yul gyi byams pa spun gsum mjal ba'i dus bzang der mi tshogs stong tsho mang po gnas 'dir byams pa'i zhal mjal la bcar gyi yod/ bod zla 3pa'i tshes 8nas bod zla 4tshes 13bar sgrub mchod chen mo tshugs shing de'i ring mchod pa gra rgyas bshams te gsang 'dus dang / bde mchog lu i pa/'jigs byed lha bcu gsum/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/ kun rigabaka' gdams thig le bcu drug tshe dpag med/ sman bla sogs rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas cho ga rgya che sgrub bzhin yod/ bod zla 3tshes 30nyin byams pa gdan 'dren zhu/de bzhin bod zla 4tshes 13nyin kha bskong gi phyir sbyin sreg dang 26

'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/klu chog tshes 14dang 15gnyis la gar 'cham gzigs 'bul gyis dad ldan ser skya mang por bsam pa'i longs spyod gya rnam pa sgrun/ sngar tshes 15nyin dam chen chos rgyal gyi sgo nas gtor zor 'phen pa dang tshes 16nyin gos sku zhal mjal dang sku rten rig dngos rtsa chen rnams la dmigs bsal gyi mjal kha gtong ba'i dus bzang khyad par can zhig yin na'ang ding sang 2008sku rten rig dngos rnying pa re gnyis la dmigs bsal mjal kha gtong ba las gzhan rnams ming gi lhag mar gyar/ bod zla 5tshes tanas 10bar phyag rdor 'khor cherno gyi sgrub mchod tshugs/ bod zla 6pa'i tshes 4nas 20bar nyin bcu drug ring smyung gnas gtong / bod zla 6tshes 15nas dbyar gnas tshugs shing bod zla 7tshes 30nyin dbyar gnas grol te dgag dbye gtong / bod zla 9tshes 22nyin rnam sras kyi sgo nas g.yang sgrub byed/ bod zla 10tshes 25nyin kun rig dang tshes 26nyin 'jigs byed kyi cho ga gtong / sngar tshes 29nyin gdugs dkar gyi gtor chen dang bod zla 12tshes 29nyin mgon po'i gtor chen gtong / de bzhin zla re'i nya stong brgyad gsum la kun rig dang 'jigs byed kyi cho ga dang / gso sbyong gtong ba ma zad yul de ga'i dad ldan mang tshogs tsho'i shi gson gyi zhabs rim khag kyang legs par sgrub bzhin pa'o/(5)dgon pa bskyar skrun rjes kyi mkhan po rim byon gyi skor/spyi lo 1985lo nas dgon pa'i nang dngos su chos phyogs 27

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/kyi byed sgo khrag spel 'go tshugs pa nas bzungaspyi lo 2008bar mkhan rabs gsum byang ba las mkhan rabs dang po ye shes chos bzang lags ni jib byang bcu drug pa'i chu pho sprel spyi lo 1932lor rgyal gyi lha khang r+shar ma zhes pa'i khyim du yum byams pa'i sras su sku 'khrungs/ 'bras blo gling gi mkhan po ye shes sbyin pa'i drung nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhus shing mtshan ye shes chos bzang zhes gsol/ gzing ngog rin po che dbu bzhugs thog mkhan slob grangs tshang ba'i dge slong dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs te dge slong gi dngos po thob/ dus de nas bzung 1959lo'i gong bar dge slong gi sdom pa yang dag par spong zhing sgom sgrub kyi nyams len la rtse gcig tu gzhol/ de rjos rig gsar skabs btson du tshud cing srid jus lhug gtong rjes btson khang nas glod bkrol gyis thog mar 'bras spangs su bzhugs pa dang de rjes rgyal lha khang du phebs te radro byang bcu drug pa'i shing mo glang spyi lo 1985lo nas rab byang drocu bdun pa'i me pho byi spyi lo 1996bar gdan sa lo bcu staganyis bskyangs shing rjes 'dzin slob ma mang po gso skyong gnang / dgung grangs 71la phebs pa rab byung bcu bdun pa'i chu pho rta spyi lo 2002lor sku gshegs/ mkhan rabs gnyis pa bstan 'dzin 'phrin las ni rab byang 16pa'i me mo glang spyi lo 1937lor 'phan yul rgyal gyi ltarmo pa grong tsho'i dkyil shar gyi khyim du yum dkon mchog gi sras su sku 'khrungs/28

'phan yul byams pa spun gsum dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/dgung lo brgyad la phebs skabs rgyal gyi mkhan po bstan 'dzin tshul khrims kyi drung nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa bzhes shing mtshan bstan 'dzin 'phrin las zhes gsol/ dgung lo nga gnyis la phebs skabs ser dgon gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen shākya lags kyi drung nas mkhan slob grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ dang thog dbu mdzad lo gsum mdzad cing de rjes rab byang bcu bdun pa'i me mo glang spyi lo 1997lo nas rab byang rbecu bdun pa'i sa pho stag spyi lo 1998lo bar lo gnyis rgodan sa bskyangs/ dgung lo re gnyis la phebs pa sa pho stag spyi lo 1998lo'i lo mjug tu dgongs pa rdzogs/ mkhan rabs gsum pa da lta'i mkhan po las thog pa/ngag dbang lam chen ni 'phan yul rgyal lha khang shar ma'i yum dbang mo dang yab 'gyur med gnyis kyi sras su rab byang bcu drug pa'i shing mo sbrul spyi lo 1965lor sku 'khrungs shing rab byang bcu drug pa'i shing mo glang spyi lo 1985lor rgyal lha khang rdzu chos zhugs gnang ba dang /lo de rang du dge lam rim pa ngag dbang phun tshogs kyi drung nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa zhus shing mtshan ngag dbang lam chen zhes gsol/ dgung lo nyer lnga la phebs skabs mkhan po rgyal mtshan shākya'i drung du mkhan slob dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus su bsnyen par rdzogs/ dbu mdzad lo gsum gnang rjes rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa mo yos spyi lo 1999lo nas gdan sa bskyangs shing da lta'ang mu mthud skyong bzhin pa'o/29

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/rgyal lha khang dgon 'di ni thog mar zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gis 'dul ba'i bstan pa dar spel gtong sa'i gnas gzhi zhig tu gsar skrun gyis rjes 'jug slob ma mang du bskyangs gnang ba dang / de rjes jo bo rje bod du phebs te mdo sngags gnyis kyi gnad gcig tu bsdus pa skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa byang chub lam gyi sgron me mdzad pa nas bzung zhang chen po yang jo bo rje'i slob ma gtso gras su gyar te dgon pa 'di nyid bka' gdams pa'i lugs gtso bor khyod pa'i dgon pa rnying gras shig tu gyur/ de rjes spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga pa nas rim pas bka' gdams pa phal che ba dge lugs su gyur ba ltar dgon pa 'dir yang rgyal stod dge lugs dang rgyal smad sa lugs sogs lugs sna tshogs shig dar na yang rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dus nas tāshā rno/zlo gtsang ma zhig tu gyur rjes da lta'ang rgyun de ltar skyong

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang/de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/gnyig klu stod byamasapa dang de'i phyaga'adebasapa po zhang snanamardo rdzedabang phyuga'ago brjod/'phan yul byams pa spun gsum gyi ya gyal klu kha stod kyi (ding sang dmangs khrod du klo ba stod zer )byams pa ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong mtsho stod shang klu kha stod grong tshor yod cing lam bar du grub brgya dgon dang / lo tsā dgon/ rgyal lha khang sogs brgyud gnas der slebs kyi yod/ yul de ni 'phan yul nub kyi sa mtshams su chags shing 'di nas la brgyab ste song na stod lung bde chen rdzong gi sa thog tu 'byor/ 'di na rgyal ba byams pa bzhugs sa'i byams khang gi phyi'i khor yug ni ri 'dabs yangs shing rgya che la rtswa dang rtsi shing du mas brgyan pa dang / byams pa'i sku rgyab tu ri bo kha ri dang / g.yas su nya mo che/ g.yon du rgyal po bla ri/(chos rgyal khri srong lde'u btsan gyi bla ri yin/) sogs brjid che'i ri bos legs par brgyan zhing / mdun phyogs su yangs shing rgya che ba'i zhing thang gis dbyar dang ston gyi dus su sngo ljang lo legs snye ma'i 'bras bzang gi mchod pa rnams spyan legs byams pa'i mdun du bshams shing / byams pa'i spyan gyis gzigs tshod kyi sa zhing dag la sad ser gyi gnod pa med pa sogs bshad srol ngo mtshar can zhig 'dug de bzhin byams khang shar phyogs kyi mi ring 31

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/ba'i sar shar gyi bzang po ri zhes ri chen ngo mtshar mchod rten gyi gzugs su grub pa zhig yod cing ri bo de ni sngar gyi dus nas de ga'i yul mi rnams kyis so nam dus tshigs brtag pa'i gal che'i ri bo zhig tu brtsis te lo ltar so nam 'debs tshod kyi snga phyi sogs ri de'i grib gzugs la brtag nas gtan 'khel byed/de lta bu'i yul lung ngo mtshar che zhing gna' bo'i bzo skrun gyi bkod pa mi nyams par gnas pa'i byams khang dang / de'i nang bzhugs su gsol ba'i spyan legs byams pa thog so gsum ldan gyi brjid che'i sku yi zhal mjal zhu bar 'dod na sku nyid 'phan po lhun grub rdzong nas rlangs 'khor du chu tshod phyed tsam bskyod rjes gnas der bde bar 'byor/da ni kla kha stod ces pa'i ming gi byang tshul skor la cung zad dpyad na/ba klu kha zhes pa ni da lta coms kheng yod sa'i nub der klu kha chu mig ces dus bzhir 'dzad mtha' med pa'i chu mig cig yod pa de'i ming yul der thogs pas klu kha zhes dang / stod ces pa ni 'phan yul gyi lung pa 'di nyid stod smad bar gsum du phye ba'i 'phan yul stod kyi sa'i char gtogs pa na klu kha stod ces brjod par snang / 'on kyang sngar gyi yig rigs khag gcig dang dmangs khrod kyi ngag rgyun du klo ba stod dang glu dga' stod kla mkhar stod ces ming sna tshogs shig 'bri srol dang 'bod grozlo 'dug kyang yul de'i ming gi dag don ngo ma klu kha stod ces pa de yin pa yul de'i sngags pa a khu pa sangs kyi drung nas gser khang 32

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lorgyus/chos kyi rgyal po'i gsol mchod bzhugs so zhes yul de ga'i yul lha'i gsol mchod kyi dpe rnying bris ma zhig lag son byang ba de'i nang 'khod gsal du/ kye rig pa'i 'byung gnas )phan yul lung pa'i phu//lha yul dngos 'dra rgyal gyi klu kha stod//gser khang zhes bya ba'i thig le na//dpal ldan rgyal po chen po bzhugs pa'i gnas//zhes pa'i tshig der dpyad na yul der sngar nas klu kha stod ces yig thog la 'bri srol 'dug kyang phyis su lo rgyus smra ba rnams kyis yul de'i ming gi byang tshul dang 'bri stangs skor la dpyad zhib nan tan gnang zlo thub pa dang sngon dus 'grim 'grul stabs mi bde bas sa cha dngos la skyod mi thub pa sogs kyi rkyen pas klo ba stod sogs ma dag rgyun 'byams kyi ming sna tshogs shig 'bri srol byung bar snyam/ des na slad nga tshos yig thog la 'bri skabakā klu kha stodaces bris na cung zad rgyu mtshan ldan la dag par snang (1 )// byams khang 'di nyid thog mar phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus dang /ji ltar phyag btab pa'i skor/'phan yul byams pa spun gsum gyi ya gyal klu kha stod spyan legs byams pa 'di ni spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gis phyag btab pa zhig yin zhing /khong gi 'khrungs 'das dang 'brel ba'i lo rgyus khag ni rgyal lha khang dgon gyi lo rgyus gleng skabs song zin pa ltar khong ni rje btsun byams pa'i sprul par grags pas ma 'ongs pa'i 'gro ba'i 33

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/skyabs gnas su 'gyur ba'i rje btsun byams pa mgon po'i sku brnyan byin rlabs can byams pa spun gsum zhes pa zhig 'phan yul du gsar bzhengs gnang rgyu'i thugs kyi 'dun pa mngon du 'gyur phyir klu kha stod dang / rgyal lha khang / rwa ma bcas so sor nyin gcig la byams pa sku bzhengs gnang sa'i sa char thig bkod tshad len dang / byams pa bzhengs grub rjes nyin gcig la rab gnas gnang ba sogs rten 'brel dang khyad chos dmigs bsal can zhig 'dzoms pa gnang nas 'gro ba'i bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing mchog khyad par can de dag legs sgrub gnang ba na/ deng skabs bod zla dang po'i tshes 15nyin byams pa spun gsum nyin gcig la mjal thub na phan rlabs che ba'i rgyu mtshan yang de ltar lags/ da ni skabs su babs pa klu kha stod byams pa'i byams khang thog so sum thog gi phyi'i bzo dbyibs ni lha khang ser po zur brgyad khang chen gyi dbyibs dang 'dra zhing rtsig pa'i 'go mjug bar gsum rdo ril mi mgo tsam sha stag gis brtsigs te rtsig ngos 'bar 'bur du gyur bas kun gyi mthong snang la gyang gog cig tu 'char srid kyang byams khang bzhengs tshonas da bar lo dgu brgya lhag tsam song na yang khang pa'i rtsig par nyams chags phran bu tsam yang med pa de las gna' bo'i bzo skrun gyi khyad chos dmigs bsal can de mngon thub la skabs de'i bod kyi rdo bzo mkhas pa'i phul byang lag rtsal de yang byams khang de'i rtsig pa las gsal por mchang thub/ des na klu kha 34

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang /de dag giphyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/stod byams khang 'di ni da lta 'phan po'i yul 'dir sngar lo dgu brgya'i gong gi bzo skrun gyi bkod pa dag yongs su ma nyams par gnas pa'i lha khang gcig pu de rang yin pa na de'i rin thang la mthong chen dang bzo skrun gyi bkod pa dag la srang skyob legs par gnang rgyu de shin tu gal che/ de bzhin narā gi sku rten la mtshon na 'og thog ka ba gnyis kyi nang rten gyi gtso bo rgyal ba byams pa sprul sku'i cha byad can dgung lo nyer bzhi'i sku tshad dang /de'i g.yas g.yon du 'jim las grub pa'i sangs rgyas mar me mdzad/ shākya thub pa/ nye ba'i sras chen brgyad bcas kyi sku mi tshad ma dang / rtsig ldebs su bzhugs khri chung chung bzos nas der 'jem las grub pa'i shā ri'i bu dang / mong gal gyi bu/ jo bo rje/ rje tsong kha pa/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad kyi sku brnyan dang / ldebs ris su ltung bshags so lnga dang / khro bo'i sku gnyis bcas bzhugs su gsol/ de nas sku yi zhal mjal grub rjes nang skor du phebs sa'i skor lam zhig kyang yod/ thog so gsum pa zhal ras lha khang nang bla ma'i bzhugs khri byin rlabs can zhig yod pa ma zad gnas de nas gnas mjal bar byams pa'i zhal ras lham mer mjal ba'i skal bzang zhig kyang thob/byams khang 'di nyid thog mar phyag btab pa nas bzung spyi lo 1959lo'i bar bdag gnyer gtso bo rgyal lha khang dgon nas gnang zhing sku gnyer grwa pa re yang mngags gtong gis lo gcig song rjes brje len gnang gi yod/35

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/(2) rig gsar rjes byams khang bskyar bzhengs ji ltar zhus pa dang / da lta sku rten sogs ji tsam yod pa'i skor/rig gsar zhes pa'i lo bcu'i nang rgyal ba byams pa gtso bo gyar ba'i sku gsung thugs rten thams cad rtsa gtor du song na zlong stabs legs pa zhig la byams khang de nyid skabs de'i ru khag gi 'bra khang byas nas rang 'jags gnas thub tsam byung /rjes su chozlo dad rang mos kyi srid jus rim bzhin lag bstar don 'khyol byung nas rab byung bcu bdun pa'i sa pho 'brug 1988lor byams pa bskyar bzhengs kyi chog mchan thob pa brgyud/de ga'i yul mi bstan pa thugs rje dang / blo bzang chos 'dzin gnyis nas 'gan 'khur gtso bzhes thog ma dngul mi dmangs shog sgor sum stong re bsdu rub gnang ba dang / de rjes shing tshong dang / mar tshong / phyi phyogs su slong mor bskyod pa sogs thabs shes sna tshogs la brten nas mi dmangs shog sgor khri lnga lhag tsam byang ba de dag gi rmang gzhi'i steng yul mi rnams kyi thugs che'i༄ rgyab skyor 'og byams khang gi phyi'i khang pa nyams gso dang / rten gyi gtso bo 'jem las grub pa'i spyan legs byams pa thog so gsum thog can de nyid bskyar bzhengs byed thub pa ma zad ldebs ris de dag la yang byi dor legs pa mdzad de sngar gyi nyams bzang mngon par byas/ de bzhin thog so gnyis par yang 'jim las grub pa'i rje tsong kha pa dang / bka' 'gyur cha tshang gnyis/ srung ma mgon po phyag drug bcas gsar bzhengs 36

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dnganade dgagi phyaga'adebasapa po'i lorgyus/dang / thog so sum pa zhal ras lha khang nang sngar gyi bla ma'i bzhugs khri de bskyar bzhengs thog 'jim las grub pa'i rje yab sras gsum dang / 'od dpag med kyi sku chung ba gcig gser za~Xs las grub pa'i shākya thub pa'i sku brnyan bcas bzhugs su ga sdo/ rjes 2007lor lha sa'i gtsug lag khang gi sku zhabs dpal 'byor 'od zer dang / nyi ma tshe ring / blo bzang / zla ba/ye shes/ blo bzang sbyin pa/ tshe ring sogs sangs rgyas bstan pa la lhag bsam shin tu dkar ba'i dge 'dun zhal grangs bdun gyis kla kha stod kyi byams khang de nyid sngar gyi nyams bzang legs par zlongon phyir mi dmangs shog sgor khri bcu lhag tsam zhal 'debs su phul nas byams pa'i zhal ras sogs la legs bcos gnang ba ma zad byams pa'i g.yas g.yon du sangs rgyas mar me mdzad dang / shākya thub pa/ nye ba'i sras chen brgyad bcas kyi 'jim sku mi tshad ma dang / rtsig ldebs su shā ri'i bu dang /mong gal gyi bu/ jo bo rje/ rje tsong kha pa/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad bcas kyisku brnyanakhru tshad ma sogs bskyar bzhengs kyis kla kha stod kyi byams khang 'di nyid dad ldan skye bo'i yid kyi brtan rno dbang med du 'phrog pa'i gnas ngo mtshar can zhig tu bskyar sgrun zhu thub pa byung /da lta byams khang bdag gnyer dang rgyun gtan chos phyogs kyi byed sgo khag sgrub mkhan dge 'dun zhal grangs bzhi grwa gcig 37

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/yod pa de dag nas res mos kyis rgyal ba byams pa'i zhabs drung trī sku gnyer gyi phyag las 'thus tshang legs sgrub thog zla re'i nya nga //tā dang / dmigs bsal chos phyogs kyi dus chen khag la sman bla dang / sgrol chog bskang gso sogs kyi sgo nas bstan dang 'gro ba'i zhabs rim khag sgrub bzhin pa ma zad/ yul de ga'i chos dad mang tshogs kyi shi gson la sman pa'i zhabs rim khag kyang gang thub sgrub bzhin pa'o//(3) rigs lnga lha khang /da lta kla kha stod byams khang yod sa'i nub der rigs lnga lha khang zhes dro'i btsun ma'i dgon shul zhig yod cing dgon pa de ni sngar klu kha stod byams par rigs lnga thengs gsum phul yang ma bzhes pa na /deng skabs klu kha stod byams pa sprul sku'i cha byad yin don de ltar lags )rigs lnga de dag 'jog sa'i gnas kyi ched du lha khang de nyid bzhengs pa ma zad rten gyi gtso bo rgyal ba rigs lnga ste rnam par snang mdzad dang / mi bskyod pa/ rin chen 'byung ldan/ snang ba mtha' yas/ don yod grub pa bcas gsar bzhengs kyis btsun ma zhal grangs 14lhag tsam nas spyi lo 1959lo'i gong bar chos phyogs kyi byed sgo khag legs par skyong bzhin yod na'ang rig gsar skabs dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas pa rtsa /rdo kā du song ba nas bzung da bar nyams gso zhu ma thub par 38

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dnganade dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/gsum/ rwa ma byams khang dang de'i phyag 'debs pa po zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyuga'ago brjod/'phan yul byams pa spun gsum gyi ya gyal rwa ma byams pa de ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong mkhar rtse shang khongs kyi rwa ma'i nang yod cing lhun grub rdzong nas chu tshod phyed tsam bskyod na gnas der bde bar 'byor/ byams khang 'di ni rje btsun byams pa'i sprul par grags pa zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gis spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang phyag btab pa nas da bar mi lo dgu brgya lhag tsam gyi lo rgyus ldan zhing zhang chen po'i mdzad pa rnam thar ni rgyal lha khang gi skabs su song zin pa ltar ro// byams khang 'di'i phyi'i bkod pa ngo mtshar mdzes sdug ldan pa zhig yod pa ni rgyal ba byams pa'i bzhugs gnas kyi lha khang gtso bo shar lho'i mtshams su zhal gzigs pa dang / byams pa'i sku rgyab brag la bcol zhing rgyab phyogs kyi brag ri rtse lnga can de dag rgyal ba byams pa'i dbu rgyan gyi rigs lnga la bsod nams can gyi skye bo zhig gis ched du bsgrun pa lta bu'i ngo mtshar che zhing bzo bkod mdzes pa dang / lha khang gi mdun phyogs su rtswa dang rtsi shing sna tshogs kyi lo 'dab rab tu rgyas shing bya dang byi'u'i skad snyan lhang lhang du sgrog pa/ lhag par du ya mtshan skye dgos pa zhig la 39

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/byams khang nye 'dabs kyi khug cha dag la dgun dus dgu 'grim pa'i dus su yang rtswa ljang sngo thing thing du mthong rgyu yod la/byams khang gi gsham du dwangs shing gtsang ba'i rwa ma'i chu bo de dbyar dgun ston dpyid med par shang shang gi sgra dang bcas shar phyogs su rgyug 'gro ba dang / chu bo de'i thog lo sum brgya bdun cu lhag tsam gyi lo rgyus ldan pa'i mdun zam pa zhes pa zhig dang / zam pa'i lho nub mtshams su mdun chu 'khor zhes pa zhig yod pa de gnyis la sngon rgyal dbang lnga pa gnas der phebs skabs rab gnas kyi cho ga legs par gnang ba'i bka' drin las zam pa dang chu 'khor brgyab nas da bar lo de tsam phyin na yang da dung skyon med du gnas thub pa der de ga'i yul mi rnams kyis zam pa dang chu 'khor de gnyis yul de ga'i shul bzhag gi dngos po rtsa chen zhig tu rtsi bzhin 'dug la/ da dung de'i nye 'khor du lo legs 'bras bzang gis phyug pa'i zhing thang dang /phyugs rigs dkar nag 'tsho ba'i spang thang gis dus bzhir ngo mtshar che ba'i rang byang gi khyad yon ngom par byas nas skye bo'i yid la spro snang ster thezhin pa ma zad rwa ma'i phu'i sman lung sgang zhes pa'i sa der spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i nang zhi byed pa'i grub mtha' thog mar bod la dar spel gnang mkhan pha dam pa sangs rgyas sgrub pa skyon sa'i sgrub khang sman grags gnam sgo can zhes pa de mjal rgyu yod la/ sngar sgrub khang de'i nye 'gram du sman lung dgon zhes btsun ma'i dgon pa zhig yod na'ang 40

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang dedagagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/gnas der rkun ma'i 'jigs pa sogs kyis rkyen pas phyis su btsun ma'i dgon pa de nyid dgon pa steng zhes pa'i sa cha der gnas spos kyis sngar gyi chos rgyun mu mthud skyong bzhin pa la rig gsar skabs dgon pa rtsa gtor song nas da lta bar gzhig gso byed mkhan ma byang yang skabs de'i rten gtso'i gras pha dam pa sangs rgyas kyi sdo yi bzhugs khri zhig gal steng bla zur zhes pa'i khyim tshang des nyar tshags zhus yod/ da dung byams khang nas ri 'dabs su babs te gang tsam song ba'i lho ngos der sngar mdun 'go'i mchod rten zhes gzungs kyi gtso bor dge bshes sha ra ba'i phyag mdzub phul ba'i mchod rten byin rlabs can zhig yod pa de rig gsar skabs gtor skyon phog na yang spyi lo 1996lor yul mi ngag dbang chos 'phel nas 'gan khur gtso bzhes kyis rgyu sbyor yon bdag gnang ste sngar gyi gzungs gzhug lhag lus yod pa rnams kyi rmang gzhi'i thog gzungs gzhug gsar pa gang legs blu sgrub thabs 'tshol gyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po 'bras lam rim pa mchog nas gzungs gzhug gsar rnying dag la khrus gsol rab gnas kyi cho ga gang legs gnang ste slar yang rnam rgyal mchod rten byin rlabs can zhig bskyar bzhengs kyis yul de ga'i chos dad pa rnams kyi bsod nams gsog pa'i rten du 'gyar bzhin pa lags/da ni rwa ma byams khang zhos pa'i ming gi byang tshul skor la cung zad dpyad na rwa ma zhes pa'i yul ming de khyos kyi lo rgyus smra ba 41

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/'ga' zhig gis rag ma zhes ra la wa zur med par rjes 'jug ga yig 'bri ba dang / 'ga' zhig gis ra rkyang pa 'bri ba sogs 'bri tshul sna tshogs shig 'dug pa la kho bos yul der rag ma dang ra ma zhes 'bri dgos don gang yin dpyad zhib 'dri rtsad byed skabs rag ma dang ra ma zhes pa'i tha snyad der go rgyu gang yang ma rnyed pas/ yang snying tha snyad de je ltar thogs min gsal rtogs thub phyir sa cha dngos la bskyod de yul gyi phyi'i chags tshul la brtag dpyad dang / rgan rabs myong ba can rnams la bka' 'dri zhu dgos pa de ni gal 'gangs chen por mthong nas slar yang bcar 'dri dang / dpyad zhib byed skabs/ sngar spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gsum pa'i nang chos sde chen po dpal ldan 'bras spungs dgon phyag 'debs mkhan rje 'jam dbyangs chos rje bkra shis dpal ldan mchog gis sprang po mi grangs bdun lhag dang mnyam du gnas skor la phebs nas log phebs skabs sprang po de dag da lta rwa ma byams khang yod sa'i lho nub der gzhis chags su bcug pa na dus de nas bzung rwa ma'i phur 'jig rten khyim pa gzhis chags pa'i sgo tshugs pa yin zhes yul de'i rgad po rnams kyi shod rgyun du chags yod la khong tsho thog mar gzhis chags sa der da lta'ang spang lung sgang zhes brjod cing /skabs der khong tsho sdod sa'i rdo g.yam gyis thog bkab pa'i khang pa de 'dra da lta dngos su mthong rgyu yod/ rje 'jam dbyangs chos rje dang khyim gzhis de dag gi dbar phan tshun 'brel ba dam 42

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang /de dag bi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/zab yod pas rjes su yul de'i yul lha'i gsol mchod cig kyang rje 'jam dbyangs chos rjes gsar rtsom gnang ste lo rgyus kyi dus yun ring mo'i nang yul lha'i gsol kha 'gyogs skabs gsol mchod de nyid kyi sgo nas gsol kha phul gnang gi yod cing /skabs der gsol mchod kyi phyag dpe dngos su ljags klog zhu myong ba da lta dgung grangs brgyad cu lhag la phebs pa'i sngags pa a khu 'jam dbyangs 'phrin las nas gsol mchod de'i nang /bdud lung rwa ma'i gsum mdo na/ zhes ra la wa zur bris shing rjes 'jug ga yig med pa gsal por gsung rgyu 'dug kyang gsol mchod kyi phyag dpe de rig gsar skabs nyar tshags zhu ma thub par rtsa med du song / gong gsal gyi tshig rkang de'i go don dang / sa cha dngos la dpyad zhib 'dri rtsad byed skabs bdud lung zhes pa ni sngon gyi dus su yul der shing nags stug cing gcan gzan ri dwags mang bas mi gcig kher rkyang du song na 'jigs snang skye dgos pa zhig yod pas bdud lung zhes grags pa dang / gsum mdo zhes pa ni rwa ma byams khang gi mdun der sa gsum dang / gnam gsum/ chu gsum gyi mdo khel ba ste shar nas rwa ma'i mda' dang / nub nas rwa ma'i phu/ lho phyogs nas lcags phu'i nang dang gro ma lung bcas sa gsum dang gnam gsum gyi 'brel mtshams dang / de bzhin byang nas byams pa'i zhabs chu dang / nub nas rwa ma'i phu chu/ lho nas lcags phu dang gro ma gnyis kyi phu chu bcas chu gsum mnyam du 43

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/'brel sa'i gnas shig tu gyar bas gsum mdo zhes brjod par snang / gsum mdo de'i lho snub gyi mtshams su yod pa'i ri chen de ni nong bu me 'bar gyi gzugs su grub cing de'i g.yas g.yon nas gyes pa'i ri chen nar mo de gnyis srog chags kyi rwa dang 'dra bas 'dra ba rgyu mtshan du byas te yul der rwa ma zhes btags par snyam la rjes su yul ming byams khang la thogs te rwa ma byams khang zhes brjod/ 'on kyang sngon gyi lo rgyus smra ba 'ga' zhig gis lo rgyus 'bri skabs chos lugs dang 'brel ba'i tshig don dag la do snang dang gtsigs cher 'dzin pa las yul gang de'i ming gi chags tshul sogs kyi skor la dpyad zhib nan tan ma gnang par dmangs khrod kyi zer sgros tsam la gzhi bcol te rang dgar bris pas da lta'i ma dag rgyun 'byams kyi tha snyad rag ma dang ra ma zhes pa sogs 'bri srol dang / 'bod srol sna tshogs shig chags pa las de'i dag don ngo ma ni rwa ma zhes pa de yin pa gong gi rgyun mtshan de dag las shes thub bo/( 1 ) byams khang 'di'i thog ma'i gzhi khyon dang sku rten sogs kyi skor/spyi lo 1959lo'i gong du rwa ma snyan legs byams pa zhes 'jim gyi rgyal ba byams pa'i sku thog so nyis thog can gzungs gzhug tu jo bo rje'i phyag tsha phul ba zhig dang / de'i zhabs 'og tu byams pa'i khrus chu zhes chu mig ngo mtshar che ba/ byams khang ṭ+wāṃ gsham 'og tu rnam rgyal mchod rten zhig bcas mjal rgyu yod

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang/de dag gi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/pa ma zad byams khang gi nye 'gram du mtshams khang shar nub gnyis yod par rgyun du sku mtshams bzhugs mkhan yod pa dang /sngon zhang sna nam rdo rje dbang phyug gis byams pa gsar bzhengs gnang ba'i rjes lo ltar bod zla 1tshes 15nyin rwa ma byams pa dang /rgyal lha khang byams pa/ klu kha stod byams pa bcas byams pa span gsum nyin gcig la mjal thub na lo de'i gegs dang bar chod zhi zhing chos dang 'jig rten gyi bya ba gang du yang lam 'gro che ba yod ces gsung srol ltar 'phan yul stod smad bar gsum nas mi tshogs stong tsho mang po byams pa'i zhal mjal la 'byor zhing /phyi dro rwa ma'i mang tshogs rnams kyis sgor gzhas bskongs te rgyal ba byams par glu bro'i mchod pa 'bul ba/ de bzhin lo ltar bod zla 4tshes8 nyin snga dro byams khang rtso zhes mang tshogs kyis rtso 'debs pa dang / de nyin rwa ma rdzong nas ja thug ste ra ba/ phyi dro sa tsha 'khrab pa zhes yul de'i pha rgan tshos gzab mchor spras te bro gar 'khrab pa sogs dga' spro'i dpal la rol bzhin yod/byams khang 'di nyid thog mar phyag btab pa nas bzung spyi lo 1959lo'i bar bdag gnyer gtso bo rgyal lha khang dgon nas gnang zhing sku gnyer grwa pa re yang mngags gtong gis lo gcig song rjes brje len gnang gi yod/( 2 ) rig gsar rjes byams khang dang bcas pa bskyar bzhengs kyis da lta phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rten sogs ji tsam yod pa dang rgyun mchodacho ga phyag len sogs kyi skor/45

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/rig gsar skabs lo ngo dgu brgya lhag tsam gyi lo rgyus ldan pa'i gnas mchog de'i rten dang brten pa bcas pa tshang ma rtsa gtor du song ste dam pa'i chos la bar chad chen po zhig byang /rig gsar rjes 'phan po grong mkhar nas yin pa ser smardo ta dbon dge blo gros shes rab kyis byams khang 'di nyid nyams gso byed thub na ci ma rung snyam du dgongs nas bzhugs yod pa'i dus der chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus lag len don 'khyol byang ste khong gi 'dun pa bzang po mngon 'gyar byang nas rwa ma byarmis khang bskyarabazhengs bya rgyu'i thugs thagasu bcardo/ de nas yun ring ma song bar bod rab byang bcu drug pa'i shing glang spyi lo 1985lo'i bod zla1tshes2/nyin khong grong mkhar nas thon te rwa ma bkra shis steng du phebs/ tshes24nyin gnas skabs kyi sdod shag rtsig tshes30nyin 'thor bshig tu song ba'i byams khang rnying pa'i sa rdo rnams dang sa rdo gsar pa rnams la sa chog dang / gnas bdag gzhi bdag rnams la bsang gsol gser skyems sogs sbyor ba legs par byas/ bod zla2tshes2nyin las ka dngos su 'go tshugs/ skabs der ar po'i mthun rkyen shin tu zhan yang bkras steng ngag dbang rigs bzang dang mnyam du ar po'i 'go mjug bar gsum du 'bad brtson hur thag zhus pa dang / dad ldan mang tshogs kyis thugs che'i rgyab skyor 'og lo de ga'i bod zla3tshes 23nyin byams khang thog so nyis thog rten dang brten pa bcas legs par grub/46

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dag gi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/dus de nas bzung lo ltar bod zla3tshes23nyin de byams khang bskyar bzhengs legs sgrub kyi dus mchod nyin mor gtan 'khel gyis nyin der bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga'i sgo nas tshogs mchod phul ba dang / a khu sngags pas byams khang nang lha bsang gtong ba sogs chos phyogs kyi byed sgo rgya che spel gyi yod pa ma zad de'i nyin yul phyogs gang sa nas mi tshogs ha cang mang po gnas der 'dzoms te rta mgrin gyi thugs ka na yod pa'i gnam lcags kyi phur ba der zhal mjal zhu ba'i dus bzang dmigs bsal can zhig yin/ de bzhin byams khang du rgyun bzhugs grwa grangs 5yod pa de dag gis rgyun gtan gyi chos phyogs byed sgo gzhan khag dper na bod zla1tshes15la byams pa spun gsum nyin gcig la mjal ba'i dus bzang de nyid mu mthud mjug skyong dang /bod zla 4tshes15nyin rnam rgyal tshe chog dang bla ma mchod pa'i sgo nas tshogs mchod rgya che sgrub ste de ga'i mang tshogs rnams kyang gnas der 'dzoms nas tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gnang ba dang /lo ltar dga' ldan lnga mchod nas 'go 'dzugs kyis zla ba gcig ring 'bum dag sgrog dang / rgyun du nya stong brgyad gsum dang tshes bcu nyer lnga/ drug pa tshes bzhi sogs chos phyogs kyi byed sgo gal chen khag la sgrol chog dang / bla ma mchod pa/ rnam rgyal tshe chog sogs sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang ba'i sgo nas cho ga gang legs sgrub/ de bzhin spyi lo 2008lor slar yang byams khang la khyon yongs nas nyams gso zhus te da lta rgya khyon ka ba 47

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/〉zhi ru rgya bskyed thog phyi nang gang sar byi dor legs par zhus da/dgon 'dir da lta gnas kyi gtso bo byams khang dang / 'du khang /byams chung lha khang zhes khag gsum yod pa las/(1) byams khang nang rten gyi gtso bo rgyal ba byams pa'i sku thog so nyis thog mtho tshad la spyi khre drug lhag tsam byas pa zhig yod pa der phra rgyan mang pos brgyan pa ni thugs kur bsam gtan sdings nas byang ba'i ngo mtshar can gyi gter dung seng ge rang byon dang / sto dbu'i dkyil du g.yu leb mo sor gsum/de bzhin gzi dang / byu ru/ g.yu/ mu tig ga'u sogs grangs mang yod la gzungs gzhug tu skyes chen dam pa mang po'i 'phel gdung / dbu lo/ gdung tsha/ gdung rus/ phyag tsha/dzik+ṣa las grub pa'i sku/ na bza'/ rdo sku rtsa chen/ gsung rten bka' bstan mang po/ thugs rten byang chub mchod rten/ 'dzam gling gnas chen khag gi sa sna rdo sna chu sna shing sna dang / rin chen sna lnga sogs kyis gnod sbyin gang bar byas yod pa ma zad sngar gyi byams pa'i gzungs gzhug kyang mang po zhig dad ldan mang tshogs kyis 'bul lam zhus te rang 'jags phul yod pa bcas byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar bzhin pa dang / da dung byams pa'i sku yi g.yas g.yon du sku rten gzhan mang po yod pa ni gser zangs kyi thub dbang dang rje rin po che'i 'dra sku/ tshe dpag med kyi 'jim sku/ rgyal ba byams pa'i bla rdo/ ldan ka rin po che'i 48

'phan yulagyi bka' gdamasapa'i dgonapa brgyad dgade dgagi phyag 'debs pa po'i lorgyus/rten gyi gtso bo gter nas bzhes pa'i rdo yi rang 'thag sang ma'i gtso bo rgyal po sku lnga dang / tshe ring spyan lnga sogs byirno rlabs can gyi rten mang po mjal rgyu yod/(2) 'du khang ni rta ra'i thog ka zhes de sngon rwa ma rdzong gi rta 'dogs sa der deng skabs gsar sgrun zhus pa'i 'du khang ka ba drug tsam yod pa de yin zhing de'i nang dkyil du 'jim las grub pa'i jo bo rje'i sku brnyan dang / g.yas su gu ru snang srid zil gnon/ g.yon du rje tshe 'dzin ma/ de'i nye 'gram du dge blo gros shes rab kyi 'dra sku/ da dung rta mgrin gyi sku byin rlabs can thugs kur gnam lcags kyi phur ba bzhugs pa zhig dang /thugs kyi rten du byang chub mchod rten dang / rnam rgyal mchod rten/ gsung gi rten du yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur/ srung ma'i gtso bo lha mo dmag zor ma dang /a phyi chos sgron sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang po mjal rgyu yod la 'du khang gi sgo 'gram du dge blo gros shes rab kyi sku zhugs 'bul gnang sar byang chub mchod rten zhig kyang mjal rgyu yod/(2) byamasachung lhakhang ni spyi lo1985lo'i bodazla3tshes23nyin byams khang bskyar bzhengs legs grub zin rjes bod zla4tshes2nyin dpal ldan 'bras spungs dgon gyi dge ba'i bshes gnyen ngag dbang dpal bzang lags dbu bzhugs thog rab gnas kyi cho ga rgya che zhig gnang bas tshes4nyin rtol le'i brag phug ces byams khang gi nub tsam na yod pa'i brag khung de 49

las rgyal ba byams pa chung chung zhig rang byon phebs nas kun la ngo mtshar chen po byang zhing deng skabs byams chung lha khang zhes dngos su mjal rgyu g.yod/ de bzhin sngar byams khang gi 'og tu yod pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten de bskyar bzhengs thog de'i 'gram du rje btsun sgrol dkar gyi tshe sgrub mchod rten zhig kyang gsar bzhengs zhus yod pa bcas so/ //

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang /de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/gnyis pa/ 'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang / de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/gcig bka' gdams spyi'i byung ba mdo tsam brjod pa/chos log mun pas gangs ljongs sgrib pa'i dus//'od gsal nyi zlas rmongs pa sel mdzad pa/dpal ldan a ti sha dang 'brom ston sogs/bka' gdams bla ma rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/zhes mchod par brjod nas bka' gdams spyi'i byang ba mdo tsam brjod pa la/ rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul gyi byadro phyogs su gnas pa'i bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir chos kyi rgyal po chen po mes dbon rnam gsum gyi bka' drin las dam pa'i chos nyi ma shar ba ltar dar zhing 'phel nas yul de'i mi rnams kyang byang chub sems kyis rab tu dul zhing gzhan phan lhag bsam gyis phyug pa'i skal bzang dga' ston la longs su spyod pa'i dus der kha bshad chos dang lag len chos min du bstar ba'i byed spyod re 'gas rkyen byas te btsan po glang dar mas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa bsgrubs pa na bod yul spyi dang lhag par dbus gtsang gi yul 'dir re zhig dam pa'i chos la bar chad chen po zhig byung / de 51

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/ltar dam pa'i chos la bar chad kyis mi lo bdun cu lhag tsam song ba'i rjes mnga' ris chos rgyal byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang /lo chen rin chen bzang po/ mdo khams smad nas bla chen dgongs pa rab gsal sogs kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa slar yang 'phel bar byas te dge 'dun gyi sde chags par byas na yang de dag 'ga' zhig sngags la mos shing 'dul ba khyad du gsod/'ga' zhig 'dul ba la mos shing sngags la khyad du gsod pa sogs gang ltar grub mtha'i kha 'dzin gyi bshad pa dang rtsod pa tsam las mdo sngags zung 'brel gyi theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rim pa nyams su len mkhan dkon la/ lhag don skabs der rgya gar nas paṇ+ḍi tar rlom pa'i gser 'tshol ba mang po zhig bod du yong nas sngags la snyad btags te rang gzhan gnyis kur gnod pa'i chos log sna tshogs spel ba ma zad/ dge slong sham thabs sngon po can bya ba zhig byang ba des sbyor sgrol zhes pa bud med la spyod pa la sbyor ba zhes ldang / dgra la sogs pa'i sems can gsod pa la sgrol ba zhes pa'i chos log spel te bod kyi skye bo rnams rim bzhin bslus nas slar yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la bar chad chen po zhig bzos pa na lha bla ma ye shes 'od dang /lo chen rin bzang sogs kyis chos log la sun 'byin pa'i yi ge sna tshogs bkram na yang phan pa cher ma thon pas rgya gar nas chos log 'dul ba'i paṇ+ḍi ta mtshan nyid tshang zhing bod la phan thogs pa zhig gdan ma drangs na cis kyang mi 'grig snyam ste lha bla mas

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/rgya brtson 'grus seng ge la sogs pa rgya gar la mngags nas/dang thog legs sbyar gyi skad bslab/ de nas mkhas grub mang po'i zhabs la gtugs te mdo sngags gnyis kyi chos mang du bslabs shing bod la phan thogs pa'i paṇ+ḍi ta zhig gang du yod med rtsad bcad pa na de dus rgya gar na paṇ+ḍi ta mang du bzhugs yod kyang bod kyi skye bo dmu rgod can de dag gdul ba la paṇ+ḍi ta thams cad kyis gtsug tu bkur zhing bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems rlabs po che thugs la mnga' ba jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha nyid du mthong nas skyes mchog de nyid gdan 'dren pa'i thabs mang du spyad kyang spyan ma 'drongs/ des na lo tsā ba dpon slob rnams tshur log ste mnga' ris chos rgyal khu dbon rnams la de'i rgyu mtshan zhus pa na lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis jo bo rje nges par du bod la gdan drangs dgos/ gal te jo bo rje bod la gdan drangs ma thub na de'i 'og nas paṇ+ḍi ta che ba zhig gdan drangs dgos dgongs te gang sar gser 'tshol du song ba na/ gar log rgyal pos rig pas sangs rgyas bstan pa slar yang dar bar 'jigs te bka' btang nas lha bla ma ye shes 'od btson du bcug de nas lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis kho dang 'thab na sems can mang po'i srog shor bar dogs te thabs mkhas pas khu bo blu bar dgongs nas gar log tu song ba na/ gar log rgyal po na re/ 'o na khyed rang paṇ+ḍi ta gdan 'dren pa'i 'phro bshol te nga'i mnga' 'og tu zhugs/ yang na 53

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/gser rgyal po dang mnyam pa zhig 'khyer la shog de nas rgyal po btang gis zer ba la gser bskyal rgyu bdams nas gang sar gser 'tshol du song ste khu bo blu bar song yang dbu'i ljid tshad tsam ma lon pas ma btang / de nas khu bo lha bla ma ye shes 'od kyis rang nyid sangs rgyas bstan pa'i don du srog dor bar sems thag bcad de gser de dag gis rgya gar nas jo bo rje nges par gdan drangs dgos pa'i bka' mngags ltar lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis nag tsho lo tsā ba tshul khrims rgyal ba la gser gyi rdzong pa dang bcas rgya gar du jo bo rje gdan 'dren du mngags/nag tsho lo tsā ba rgya gar du 'byor rjes rgya brtson 'grus seng ge dang bka' gros legs par bgyis te jo bo rje gdan 'dren pa'i thabs bkod byas pa na re zhig jo bo'i zhal mjal dka' na yang /nyin zhig rgya gar gyi rgyal po dang paṇ+ḍi ta gzhan gyis ma 'tshor ba'i thog nas rgya brtson seng shes nag tsho lo tsā ba jo bo'i gzim khang du khrid/ gser mang du phul nas rgya brtson seng gis/ bod kyi rgyal po byang chub sems dpa' yin lugs/ bod nang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dar rgud ji ltar byang lugs/ lha bla ma khu dbon gyis jo bo spyan 'dren pa'i phyir༄ dka' ba ji ltar spyad lugs/da lta bod la chos log ji ltar dar lugs sogs zhib par zhus/ jo bo rjes bod du byon nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la phan mi phan dang / gegs dang bar chad ji tsam yong min sogs la brtag pa mdzad phyir lhag pa'i lha rnams la gsol ba 54

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dnganade dgagi phyaga'adebasapa po'i lo rgyus/thugs drags su btab pas bod du byon na phan thogs pa'i lung bstan pa ma zad/ bar chad lta bur tshe thung du lo nyi shu 'gro ba gzigs kyang / bod la phan thogs na tshe thung yang thung snyam pa zhig byang nas bod la 'gro ba thag gis bcad/ de dus rgya gar ba rnazlos kyis jo bo rje bod la phebs rgyur bkag 'gog nan tan mdzad kyang jo bos thabs mkhas kyi sgo nas bod la phebs rgyu phyi bshol ma gnang bar mthar rab byung dang po'i lcags pho 'brug spyi lo 1040lor rgya gar nas bod du chibs kha bsgyur/lcags mo sbrul spyi lo 1041lor bal yul du 'byor zhing der lo gcig bzhugs te chu bo rta spyi lo 1042lor bod du 'byor nas thog mar mang yul du phebs pa dang de rjes mtho lding gser gyi lha khang du phebs/ mtho lding du phebs rjes lha bla ma byang chub 'od dang / lo chen rin chen bzang po sogs kyis zhabs tog legs par zhus te chos mang po gsan pa dang / de nas lha bla ma byang chub 'od kyis jo bo rje la 'di ltar gsol ba ni/ byang phyogs kha ba can gyi ljongs 'dir chos rgyal mes dbon rnam gsum gyis dka' ba brgya phrag du ma spyad nas sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa ji ltar btsugs lugs/ de nas glang dar gyis bstan pa bsgrubs lugs/ de nas rang gi yab mes mnga' ris chos rgyal rnams kyis slar yang sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa btsugs kyang chos log smra ba mang pos bstan pa log lam du 'khrid tshul sogs spyan nas mchi ma 'khrug bzhin du zhib par 55
