'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/zhus te da ni jo bo thugs rje can khyed kyis bod kyi gdul bya dmu rgod can 'di rnams kyis go bde zhing lhag par rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thams cad hril gyis dril la nyams su blangs bde ba bod spyi la phan pa'i chos shig thugs rjes 'dzin par zhu zhes zhus pas/ jo bo rje shin tu dgyes nas/ dus gsum rgyal ba thams cad dag dang de yi chos//dge 'dun rnams la gus pa chen pos phyag byas te//slob ma bzang po byang chub 'od kyis bskul gyur bas//byang chub lam gyi sgron me rab tu gsal bar bya// zhes gsungs te jo bos mnga' ris gu ger mdo sngags gnyis ku'i gnas gcig tu bsdus pa'i byang chub lam gyi sgron me mdzad pa na/ jo bo'i thugs bskyed bzang po'i mthus/ ji ltar nyi ma shar ba na/'byang po'i bya rnams sgra mi grags pa ltar chos log spel mkhan gyi snyung spyod can rnams rang bzhin gyis 'joms par gyar/de ltar jo bo rje bod du byon nas mnga' ris su lo gsum/ bsnye thang du lo dgu/ dbus gtsang gzhan du lo lnga'i bar du skal ba dang ldan pa rnams la mdo sngags gnyis kyi gzhung gcig tu dril ba'i gdams ngag ma lus par bstan nas bstan pa'i srol nub pa rnams gsar du btsugs/ srol cung zad yod pa rnams 'phel bar mdzad/ log par rtog pa'i dri mas sbags pa rnams legs par gsal te bstan pa rin po che dri ma dang bral bar mdzad nas gdul bya thun mong ba'i snang ngor 56

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/dgung lo bdun cu don gsum pa shing pho rta spyi lo 1054lo'i ston zla 'bring po'i tshes bco brgyad la snye thang du sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i tshul bstan/ jo bo rje sku gshegs khar 'brom la zhal chems kyi tshul du/ khyod kyis gnas gzhi chung ngu zhig rtsigs/ nga'i bstan pa rnams khyod la gtod pas bzung zhes gsungs/ 'brom gyis jo bo'i 'das mchod legs par grub rjes jo bos skyong ba'i tshogs pa rnams phyag phyir 'khrid de stod lung la byon nas gnam gyi bye ma lung du gang tsam zhig bzhugs/ de'i tshe slob ma'i gtso bo rnams kyis gros byas te 'brom rwa sgreng du spyan 'dren pa thag gis bcad la/ 'phrang kha ber chung gis kyang yang bskyar zhu ba slebs pa na/ 'brom ston rgyal ba'i 'byang gnas kyis rab byang dang po'i me pho sprel spyi lo 1056lorjo rwa sgreng du phebs te jo bo'i zhal chems bzhin me mo bya spyi lo 1057lor bka' gdams pa'i gdan sa ang dang po rwa sgreng dgon pa phyag btab nas jo bo'i bzhed srol dri ma med pa sde snod gsum gyi snying po skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa/ theg pa gsum gyi gsung rab ma lus pa las bor rgyu rdul tsam yang med pa gang zag gcig 'tshang rgya ba'i cha rkyen du ston pa'i gdams pa mchog tu gyur ba byang chub lam gyi sgron me de nyid dar spel shin tu che ba byung bas/ dus de nas bzung bka' gdams pa zhes pa'i grub mtha' de yang bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir 57

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/dar zhing rgyas par gyar te rjes 'jug slob ma yang mang du bskyangs/ de rjes 'athrem ston pa'i slob ma dge bshes po to ba nas brgyud pa la bka' gdams gzhung pa dang / dge bshes spyan snga pa nas brgyud pa la bka' gdams gdams ngag pa zhes pa'i bzhes srol mi 'dra ba gnyis yang byang ba yin/ de ltar lha bla ma ye shes 'od sogs chos rgyal dung chub sems dpa' rnams kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa la dag ther mdzad de jo bo bka' gdams pa'i lugs kyi lam srol thog mar phye ba'i byang ba mdo tsam brjod pa re zhig rdzogs so/// sto

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/gnyig po to dgonadang de'i phyaga'adebasapa po po to ba rinachen gsaga'ago brjod/bka' gdams sku mched gsum gyi ya gyal dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'jam dbyangs po to ba rin chen gsal gyis phyag btab pa'i po to dgon de ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong gsum 'phreng shang khongs spras kyi phu'i seng ge'i nang zhes pa'i ri steng du chags shing lam bar du rje rin po che'i dngos slob nyan po shākya rgyal mtshan gyis phyag btab pa'i rin chen brag dgon dang / brag rgyab dgon sogs sngar gyi dgon gnas rnying pa khrag gcig kyang dus gcig tu mjal thub kyi yod/ po to dgon 'di chags btab nas da bar lo dgu brgya lhag tsam phyin pa'i dgon pa rnying gras shig yin la bka' gdams gzhung pa'i gdan sa thog ma de yang yin/ dgon 'di'i phyi'i khor yug ni phyogs bzhi thams cad g.yu ltar sngo ba'i spang ljongs dang / yan lag brgyad ldan gyi dwangs gtsang chu mig rgya phrag gis bskor te rnam kun nga tshos brjod pa'i lha yul mi yul du 'phos pa zhes pa de gnas der mngon sum du chags yod/ gal te sku nyid lha sa nas rlangs 'khor du bzhugs te chu tshod gcig dang byed tsam phebs na gnas der bde bar 'byor/da ni po to dgon zhes pa'i dgon pa'i ming gi thogs tshu19

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/skor la cung zad dpyad na po to zhes pa'i ming gi byang tshul la sngar gyi lo rgyus smra ba rnams kyis bshad srol mi 'jo ba gnyis 'dug pa ni las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams pa'i bka' gdams chos byang gsal ba'i sgron me yi shog grangs 428nang 'phan yul rten por byon nas bzhugs pa'i tshe po to bar grags/ zhes 'khod pa dang / dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas brtsams pa'i chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston shog grangs 711nang phyis pu tor dgon pa btab ste bzhugs pas pu to bar grags/ zhes 'khod pa na da lta dgon pa chags sa'i gnas de dang yul nyan po gnyis kyi bar la bar thag ring po zhig chod pas yang snying po to dgon zhes pa'i ming de'i thog ma'i 'byang khungs kyi thad la dpyad zhib nan tan zhig mi byed thabs medo du 'gyar/ de yang dang thog sngar gyi dag yig khag gi nang po to dang༄ / po tho/ po mtho/ spo tho zhes pa 'di dag don gcig tu go zhing / 'di dag gi go don ni rtswa yod pa'i sar rang 'bur du thon pa'i rdog rdog la go ba dang yang na sa bong ba lta bu sa rdog rdog ri'u zhes tshig 'grel zhus yod pa ma zad dge bshes chos grags kyis brtsams pa'i brda dag ming tshig gi nang po to ni ri po tho lta bu'i steng du dgon pa btab pas na po to ba zer ba dang zhes tshig 'grel zhus pa 'di dag dang / kho bos po to dgon pa chags sa'i sa cha dngos la brtag dpyad byas par gzhigs na/ po to dgon 'di ni ri ha cang mtho bo zhig gi ngos 60

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/su spang ljongs yangs shing rgya che ba zhig yod pa de'i lho ngos su sa 'bur mchod rten chen po'i zhabs ra lta bu zhig gi steng du dgon pa phyag btab yod pa na gnas de ni dag yig khag gi nang 'grel zhus pa dang khyad chos gcig mtshungs su 'dug pas po to'am sa 'bur de rang gi ming dgon par thogs te po to dgon dang /dgon pa'i ming bla mar thogs te dge bshes po to ba zhes brjod par snang yang / las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis 'phan yul nyan por byon nas bzhugs pa'i tshe po to bar grags zhes pa de la rgyu mtshan zhig med dam snyam nas kho bos ched mngags 'phan yul nyan por skyod de sa cha dngos la brtag zhib 'dri rtsad byed skabs yul der spo dang 'brel ba yod pa'i sa ming gnyis 'dug pa ni dang po spo bo brag dmar yul skad du spo bo bag dmar zer/zhes slob dpon pad mas bka' bskos dam 'dogs gnang pa'i yul de ga'i yul lha bzhugs sa'i ri zhig 'dug pa dang ri de'i rtse mor yang spo bo'i rtse zhes brjod/ gnyis pa ri de'i 'dabs su sngar spo rags zhes pa'i khyim tshang zhig yod cing khyim de'i nye 'gram du byams khang zhig yod pa de'i sku gnyer zhabs zhu sogs khong tshos byed srol dang khyim rgyud 'di'i mi rnams tshe tshad shin tu ring bas da bar lo brgya dang bcu yan lon pa'i mi thog gnyis byang zin cing da lta 'tsho bzhugs kyi mi thog gsum pa de yang dogung lo 87 la phebs yod/ kho bos da dung yul de ga'i rgad po myong ba can 'ga' zhig btsal nas dge bshes po to ba gnas 61

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/'dir phebs myong min gyi lo rgyus de 'dra mkhyen rtogs yod min bka' 'dri zhu skabs khong tsho tshang mas dge bshes po to ba nyan por phebs pa'i skor gyi lo rgyus shig da bar go thos yong ma myong zhes gsung gi 'dug la/ yul lha bzhugs sa'i ri der spo bo brag dmar zhes brjod dgos don ni yul lha de'i gzugs brnyan rgad po lo na shin du bgres pa zhig yod pas spo bo zhes brjod pa dang / brag dmar ni yul lha gnas sa'i ri de kha dog dmar por 'dug pas brag dmar zhes brjod par snang / de bzhin spo rags zhes pa'i khyim de yang spo bo brag dmar gyi ri 'dabs su rags skong pa ltar chags pas spo rags zhes brjod pa las po to dgon zhes pa'i po to dang 'brel ba gang yang med pa gsal shes thub par brten kho bos sa cha dngos la dpyad zhib byas pa'i 'bras bu dang / yi ge'i dag don gang du bsam kyang po to zhes pa ni dgon pa phyag btab sa'i ri chung ngam sa rdog de rang la brjod pa dpang po 'phel nges su 'dug kyang slad bod kyi lo rgyus smra ba rnams kyis mu mthud dpyad zhib dang 'brel chos byang mkhas pa'i dga' ston sogs su po yi tshab tu pu zhes zhabazlo kyu bris pa de yang rtsom pa pos pu to zhes kha skad rang sor bzhag pa'am yang na yig par skabs nor ba gang yin dpyad dgos par 'dug go(1) dgon pa 'di thog mar phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus dang ji ltar phyag btab nas dar rgud ji byung gi skor/62

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyaga'adebasapa po'i lorgyus/rgyal ba'i gdung 'tshob bshes gnyen po to ba/ zhes bsngags pa gangs ri'i khrod 'dir rgyal ba'i bstan pa spel ba'i slad du bsam bzhin du byon pa'i sprul pa'i skyes mchog dka' thub kyi ri sul du drang srong gi spyod tshul gyis gnas nas bstan pa'i bdag po mdzad pa dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba ni/ 'phan yul spras ba'o thang du (spras ba'o thang zhes pa'i sa de ni deng skabs gsum 'phreng shang khongs rwa ma grong tsho'i phu der yod cing de ga'i yul mi rnams kyis ba'u thang zhes brjod la rwa ma grong nas chu tshod phyed tsam rkang thang du skyod na gnas der 'byor/ gnas 'di nas gyang ro dang rtsig gdan sogs sngar gyi yul grong chags yul dang / dge bshes po to ba 'khrungs sa gsal por ngos zin thub cing gyang ro dang jig gdan de rnams la nye 'khor yul mi rnams kyis ba'u gyang gog ces brjod kyi yod/ dge bshes po to ba 'khrungs sa'i gnas ba'o thang zhes pa 'di'i sa'i chags dbyibs ni rgyab kyi ri tshogs brjid nyams che la mdun gyi spang ljongs yang shing rgya che ba sogs gnas kyi chags dbyibs ngo mtshar can zhig tu 'dugade yang rang cag 'phan yul gyi skad cha'i nang ya btags dang ra btags chad pa mi nyung ba zhig yod pa de yongs grags ltar 'dir yang ba'o thang zhes ra btags chad pa yin zhing de'i dag don ngo ma ni bra'o thang zhes 'bri dgos par snang /)yab sku gshen srid la phyug ste srin po zhes grags pa dang / yum rigs rnam par dag pa le mo zhes grags pa gnyis kyi sras su rab byang dang po'i me mo yos spyi lo 1027lor sku 'khrungs/ gdung /nyos/ byis pa'i dus nas byams snying rje byang chub kyi sems rlabs po che rang 'khrungs su byung ste 'gro ba gzhan sdug bsngal pa gzigs na gting nas mi dga' zhing 'di'i sdug bsngal 'di thabs gang gis sel bar nus snyam pa dang / gzhan bde bar gzigs na thugs dga' zhing 'di'i bde ba 'di nam yang mi nyams par gong 'phel du song na snyam pa zhig yod/ yab de bon yin pas 63

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/khong gis kyang byis pa'i dus bon chog 'dra mdzad pas bon gyi cho ga 'di dkon mchog gsum las phyi rol du gyar ba 'di 'dra ci la rung zhes thugs ma mnyes pa'i bka' yang pastsal/ de tsa na sgom chen zhig shi ba'i spur sbyangs pas 'ja' dang 'od la sogs pa byang /de yab la dris pas sgom chen zhig grongs pa yin zer pas rngos kyang bslab na sgom chen zhig 'ong snyam pa byang gsungs/ yab la bla mchod sba sgom zhes pa gang zag khyardo par can zhig yod/de las byis pa'i dus su bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa blangs nas sang bsrung de ring chang btung pas bad kun la phog nas skyugs/yab kyis khams ngan par 'dug pas de ring ma srungs/ nya stong brgyad gsum bya ba yin pas sang srungs byas pas/ yab ci dga' dga' zer dus nam yin pa na srung ba yin/ khams bzang na bsrung la/ khams ngan na ma bsrung pas ga na 'ong gsungs/ de la sba sgom mnyes nas/ gnyen po dang ldan pa zhig 'ong ba 'dug rab tu byung la chos shig byed du zhugs dgos zhes pha ma gnyis la yang yang bskul zhing gzhon nu rang nyid kyang sngon goms pa'i bag chags mthug po'i mthus spyir 'khor ba'i gnas thams cad yid brtan mi rung ba sdug bsngal gyi rang bzhin can du rig cing / khyad par khyim gyi gnas ni nyon mongs dang nyes par spyod pa'i 'byung gnas sdug bsngal gyi rtsa ba btson ra lta bur gzigs nas rab tu byung bar 'dod pa'i 'dun pa drag pos bskul zhing pha ma gnyis kyis kyang gnang ste 64

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dgade dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/yer pa ba rngog byang chub 'byang gnas kyis mkhan po dang / glan tshul byang la slob dpon zhus nas rab tu byang / tshan rin chen gsal zhes gsol/ bdag nyid chen po zlodi gzhon nu'i dus su jo bo rje yang bzhugs pas dge bshes ston pa byang du gser 'tshol du bzhud pa'i shul du nag tshos lo tsā byas nas yer bar jo bo'i drung nas sgom rim bar pa gcig gsan pa la skad ni ma shes/ ban gsar du song bas brda gzhan med paṇ+ḍi ta la bzla rgyu mang po 'ong bar 'dug pa la lo tsā ba la cung zad las mi 'ong bar snang gsungs / brag rgyab tu gnyer gcig mdzad pa la go shin tu chod pa cig mdzad de/ mdo mang gcig gi phyag len yang mdzad/ de'i bar la dge 'dun spyi las lhag pa zho bshal gcig las 'thung ma myong gsungs/ brag rgyab dpon ra zhag shākya rin chen na re/ ra ba zlum po la sogs pa'i gnyer byed dgos zer ba la skyo shas chen po mnga' bas mi byed gsungs nas don med pa'i bya ba thams cad spangs te rab tu byang ba'i bya ba gtso bo klog pa thos bsam dang / spong ba bsam 8tan la khor yug tu brtson par mdzad/ de nas dben pa'i gnas shig tu rtse gcig tu sgom par bzhed nas yab kyi mchod gnas rang nyid kyis bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa zhus pa'i slob dpon sba sgom la gros zhus pas/ sba sgom gyis khyod sgrub pa gsha' ma zhig bya 'dod na byang rwa sgreng na jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i man ngag yongs su rdzogs par mnga' ba 'brom ston pa zhes bya ba bzhugs pas 65

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/de'i zhabs drung du phyin nas man ngag rnams zhus na legs zhes bskul ba ltar rang nyid kyang dad gus chen pos de ltar bya bar 'dod nas rwa sgreng du dge bshes ston pa'i spyan sngar phyin la dbyar dgun gcig tsam bsdad/ gdams ngag zhus nas khams su phyin te ming rus tshun chad spos la sgom zhig bya snyam nas cang ston dang 'grogs te rgyal gyi glan tshul byang dge tshul gyi slob dpon yin pas phyag 'tshal du byon/ de nas rwa sgreng du byon pa la brag rgyab dpon gyis dge bshes ston pa la khyed kyi spyan sngar nga'i mi zhig thal gyi/ de gzhan du ma gtong zhig zer ba'i 'phrin yig slebs/ 'brom rin po ches rang gi sras kyi thu bo bstan pa'i bdag por 'gyar bar gzigs nas spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar bskyangs shing / rlom gyi rim pa'i dbu bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas thar chags su gdams shing dmigs skor re re nas bshad chos tsam du ma lus par rgyud la skor te myong ba thon nges su 'khrid par mdzad pas dge ba'i bshes gnyen ston pa rin po che'i yon tan dang / ji ltar gsungs pa'i lam gyi gnas rnams la yid ches kyi dad pa brtan po skyes shing khyad par du spyod 'jug gi bdag ni 'gro ba don gnyer la//rnyed dang bkur stis 'ching mi dgos//zhes pa la brten pa'i man ngag gsung pa'i thad kur thugs sna 'gyar te tshe 'di'i rtog pa bskyur/ de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyer+sha po to bas 'brom rin po che thog mar mjal ba nas mthar nam gshegs bar du skad cig kyang 'bral 66

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyugam phod par bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten/'brom gyis kyang sras kyi thu bor bzung nas nga'i jo bo chen po zhes mnyes mnyes mdzad/ mthar 'brom rin po che mya ngan las 'das khar khong la dwa ma ma bzhugs na su la brten zhus pas/bod phu thung tsam 'di la khyod kyi dge bshes ngas ma mthong gi dge bshes mdo sde la gyis gsungs/ dge bshes ston pa mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus su zang zing gi bgo skal ni ci yang med/thugs dam du dge bshes ston pa'i rag sha'i phreng ba nyi shu rtsa gcig dang / phyag 'khar gnyal du spyan drangs pa de gnyis yod gsungs/ de ltar rang rgyud smin te dgung lo lnga bcu nga lnga nas gzhan don gyi tshogs bsdus pa'i dang po sgro lag dgon pa yin par gsal te/ dge bshes dol pas sgro lag tu mjal tsa na tshogs nas lo ngo gsum song zhing / grwa ba sum cu tsam 'dug gsungs/ de nas khrab 'dzab khung mig tu dbyar thog gnyis bzhugs nas lam sgron dang / yon tan mtha' yas par bstod pa dang / bshes pa'i springs yig gsungs pas grwa ba brgya tsam 'dus/ dgun rgyal gyi gangs rgyal mor bslab btus gsungs/grwa pa sum brgya tsam 'dus/ de nas po to ba dar yul ku ru na bzhugs pa'i tshe khong gi yab spyan sngar byung ste phyag btsal nas/phyi mar thugs la gdags par zhu/ gos dug 'di kun dge bsnyen gyis bgor btub bam/ glang gcig yod pa grwa ba'i khal gyis zer nas bzhud/ dge bshes po to ba'i zhal 67

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/nas/ a na pha rgan de ltos dang gsungs nas bltas pas mal na 'das nas 'dug de nas yun ring ma song ba bod rab byang dang po spyi lo 1085g.yas g.yon du po to dgon pa phyag ba)ba nas rjes 'jug slob ma mang po gso skyong gis grwa ba mang dus nyis stong brgyad brgya lhag tsam byang ba'i lo rgyus kyang yod/ de rjes dgung lo drug cu re gcig snol spras kyi po to dgon pa na bzhugs pa'i dus su 'phan yul stod du sde rtsod chen po zhig byang bas sa phug pa'i jo bo mang po dang / rgyal nas bros pa mang po ༄byang / de thams cad la dgun 'di ji ltar btub btub gyis shog dbyar nas spras su bsdad kyi gsungs/ phyis stag lung du chos nyan pa dge 'dun rnams la gser zho phyed byed gnang bas gser sung brgyad cu tsam song / grwa ba stong dang sum brgya tsam bzhugs par gsal/ gzhu mkhan brag dang dbyar sa dgun sa mdzad de gnyis kur bzhugs/ de nas dge bshes sbrags pa zhes grags par byung / sbrags su mi dga' ba cung zad byung nas mkhar thog tu bzhugs pas dge bshes mkhar thog pa zhes zer/ ram sdings ma ba la khyed ma 'dzem nas yid chad mi dgos nga gnas brten bcu drug gi gcig yin pas nga dang mjal ba khyod bsod nams mi chung gsungs/ de la dge bshes po to ba chen po de gnas brtan yan lag 'byung gi sprul par grags shing grags pa ltar du rang nyid kyis kyang zhal gyis bzhes/ khong gis 'brom rin po che kho na la bsten nas byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i 'go 68

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dgadodagagaphyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/bshes gnyen bsten tshul nas 'bras bu mi slob zung 'jug 'grub pa'i bar dmigs skor re re nas myong ba phul phyin pa bton te bskyangs pas skyes bu chung 'bring gi lam la sbyangs pa'i 'bras bu tshe 'di'i lus longs spyod bsnyen bkur snyan grags 'khor g.yog sogs gang la'ang ma chags par ri dwags rmas ma bzhin du dben pa nas dben par 'pho bar mdzad/ lan cig sbyin bdag cig gis g.yu gru dmar chen po zhig phul ba na phyag tu ma bzhes par mdun du zhogs zhes pa'i brda mdzad/ bsngo ba legs par gnang / sang nyin dge bshes dpon slob rnams phyogs gzhan zhig tu phebs pa na sbyin bdag de yid ma ches par bzhugs sar bltar phyin pas g.yu de mdangs gang bzhag sa de kha rang na 'dug zer/ dge bshes po to ba dang de'i 'khor thams cad kyang zang zing gi dngos po gang la yang mi chags par tshe blos btang sha stag byang ste rnam par thar ba de tsam yang bstan pa rin po che'i rgyan du cho'o/ dge bshes po to ba chen po de la tshe blos gtong gi grwa ba rnam grol sgrub pa sha stag stong tsam re 'khor du 'dus shing / thams cad sdom gsum gyi bcas mtshams dag pa bstan pa yongs rdzogs kyi nyams len la gcig tu gzhol ba/ sgo gsum gyi spyod pa thams cad dge bshes po to ba nyid kyi rjes su slob pa sha stag byung bas 'dzam bu'i gling gi sa'i cha thams cad du snyan pa'i grags pa khyab ste rgya gar 'phags pa'i yul du'ang bod na rab tu byung ba stong tsam rnam thar gcig la 'god 69

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/nus pa'i sems dpa' chen po zhig bzhugs yod 'dug ces grags pa byang / dge bshes po to ba de 'brom rin po che la gsang sngargos kyi man ngag rnams mthil phyin par zhus nas bla med kyi lam rim gnyis kyi nyams len mthar phyin par mdzad pa zhig yin yang gsang sngags shin tu gsang bar mdzad nas rgyun gyi dam tshig gi rdor dril nye gnas kyis kyang zhing gshegs nas ma gtogs ma mthong / gsang sngags kyi bzlas brjod mthar phyin pas chos srung rnams kyang bran du khol ba zhig ste 'ol pa ston chung gis dpal lha mo sbal pas dge bshes mkhar pu ba 'das/'khor rjes na 'dug pa la yang gnod pas dge bshes po to bas dpal lha mo la 'di ltar bka' bkyon te/ khyod sangs rgyas la chos dngos su nyan pas kyang 'di ltar byed na/ nged lung la brten pas ji ltar byed gsungs bas/ nub gcig mnal lam na bu mo gzhon nu ma gcig gis g.yag rgod gnyis gnya' bcag nas ded song / pha tshad song ba dang thams cad nam mkha' la 'phur nas song ba zhig rmis/ de nas phyis gnod pa ye ma byang gsungs/ dge bshes po to ba chen po'i sku'i rnam pa ni gasdong dkyus thung nge ba/ zhal dkyil dkar la dmar ba'i mdangs chags pa/ spyan rtsa hur re mdzad pa zhig bzhugs/ chos gsung dus hur bton nas gsung bas dang po phyam tshe zhus/ de nas bla gos kyang sked pa tsam du zhus 'gro ba/ thugs shes rab shin tu che bas tshig bzhi pa re la yang 'di'i cha nas 'di ltar 70

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dnganade dgagaphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyuga'agro 'di'i cha nas 'di ltar 'gro zhes don mi 'dra bcu bcu tsam 'chad pa zhig yod par gsungs/ dge bshes po to bas lam rim 'chad pa'i tshe lam sgron rtsa bar byas nas/ bka' gdams gzhung drug dang / rin chen phreng ba/ slob springs/ bshes springs/ka ma la shi la'i sgom rim rnams dang sbyar te mtha' chod par mdzad/gzhan yang jo bo'i bden gnyis la sogs pa po ti la byang bshad mdzad pas slob dpon pas chos 'di tsam su las /slabs pa lags zhus pas/ slob dpon prarnyo la bslabs pa yin gsungs/bka' gdams zer ba'i sgra bo che de yang dge bshes po to ba chen po'i dus su grags pa yin/ rnam thar gtsang ma dang / khyab gdal che ba'ang de dus byang ba yin gsungs/ shin tu gting zab pas nga la yon tan nya'adi yod mi gsung yang byang chub kyi thugs mnga' ba/ yi dam gyi zhal gzigs pa/ mngon par shes pa rgya chen po dang ldan pa zhig go de nas shing mo bya'i lo dbyar zla 'bring po'i nya la dbyar gnas mdzad nas/ tshes bcu bdun la slob ma la springs pa'i dbu btsugs/ nyi shu gsum gyi nyin rgas pa'i sdug bsngal yan chad thon/ ka ba li zhal bsdams nas khyed cag nga la dge bshes shig re ste da lta ming las med pa 'ong ba na mtshan nyid dang ldan pa zhig 'grub bya/ 'u cag rnams gtor ma chen po zhig bshams la mna' tho zhig gcad dgos/ da phyin chad sdug tu 'jug mkhan tshe 'di'i rnam rtog yin pas/ de mi bor ri/ sangs rgyas bstan pa 'ur byid du gtong ba'i bya rog 71

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/dang 'ug pa byed ri byas la mna' skyol gsungs nas/ spyan chab sgor sgor mdzad cing stan las bzhengs te nang du gshegs so/de'i nub mo nas cung zad bsnyung / sang dro'i dus su chos ston thon nas jo rin nga yang 'gro bar 'dug ste ma sngas ran pa yin/'gyod pa med par 'gro gsungs nas gzim khang du phebs so/de'i nyin par chos ma gsungs/ mtshan mo cang ston la sogs pa snyan g.yog pa rnams la nga gnyid bzi ba 'dra ba zhig la phyogs bcu'i nam mkha' gang ba'i sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad mthong nas/ de dag la gsol ba btab pa'i snang ba zhig byang gsungs de'i dus su grwa ba rnams kyis sku rim byed pa'i khras bsdus pa na/ theg pa chen po'i bla ma'i rim 'gro byed pa la bre sung krog grog byed pas ci yang mi phan/ dug hrul gyon nas sa skyor la phar mnyes tshur mnyes byed pa zhig dgos pa yin gsungs/ nyi shu dgu'i dgong mo bgres pa rnams zhal mjal du 'ong bas/ mar me mdun du khyer la shog gsungs nas kho thag chod par ltar gnang ste da sangs gsungs/de nas cung zad lon pa na zhabs 'bring nang 'khor ba dag dang /mchod gnas rnams spyan sngar byon pa la/ khyed rnams kyis dge ba'i bshes gnyen mnyes par byas te/ spyan dang ldan pa'i jo bo a ti sha'i zhal nas/ bla ma'i zhabs tog byas pa don chung ba ma yin/ don chung ba ma yin gsungs pas/ nga'i tshig la yid ches par gyis/ khyed rnams la las nga'i mig gi dod byas/ la 72

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagyiphyaga'adebasapa po'i lorgyus/las lag pa'i dod byas te don che ba yin gsungs/ gnam stong nyin cang ston dkon mchog 'bar gyis tshogs pa la zhal gcig ston par zhu/ grwa pa rnams de sngar bkag pas bdag cag la 'bar zhing bdog lags zhus pas/ rgan po 'chi kha ma cig la bltas pa la dgos pa cang yod dam gsungs/ nan gyis zhus pas 'o na khri rtsigs mchod pa bzang po shoms shig gsungs/grwa ba rnams kyis de ltar byas pa'i tshe dge bshes po to ba chen po khri la byon te chos shig gnang nas phyag thal mo sbyar te sems can skyabs med pa rnams kyi skyabs/ mgon med pa rnams kyi mgon/de bzhin du gnas dang / gling dang / dpung gnyen dang / 'khra sa med pa rnams kyi 'khra sar gyar cig gsungs nas/ thal mo phyi la shig gis song ste sku'i bkodo pa bsdu bar brtsams/ de ltar dge bshes po to ba de nyid bstan 'gro'i don mdzad nas dgung lo bdun cu don dgu la phebs pa rab byang gnyis pa'i shing mo bya spyi lo 1105lo'i dbyar zla 'bring po'i༄ gnam stong gi snga dro po to dgon du zhi bar gshegs/ de nas gnam stong gi mtshan mo sku gdung khyams su spyan drangs nas srod dang / gung dang / tho rings gsum du g.yor gtsang dang / chu 'khris pa dang / 'phan yul ba gsum gyis mchod pa rgya chen po mdzad/ tshes gcig la g.yor ston chos 'bar dang / gtsang pa rje btsun ye rgyal dang / chu 'khris pa ston pa dbang gzhon dang / zhang btsun shes rab rgya mtsho dang / stod lung pa ston pa rgyal po dang / 'phan yul ba 73

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/ston pa shākya gzhon rnams kyis gdung gnyer mdzad nas spur sbyangs pa'i tshe/ spur khang gi phyogs bzhir rin po che'i mchod rten bzhi byang ba dang / dkar phyogs kyi lha rnams kyis phyag dang mchos pa byas shing / phyag 'tshal lo zhes pa'i sgra mi rnams kyis kyang thos pa byung / las tshan gsum dang / brag rgyab pas phyogs bzhi nas mchod pa phul/ thugs ljags ring bsrel la sogs pa'i rten ngo mtshar can mang du byon/ tshes gnyis la gdung cha lngar bgos/ tshes gsum la na bza' bgos/ dbyar grwa ba rnams der bzhugs nas spur sbyangs pa'i sar mchod rten bzhengs te dgag dbye thog nas so sor byon/ gdung khang du dngul gyi mchod rten byed pa dge bshes phu chung bas gsan nas/gdung rten dngul las byas na dngul mi ngan gyis 'khyer nas nga'i grogs po'i sku gdung grog nang du spur nge 'ong dogs yod dgongs nas jo bo tshul bsod la 'dir shog gyis gsungs bas/tshul bsod 'byon du ma gnang / phyis rab gnas la phu chung ba spyan drangs pa'i dus su zhal nas dngul ma byas na legs pa yin te/da byas kyi rting la rab gnas la bab pas dbyar do bo dgon par sdod pa'i lam zhor la bya ya/ 'khor lo yan chad rgyan yin pas ma tshar yang btub/ bre man chad tshar bar gyis gsungs nas tshur lam gdung rten gyi rab gnas mdzad/ dge bshes po to bas bstan pa'i bya ba rgya chen po mdzad pas spyir gdul bya bgrang las 'das shing / dus gcig tu 'dus pa la'ang las dang skal bar 74

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dag gi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/ldan pa'i grwa ba nyis stong brgyad brgya lhag tsam 'dus pa'i nang nas bka' bab kyi bu chen brgyad du grags pa ni dge bshes pho brang sdings pa/ dge bshes dol pa chen po/ dge bshes glang ri thang pa/ dge bshes sha ra ba/ dge bshes ram sdings ma/dge bshes dri'u lhas pa ye shes rgyal mtshan/ dge bshes brag dkar ba/ dge bshes gnyal ba chos 'bar bcas so/ dge bshes po to ba sku gshegs rjes khong gi slob ma mang che ba sha ra ba'i rjes su 'brangs pa dang / la la zhig rang rang gi gnas gzhi bzung ste bka' gdams pa'i bstan pa dar spel gnang / la la zhig sgom sgrub nyams len kho na la zhugs/ la la zhig po to dgon du bzhugs te bstan pa mu mthud 'dzin skyong spel gsum gnang ste lo 135 tsam song ba rab byung bzhi pa'i lcags pho phag spyi lo 1240la hor gyi dmag dpung 'phan yul du slebs te bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa mang che bar gtor skyon phog pa ltar dgon pa 'di yang de'i dus su 'thor bshig tu song /rjes su dgon gnas 'di nyid slar gso byed skabs btsun ma'i dgon pa zhig tu 'gyur nas bla rabs kyang nges pa ma rnyed/phyis su rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dus nas ri bo dge lugs pa'i phyag bzhes gtsang mar mdzad de thog mar rtse rnam rgyal grwa tshang gi khongs yin pa la rjes su 'phan po thang sag dga' ldan chos 'khor dgon gyis dgon bdag gnang ste dgon pa'i phyag dpe slob khrid dang cho ga gtso skyong sogs kyi bla ma zhig kyang dga' ldan 75

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/chos 'khor dgon nas gtong srol yod pa ltar thog mar lha sa ba rgyal mtshan legs pa dang / ra sha blo bzang dar rgyas/ mnyes thang blo bzang 'jam dbyangs/ pa ri mdo sde rgya mtsho/ lha sa phun tshogs chos ldan/ rdo ba nam mkha' bzang po/ dngos grub rgya mtsho sogs mi nyung ba zhig byang ba dang / de rjes spyi lo 1959lo'i gong gi bla ma las tho| pa bstan dar lags zhu ba de yin zhing skabs der dgon par btsun ma 90lhag tsam yod pa de dag rgyun bzhugs thog dgon pa'i cho ga phyag len khag gang legs skyong bzhin pa ni rje bla ma'i bka' rtsom mi 'khrugs lha sku'i cho ga dang / spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa'i las byang gi sgo nas bsgrub mchod dang gshin chog sogs gtong ba ma zad bod zla 1tshes 10nas 16bar smon lam tshogs pa dang / bod zla 3tshes 30 nas bod zla 4tshes 16bar smyung gnas dkar po cha brgyad / drug pa tshes bzhi dang / dgu pa lha babs dus chen/dga' ldan lnga mchod bcas la yang smyung gnas kyi cho gabod zla 12tshes 2nas tshes 16bar ma ṇi'i cho ga dang ma ṇi 'bum sgrub/ da dung zla re'i nya stong brgyad gsum la sgrol chog dang / gnas brtan phyag mchod / bla ma mchod pa/ sman bla sogs gang rung res mos kyis shi gson la sman pa'i cho ga khag sgrub bzhin pa dang / de bzhin skabs der dgon 'di'i phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rten khag ni gtsang khang ka ring brgyad dang / 'du khang ka ba brgyad/ mgon khang ka ba gnyis bcas 76

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/yod cing / gtsang khang du rten gyi gtso bo 'jim las grub pa'i byams pa spun gsum mtho tshad la rmid bdun lhag dang / de'i g.yas g.yon du jo rngog 'brom gsum/ dge bshes po to ba bcas kyi 'dra sku dang / dge bshes po to ba'i thugs dam gyi rten a rang byon/ mgon po'i bla rdo sogs dang / gsung rten du shar nub kyi ngos gnyis su gser dngul las bris pa'i rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur cha tshang / de bzhin bka' gdams glegs bam sna tshogs pod grangs brgya lhag tsam dang / 'du khang nang shar li las grub pa'i po to ba bu slob bdun gyi gdung rten mtho tshad la rmid gnyis tsam dang / 'du khang nub ngos kyi mgon khang nang mgon po dang / dbye ma ra/ bstan ma rdo rje g.yu sgron sogs yod/ dgon pa'i lho phyogs kyi ri 'debs su mchod rten lnga yod pa ni sngar dge bshes po to ba zhal bzhugs skabs rgya gar nas dung dkar rtsa chen zhig 'bul mkhan byung ba de gzungs gzhug tu phul te mchod rten gcig dang de'i g.yas g.yon du mchod rten re re bcas khyon mchod rten gsum bzhengs gnang ba dang /rjes su dge bshes po to ba sku gshegs rjes khong gi bu slob rnams kyis spur sbyangs sar mchod rten bzhengs te de'i gzungs gzhug la po to ba'i gdung sogs bzhugs shing nang log gi gdung rten dngul las byas pa sogs bka' gdams chos 'byung du gsal ba dang / nub der khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten zhes mchod rten chung chung zhig yod pa bcas so/77

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/(2) rig gsar rjes dgon pa bskyar bzhengs nyams gso ji ltar zhus nas da lta dgon pa'i phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rten sogs ji tsam yod pa'i skor/rig gsar rjes chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus lag bstar don 'khyol byang nas sngar gyi dgon pa dang lha khang sogs nyams gso bskyar (na byed chog pa'i skal bzang gi dus shig shar ba na sngar dga' ldan chos 'khor dgon gyi grwa yin pa zhang blo bzang lags dang / sngar po to dgon gyi btsun ma skabs der sdom gtsang du bzhugs pa lhun grub chos sgron dang sku bzang rnam rgyal bcas nas 'gan khur gtso bzhes thog sngar dgon pa de ga'i btsun ma yin pa rig gsar skabs skya sa babs pa khag gcig nas kyang phya gru mnyam 'dregs kyis sa phyogs gang sar bsod snyoms su phebs te dngul dngos gang tsam grab gsog thub pa dang /de bzhin nye 'khor gyi yul mi rnams kyi shugs che'i rgyab skyor thob pa brgyud rab byang bcu bdun pa'i lcags pho rta spyi lo 1990lo'i bod zla 1nas rāgo 'dzugs kyis dgon pa bskyar skrun byed 'go tshugs pa dang lo de ga'i bod zla 6tshes 4nyin dgon pa'i phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rten sogs gang tsam legs sgrub thub par bkra shis rten 'brel dang khrus gsol rab gnas kyi ched du dga' ldan chos 'khor dgon gyi mkhan po blo bzang dpal ldan dang / dge slong ngag dbang bstan 'phel/ ngag dbang dar rgyas/bstan 'dzin snyan grags/ po to dgon gyi bla ma las thog pa blo 78

'phan yul gyi bka' gdamasapa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/bzang bsam 'phel/ de bzhin dga' ldan chos 'khor dgon gyi btsun chung bcu phrag gcig lhag bcas gnas 'dir dngos su zhabs bcags nas dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas par khrus gsol rab gnas rgya che gnang ba dang / de rjes lo de ga'i bod zla 7 tshes 15nyin ser dgon gyi mkhan po ser smad dge bshes ye shes byams pa mchog gnas 'dir zhabs sor 'khod de gsar du sgrig zhugs gnang ba'i btsun ma bdun cu lhag tsam la sbyor dngos rjes gsum legs par tshang ba'i sgo nas dge tshul gyi sdom pa yang dag par gnang / dus de nas bzung spyi lo 2008lo bar dgon pa'i phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rten sogs gang 'tsham zhig bskyar bzhengs thub yod pa ni 'du khang ka ba bcu drug gi nang rten gyi gtso bo 'jim las grub pa'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang po dang / spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong / jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha/ 'brom ston pa/ dge bshes po to ba/ rje yab sras gsum bcas kyi sku mi tshad ma dang / gser zangs las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong dang / spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ shar li'i byang chub mchod rten dang / dge bshes po to ba'i thugs dam gyi rten a rang byon/ mgon po'i bla rdo/ nub der 'jem las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa dang / po to ba'i sku chung ba re/de bzhin slob dpon snang srid zil gnon gyi 'jim sku che ba gcig dang chung ba stong dang brgyad bcas bzhugs su gsol ba 79

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/ma zad steng du ston pa'i sku dang / dzik+ṣi las grub pa'i rje rin po che/gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal tshab rje dang mkhas grub rje/'jim las grub pa'i rje yab sras gsum dang sgrol ma/ gsung gi rten du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur/ — yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum/srung ma'i gtso bo mgon po dang / bstan ma rdo rje g.yu sgron/lha mo/ dbye ma'i zhal 'bag bcas bzhugs su gsol/dgon pa'i lho phyogs kyi spang ljongs yangs shing rgya che ba de'i steng du sngar nas yod pa'i mchod rten lnga po de dag bskyar bzhengs zhus yod pa ni shar nas rtsis pa'i dang po byang chub mchod rten dang / gnyis pa dang gsum pa bka' gdams mchod rten/bzhi pa rnam rgyal mchod rten/ lnga pa khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten sogs kyis dgon 'dir dmigs bsal gyi byin rlabs shig 'jug par byas yod/(3) dgon pa'i dmigs bsal dus mchod dang cho ga phyag len sogs kyi skor/deng skabs dgon par btsun ma zhal grangs lnga bcu lhag tsam yod pa de dag gis sngar bzhin ri bo dge lugs pa'i phyag bzhes gtsang mar mdzad de rgyun du dgon pa'i cho ga phyag len khag slob sbyong dang nyams len gtso bzhes thog nye 'khor yul mi rnams kyi re 'dun ltar shi gson la sman pa'i zhabs rim khag gang thub sgrub bzhin pa dang / da dung lo gcig gi dgon pa'i 80

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang /de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/cho ga phyag len khag ni bod zla 1tshes 10nas 15bar lo res mos kyis bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur ljags klog zhu ba dang /bod zla 3tshes 30nas bod zla 4tshes 16bar smyung gnas dkar po cha brgyad/ drug pa tshes bzhi dang / dgu pa lha babs dus chen gnyis la spyan ras gzigs kyi cho ga bod zla 10tshes 25la sman bla dang bde mchog gang rung gi cho ga bod zla 12tshes 2nas tshes 16bar ma ṇi'i cho ga dang ma ṇi 'bum sgrub/de bzhin zla re'i nya stong brgyad gsum la sgrol chog dang /gnas brtan phyag mchod / bla ma mchod pa/ sman bla sogs res mos kyis cho ga sgrub bzhin pa bcas so /

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/gsum/ phu chung ri khrod dang phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan/(1) phu chung ri khrod kyi gnas bshad/bka' gdams sku mched gsum gyi ya gyal spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul pa phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan sgom sgrub nyams len la bzhugs sa'i phu chung dben pa'i ri khrod de ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong yul snga phu chung gi ri 'dabs su chags shing lha sa nas rlangs 'khor du bzhugs te chu tshod gcig tsam phebs na gnas der bde bar 'byor/ phu chung ri khrod kyi phyi'i chags dbyibs ni g.yas ri spang ljongs dang / g.yon du rdza ri nags tshal gyis rab tu brgyan pa'i khrod nas byi'u 'jol mo sogs bya rigs sna tshogs kyi gsung snyan lhang lhang du grags shing rdza dang spang gi mtshams su dwangs shing gtsang ba'i phu chu shang shang du rgyug ste dben pa'i ri khrod nyams dga' ba zhig 'dug gnas der sngon dge bshes phu chung ba sgrub pa skyon sa'i sgrub khang gong 'og gnyis 'dug cing sgrub khang 'og ma ni khor yug yangs shing rgya che la phyogs bzhi thams cad khams sdong dang se ba sogs ljon shing sna tshogs tshang tshing du skyes pa dang / sgrub khang gi sku rgyab tu byin rlabs can gyi mchod rten gyis bskor ba ma zad sngon dge bshes phu chung bas brag gi dkyil la gser bre dngul bre yod pa mngon par mkhyen nas brag kha bshags te gser dngul bton pa'i rdo 82

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang/de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/khung gi rjes shul da lta dngos su mjal rgyu yod la gser dngul de dag gzungs gzhug tu phul te bzhengs pa'i mchod rten de yang da lta nyams gso zhus yod/ sgrub khang 'og mar gnas mjal grub rjes grog rong de rang brgyud nub phyogs su gang tsam song na sngon dge bshes phu chung bas phyag mdzub btsugs te bton pa'i sgrub chu de mjal zhing sgrub chu'i byin rlabs zhus nas byang phyogs kyi rdza ri brgyud mu mthud dus tshod skar ma nyi shu tsam rir 'dzegs na dge bshes phu chung ba'i sgrub khang gong mar 'byor/ shing nags stug cing brag ri g.yang gzar can de lta bu zhig gi steng nas dben pa'i ri khrod ngo mtshar can zhig mjal skabs rang sems la dad pa dang tshor snang gsar pa zhig slebs rgyu yin pa ni sku nyid gnas der dngos su phebs na shes so/ sgrub khang gong 'og de gnyis la dge bshes phu chung ba sku gshegs pa'i rjes su yang mu mthud sgrub pa nyams len la bzhugs mkhan mi rabs nas mi rabs brgyud ha cang mang po zhig byang ba'i skor yul de ga'i rgad po dag las thos rgyu 'dug kyang zhi( phra'i lo rgyus da bar yig thog la 'khod pa ma mthong ngo //da ni yul snga phu chung zhes pa'i ming gi byang tshul skor la cung zad brjod na yul snga zhes pa yul gyi chags tshul gyi go rim snga phyi la gzhigs te btags pa zhig yin pa ni yul de nyid shar nub kyi ri rgyud gnyis kyi bar du chags pa dang / shar phyogs kyi ri de nas la brgyab ste song na 'phan po gzhogs zhes pa'i yul der 83

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/'byor zhing yul de gnyis thog mar chags skabs yul snga sngon dang gzhogs pa rjes su chags par grags pas yul snga mo nas chags pa'i yul snga dang de yi gzhogs su chags pa'i gzhogs pa zhes pa'i gtam dpe zhig mi thog nas mi thog brgyud de grags pa ltar yul de'i ming gi dag don ngo mar yul snga zhes 'bri dgos par snang / phu chung zhes pa ni dge bshes phu chung ba sgrub pa skyon sa'i lung thur der phu chung nang zer zhing de ltar zer ba'i rgyu mtshan ni lung thur de'i mdo nas phu bar phu thag thung thung zhig las med pas phu chung nang zhes brjod la phu chung ni phu thag thung ba'i don yin/ des na dge bshes gzhon nu rgya mtshan khong gnas der sgrub pa skyon pas yul ming khong la thogs te dge bshes phu chung ba dang / yul ming sgrub khang la thogs te phu chung sgrub khang ngam phu chung ri khrod zhes brjod par snang ngo //(2) dge bshes phu chung ba'i 'khrungs 'das lo rgyus dang mdzad pa rnamathar/'brom rin po che'i thugs sras phu chung ba gzhon nu rgyal mtshan ni 'phan yul rgyal gyi skyi ra rdzing khar rab byang dang po'i lcags mo lug spyi lo 1031lor sku 'khrungs/ ts+tsha rabs mang por lam la sbyang pa'i bag chags brtas pas byis pa'i dus nas mi rtag pa rtogs pa'i blo rang 'khrungs byang ste srid pa'i phun tshogs gang la yang ma chags par rgyal babit+yā bstan pa la zhugs te chos rnam dag cig mdzad bzhed nas yab yum 'byor pa chung 84

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang/de dgagyiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/yang gser zho do bsnams nas rgyal lha khang du bros te zhang chen po dang / glan tshul byang la rab tu byung / mtshan gzhon nu rgyal mtshan du btags/ lha khang pa'i bza' ba byas/ zhang chen po la kho bos gnyer mi 'ong zhus pas ma gnang / glan tshul byang la zhus pas gnang / de nas 'dul ba'i bcas mtshams rnams mig gi 'bras bu ltar bsrung zhing sngon byon dam pa'i rnam thar bsams te thos bsam sgom gsum cha tshang ba zhig mdzad bzhed nas mkhas pa chen po khu ston la phar phyin 'grel chung tshar bco lnga gsan pa sogs thos pa mang du mdzad/ 'dul ba la'ang gsan sbyong mthar phyin pa mdzad nas/ snye thang du jo bo'i zhal mjal zhing chos kyang cung zad gsan/ jo bo gshegs nas dge bshes ston pa'i phyag phyi mdzad nas rwa sgreng du phebs/ gdams pa rdzogs par gsan zhing thugs nyams su bzhes/ dge bshes ston pa'i bka' lung gis slob ma skyong ba'ang mdzad de/ brom rin po che'i zhabs drung du dge slong gsar bu byang ba rnams la 'dul ba'i bslab bya legs par slobs shig cermi bka' gnang nas/ 'dul ba'i phyag len khrid par mdzad/ po to ba las na gzhon kyang bslab pa bgres shing dge bshes bsten yun ring bas sku mchedagazhan gnyis kyis kyang gong du 'khur zhing dbu mdzad ces 'bod/ ston pa lo ngo bcu gcig tu bsten nas yon tan ma lus pa mnga' bar gda'/ spyan sngas lo brgyad/ po to bas lo ril po lnga dang ngo mthong bdun bsten te bsten yun thung 85

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/pas po to ba gzhon shos su byed pa'ang snang / dge bshes ston pa 'das nas tshe 'di'i 'khri ba phra mo'ang med par dben pa'i gnas su mdo sngags kyi lam cha tshang la nyams len mthar phyin pa zhig mdzad/ khong ni skyes kyang nags su skyes/ dengs kyang nags su dengs pa lta bu zhig yin te sha gzug rang za gsungs nas sgrub pa 'ba' zhig mdzad/ 'phan yul yul snga'i phu phu chung du sgrub khang brtsigs te sgrub pa gtso bo gnang / brag gi dkyil na gser bre dngul bre yod pa mngon par mkhyen te gter nas bton pa'i rjes dang zhabs rjes sogs brag la da lta'ang yod/de'i tshe sgrub khang gi nub na brag la phyag mdzub btsugs par sgrub chu byang ba yang yod/ 'dis slob ma drung du 'dus pa dag la'ang rterno cing 'brel bar 'byang ba yan lag bcu gnyis kyi gdams pa gtso bor 'debs parno mdzad cing / lam gyi rim pa'ang de'i khongs su 'thus par mdzad/ bu slob cher mi bsten kyang sha po sgang pa/ dge bshes 'ben sdings pa shes rab rgya mtsho/kurma brag pa sogs byon/ bdag nyid chen po 'di ri dwags rmas ma ltar 'du 'dzi la ches 'jigs pas sku mched gsum tshogs pa'i skabs ma gtogs tshogs mi sdud cing / gcig pu gnyis su med par dben pa nas dben par 'pho bar mdzad kyang yon tan gyi dri bsung la thams cad 'khor te sku mched gnyis kyi slob ma phal che bas chos ma gsan pa med/ spyan snga gshegs nas bya yul bas phu chung du byon te rten 'brel gyi khrid gsan cing 86

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/bzhugs dus mang ra'i zhal nas/ da lta phu chung na nyan thos kyi rdzu 'phral gyis 'gro ba'i byang chub sems dpa' zhig smin bdog gseng skad/ phu chung ba'i lugs kyi rten 'brel gyi khrid nyams su len tshul bya yul ba'i bka' rgyud la dar che bar byang la bka' gdams pa'i nang gses man ngag pa'i srol yang phye/stodage bshes phu chung ba de nyid dkon mchog mchod pa la gtso bo mdzad pas gzim khang gi phyi rol du spos kyi dri ngad ldang ba lags par gda'/ zhal nas ngas dang por spang spos sna tsha ting nge ba phul/ de nas reng bu bzhi sbyor mngar sing nge ba 'bul rgyu byang / da lta a ka ru dang du ru ka la sogs pa dri bsung ching nge ba 'ebul gsungs/ lan cig la gser srang nyi shu rtsa gnyis kyi spos sbyar skad/ yang zhal nas da lta nas skyabs 'gro goms tsa na na ba'i tshe a ra zer ba'i dod la sangs rgyas sogs 'ong ste gsungs /yang lan cig g.yang thun mgo la bkab nas rgyal lha khang gi shi ba rnams bgrang gin snang skad/ yang lan cig phu chung ba dang kha lung ba 'dzoms dus dge bshes ba ni las 'bras kho na gal che bar gsungs ba la/ da lta bshad rin dang nyan rin dang sgom rin med par byed de/ 'di kho na nyams su blangs dka' sems gsungs bas phu chung ba yang de tsug lags gsungs ba dang /yang phu chung ba'i zhal nas/ nga ni rgas khar mdzangs blun la kha lhan gyis song gsungs skad/ yang zhal nas/ 'u cag dge ba'i tshig 'bru bton dang mi dge ba'i don bton du 'gro gsungs/87

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/yang phu chung ba chen pos lan cig nam byed tsa na a tsa ma gsungs/ci nong zhus pas/ de ring mdo sde bltas pa na dus kyi mtha'i nyan thos byed ma'i sgro ba kha sbub pa bzhin mar la 'gro ba bshad snang / de'i gseb na ni nga yang yod/ bla lhag pa'i chos ni ma byas/ srub kur chags pa 'dra yin na rung ste zhes gsungs/yang zhal nas/ chos byed pa la shes dgos / de la go dgos/ de la nyan dgos/ yang hur chen po byung nas byed dgos/ lung pa'i srol bsgyur nas chos byed dgos te/ bdag gzhan brje ba'am/ 'jig rten dang mi mthun pa byed dgos/ gtam ngan blangs nas byed dgos/ snying khams rang dpe the'u tsam dgos gsungs/ yang lan cig zhal nas 'chi ba mi rtag pa dang 'bras bu mang du sgoms shig phas pham pa bzhi byang yang sbyong nus pa zhig 'ong gi de nga'i kha chems yin gsunges/ yang zhal nas/bdag nyid gang la mi dga' ba/ gzhan la kun du chi spyad do/zhes byang chub sems dpa'i bslab pa'i khog pa yin gsungs/'brom rin po che'i zhabs drung du sku mched gsum 'tshogs nas 'brom rin po che zhing gshegs kyi bar du 'bras med du bzhugs kyang jo bo yab sras kyi gsang ba'i chos rdzogs par mnga' ba ni phu chung ba nyid yin te/ 'brom rin po che'i zhal nas kyang /tshul khrims 'bar ba rin chen 'od gsal pa/ rin chen gsal bas tshul khrims rgyan mdzes pa/ nga yi rnam thar mi nub skyong bar mdzod/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan nga dang gnyis su med/ thugs rje 88

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang/de dgagi phyaga'adebasapa po'i lo rgyus/chen po kun t+yā sbas pa'i bu/ 'jig rten khams rnams rgyal mtshan 'di yi gang / pad ma'i sul rnams gzhon nu 'di yis brgyan/ces dang / 'di la gra bar gyur ba su yang med/ slob mar ma gyar chos pa su yang med/ 'di la gnas med zhing khams thems cad 'dzin/ mi gral nas bud mi dbang rnams kyis mchod/ gzhon nu rgyal mtshan rtag tu rgyal gyar cig/ces gsungs te legs par bsngags pa'i sems dpazlo chen po 'dis jo bo yab sras kyi gsang chos bka' gdams thig le bcu drug gi dbang dang gdams ngag ji ltar gsan pa dang / nyams len ji ltar mdzad pa/ bdag nyid chen po 'di'i phyag tu sprul pa'i glegs bam ji ltar byang tshul sogs lo rgyus rnam thar rnams shes par 'dod na lam sdom bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar gyi shog grangs 915nang gzigs par 'tshal/ de ltar dge bshes phu chung ba de nyid rang gzhan gyi don mthar phyin par mdzad nas dgung grangs don drug la phebs pa/ rab byang gnyis pa'i me pho khyi spyi lo 1106lor dbyar tshul du 'ju| khar rgyal du thegs pa'i lam zhor la po tor gdung khang la rab gnas mdzad de/ dbyar rgyal gyi do bo dgon par bzhugs nas grwa ba nyi shu 'dus/ston mya ngan las 'das pas ngo bor rgyal gyi zla ba'i nyi shu gnyis la sku gshegs par grags so///

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/bzhi/ lodagonagadangade'iphyaga'adebasangapospyanasngagatshulakhrimasa'abar/'go brjod/bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen phyag rdor gyi sprul pa spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar gyis phyag btab pa'i dpal ldan lo dgon pa de ni 'phan yul gyi mda' stag rtse rdzong thang dkar shang gi phu lo skyid mo'i gzhung zhes pa'i sa der chags shingalam bar du lo mda' phag mo chos sde dang / khyung tshang btsun dgon sogs kyang rim pas mjal thub kyi yod/ lo dgon pa 'di nyid thog mar phyag btab pa nas spyi lo 2008bar lo 913lhag tsam gyi lo rgyus ldan pa'i bka' gdams kyi dgon gnas rnying shos shig yin la/ bka' gdams gdams ngag pa'i gdan sa thog ma de yang yin/ dgon pa 'di'i phyi'i khor yug ni rgyab ri glang chen nyal ba lta bu'i ri ldebs su shing tshar pa dang / se ba/ skyer pa sogs shing sna phun sum tshogs shing / byi'u 'jol mo dang /lha bya gong mo sogs bya rigs sna tshogs kyis gsung snyan lhang lhang du grags pa dang / mdun ri bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi mtshan ma yongs su rdzogs pa/ nub ri mkha' 'gro'i ri zhes dgon 'dir maṇ+ḍal phul ba lta bu/ shar phyogs nas dwangs gtsang yan lag brgyad ldan gyi phu chu zhig dgon par kha gtad de 'bab pa sogs90

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dnganade dgagiphyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/ngo mtshar bkod pas rab tu phyug pa'i gnas mchog cig tu chags shing / sku nyid lha sa nas rlangs 'khor du bzhugs te chu tshod gcig dang phyed tsam phebs na gnas de'i ngo mtshar bkod pa rnams 'dren byed lam du mngon sum du 'char ro/da ni lo dgon pa zhes pa'i lo yi ming gi thogs tshul skor la cung zad brjod na/ da lta dgon pa chags sa'i yul de'i sngar gyi ming la nyan zhes brjod cing dge bshes spyan snga ba 'khrungs sa yang nyan gyi snang ra sgang zhes da lta dgon pa yod sa'i 'dabs der yin/ 'on kyang phyis su nyan zhes pa'i yul ming de lo zhes par ming 'gyar gyis da lta yul der kun gyis lo'i nang zhes brjod pa lazlo nyan gyi nang zhes brjod mkhan med/ des na lo zhes pa'i ming de yang snying ji ltar byung zhe na/ der bshad srol mi 'dra ba gnyis yod pa ni/ (1)dge bshes spyan snga ba shing tsan dan 'khrungs sa'i sgrub khang der sgrub pa skyon nas bzhugs skabs nub cig rmi lam du dge bshes ston pas bu khyod kyi dgon pa sa 'di ru 'debs lo gsung ba zhig byang bas dgon pa'i ming yang lo dgon par thogs shing rjes su stodagon pa'i ming yul la thogs te sngar gyi nyan zhes pa de yang lo zhes par ming 'gyur byung ba'i bshad srol zhig dang / (2)dge bshes spyan snga ba sgrub pa skyon sa'i sku rgyab tu shing tsan dan zhig 'khrungs yod pa de'i thog lo ma gzhan las che ba zhig gi steng du lo zhes pa'i rang byang gi yi ge zhig 'khrungs pa gzigs pa na dgon pa'i ming zlo lo zhes 91

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/btags la yul ming yang nyan nas lor 'gyur bar grags/gang ltar dge bshes spyan snga bas lo dgon pa btab rjes dgon ming yul la thogs te sngar gyi nyan zhes pa nas lo zhes par ming 'gyar byas pa de rtsod med yongs grags so//cu (1) dgon 'di'i thog ma'i phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus dang ji ltar phyag btab nas dar rgud ji byung skor/dge bshes ston pa'i sras kyi thu bo sku mched gsum las sku na gzhon shos spyan snga ba tshul khrims 'bar ni nyan gyi snang ra sgang du /yab dbas shākya rdo rje dang / yum li mo ye shes sgron gnyis kyi sras su rab byung dang po'i chu mo bya spyi lo 1033deb sngon sogs su sa pho stag spyi lo 1038lor 'khrungs zhes gsal/ lor 'khrungs/ mtshan stag tshab 'bar zhes btags/ sngon yun ring po nas lam la sbyang pa'i bag chags brtas pas gzhan gyis bskul ba la ma bltos par skyes bu gsum ga'i lam gyi gnas rnams la bag chags sad de byis pa'i dus su spyir 'dus byas 'di thams cad sdod pa'i mthu med par 'jig pa dang / khyad par rang gi lus myur du 'jig pa'i ngang tshul dran nas rgyun du bshum pa zhig byang bas yum des khyod 'jig mi dgos myur du shi 'gro snyam pa'i༄ blo de slar brjed 'gro zer/ spyan snga'i yum de ni rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma zhig yin par grags pas deng sang rang cag tha mal ba rnams la bla ma re'i bka' drin las 'chi ba dran pa'i blo rib tsam re byung yang snang shas mthu che bas chu la dbyug gus bris pa ltar de ma thag 92

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgabi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/brjed nas rtag 'dzin dbang du 'gro ba'i ngang tshul de yum des brjod pa'o/ / de dus yum gyis pang du 'khyer nas slob dpon grong 'dul ba zhig la phung po lnga'i rab byed gsan pas/ phung po 'di lngar 'byed tshod kyis mthar stong pa nyid du 'dug snyam ste bdag med pa'i lta ba rang 'khrungs su byang / gzhan yang byis pa'i gnas skabs der lhag pa'i lha mji po'i snang ba yang yang 'char ba zhig byung / lo bcu gnyis lon tsa na rnal 'byor ma gong mo sgang ba bya ba byon nas gdams ngag cig gsungs bas myong ba khyad par can skyes pa zhig byang ste/ de ni rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor mas byin gyis brlabartso pa yin par gsungs/ yang lan cig tsa na ra lug 'tshor ri zhig gi rtser byon pas/ da ste lo brgya tham pa na 'di nas mthong ba'i mi thams cad 'chi ba yin dgongs thugs phyung ba'i mgur gsung pa ri zhol gyi mi rnams la snyan par byung nas/ 'or che stag tshab 'bar snyan rang snyan da dung zhig longs dang zer bas/ nga ma dga' ches nas blangs pa la khong da dung longs zer ang gsungs/ de nas dgung lo bco brgyad pa la stod lung tsha thog dgon par mal shes rab sems dpa'i drung du rab tu byung / mtshan tshul khrims 'bar du btags/der yum gyi rmi lam du dung dkar zhig bus pa 'dzam bu gling pa thams cad kyis thos pa zhig byang bas/ nga'i bu 'di rab tu byang nas grags pa yang che ba zhirgo 'ong ba 'dug zer/ slob gnyer mdzad dus tsha thog dgon par byon pa'i zhor la/ jo bo snye'i na 93

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/mo cher bzhugs pa dang mjal/ sems bskyed gsungs ba gsan/de dus jo bos 'di pa'i spyi bor phyag bzhag ste maskṛta'i skad du bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad mang po mdzad/ gser gling pa'i bum pa pad+ma'i mchu can gnang / nga'i chos rgyud 'dzin pa/ cig 'ong gsungs/ de nas lan tsha rab dang / rug par sde snod kyi gsan sbyong mang du mdzad/ rgya gar rdo rje gdan chos kyi 'byang khungs yin pas der 'byon dgongs te skad dod dang rgya chog mang du bslabs/ de'i dus su mdo sde gzigs pas chos thog tu hril hril 'gro bar byang bas so so'i skye bo'i sa nas sangs rgyas kyi sar 'gro ba la bla ma༄ mi dgos par snang snyam pa byang / phyis su bsams tsa na sngar gyi des gar yang mi phyin pa༄ 'dug gsungs skad/ de'i dus su yum rug par byon nas rug pa'i ban de rnams la 'di ni dgras bdas pa yin/ 'di 'dres bdas pa yin/ snying nas chos byas bsam nas rab tu byung ba ni khyod dang slob dpon zhang btsun gnyis yin/ khyod chos gsha' ma zhig byed na rwa sgreng du dge bshes ston pa'i spyan sngar 'gro gsungs nas yum gyis khrid de dgung lo nyer lnga pa la dge bshes ston pa dang mjal/ spyan snga'i zhal nas/ nga'i ma de rang bzhin gyi rnal 'byor ma yin pas 'dir bskyal ba yin gsungs/ de'i tshe dge bshes ston pa la lam gyi 'gro chos zhus nas rgya gar du rnal 'byor ba zhig la gtug snyam du dgongs pa la dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ khyod rgya gar du ma 'gro ngas thugs la 94

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/gdags kyi gsungs bas/ dge bshes ston pas thugs la 'dogs na rgya gar du 'gro don mi 'dug dgongs pa byang nas bshes gnyen ston pa rin po che bsam sbyor gnyis skyos tshul bzhin du bsten nas dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad gang nas gshegs pa'i lam po che bka' dang dgongs 'grel thams cad kyi snying po'i don byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i myong khrid gsan pas lam gyi rim pa'i dmigs skor rnams bsam du btub pa byang ba la/ dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas dus tshod 'di tsa na shog gsungs bas spyan sngar phyin dus grog po'i gseb la nyi ma byang ba de/ spyan snga'i na bza' la shar bas bkra shis rdzas rbergyad la sogs pa'i gzugs mang po byang bas rten 'brel shin tu bzang gsungs nas mnyes pa yin༄/ dge bshes ston pa de phar phyin gsung ba'i dus su sku mched gsum ka ba li gcig la gzigs pa yin par gda'/ dge bshes ston pa grub mtha' zhig gsung ba gsan du byon pas/ ston pa'i zhal nas/ nga khyod la sgom chen zhig re ba yin/ khyod rang nang du sgoms shig gsungs bas/ spyan sngas phyag mdzad nas byon pa dang / ston pa'i zhal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa la spyod pa bya ba de kho 'dra ba zhig la zer ba yin gsungs/ yongs rdzogs rnal 'byor ba'i zhal nas/dge bshes ston pas thugs la 'dogs par snang bas/ khyed rang gsang sngags kyi chos zhus na 'ongs gsungs bas/ sku 95

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/mched gzhan gnyis kyis dro'i du ba reng byang dus spyan sngas dro thon par byas/ der dge bshes ston pas ze'i dus zhes skyo sun re gsol bas/ de dus su gdams ngag zhus pas theg pa chen po gsang sngags kyi gdams pa ma lus pa gnang ba yin/ spyan snga'i zhal nas/ yongs rdzogs rnal 'byor ba 'di nga la bka' drin che gsungs/ yang dge bshes ston pa'i zhal nas/ jo bo pa nyon mongs pa brgyad khri bzhi stong gi gnyen por chos kyi sgo mo brgyad khri bzhi stong gsungs pa de/ 'dod chags kyi gnyen por gsungs pa rnams kyis zhe snang 'joms mi nus/ zhe snang gi gnyen por gsungs pa rnams kyis 'dod chags 'joms mi nus pas nyon mongs so so'i gnyen po so sor bsten dgos pa yin/ nyon mongs thams cad kyi gnyen po byed nus pa'i chos ni rten cing 'brel bar 'byang ba zab mo stong pa nyid sgom pa 'di yin gsungs nas 'phagazlo pa kla sgrub kyis rgyal ba'i dgongs pa bkral ba'i man ngag dbu ma'i rkodams ngag rnams legs par gnang / de ltar dang por dge bshes ston pa dang mjal ba nas nam gshegs kyi bar 'bral med du lo brgyad bsten/ rgyun du spyan sngar bzhugs pas mtshan yang spyan snga pa zhes thogs/ bod kyi lo rgyus thog tu spyan snga pa'i mtshan thogs pa dang po'ang yin/ de nas dge bshes ston pa sku gshegs pas thugs ngal chen po byang ba na/ nub cig rmi lam na nyi ma zhig lus la shar ba rmis/ gde dge bshes ston pa'i yon tan ma lus pa rang gis 96

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang/de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/thob pa yin ang snyam pa byang / de nas thugs dgongs la rnal 'byor pa gong 'og 'di snoms la jo bo'i yon tan ma lus pa mnga' ba yin snyam nas bsten te rnal 'byor pa chen po de bden pa gnyis dang las kha tshar la dge bshes ston pa bas kyang ci zhib tsam du byang / dgon pa ba de sgom skyon sel ba dang chos zab mo thamazlo cad la dge bshes ston pa bas kyang ci zhib tsam du byang /rnal 'byor pa shes rab rdo rje de grub mtha' la dge bshes storno pa bas kyang ci zhib tsam du byang / de nas spyan snga bas rwa sgreng du jo bo'i slob ma rnal (byor pa chen po dang / dge bshes dgon pa ba sogs bsten cing tshe 'di'i bya ba thams cad blos btang ste byang chub lam gyi rim pa sgom pa la dka' spyad drag po'i sgo nas brtson pa hur mdzad/ de dus spyan snga ba 'tsho chas shin tu bkren pas na bza' rnams hral hrul du gyar te mthang gos la ko ba'i lhan pa byas pas spyan snga ko sham pa donas grags pa byang /nges 'byang shugs drag pos rgyud bskul nas mtshan mo mnazlo ye med parno lam rim sgom pa la khor yug tu 'bad pas rnal 'byor ba chen pos bag re chog de tsam la brtson pa che na khams log nyen yod gsungs ba la/ spyan sngas de ltar lags te/ dal 'byor 'di rnyed par dka' bas zhes gsungs/ spyan snga ba thugs dam la 'jug res kyis/ gang tshe rang dbang 'jug cing mthun gnas pa//gal te 'di dag 'dzin par mi byed na//g.yang sar lhung bas gzhan dbang 'jug 'gyur ba//de las phyis nas 97

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/gang gis slong bar 'gyar//zhes 'jug pa nas gsungs pa de lan re bton te dal 'byore rnyed dkas rgyud bskul te 'jug yang spyan sngas bya yul pa la dal ba 'byor ba mi'i lus thob pa dran nam zhes yang yang gsungs bar mdzad de dal 'byor don che rnyed dka' dang nam 'chi cha med dran pas rgyud bskul te skad cig kyang yengs long med par lam rim sgom pa la brtson pa chu bo'i rgyun bzhin mdzad do/ de ltar sgrub pa dar drag la rgyun ring bar mdzad pas lam gyi rim pa la myong ba phul phyin thon zhing /me long g.ya' dag pa la gzugs brnyan 'char ba je bzhin du sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mang pos zhal bstan nas dngos su byin gyis brlabs/ nangs cig bcom ldan 'das gar gyi dbang phyug phyag tu bum pa bsnams pa cig byon nas sku khrus gsol bas sku lus kyi mi gtsang ba thams cad sangs kyis dag pa'i snang ba byang / lan cig khong rang jo bo mi g.yo bra zhwa theb chung chung gartsol ba gcig tu gzigs/ spyan snga ba 'di ni rig gnas mtha' dag la mkhas pa zhig ste/ rgya yig rang yang rigs mi 'dra ba bdun tsam mkhyen/ ngas lo tsā byas kyang 'bring po zhig 'ong ngam snyam pa yin/ ngas theg pa chen po'i gsang sngags la phan yon che zer ba rnams la bsnyen pa tshad du ma bskyal ba med/ las tshogs rnams la'ang nyams su ma blangs pa med/swats+tsha gcig pu'ang ri di'u tsam btab pa yin/ spang spos gcig pu'ang khang pa gang ba tsam gtams pa yin gsungs/98

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dag gi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/de nas dpal ldan lo dgon pa phyag btab tshul ni khong dgung lo re gsum la phebs pa rab byang gnyis pa'i shing mo phag spyi lo 1095lor lo dgon pa gdadro par dgongs nas rgya yon bdag la rmi lam brtag pa zhus pas/ rgya'i zhal nas chos bgres po zhig yul du 'gro zer ba byang / spyan snga'i zhal nas rmi lam rno gsungs skad/ de rjes rwa sgrong nas nyan du byon te dben gnas der sgrub pa rtse gcig tu zhol/ sgrub khang gi nub der sgrub chu'ang rang bzhin du thon zhing sgrub chu de da lta'ang dngos su mjal rgyu yod/ skabs der spyan snga'i zhal nas gzhan gyi yul la gnas skor 'gro ba las/ skyid mo'i gzhung 'dir gnyid cig nyal ba dga' zhes gsungs nas yul der thugs mnyes par mdzad/ dgong mo zhig thun la bzhugs pas gnyid dang 'od gsal 'dres pa la/ dge bshes ston pa byon nas bu khyod kyi rdo rje gdan 'di rang yin/ byang chub kyi shing yang de rang du 'khrungs 'dug gsung ba zhig rmis/ gnyid bsad pa na ci yang mi 'dug nga'i dgon pa 'di sa 'di na 'debs e lo dge bshes ston pa la 'dri snyam pa zhig byung gsungs/ nyin der sgrub pa mdzad sa'i sku rgyab na shing zhig mgo 'bur 'dug pa gzigs pas grub rtags thon pa dang mnal lam rtags mthun pa min nam snyam yid dga' ba byung gsungs/ shing de rim bzhin skyes pas rjes su tsan dan dkar po dri zhim mchog tu spro ba zhig 'khrungs/ shing de da lta'ang mjal rgyu yod/ de nas nub cig rmi lam du 99

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/dge bshes ston pas bu khyod kyi dgon pa sa de ru 'debs lo gsungs pa zhig byang bas dgon pa'i ming yang lo dgon par thogs shing rjes sh+lau dgon pa'i ming yul la thogs te sngar gyi nyan zhes pa de yang lo zhes par ming 'gyarabyas zhes grags/ yon bdag bya rje stod pas mar gyi me tor+sha mang po phul bas nga'i yon bdag dpal gsum phul ba gsungs nas mnyes/ de nas lo'i gtsug lag khang ka ba bzhi bzhengs/ rten gtso la dzik+ṣa las grub pa'i ston pa gtso 'khor lnga/ dge bshes ston pa/rnal 'byor pa chen po/ dgon pa ba gsum gyi nang rten du dngul gyi gdung khang dang / gser 'bum g.yu phra can/ shog nag thog rin chen sna lngas bris pa'i 'bum cha tshang / spyan snga sku na chung dus rdzi bo la phebs skabs 'bri bcug pa'i brgyad stong /phyi rten du mchod rten gsum bzhengs/ de rnams kyi rtsig 'phreng re re la bkra shis mched lnga'i rab gnas dang slob dpon nā ga bo dhī dngos su spyan drangs tshul sogs byin rlabs shin tu che zhing snyan grags kyang gang sar khyab pa lags/ bya yul bas spyan snga la/ slob dpon ma ga bo rnyi zhal gzigs zer ba med dam zhus pas/ a na ma btsun chung 'dra 'drir bcug pa'i chos mi 'dri bar/ 'drir ma bcug pa'i de 'dra bas ci bya gsungs nas ma gnang / yang zhus pas ngas slob dpon nā ga bo rnyi zhal mthong chos thos khyod rang yang gsol ba thob dang byin gyis rlob pa yin gsungs/ sngon rwa sgreng du byon pa zhig la pha bong thang na yar 100

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang/de dag gyiphyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/slob dpon na ga bo rnyi dge bshes ston pa'i rnam par byas nas bzhugs pa zhal gzigs/ de nas gar bzhud cha med du gyur/nga rang dad gus chung bar lan snyam nas gsol ba shugs drag btab pas dngos su byon nas byin gyis brlabs/ chos bzhi tshan bzhi la sogs pa gsungs pa ni/ gnyid dang rmi lam gyi dpes/snang ba de 'khrul bar shes pa'i rnal 'byor/ chab dang chab rom gyi dpes/ snang stong dbyer med du shes pa'i rnal 'byor/bu ram gyi ming gzugs kyi dpes/ snang grags kyi chos thams cad ro gcig tu shes pa'i rnal 'byor/ spyod pa pha rol du phyin pa drug la bslabs gsungs/ thams cad sems su rtogs pas chos thams cad la skur ba mi gdag sems sangs rgyas su rtogs kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen mi spongs/ rang la 'khor ba dang ngan song gi dgos pa med kyang sdig pa mi dge ba phra mo tsam yang spongs/ rang dang sems can tha dad med par rtogs kyang sems can thams cad la snying rje chen po mi spongs gsungs/ting nge 'dzin sems la zhogs/ yang dag don la ltos/ byams dang snying rje sgoms/ lha sku 'ja' tshon lta bur sbyongs gsungs/a skye ba med pa rlung mtshan ma med pa sems rang bzhin med pa re zhig lus la brten pa yin/ zhes sogs mang du gsungs te rtsa ba'i bla mar 'dzin pa yin/ lan gcig thugs bag tsam ma bde bas skyid smad du 'byon dgongs nas byon pa na/ nyan pa'i skye ban rnams kyis gdong bcad nas 'byon dbang ma byung / de 101

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/nas yar byon te thang skya'i de nas yar phebs dus/ sgom ma gcig gis sran ma'i me tog zhib ma gang phul bas/ mkha' 'gro ma'i lung bstan byang gsungs skad/ de nas smyug rum du byon te nga'i rdo rje gdan shādi yin/ nga ni tshogs yongs su rdzogs pa'i gang zag yin gsungs/ de'i tshe pha bong dkar leb bya ba'i steng nas bya yul gyi rgyab ri gzigs pas/ ri de rgyal ba'i gtsug tor 'dra/ yan lag brgyad ldan chu bo 'bab/ de yi shar lho'i phyogs mtshams na/ tshe dang ldan pa'i dgon gnas yod/ ri bya yul yul ba pha gi'i thad du gtsug lag khang bzhengs nas sems can la phan pa mang po gyis zhes lung bstan/ der zhabs rjes kyang byon/ de nas cung zad bsnyel ba'i dus shig rnal 'byor pa chen po gar gshegs gsungs/ de ni rnal 'byor pa chen po dang mjal bar nges/ yang lan cig nyi ma shar ang gsungs/ lan cig 'khor lo 'khor ang gsungs/ci lags zhus pas/ 'jam dpal brtan pa'i 'khor lo gsungs/da snga ma myong ba'i bde ba cig myong bar snang gsungs/ de nas dgung lo bdun cu don gcig la phebs pa rab byang gnyis pa'i chu mo lug spyi lo 1103smal po zla ba'i tshes 21blo smyug rum du zhi bar gshegs/ de nas lo pa'i sde ba rnams kyis spar brkus nas gdan 'dren rtsis byas pa la gdan 'dren mnya thub par gtsang kha der zhugs la zhen/ de'i tshe spyan snga'i thugs nam mkha' la byon te bya yul pa chen po smyug rum gyi gdong de na 102

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang /de dag gi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/gsol ba 'debs kyin bzhugs pa'i pang du byung bas thugs kyi gtod sa nga rang yin snyam du dgongs pa byung gsungs/ de ltar sems dpa' chen po spyan snga ba 'dis rgyal ba'i bstan pa la bya ba rgya cher mdzad de dge 'dun gyi sde mang du btsugs/ sku gsung thugs kyi rten mang du bzhengs/ skal ba dang ldan pa mtha' yas pa la lam gyi rim pa'i khrid gnang ste tshogs pa bdun brgya tsam 'dus pas bstan pa 'dzin pa'i slob ma mang du byung zhing thams cad kyi nang nas 'gran zla med pa'i thugs sras ni bya yul pa chen po/ stod lung pa chen po/ smyug rum pa chen po gsum ste 'di gsum la spyan snga'i slob ma 'gran gyi do med gsum zhes grags/dgon 'di'i gdan sa rim pa bzhin du spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar/ lo ba gzhon nu smon lam/ rtog ldan sdings po ba/ smon lam blo gros/ gtsang pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan/ glang lung pa rin chen brtson 'grus/ se rnal 'byor ba bsod nams rgyal mtshan/sangs rgyas sgom pa rdo rje gzhon nu/ gtsang pa jo sras/ zem grags pa seng ge kha lung pa rin chen seng ge gtsang ston/sangs rgyas jo bo dbang phyug gzhon nu/ sangs rgyas ston pa tshul khrims seng she sangs rgyas sgom pa shes rab tshul khrims/sangs rgyas dbon gzhon nu smon lam/ bcu bzhi ba tshul khrims mgon po/ gnam gang pa gzhon nu ye shes/ tshes bcu pa chos kyi rdo rje/ bco brgyad pa blo gros rin chen/ rin chen rgyal mtshan/byams mgon gnyis pa tshul khrims dar/ bsod nams lha'i 103

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/dbang po/ gcung bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ spyan snga chos grags rgyal mtshan/ mi tri don grub rin chen/ rgya ma ba sbyin pa ngag dbang kun dga' don 'grub/ sems dpa' sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang phun tshogs rnam rgyal/ tre bo nam mkha' bsam 'grub/ sems dpa' sku phreng drug pa ngag dbang phun tshogs bsod nams dpal bzang / slob chung pa snyan grags rnam rgyal/ sems dpa' sku phreng bdun pa blo bzang snyan grags rgya mtsho/sems dpa' sku phreng brgyad pa blo bzang ye shes grags pa rnam rgyal/sems dpa' sku phreng dgu pa blo bzang ye shes grags pa rgya mtsho/sems dpa' sku phreng bcu pa thub bstan nyin byed grags pa rgya mtsho/sems dpa' sku phreng bcu gcig pa blo bzang bshes gnyen rgya mtsho/byang gling bstan pa rab brtan/ dga' ldan rtse pa ngag dbang bstan 'phel/ bshes gnyen byams pa chos ldan/ sems dpa' sku phreng bcu gnyis pa lung rig chos 'byor rgya mtsho/ byang pa ngag dbang chos 'byor/ gzhogs pa sbyin pa don yod/ nyi sdings pa grags pa bstan 'dzin/ 'on rgyal sras 'jigs med blo gros/ sems dpa' sku phreng bcu gsum pa blo bzang thub bstan bshad sgrub rgya mtsho/ khang mo che ngag dbang rab brtan/a mdo reb rtsa sprul sku ngag dbang blo gros bstan pa/ sems dpa' sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bstan 'dzin dge legs chos kyi dbang phyug dge ba'i bshes gnyen tshul khrims dbyig gnyen/rgyud stod mkhan chen blo bzang shes rab bcas mkhan rabs lnga 104

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/bcu tsam byung / da dung dgon 'dir dmigs bsal gyi bka' drin che ba spyan snga ba'i slob ma bya yul pas sgrub khang nub kyi sgrub chu yod sa der sgrub chu dkyil du bzhag nas klu 'bum lha khang ka ba bcu drug khyams ra dang bcas pa gsar bzhengs dang/ de rjes gdan rabs dgu pa gtsang pa jo sras kyis dbu rtse gsar ma ka ba drug gsar bzhengs dang / gdan rabs bcu gcig pa kha lung pa rin chen seng shes dgon pa'i gling rgya bskyed kyis khyams ra smad gsar skrun dang / gos sku gsar bzhengs/sngon dge bshes spyan snga pa'i sgrub khang rgya bskyed kyis tsan dan shing der kun dga' ra ba btsugs/ de rjes gdan rabs bcu drug pa sangs rgyas dbon po gzhon nu smon lam gyi skabs su lo'i gdan sar gong grwa tshang dang / khang mo che'i grwa tshang /byang pa grwa tshang bcas grwa tshang khag gsum gsar 'dzugs kyis bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel/ gdan rabs nyer gnyis pa byams mgon gnyis pa tshul khrims dar rgyas kyis 'bri lugs kyi dbang bka' dang gar 'cham sogs kyi srol mdzad/ gdan rabs nyer gsum pa chos kyi rgyal po bsod nams lha'i dbang pos gong gi grwa tshang gsum gcig tu sgril te sngar dge bshes spyan snga pas ri'i chu 'gog ched du bskrun pa'i lcags rir mthud de dgon pa'i khor mo yug tu lcags ri gsar bsgrun mdzad cing cho ga phyag len yang phal che ba sa lugs su gyur ba ma zad sa lugs kyi srung ma gur zhal gnyis kyi sgo nas gar 'cham kyang mdzad/105

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/dus de nas bzung sa 'bri gnyis kyi gar 'cham de dus tshod nges med yin kyang lo ltar gtong srol yong/ de nas gdan rabs nyer bzhi pa gcung bsod nams rgyal mtshan gyi dus su sa lugs kyi cho ga dar khyab chen po byang ste kye rdor dang / bde mchog lu i pa/ gshed skor sogs tshugs te sgrub mchod dar/ bla brang ka bzhi gdung brgyad dang de'i shar du mgon khang zhig kyang bzhengs par grags/ de rjes gdan rabs nyer brgyad pa sems dpa' sku phreng lnga pa ngag dbang phun tshogs rnam rgyal gyi sku dus su dgon pa 'di'i sngar gyi sa 'bri gnyis kyi grub mtha' mang che ba dge lugs kyi grub mtha' ru gyur te ri bo dge lugs pa'i bshad sgrub kyi bstan pa rgya cher spel zhing / bla brang rgya bskyed dang /chos ra gsar bzhengs kyis bshad grwa gsar 'dzugs gnang /gdan rabs so gsum pa sems dpa' sku phreng brgyad pa blo bzang bshes gnyen grags pa rnam rgyal sems pa smyon pa'ang zer gyi skabs su stag rtse dpon mi dbang bsod nams stobs rgyal gyis sbyin bdag gnang ste lo'i dbu rtse rnying ma'i thog khar tshe dpag lha khang dang / dbu rtse gsar ma'i steng du gser zangs kyi rgya phibs gsar bzhengs gnang / de rjes gdan rabs so bzhi pa sems dpa' sku phreng dgu pa blo bzang bshes gnyen grags pa rgya mtsho mchog gis rgyal ba byams pa'i gos sku gsar bzhengs mdzad pa ma zad lo ba bla brang rgya bskyed kyis thog so gsum dang gser zangs kyi rgya phibs gsar bzhengs gnang / dus de 106

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang /de dag gi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/nas bzung dgon pa 'dir sa 'bri gnyis kyi gar 'cham tsam ma gtogs dge lugs gtsang mar gyur cing sngar yod sa 'bri gnyis kyi gar 'cham thog rang lugs kyi srung ma'i gar 'cham mdzad nas dus tshod kyang nges gtan gyis lo ltar bod zla 11tshes 30 nyin lo gnam gang mchod pa zhes bod kyi mchod pa chen po bzhi'i ya gyal du gyar te bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher spel bar bka' drin che ba lagazlo/ dus der lo spro khang yang gsar bzhengs mdzad/ gdan rabs zhe lnga ba sems dpa' sku phreng bcu gsum pa blo bzang thub bstan bshad sgrub rgya mtsho mchog nas lo ba bla brang lnga thog bzhengs 'go tshugs/ de rjes gdan rabs zhe brgyad pa sems dpa' sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bstan 'dzin dge legs chos kyi dbang phyug gi skabs su lo ba bla brang lnga thog legs par bzhengs grub kyang rig gsar skabs rtsa gtor du phyin/ gong gsal gyi gdan rabs mkhan po rim byon dag ni dpal lo dgon pa'i gdan sa rgyun 'dzin dang 'phel rgyas kyi khrod du mdzad rjes dmigs bsal can sha stag go de ltar dpal lo dgon pa 'di nyid thog mar phyag btab pa nas spyi lo 1959lo'i bar gyi lo rgyus kyi dus rim de'i nang grwa grangs mang dus sum stong lhag tsam dang zhung dus lnga bcu lhag tsam du gyur ba ༵༵༵ r+sha ṭ+wāṃ rgud sna tshogs shig brgyud myong ba ni kun dang gcig 107

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/(2) rgyun mchod cho ga phyag len sogs kyi skor/spyi lo 1959lo'i gong du dgon 'dir khyon lha khang lnga dang mgon khang gcig yod pa las/ (1)dge bshes spyan snga pa tshul khrims 'bar gyi sku dus nas phyag btab cing rjes su rim pas rgya bskyed byung ba'i lo'i gtsug lag khang dbu rtse ka ba bzhi dang /tshogs khang ka ba bcu drug gi nang rten gyi gtso bo sman 'dam las grub pa'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang po thog tshad ma dang / sman 'dam las grub pa'i dge bshes ston pa dang / rnal 'byor ba/dgon pa ba bcas kyi sku 'dra mi tshad ma dngul gyi gdung khang bzhengs pa/ sems sprul lnga pas bzhengs pa'i gser zangs kyi rje bdag nyid chen po'i sku brnyan thog tshad ma/ gsung gi rten du shog nag gi steng rin chen sna lngas bris pa'i 'bum g.yu khra can/thugs kyi rten du jo bo rjes gnang ba'i bum pa pad ma'i mchu can sogs sku gsung thugs rten mi nyung ba zhig yod pa dang /(2)dge bshes bya yul bas bzhengs pa'i klu 'bum lha khang ka ba bcu drug gi sbug tu rten gyi gtso bo sman 'dam las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa thog tshad ma zhal byang gzigs dang / lam rim bla brgyud cha tshang / tsan dan las grub pa'i gnas brtan gzhon nu smon lam gyi dmar gdung / rtog ldan sdings po ba dang /gnas brtan smon lam blo gros/ sangs rgyas dbon ston/ bcu bzhi pa tshul khrims mgon po bcas kyi gdung rten dngul las 108

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dbade dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/grub pa/ de bzhin mtshan byang mi gsal ba'i gdung rten gsum bcas khyon gdung rten brgyad bzhugs/ gsung gi rten du bka' 'gyar dang / bstan 'gyar gyis gtsos chos dpe mang po rtsig pa'i gzhogs gnyis su (rtsigs yod/ thugs kyi rten du spyan snga rin po che'i nang gi rten lnga zhes grags pa'i shar li'i mchod rten thog tshad ma lnga dang / shar li'i mchod rten chung ba brgya phrag mang po bzhugs/ de nas tshogs khang nang rten gyi gtso bo lo sems dpa' sku phreng bcu gsum pa blo bzang thub bstan bshad sgrub rgya mtsho'i sku dmar gdung bzhugs pa'i dngul gyi gdung rten thog tshad ma dang / 'dra sku sman 'dam las grub pa mi tshad ma/ de'i g.yon du sman 'dam las grub pa'i dge bshes spyan snga pa'i 'dra sku thog tshad ma/ de'i g.yon du sman 'dam las grab pa'i rje tshe 'dzin ma'i 'dra sku mi tshad ma/ de'i g.yon du bzlogs khri chen mo/ de'i g.yon du sems dpa' sku phreng bcu gnyis pa blo bzang snyan grags chos 'byor rgya mtsho'i dngul gyi gdung rten thog tshad ma/ 'dra sku sman 'dam las grub pa mi tshad ma/ de'i g.yon du shing gi steg bur sman 'dam las grub pa'i sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ bsil g.yang gi rtsig ldebs su 'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug dang / shar gyi rtsig ldebs su gsang ba 'dus pa/ spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong / bde mchog khro bo mi g.yo ba/ phyag rdor 'khor chen/'phags pa gnas brtan bcu drug nub kyi rtsig ldebs su 109

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang ma dzod/'jigs byed lha bcu gsum/ tshe 'phags lha dgu rgyal ba mi 'khrug pa/ sman bla bde gshegs brgyad/ lho'i rtsig ldebs su bstan srung khag gi ldebs ris dang / mgon po phyag drug chos rgyal/ rnam sras/ 'phrin las mgon po bcas dang / bsil g.yang gi khyams 'khor du dpon mi dbang pho lhas phul ba'i sman lha'i zhal thang dang / sgo mchor nang ma'i rtsig ldebs su chos skyong bco lnga'i ldebs ris bcas bzhugs/ (3)bstan ma khang ka ba bcu drug gi nang rten gyi gtso bo sman 'dam las grub pa'i thub dbang / gnas brtan bcu drug brag ri dang bcas pa thog tshad ma/ sman 'dam las grub pa'i lha mo nam mkha'i gos can thog tshad ma/ bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi gtso mo bkra shis tshe ring ma thog tshad ma/ lho'i rtsig ldebs su gzhi bdag a ce 'brog mo'i cha lugs can/(4)kha lung pa rin chen seng ges 'di nyid dge bshes kha lung pa sgang shākya yon tan dang ma nor ba dgos/phyag btab pa'i dbu rtse smad ka ba drug dang / thog khar gzim chung ka ba drug khyams ra smad ka ba so drug las dbu rtse smad ka ba drug gi nang rten gyi gtso bo gser zangs las grub pa'i thub dbang thog tshad ma dang / dzik+ṣi las grub pa'i jo bo lung bstan sgrol ma mi tshad chung ba tsam/ spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang gi dmar gdung dngul las bzhengs pa/shar li'i mchod rten brgya phrag g.yas g.yon du bka' 'gyar gyi chos rtsig thog khar sku bzang rab brtan zhes gzim mudro ka ba 110

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang /de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/drug gi nang shar li'i mchod rten brgya phrag gcig lhag yod/khyams ra smad ka ba so drug gi nang rten gyi gtso bo sman 'dam las grub pa'i gtsang pa rin po che rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang /sangs rgyas ston pa rdo rje gzhon nu/ zem rin po che grags pa seng she sangs rgyas ston pa tshul khrims seng ge ma bcu pa chos kyi rdo rje bcas kyi 'dra sku mi tshad ma/ byang gi gras 'gor sman 'dam las grub pa'i tshe lha rnam gsum thog tshad ma/ da dung ldebs ris mang po yod kyang sngon hor dmag gis dgon pa gtor skyon gtong skabs lha khang 'di'i nang me btang ste du dreg mang po bzos pas dus de nas bzung ldebs ris de dag mthong mi thub par gyur zhes grags/ (5)dbu rtse gong gi thog khar tshe dpag lha khang ka ba bzhi yi nang rten gyi gtso bo dpon mi dbang gi a ma'i 'khrungs rtags su bzhengs pa gser zangs las grub pa'i tshe dpag med thog tshad ma/ mtshan byang mi gsal ba'i dngul gyi gdung rten thog tshad ma gnyis/ bka' 'gyar bris ma pod brgya tham pa/ shar li'i mchod rten che chung sna phyogs brgya phrag lhag bzhugs/(6) khyams smad kyi sgo 'gram du mgon khang ka ba gnyis kyi nang srung ma'i gtso bo 'jim las grub pa'i mgon po gur dang /lha mo dung skyong ma/ lha mo nam gos ma bcas kyi 'dra sku thog tshad ma sogs sku rten byin rlabs can mang dag cig bzhugs pa bcas so/ / 111

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/spyi lo 1959lo'i gong gi dgon 'di'i dmigs bsal dus mchod dang cho ga phyag len khag ni lo ltar bod zla 1tshes 1nyin sgrol chog gi sgo nas tshogs phul ba dang / tshes 3nyin grwa tshang nas rgyal po lo gsar zhes rten 'brel gzab rgyas byed pa dang lo sems dpa' rin po che'i 'khrungs lha gsol/ tshes 15nyin dgon pa'i sku rgyab kyi mchod rten bkra shis mched lnga'i mdun mchod pa sna lnga dang / mchod me brgya mchod bshams te bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dang / khrus gsol rab gnas rgya che sgrub/tshes 24nas dus mchod chen mo zhes 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi bdag 'jug nyin bdun dang / nyin mjug mar sbyin sreg dang / de rjes bskang gso'i gtang rag nyin gcig sher snying bdud zlog gi cho ga nyin gcig rgyab bzhi'i mdos nyin gcig bod zla 2nang rgyun ja dang yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong ma gtogs dmigs bsal dus mchod med/ bod zla 3tshes 8nas brgyad gtor chen mo zhes nyin bdun ring bskang gso mgon po phyag drug dang / chos rgyal/ rnam sras/ tshangs pa/gri gug 'phrin las mgon po/ mgon po zhal/ mgon po beng /lha mo nam gos ma bcas kyi gsol mchod phul/ bod zla 3tshes 30nas bod zla 5tshes 10bar nyin bzhi bcu'i ring chog grwa khag bgos kyis rgyud sde bzhis gtsos pa'i dkyil 'khor bcu gnyis tshogs srol yod pa dang / nyin mjug ma'i dgong mo bkra shis spos skor gyi sgo nas tshogs grol/ bod zla ldanang rgyun 112
