'phan yul gyi bka' gdamasapa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagiphyaga'adebasapa po'i lorgyus/ja dang yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong ma gtogs dmigs bsal dus mchod med/ bod zla 6tshes 1nas 7bar rab gnas chen mo zhag bdun dang / tshes 15nyin zhigs pa 'du khang thog kha nas snyan gsan phul rjes grwa mang nas ser phreng gzab rgyas dang /mi ser nas gzab mchor legs par spras te gos sku gdan 'dren dang 'grem ston zhu ba/ bla ma sems dpa' rin po che dbu bzhugs thog mkhan po dbu mdzad dge 'dun dang bcas pas zhal thang la khrus gsol rab gnas dang / bla ma mchod pa dang / bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam sogs kyi sgo nas thugs smon rgya che gnang srol yod/ de'i nyin snga dro yul phyogs gang sa nas dad ldan ser skya stong tsho mang po gnas 'dir 'du 'dzoms kyis gos sku dang bla ma'i zhal mjal dang / lha khang khag la rten mjal sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa'i dus bzang khyad par can zhig srung rtsi dang / phyi dro gzhas dang zhabs bro skyon nas dga' spro'i dpal la rol bzhin pa ma zad tshes 15nas rtsis pa'i nyin gsum ring lo'i bro ba dang lha mo ba/ klung shod kyi gzhas dmangs sogs nas bro dang lha mo sgor gzhas sogs 'khrab ston gyis bstan pa rgyas shing 'gro rnams skyid pa'i dus ston zhig srung brtsi dang / da dung dus yun de'i ring lha sa sogs yul phyogs gang sa nas tshong pa brgya phrag mang po gnas 'dir 'dzoms te dbyar dus kyi tshong 'dus shig kyang tshugs gnang gi yod/ bod zla 6tshes 18nas nyin bzhi bcu zhe lnga'i 113

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/ring dbyar gnas tshugs shing de'i ring dmigs bsal gyi dus mchod med kyang bod zla 7tshes 1nas dbu 'dzugs kyis sbyor chos nyin gsum dang / sman bla rgyas pa nyin bzhi tshogs/ bod zla 8nang rgyun ja dang yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong ma gtogs dmigs bsal dus mchod med/ bod zla 9tshes 22nas dbu 'dzugs kyis kun rig nyin bdun tshogs shing nyin mjug mar dbus dang byang sogs kyi tshe 'das rnams la sbyang chog gnang srol yod/ bod zla 10tshes 20nas thugs dam dpag dka' ma chen mo zhes lo dgon pa dang / klung shod spyi bo dgon pa/ chums nyi sdings dgon pa sogs dgon khag gsum gyi bla grwa rnams gnas 'dir 'dzoms nas rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyar dag klog dang / tshes 25nyin dga' ldan lnga mchod song nyirno gung bla ma mchod pa'i sgo nas gsol tshogs phul zhing / dgong mo gdugs dkar dang / sgrol ma/ zhabs brtan khag cha gsum/ lha mo dam can bcas gsung / nyin mjug mar bkra shis spos skor dang / dmigs rtse ma'i rta ring 'don bzhin tshogs grol/ bod zla 11tshes 12nas lha mi kun gyi dus ston lo gnam gang mchod pa'i sbyor ba rim par sgrub dgos pa ni thog mar gtor ma bzhengs pa dang dkar rgyan bzo ba/ de rjes tshes 14dgong mo yar tshogs kyi 'ding brgyab nas mchod par byin rlabs 'jug pa dang zhabs brtan gnang / sa dzub mtshams snyan gsan phul/ tshes 15nas bskang gso/ tshes 114

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang /de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lorgyus/25nyin zhogs tshogs grol rjes sor bshag ces dge 'dun rnams nas gzab sbyor gang legs kyis gar 'cham thog ma de phul ba dang / tshes 28dang 29la 'cham gos gyon nas 'cham chung dang 'cham chen zhes nyin gnyis ring dngos gzhi'i gar 'cham phul / dgong mo mnga' gsol rjes lha zhol zhes 'brog pa rnams nas rta nor sogs khrid de tshe thar gtong srol dang /gtang rag gi mchod pa phul nas tshogs grol/ tshes 30nyin mchod pa sna lnga gzhung sgo'i gsham du bsgrigs nas dam chen chos rgyal gyi zhal thang bshams pa dang / dge 'dun rnams kyis gtor sgrub tshar rjes gtor ra nang mar dmar chen gtor ma bzhag ste zhal 'don sgrub rjes g.yas ru g.yon ru zhes dung dang /rnga/ rkang gling / sbub chal/ sil snyan bcas cha sgrig tu phebs/de nas dmar chen gtor ma gtor ra phyi ma'i 'cham ra'i mthil du bzhag mkhan po phebs nas gtor rgyab tu bzhengs/ dbu mdzad kyis dal po'i 'gros dang bcas gnas der phebs te gtor rgyag brgyab/ srung ma spyan 'dren gyis dpal mgon bram gzugs dang / dam chen chos rgyal / yum mchog tsa mu tri/ lha chen tshangs pa bcas kyi gar 'cham yang phebs/ srung ma rnams gar 'cham grub nas rkub stegs khri'u shing gi steng bzhugs rjes mang tshogs rnams kyis mjal kha zhu bzhin 'cham dar sgron/de rjes mnga' gsol dang gtang rag gi mchod pa phul nas tshogs grol/ bod zla 12 tshes 1nyin lo sems dpa' rin po 115

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/che dang / mkhan po dbu mdzad rnams kyis tshe sgrub kyi bka' dbang sgrub rjes khrir 'khod/ 'cham pa rnams nas dbang 'cham 'go tshugs te rim bzhin rnga 'gengs dang / byin 'bebs/zhwa nag tshe 'gugs/ gri 'gengs sogs gnang / de rjes sems dpa' rin po che nas 'chi med dpal ster gyi dbang gnang ba dang / dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyis rang rang gi 'khos dpag la gzhigs pa'i dngul dngos sna tshogs 'bul srol yod/ de'i dgong mo 'brong dar ma 'khrab pa dang / 'brong rdzi gnyis nas gzhas chen gtong ba/ mang tshogs nas sgor gzhas 'khrab pa sogs lha mi kun dga' spro'i dpal la rol/ bod zla 12 tshes 12nyin lo gtor brje ba dang / gur zhal gyi mdos bzhengs shing tshes 13nas tshogs nyin bdun ring bskang gso dang / tshes 19dgong mo gur zhal gyi mdos skyon/ tshes 29dgong mo gdugs dkar 'don pa dang cha gsum skyon rjes grwa mang kun dga' spro'i ngang dgu thug mchod bzhin lo gsar par bsu ba zhu ba'i gra sgrig la rol to//(3) rig gsar rjes dgon pa bskyar sgrun nyams gso ji ltar hās pa // /yod lta 'id/na pa'i phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rten gaṭīka' r+shadakā ༵ ba/na/ pa'i gnas gzhi byin rlabs can zhig tu gyur ba dpal ldan lo dgon pa 'di nyid bod ljongs spyi dang 'dra bar spyi lo 1959lo nas bzung dus zing sna tshogs kyi rkyen 116

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dag giphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/pas grwa ba lo chung rnams dgon par sdod thabs bral ba dang /bla grwa rgan pa rnams la gnas skabs chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus shig thob na yang khong tsho mang che ba lo na rgas te dgon pa do dam sogs kyi zungs nus yongs su nyams pa na spyi lo 1960lor dgon pa'i tshogs khang ka ba bcu drug dang / dbu rtse ka ba bzhi/ kla 'bum lha khang ka ba drug bcas 'byang ba me yi gnod pas dmirges med du bcom pa dang / skabazlo der grwa rgan rnams dang dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyis srog nyen la ma 'dzems par me bsad pa las dbu rtse smad ka ba drug dang /khyams smad ka ba so drug sku bzang rab brtan ka ba drug bcas la me skyon ma byang tsam byang na yang rjes su slar yang rig gnas gsar brje rnos yin spron phyin ci log tu spyod pa'i dus skabs de'i ring dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas pa yongs su rtsa gtor du song nas bya byi'u rnams smre sngags 'don sa'i gnas tsam las mi med lung stong du gyar/ 'on kyang mi bzhi shog khag thal ba'i rdul du brlag rjes chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus khag rim bzhin don 'khyol byang ste chos dad mang tshogs khri stong mang po dgun 'khyag gis ra( tu mnar ba'i srog ldan rnams la khu byag gi sgra thos pa bzhin dga' spro'i dpal la rol bzhin pa ma zajo/ khong tshor chos phyogs kyi byed sgo spel sa'i gnas gzhi zhig dgos pa kha tsha dgos gtugs su 'gyar ba'i skabs der lo sems dpa' sku phreng bcu bzhi pa bstarno 'dzin dge legs chos 117

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/kyi dbang phyug gam mtshan gzhan 'phrin las chos bzang mchog kyang dkar 'don gnang ste lha sa grong khyer chos tshogs kyi u yon la gnas spar byung ba na/dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyis khong la re 'dun bton pa ltar khong nas dgon pa bskyar bzhengs bya rgyu'i 'gan khur gtso bzhes thog dam pa'i chos la lhag bsam shin tu dkar ba'i sbyin bdag mkhas grub klu dbang dang /bstan 'dzin byams pa/ bkra shis bsam grub/ kun dga' dbang 'dus sogs dang / skabs der sdom gtsang du gnas pa dge tshul khrims dbyig gnyen dang / grags pa chos 'byor/mkhas grub thabs mkhas/ mkhyen rab dar rgyas/ byams pa tshe ring /byams pa rgya mtsho/ 'bras blo gling dge ye shes phan bde sogs nas kyang phya gru mnyam 'dregs kyis ma dngul thabs 'tshol dang grabs gsog gnang ba dang / gong rim la dgon pa bskyar bzhengs zhus chog pa'i chog mchan zhus pa brgyud rab byang bcu drug pa'i shing mo glang spyi lo 1985lor gong rim nazlo bka' khrol chog mchan phebs pa dang dus mtshungs mi dmangs shog sgor khri gsum gyi ma dngul gnang ba bcas la brten nas lo de ga'i bod zla 2tshes 15nyin nas dgon pa bskyar skrun nyams gso byed 'go tshugs shing dang thog dge bshes spyan snga pa'i sgrub khang nyams gso nas 'go tshugs kyis gnas der sa bshang skyon skabs sngar gyi tsan dan de nyid lo mang sa 'og tu bsdad kyang da dung ma rul bar bzhugs yod pa der tshang mas rten 'brel 118

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang /de dag gi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/bzang por gzigs te dga' spro tshad med byang ba dang / gong rim 'brel yod tshan pas kyang tsan dan gyi snang po der gzigs rtogs kyis ngo mtshar dang gdeng 'jog chen po gnang / de ltar sgrub khang steng gzim chung ka ba gnyis gsar bskrun gyis rgya che'i chos dad mang tshogs tsho'i gnas skabs kyi chos phyogs byed sgo spel sa zhig tu gyar/ de rjes sngar dgon pa de ga'i grwa pa yin pa rig gsar madros skya sa babs pa dbu mdzad dge legs dang /'cham dpon mkhas grub 'jam dbyangs/ dung pa rin blo/'jam gling pa bstan 'dzin byams pa/ mkhas grub bzang po/byams pa snyan grags/ dbu mdzad zla grags/ chos mdzad mkhyen rab phun tshogs/ chos mdzad pad ma tshe brtan/ nor dpon/ dga' dga' blo bzang / byams pa rgyal mtshan/ rgan 'jam dpal rnam rgyal sogs nas ma gros bsam pa gcig mthun gyis sngar gyi dgon pa'i cho ga phyag len sogs chos phyogs kyi byed sgo khag nyams pa slar gso'i ched du sku ngal tshad med skyon gnang ba dang / skabs der sdom gtsang du bzhugs pa rnams nas dge phrag gso skyong gis khong tshor phyag dpe slob khrid dang /'don rta dobyangs sogs kyi sbyong brdar gang legs gnang ste chos phyogs kyi rmang gzhi sra brtan zhig 'dzugs rgyur 'bad rtson chen po gnang yod pa ma zad/ lo sems dpa' rin po che'i thugs rje'i bka' drin dang / dgon pa'i grwa dmangs dang dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyis thugs che'i rgyab skyor la brten nas 119

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/dgon pa'i gzhi khyon yang rim bzhin rgya bskyed byung ste dbu rtse ka ba bzhi dang / brtan ma khang ka ba drug 'du khang ka ba bcu drug thog phyi nang gi sgo mchor sogs bskyar bskrun legs sgrub byung nas nang gi sku gsung thugs rten yang gang la gang 'tsham zhig bskyar bzhengs thub yod pa ni/ (1)dbu rtse ka ba bzhi yi nang zhal ras gser zangs dang gzhan rnams 'jim las grub pa'i jo bo shākya mu ne thog tshad ma/ de'i mdun du sems sprul bcu bzhi pa'i yongs 'dzin reb rtsa sprul sku'i 'jim brnyan khru tshad ma/ rgyud stod mkhan chen blo bzang shes rab nas phul ba'i sman 'dam gyi thub pa'i sku khru tshad ma/ lo pa bstan 'dzin byams pa nas phul ba'i thub dbang dang / gnas brtan bcu drug dge bsnyen dharma/ ha shang / rgyal chen rigs bzhi sogs gser zangs kyi sku rnying khru tshad ma grangs nyer lnga tsam/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen spyan snga pa'i chibs rta'i sga shing las grub pa cha gcig gsung gi rten du rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang / rje tsong kha pa'i gsung 'bum dang byang chub lam rim chen mo bcas bzhugs su gsol/ (2)mgon khang ngam bstan ma khang ka ba drug gi nang 'jim las grub pa'i mgon po gri gug dang /sprel gdong drag po can/ lha mo nam mkha'i gos can bcas dang /gsung rten du mgon po phyag drug dang / chos rgyal/ gri guga'aphrin las mgon po/ mgon po gur zhal/ rnam sras/ tshangs pa/lha mo nam gos ma sogs kyi bskang gso phyogs sgreg zhus pa cha tshang 120

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/gcig (3)khyams stod dam 'du khang ka ba bcu drug gi nang rten gyi gtso bo dge bshes spyan snga pa dang / rje tshe 'dzin ma'i 'jem sku mi tshad ma/ lo grwa blo bzang mkhas btsun nas phul ba'i sman bla'i 'jem sku mi tshad chung ba tsam/ dge byams pa tshe ring gis phul ba'i sman 'dam las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa khru tshad ma/ sems sprul dang po blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi 'dra sku thog tshad ma/ 'jim las grub pa'i 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum thog tshad ma/ dge blo bzang mkhas btsun nas bzhengs pa'i 'jim las grub pa'i thub pa'i sku thog tshad ma/ 'brog rig 'dzin rdo rje nas phul ba'i dzik+ṣi las grub pa'i slob dpon gyi sku tho tshad ma/ dge ye shes phan bde nas phul ba'i sgrol ma'i zhal thang rnying pa spus legs gcig snyan grags nas phul ba'i ltung bshags so lnga'i thang ga rnying pa spus legs gcig da dung gsung gi rten du pad ma rgyal po lags nas phul ba'i bka' 'gyur dpe rnying pod gsum dang / byams pa snyan grags nas phul ba'i sems dpa' sku phreng bcu gsum pa'i phyag bris gnang ba'i brgyad stong pod gcig 'bum par ma pod bcu gnyis/nyi khri pod gsum/ da dung gzungs bsdus dang brgyad stong sangs rgyas tshe 'bum sogs kyang bzhugs su gsol ba bcas so/ thugs kyi rten du spyi lo 1986lor sa 'og nas thon pa'i shar li'i mchod rten khru do tsam byas pa byin rlabs can gcigashar nub gnyis su shar li'i mchod rten tho gang dang sor lnga tsam 121

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/byas pa grangs bcu gcig sems dpa' sku phreng dang po nas bcu gsum bar gyi spyi 'thus su dngul gyi gdung rten thog tshad ma phra rgyan can spus legs gcig spyi lo 1989lor dngul bzo ba skad grags can ngag dbang gis dngul rnying las bzhengs pa'i mchod rten mi tshad che ba tsam yod pa de'i sgo khyim nang bar dgon pa'i mkhan po dge thub bstan nas rig gsar skabs nyar tshags zhus pa'i lo sems dpa' sku phreng dang po blo gros rgyal mtshan gyi 'dra sku gser zangs las grub pa tho gang lhag tsam byas pa de dang / de snga'i gdung rten nas byung ba rig gsar skabs gzhan gyis nyar tshags zhus te rjes su kun khang gsar gyi rnam rgyal tshe ring nas blu yon phul te lo dgon par phul ba'i spyan snga bsod nams lha dbang gi phyag g.yas pa/ khyim bdag byams pa blo gros nas rig gsar skabs nyar tshags zhus te phul ba'i shar li'i mchod rten/ de bzhin lo sems dpa' rin po che la bla sprul khag dang dad ldan sbyin bdag khag nas phul ba'i rgya gar paṇa grub rnams kyi na bza' dang byin rten/ sangs rgyas 'od srang gi ring bsrel/ sgom chen dkar po'i pags pa/ bla ma sdus chen dam pa mang po'i byin rten sogs srid 'dir rnyed par dka' ba'i rdzas sna dang gzungs gzhug gis legs par gtams pa ma zad lo de ga'i bod zla 4tshes 5nyin dpal ldan rgyud stod kyi mkhan po dge blo bzang shes rab dang / bar mkhan po ngag dbang chos grags/ lo mkhan po tshul khrims dbyig gnyen 122

'phan yul gyi bka' gdamasapa'i dgon pa brgyad dang/de dgagi phyag 'debs pa po'i lorgyus/sogs dbu bzhugs thog dgon pa'i grwa mang yongs nas mchod rten de nyid gtso bo gyar ba'i dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas par khrus gsozlo rab gnas rgya che zhig gnang ba dang / de rjes lo de ga'i bod zla 9tshes 22nyin sems dpa' rin po che 'phrin las chos bzang nas mchod rten de nyid kyi grub ston phyir 'gan khur rkang bzhes thog bod kyi bla sprul che khag rwa sgreng bstan 'dzin 'jig med dang / stag lung brtse ba sprul sku thub bstan rgyal mtshan/ dgon pa gsar sprul sku sogs bla sprul brgyad tsam dang / dgon pa'i grwa dmangs yongs nas slar yang mchod rten de nyid gtso bor gyar ba'i dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas par khrus gsol sdob gnas rgya che zhig mdzad pa dang chabs cig dad ldan ser skya rnams la bla ma skyes chen dam pa mang po dus gcig tu zhal mjal gsung thos kyi bkra shis pa'i nyin mo zhig kyang 'char/ 2006lor lo sems dpa' rin po che dang /sbyin bdag blo bzang thogs med gnyis nas 'cham rar rdo gcal bting pa dang / 2008lor dgon pas slar yang klu 'bum lha khang ka ba nyi shu dang / dbu rtse smad ka ba bzhi/ sku bzang rab brtan ka ba bzhi bcas bskyar sgrun legs sgrub kyis slad de dag nang sku rten sogs bzhengs grub rjes dgon pa 'di nyid sngar gyi dgon pa'i —gzhi khyon rang sor chud pa sogs rten 'brel bzang po zhig sgrig bzhin pa'o//123

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/(5) deng skabs dgon pa'i dmigs bsal dus mchod dang /cho gaphyagalenasogasakyi skor/deng skabs dgon par grwa grangs 47tsam yod pa de dag gis rgyun du ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i gzhung lugs spyi dang bye brag dgon pa 'di ga'i cho ga phyag len dang sgom sgrub nyams len sogs la brtson pa hur len zhu bzhin pa'i rmang gzhi'i thog lo gcig gi dgon pa'i cho ga phyag len khag ni bod zla 1tshes 1nyin lo gsar pa'i rten 'brel gyi phyir sgrol chog gi cho ga dang / tshes gsum nyin lo sems dpa' rin po che'i 'khrungs lha gsol /dgon pa spyi nas rgyal po lo gsar zhes dmigs bsal gyi lo gsar gtong srol yod/ tshes 15nyin dgon pa'i sku rgyab kyi mchod rten bkra shis mched lnga'i mdun mchod pa sna lnga dang /mchod me brgya mchod bshams te bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga dang /khrus gsol rab gnas rgya che sgrub/ tshes 24nas dus mchod chen mo zhes 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi bdag 'jug nyin bdun dang / nyin mjug mar sbyin sreg dang / de rjes bskang gso'i gtang rag nyin gcig sher snying bdud zlog gi cho ga nyin gcig rgyab bzhi'i mdos nyin gcig bod zla 2nang rgyun ja dang yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong ma gtogs dmigs bsal dus mchod med/ bod zla 3tshes 8nas brgyad gtor chen mo zhes nyin bdun ring bskang gso gtong / bod zla 4tshes 8nas ma ṇi 'bum sgrub nyin bdun/ tshes 16zhigs pa tshogs 124

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/grol rjes ser phreng sgrig ste 'du khang la skor ba gsum skyon/nyin gung gi tshogs su mang tshogs la thugs rje chen po'i dbang dang ma ṇi ril bu gnang / dgong mo bkra shis spos skor gyis tshogs grol/ bod zla ldanang rgyun ja dang yar ngo mar po'i gso sbyong ma gtogs dmigs bsal dus mchod med/ bod zla 6tshes nyanas 7bar rab gnas chen mo zhag bdun dang / tshes 15nyin zhogs pa 'du khang thog kha nas snyan gsan phul rjes grwa mang nas ser phreng gzab rgyas dang / mi ser nas gzab mchor legs par spras te gos sku gdan 'dren dang 'grem ston zhu ba/ bla ma sems dpa' rin po che dbu bzhugs thog mkhan po dbu mdzad dge 'dun dang bcas pas zhal thang la khrus gsol rab gnas dang / bla ma mchod pa dang / bstan pa rgyas pa'i smon lam sogs kyi sgo nas thugs smon rgya che gnang / de'i nyin snga dro yul phyogs gang sa nas dad ldan ser skya stong tsho mang po gnas 'dir 'du 'dzoms kyis gos sku dang bla ma'i zhal mjal/ lha khang khag la rten mjal sogs bsod nams kyi tshogs gsog pa'i dus bzang khyad par can zhig srung rtsi dang / phyi dro gzhas dang zhabs bro skyon nas dga' spro'i dpal la rol bzhin pa ma zad tshes 15nas rtsis pa'i nyin gsum ring lo'i bro ba dang lha mo ba nas bro dang lha mo sgor gzhas sogs 'khrab ston gyis bstan pa rgyas shing 'gro rnams skyid pa'i dus ston zhig dga' gtong dang /da dung dus yun de'i ring lha sa sogs yul phyogs gang sa nas 125

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/tshong pa brgya phrag mang po gnas 'dir 'dzoms te dbyar dus kyi tshong 'dus shig kyang tshugs/ bod zla 6tshes 16nas bod zla 7tshes 30bar dbyar gnas tshugs shing dgag dbye nyin 3gtong /bod zla 7 tshes 1nas sbyor chos nyin gsum dang / sman bla nyin bzhi tshogs/ bod zla 8nang rgyun ja dang yar ngo mar ngo'i gso sbyong ma gtogs dmigs bsal dus mchod med/ bod zla 9tshes 22nas dbu 'dzugs kyis kun rigs nyin bdun tshogs shing nyin mjug mar dbus dang byang sogs kyi tshe 'das rnams la sbyang chog gnang srol yod/ bod zla 10tshes 20nas thugs dam dpag dka' ma zhes bka' 'gyar dag klog dang / tshes 25nyin dga' ldan lnga mchod song sgron gung bla ma mchod pa'i sgo nas gsol tshogs phul zhing / dgong mo gdugs dkar dang /sgrol ma/ cha gsum/ lha mo dam can bcas gsung / nyin mjug mar bkra shis spos skor dang / dmigs rtse ma'i rta ring 'don bzhin tshogs grol/ bod zla 11tshes 12nas lha mi kun gyi dus ston lo gnam gang mchod pa'i sbyor ba rim par sgrub dgos pa ni thog mar gtor ma bzhengs pa dang dkar rgyan bzo ba/de rjes tshes 14dgong mo yar tshogs kyi 'ding brgyab nas mchod par byin rlabs 'jug pa dang zhabs brtan gnang /sa rub mtshams snyan gsan phul/ tshes 15nas bskang gso/tshes 25nyin zhogs tshogs grol rjes sor bshag ces dge 'dun rnams nas gzab sbyor gang legs kyis gar 'cham thog ma de 126

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagaphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/phul pa dang / tshes 28dang 29la 'cham gos gyon nas 'cham chung dang 'cham chen zhes nyin gnyis ring dngos gzhi'i gar 'cham phul/ dgong mo mnga' gsol rjes lha zhol zhes 'brog pa rnams nas rta nor sogs khrid de tshe mthar gtong srol dang / gtang rag gi mchod pa phul nas tshogs grol/ tshes 30nyin mchod pa sna lnga gzhung sgo'i gsham du bsgrigs nas dam chen chos rgyal gyi zhal thang bshams pa dang / dge 'dun rnams kyis gtor sgrub tshar rjes gtor ra nang mar dmar chen gtor ma bzhag ste zhal 'don sgrub rjes g.yas ru g.yon ru zhes dung dang /rnga/ rkang gling / sbub chal/ sil snyan bcas cha sgrig tu phebs/ de nas dmar chen gtor ma gtor ra phyi ma'i 'cham ra'i mthil du bzhag mkhan po phebs nas gtor rgyab tu bzhengs/ dbu mdzad kyis dal po'i 'gros dang bcas gnas der phebs te gtor rgyag brgyab/ srung ma spyan 'dren gyis dpal mgon bram gzugs dang / dam chen chos rgyal / yum mchog tsa mu tri/ lha chen tshangs pa bcas kyi gar 'cham kyang phebs / srung ma rnams gar 'cham sgrub rjes rkub stegs khri'u shing gi steng bzhugs nas mang tshogs la mjal kha btang rjes mang tshogs rnams kyis mjal kha zhu bzhin 'cham dar sgron/de rjes mnga' gsol dang gtang rag gi mchod pa phul nas tshogs grol/ bod zla 12tshes 12nas lo gtor brje ba dang /sgrol ma g.yu zlog gi mdos bzhengs te tshes 19nyin mdos phul/127

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/tshes 29dgong mo gdugs dkar 'don pa dang cha gsum skyon rjes grwa mang kun dga' spro'i ngang dgu thug mchod bzhin lo gsar par bsu ba zhu ba'i gra sgrig la rol to/ deng skabs bod zla 6tshes 15nyin 'grem ston zhu bzhin pa'i gos sku rnam rgyal dpal 'bar 'di nyid gsar bzhengs je ltar zhus pa'i skor la cung zad gling na/ dgon 'di'i gdan rabs bcu gcig pa kha lung pa rin chen seng ges gsar bzhengs zhus pa'i lo'i gos sku che ba mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po la gnas brtan bcu drug gis bskor ba dang / dgon 'di'i gdan rabs so bzhi pa sems dpa' sku phreng dgu pa blo bzang bshes gnyen grags pa rgya mtsho mchog gis gsar bzhengs zhus pa'i gos sku chung ba rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan de gnyis kyis mi thog mang por dad ldan mang tshogs kyi bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing sa ru gyar kyang spyi lo 1960lor dgon par me skyon byang skabs gos sku de gnyis kyang me lha'i zhal du gsol te rtsa mejo du gyar/ dus de nas bzung spyi lo 2000lo bar gos sku bltar bzhengs zhu mi thub cing spyi lo 2001lor lo sems dpa' rin po ches 'gan khur gtso bzhes thog dgon pa'i grwa mang yongs nas bka' gros gang legs gnang ba brgyud sngar gyi gos sku de gnyis kyi 'thus tshab lta bur gos sku che ba zhig gsar bzhengs gnang rgyur mos mthun gyis stag lung rtse sprul rin po che brgyud nas lha bris pa rdo rje rgyal mtshan dang / stag lung dgon pa'i sku zhabs dpal 'bar dang 128

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgogaphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/bkra shis sogs khyon mi drug gis lo de ga'i spyi zla 4pa nas 'go 'dzugs kyis nyin bzhi bcu lhag tsam skya bris dang / de nas lo de ga'i spyi zla 9tshes 30nas dbu 'dzugs kyis mal gro gung dkar rdzong rtsa zhol shang gi 'tshem bzo ba de sngon 'bri gung pa'i na bza' chen mo phun tshogs lags dang / khong gi bu dge bsnyen chos 'phel gyis lo gsum ring 'tshem drub zhus pa brgyud mthar gos sku rnam rgyal dpal 'bar de nyid rab byang bcu bdun pa'i shing sprel lo'i bod zla 6tshes 15spyi lo 2༄04lo'i zla ba 7tshes 21nyin legs par bsgrubs te slar yang 'gro ba'i bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing sa ru gyar/ gos sku de'i me long ngos su jo bo rje sogs bka' gdams zlo ma rnams dang / lhag pa'i lha bcas zhal grangs nyer lnga mchis shing sku brnyan de dag gi go rim 'jog tshul ni dbus su jo bo rje dang / de'i g.yas su rgyal ba 'brom ston pa/ g.yon du ngog legs pa'i shes rab/ steng gi dbus su ston pa thub pa'i dbang po/ de'i 'og g.yas phyogs su 'phags pa thogs med/ de'i g.yas su spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa/ g.yon du gser gling pa/ rim pa de mtshungs g.yon phyogs su mgon po klu sgrub/ de'i g.yas su rig pa'i khu byugagayon du rje btsun sgrol ma sngon po/ de'i 'og g.yas phyogs su rgyal ba byams pa/ g.yon phyogs su rje btsun 'jam dbyangs/de'i 'og g.yas phyogs su khro bo mi g.yo ba/ g.yon phyogs su 'jam dbyangs nag po/ de'i 'og g.yas phyogs su po to ba/129

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/de'i g.yas su spyan snga pa/ g.yon du phu chung ba/ rim pa de mtshungs g.yon phyogs su dbus su rje tsong kha pa/ de'i g.yas su rgyal tshab rje/ g.yon du mkhas grub rje/ sems dpa' blo gros rgyal mtshan/ 'og tu g.yas nas rim pa bzhin mgon po gri gug 'phrin las mgon po/ dpal mgon bram gzugs/dpal ldan lha mo bcas rim par bzhugs su gsol/ de lta bu'i gos sku rtsa chen zhig bzhengs rgyur dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyis rgyab skyor dang lhag par byang gling bla ma dge legs ldan lags sogs kyis thugs khur zab bzhes gnang bar bka' drin lhag par che zhing bsod nams kyi tshogs rlabs po che bsags pa ni gdon mi za/(6) mchod rten mched lnga'i skor/dgon pa'i sku rgyab tu bzhugs pa'i bkra shis mched lnga zhes pa'i jo bo bka' gdams pa'i lugs kyi mchod rten lnga po 'di ni dge bshes spyan snga pas dgon 'di thog mar gsar bzhengs gnang skabs phyi'i rten du mchod rten gsum bzhengs pa ni nub kyi mchod rten gsum po de yin zhing / mchod rten gsum po 'di thog mar bzhengs skabs rtsig phreng re re la bkris mched lnga'i rab gnas dang / slob dpon na ga bo rnyi dngos su spyan drangs te byin rlabs shin tu che bar grags/ de bzhin nub nas rtsis pa'i mchod rten bzhi pa de ni spyan snga pa'i slob ma'i gtso bo dge bshes bya yul ba sku gshegs rjes khong gi slob ma rnams 130

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dnganade dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/kyis bzhengs pa yin zhing / mchod rten de'i nang du byin rlabs che ba'i gzungs gzhug dang mnyam du bya yul ba'i na bza' dang dbu lo sogs kyang bzhugs su gsol/ mchod rten lnga pa de ni skabs de'i sa lhag rdo lhag gis bzhengs pa yin zhes brjod/ mchod rten 'di dag rig gsar skabs gtor skyon chen po phog na yang rjes su dgon pa bskyar bzhengs zhu skabs mchod rten 'di dag kyang mnyam du bskyar bzhengs nyams gso zhus te dad ldan mang tshogs nas phul ba dang / dgon pa nas thabs 'tshol zhus pa'i byin rlabs can gyi gzungs gzhug gang legs phul gnang ba dang / rab gnas kyi cho ga rgya cher bsgrubs nas sngar bzhin byin rlabs can zhig tu gyur ro//

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/wa lubadagonadang de'iphyaga'adebasapa po khalung pa sgang shākya yonatana'ago brjod/'phan yul du yod pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dgon gnas dang po'i gras kha lung dgon de ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong lcang shar shang yul snga kha lung phu chen gyi ri 'dabs su chags shing dgon pa phyag btab nas da bar lo dgu brgya bzhi bcu lhag tsam song ba'i dgon gnas rnying gras shig yin/ lha sa nas rlangs 'khor du chu tshod gcig lhag tsam skyod na gnas der bde bar 'byor la lam bar du dbus kyi gram bu shel dkar zhes snyan grags gangs ljongs su khyab pa'i mchod rten byin rlabs can de yang mjal thub kyi yod/ dgon gnas 'di'i phyi'i khor yug ni rgyab ri bum pa ri/ mdun ri dbu zhwa ri ri de ni dbu zhwa sgro lug gi gzugs su grub/g.yas ri dung dkar ri/ g.yon ri rgyal ba ri lnga sogs sngo zhing dwangs ba'i spang ri dang / rtswa rtsi shing sna tshogs kyis brgyan pa'i rdza ri dang brag ri dag gis dgon pa'i mtha' nas bskor zhing / mdun ri dbu zhwa ri'i 'dabs kyi dus bzhir 'gyar ba med pa'i yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu mig de ni dgon 'do'i sku rten rnams la ched du yon chab phul ba lta bu'i 132

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagaphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/dmigs bsal khyad chos ldan pa dang / 'bras ldan ljon pas dgon 'dir dmigs bsal gyi mdzes rgyan sprad pa sogs dben gnas nyams bzang can zhig yod pa ni sku nyid gnas der phebs na shes so/ da ni dgon 'di'i ming gi byang tshul skor la cung zad dpyad na/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen sgang shākya yon tan mchog stod gangs rin po cher gangs skor du bskyod nas log phebs skabs gangs rdog po zhig bsnams te gangs de gang du lhung ba'i sar dgon pa phyag 'debs dgos dgongs pa na khong da lta dgon pa yod sa'i gzhogs g.yas der phebs te rdo'i bzhugs khri zhig gi thog ngal gsos nas bzhugs skabs gangs der lhung bas der dgon pa phyag gdab rgyu'i thugs thag bcad/des na dgon gnas 'di ni kha bas lung du bstan pa'i gnas shig tu gyur ba na dgon pa'i mtshan la kha lung dgon zhes thogs par grags la rjes su dgon pa'i mtshan bla mar thogs nas dge bshes kha lung pa zhes brjod par snyam/ gang ltar skabs der khong bzhugs sa'i rdo'i bzhugs khri de da lta dngos su mjal rgyu yod la gangs lhung sa'i gnas de las gangs kyi 'phel gdung zhes rdo dkar chung chung de 'dra da lta yang btsal rnyed thub kyi yod/ 'on kyang sngon gyi deb ther khag gi nang dge bshes khams pa lung pa dang / khams lung dgon zhes dang / kham lung pa dang kham lung dgon zhes pa sogs ma dag rgyun 'byams kyi 'bri tshul sna tshogs shig chags pa na slad nga tshos dgon 'di'i ming gi byung 133

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/tshul gyi lo rgyus dngos la gzhi bcol te dge bshes kha lung pa dang /kha luji dgon zhes bris na cung zad rgyu mtshan ldan la dag par snang ( 1//) dgon 'di'i thog ma'i phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus dang ji ltar phyag btab nas dar rgud ji byang skor/dgon 'di thog mar phyag 'debs pa po༄ bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po sku mched bzhir grags pa kha lung pa sgang shākya yon tan ni rab byang dang po'i shing mo glang spyi lo 1025lor 'phan yul yul rmo'i phur sku 'khrungs shing / khong gi rus sgang dang rten dge bsnyen / gzhon pa'i dus sde snod gsum la sbyang pa mdzad de/ nyid kyi zhal nas ngas lha sa snye thang du ba ma yin pa dang rta ma yin pa la mi tshe bskyal zhes grags/ snye thang du jo bo nyid dang mjal zhing phyis rwa sgreng du dge bshes ston pa yun ring du bstan/ de rjes rab byung dang po spyi lo 1065g.yas g.yon du kha lung dgon phyag btab cing / khong zhal bzhugs pa'i dus grwa pa mang dus nyis stong lhag tsam byang ba'i lo rgyus kyang yod/ po to ba'i zhal nas yul snga'i joge bshes sgang shākya yon tan gyis chos bden par bzung nas skyabs su mchi byas pas/ da lta yul snga lung pa na khong las bde skyid che ba med ces gsungs/ khong gis slob ma skyong skabs gnang ba'i blo sbyong gi khrid la/ blo sbyong thun brgyad ma zhes grags/ byang chub kyi thugs 'byongs bas thams cad dad par 134

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang/de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/gyar/ phyogs mtha' dag nas mjal mi byung ba na/ khyed cag gi tshul na mi rgan med dam zhes gsungs pa la/ mi rgan ta yod de khyed lta bu med ces zhus/ khong gis 'khor ba'i sdug bsngal gyis mnar ba'i sems can rnams la dgongs nas snying rje kho na bsgoms te bshums pa sogs/ mdor na khong ni mthong thos dran reg don ldan du 'gyar nges pa'i skyes bu chen por grags/de ltar khong gis dgung sgro go gcig bar rjes 'dzin slob ma skyong ba dang / sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs shing sems can gyi don mdzad nas rab byang gsum pa'i shing mo lug spyi lo 1115lo'i rta zla'i tshes rbecu la kha lung dgon du zhi bar gshegs/༈ yul ze/ rin po che'i slob ma dge bshes kha lung pa rin chen seng ge dang 'di nyid ma ra bas nga sazha/ la bzhugs pa'i dus su dgon gnas 'di nyid dam pa'i chos la thos bsam sgom gsum zhu sa'i bka' gdams pa'i dben gnas grags can zhig tu gyur na yang khong sku gshegs rjes grwa pa mang che ba sne'u zur pa'i sar 'khod de dgon gnas 'di nyid la dar rgud sna tshogs shig byang nas 1959gong du ser byes sba ti khang tshan gyis dgon drodag byed pa'i 'og dge slong brgyad grwa gcig rgyun bzhugs kyis sgom sgrub nyams len zhu sa'i dben gnas chung chung zhig tu gyar zhing skabs de'i dgon pa'i phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rterno ni 'du khang ka ba 26nang rten gyi gtso bo 'jim las grub pa'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang po dang / jo bo rje/ dge bshes kha lung pa bcas kyi 'dra sku mi tshad 135

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/ma dang / spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong gi g.yas g.yon du 'jam dbyangs dang rgyal ba byams pa rje yab sras gsum mi tshad ma/ da dung gsung gi rten du gser dngul las bris pa'i bka' 'gyar dang bstan 'gyar bcas bzhugs su gsol/ nyi thog tshozlos chen ka ba bzhi rnyi nang 'jim las grub pa'i rgyal ba 'brom ston pa dang / kha lung pa dbu zhwa lcang lo can/rgyal dbang lnga pa/ brag sgo rab 'byams pa/ khri chen 'jam dpal tshul khrims/ rta mgrin bcas kyi sku mi tshad ma dang /li las grub pa'i byang chub mchod rten mi tshad ma/ de bzhin gnas brtan bcu drug dang byang phyogs sham bha la'i dpe ris kyi zhal thang / bsam rtse dgon gyi srung ma mgon po phyag drug bcas bzhugs su gsol ba dang / sum thog gzim chung ka ba gnyis kyi nang 'jim las grub pa'i tshe lha rnam gsum dang / rje yab sras gsum/ rta mgrin gyi sku bcas dang / mgon khang ka ba bzhi yi nang 'jem las grub pa'i 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum dang /mgon chos lha lnga mi tshad ma/ rdo rje g.yu sgron/ sku lnga'i zhal /the/ ba'okha/ lung pa'i 'dod lha nag bris bcas bzhugs su (2) rig gsar rjes dgon pa bskyar bzhengs nyams gso ji ltar zhus nas da lta dgon pa'i phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rten sogs ji tsam yod pa'i skor/rig gsar rjes chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus rim bzhin 136

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/lag bstar don 'khyol byang nas lo shas song ba'i dus te bod rab byang bcu bdun pas sa mo sbrul spyi lo 1989lor gong rim 'brerla yod tshan pas dgon pa bskyar bzhengs dang nyams gso zhus chog pa'i bka' khrol thob pa brgyud yul snga phu shar gyi/a khu rdo rje tshe ring sogs tshes bcu'i dkyil 'khor gyi mi grangs bco brgyad dang ma zhing gi bu tshe ring / sngar ser dgon gyi grwa lha sdings sgang nas yin pa zhang blo bzang thogs med/ yul thang nas yin pa zhang ngag dbang chos grags/ de bzhin lha sdings sgang nas yin pa grwa phur bu tshe ring / mkhar khang blo bzang tshe brtan sogs kyis 'gan khur gtso bzhes thog ma dngul bsdu slong dang yul snga khul gtso bor 'gyur ba'i dad ldan ser skya mang pos thugs che'i rogs ram gnang ba brgyud shing bzo ba skal bzang stobs rgyal gyis ar po'i 'gan khur gyis dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas pa nyams gso bskyar skrun gang tsam zhig zhu thub pa ma zad rab byang bcu bdun pa'i chu pho sprel spyi lo 1992lor rang cag 'pharno yul gyi rtsa ba'i bla mar gyar ba ser smad dge bshes ye shes byams pa mchog dgon 'dor zhabs sor 'khod de dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas pa la rab gnas kyi cho ga rgya che gnang nas bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po sgang shākya yon tan nam dge bshes kha lung ba'i gdan sa byin can 'di nyid slar yang dad ldan ser skya mang pos mjal ba'i gnas bzang zhig tu gyur cing da lta dgon pa'i 137

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/phyi'i gzhi khyon la ka ba nyer drug tsam yod pa las 'du khang ka ba brgyad kyi nang rten gyi gtso bo dkyil du 'jim las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa mi tshad ma dang / de'i g.yas g.yon du 'jam dbyangs dang phyag rdor gyi sku khru tshad ma/ rigs gsum mgon po'i sku rgyab tu g.yas nas rtsis pa'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang po de sbyin bdag pa sangs tshe ring gis phul ba dang de'i 'gram du jo bo rje/ sbyin bdag bsod nams ye shes kyis phul ba'i rje yab sras gsum/sbyin bdag mkhar khang blo bzang grags pas phul ba'i dge bshes kha lung pa bcas kyi 'jim sku mi tshad ma/ de dag gi g.yas g.yon du srang ma'i gtso bo rnam sras dang mgon po phyag drug de brkon ltung bshags kyi thang kha rnying pa zhig dang / gnas brtan bcu drug mgon chos lha lnga bcas kyi thang kha cha tshang / gsung gi rten du bka' 'gyur cha tshang gahās/yo da dung bla ma'i bzhugs khri zhig kyang bzhugs su ga rdo ya// dgon pa'i g.yon ngos kha dog ser po yin don ni sngon rgyal dbang lnga ba dgon 'dir chibs sgyur gnang skabs khong gi bzhugs gnas la sku dkar ser po sgron pa nas bzung lugs srol de 'dra zhig da bar rgyun mthud pa yin/ de bzhin dgon pa'i nub der sngar gyi mchod rten lnga po de dag rang gnas su nyams gso zhus yod pa ni dga' 138

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/ldan khri thog don gnyis pa khri chen 'jam dpal tshul khrims dang / khong gi yang srid khri ngag dbang blo bzang / khri dpal bzang po bcas kyi gdung rten dang / de'i g.yon zur du byang chub mchon rten zhig dang / de'i nub kyi mchod rten de ni skyab rje khri byang rin po che mchog gis rgyu 'byor yon bdag gnang ba'i bka' drin las byang chub mchon rten gyi gzungs bzhug tu gser yig las grub pa'i bka' 'gyur cha tshang zhig phul yod pa bcas so/kyi 3) dgon pa'i dus mchod dang cho ga phyag len sogs /nga/ skabs dgon 'dir grwa grangs dgu yod pa de dag gis gcig nas yul de ga'i dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyi shi gson gyi zhabs rim khag sgrub pa dang / gnyis nas grwa gsar rnams la cho ga phyag len sogs gyi slob gnyer dang rgyun gtan chos phyogs kyi byed sgo khag gang legs sgrub bzhin pa ni lo ltar bod zla 1tshes 3nyin yul de ga'i dad ldan mang tshogs ha cang mang po dgon par 'du 'dzoms kyis dar chen sku bzhengs kyi mdzad sgo zab rgyas bshams nas sman bla'am bde mchog gang rung gi sgo nas cho ga sgrub pa ma zad bstan dang 'gro la sman pa'i smon lam gang mang gsog sgrub zhu ba dang / de bzhin zla re'i nya stong brgyad gsum sogs chos phyogs kyi dus chen khag la sman bla dang /139

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/sgrol chog gnas brtan phyag mchod sogs kyi cho ga gang rung sgrub shing tshes 29rtag tu bskang gso gtong ba bcas dgon 'di'i 'khos dpag la gzhigs pa'i zhabs rim khag gang thub sgrub bzhin yod/ de yang kha lung dgon 'di ni dang thog dge bshes kha lung pa mchog gis jo bo bka' gdams pa'i chos rgyun zab mo de nyid dar spel gnang sa'i gnas gzhi zhig tu gsar skrun gyis thos bsam sgom gsum la byang chub pa'i snod ldan gyi slob ma stong tsho mang po gso skyong gnang ba dang rjes su rim bzhin bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa mang che ba bka' gdams gsar ma ste dge lugs par gyur ba ltar dgon pa 'di yang dge lugs su gyur ba nas bzung da bar ri bo dge lugs pa'i phyag rgyun gtsang mar skyong bzhin pa bcas so// /

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dgade dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/drug sne'u zur dgona~X/shāḥpa/debasapa po sne'u zur 'go brjod/chos brgyad dri mas ma gos khyad 'phags sku/ gzhan phan kho nar dmigs pa'i legs bshad gsungs/zab mo ting 'dzin sgom la 'gran bral thugs//mkhas mchog sne'u zur zhabs la gus phyag 'bul//'phan yul du bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis 'gro ba'i don du dam chos gser gyi 'khor lo bar med du bskor sa'i gnas khyad par can mang po zhig phyag btab yod pa'i khrod nas sne'u zur dben pa'i dga' tshal 'di ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong sum 'phreng shang gi nye 'dabs su yod cing lha sa nas rlangs 'khor du chu tshod gcig dang skar bco lnga tsam skyod na bde bar 'byor/dgon 'di phyag btab nas da bar lo dgu brgya lhag tsam song zhing dgon pa'i phyi'i bkod pa ni dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil ba lta bu'i ri bo'i ngos su shing tshar pa dang / se ba/ sgro ba/ kham sdong sogs nags tshal stug pos rab tu brgyan zhing / shang shang chu mo mdun nas rgyug pa sogs mdzes sdug rnam par bkra ba'i ldum rwa zhig dang gnyis su ma mchis/141

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/de lta bu'i rdza ri dang / nags tshal/ spang ljongs bcas kyis legs par brgyan pa'i ri ldebs su g.yon du mchod rten 'bum mo che sogs mchod rten chen po bcu gnyis dang / g.yas phyogs su dgon pa'i 'du khang dang / byams khang / rung khang / grwa shag sogs bsod nams gsog pa'i zhing sa ru gyar ba'i dben pa'i ri khrod khyad par can zhig skye bo'i 'dren byejo lam du mngon sum du mjal rgyu yod/da ni sne'u zur dgon zhes pa'i ming gi byang tshul skor la cung zad brjod na sne'u zur zhes pa'i ming de rno da lta dgon pa yod sa'i mdun der spras sne'u zur thong pa sgang zhes gyang ro 'dra ba'i sbungs tho 'ga' zhig yod pa de dge bshes sne'u zur pa thog mar sku 'khrungs sa de yin pa dang / da lta dgon pa yod sa'i shar ngos kyi ri sul nas kha byang la phyogs te gang mtshams skyod na ri gdong zhig tu gyang ro 'ga' zhig mthong rgyu yod pa de ni spras sne'u zur dben pa'i sgang zhes khong thog mar sku mtshams la bzhugs sa de yin zhing de ltar spras zhes pa ni deng skabs sum 'phreng shang gi mnga' khongs su gyar ba'i yul spyi'i ming la spras kyi nang zhes brjod cing de ga'i tshul mi rnams kyis spas kyi nang zhes brjod/sne'u zur zhes pa ni skabs der dgon pa gnas sa'i brgyud kyi khor yug spyi'i ming yin pa na rjes su sa ming mi la thogs nas dge bshes sne'u zur pa zhes dang sa ming dgon par thogs te sne'u zur dgon pa zhes btags par snyam mo/142

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/(1) dgon 'di'i thog ma'i phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus dang ji ltar phyag btab pa'i skor/dge bshes dgon pa ba'i slob ma bu chen bzhi'i ya gyal sne'u zur pa ye shes 'bar ni 'phan yul spras sne'u zur thong pa sgang zhes pa'i gnas der yab stag po zhes pa'i sras su rab byung dang po'i chu pho rta spyi lo 1042lor sku 'khrungs/ (dmangs khrod du khong gi yum a ma ra gcig ma yin zer yang yig thog la 'khod pa da bar ma mthong /)khong sku 'khrungs pa'i lo der jo bo rje thog mar mnga' ris su phebs/gzhon nu'i dus brag rgyab tu rab tu byang / mtshan yis shes 'bar zhes gsol/ de dus nas skye bzlo thob pa'i ting nge 'dzin legs par 'khrungs/ brag rgyab la bzhugs ring gnyer pa yang lo gcig mdzad/ brag rgyab pa'i ston pa shākya tshul rwa sgreng du phebs skabs dgon pa ba'i spyan sngar byon nas nged kyi de na btsun chung skyes stobs kyi ting nge 'dzin mnga' ba zhig yod pas thugs la 'dogs pa zhu zhus pas/ dgon pa bas sku stod dgye dgye mdzad nas a ha ha a re skyid a re skyid/ yang na kho'i de la bla ma mi dgos par tal gyis 'gro ba'ang srid/ yang na bla ma zhig dgos pa'ang srid gsungs nas/ thugs dgyes pa'i mtshan ma mdzad/ de nas ston pa shākya tshul brag rgyab tu 'ongs nas khyed 'dir ma sdod rwa sgreng du song / dgon pa gong ma bas thugs la 'dogs pa 'dug byas pas/ dus re zhig thon ma thub kyang / phyis 143

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/dgung grangs nyi shu rtsa drug la phebs pa rab byang dang po'i me mo lug spyi lo 1067lor rwa sgreng du dgon pa bcu mjal bar phebs kyang / sku mtshams dam pas mjal sa med zer/ gzim khang la bskor ba lan gsum byas/ byang phyogs kyi chu mig kha de nas phyag gsum 'tshal te skye ba 'di la skyes bu dam pa khyed kyi gdul byar ma gyar kyang / ma 'ongs pa na skyes bu dam pa khyed kyi gdul byar gyarno cig ces smon lam btab/ spos kyi reng bu gcig kyang bsre|sa nas phul/ chu mig kha der dro btab/ de nas mngon par mkhyen pas dgongs te nye gnas btang nas shog gsungs/zhabs drung du byon pas/ a ti shas nga la dang por 'di gnang ba yin gsungs nas/ kha 'bar ma'i gtor ma dang / skyabs 'gro thun mong ba gnyis gnang / jo bo'i gdams pa ji ltar ba bzhin du gnang bar 'dug snyam pa bzhin/ gdams pa sna tshogs pa thugs la btags/ res 'ga' phyag btsal nas nga la zhabs kyis byin rlabs gnang byung bsam pa na/ bla mas zhabs nar gyis brkyangs nas 'ong / lan cig phyag sor gsum gyis mgo la byin rlabs mdzad pas/ dbu la phyag sor gsum thim pa'i shul kyong log ge ba ji srid 'tsho'i bar du yod/ yi dam du rje btsun mi g.yo ba gnang nas de'i bsnyen pa mang du mdzad pas zhal yang legs par gzigs/ der ma zad dgon pa ba'i gdams pa la brten nas dam tshig gsum gyi rgyal po'i gdams pa mdzad pas kyang sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' mang po'i zhal 144

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/gzigs/ de ltar dge bshes dgon pa ba'i drung nas thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad pa rtse gcig tu gnang ste lo bcu bzhi tsam bzhugs pa'i rjes dgon pa ba gshegs nas po to ba'i drung du mu mthud thos bsam sgom gsum legs par mdzad de lo bcu bzhi tsam song ba'i dus der po to bas spyir sngags la mi dgyes pa zhig 'dug khyad par snyan phra bag tsam byang bas/ bka' bkyon 'dra mdzad pa la/ nga la 'di'i skyon tre+e med pa zhig yin zhus pas/ po to bas spyan hur mdzad de mi bden na khyod kho na la phan gyi gsungs nas bus mdzad/ skabs der thugs la nga'i bla ma de bzhugs na 'di 'dra mi yong dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis kyang snyan phra la gsan pa 'dug snyam pa'i yid mug kyang byung gsungs/ nga rang lkog tu dge sbyor yang 'phel/ da tshogs mi thub par 'dug snyam nas spras thong pa na sngon gyi dus su g.yog byas pa'i yon bdag gcig gis zhabs tog byas nas sne'u zur gyi dben tsha gog po de la brten nas khang chung zhig brtsigs te thugs dam rtse gcig tu mdzad pas/ dge sbyor shin tu 'phel nas 'di bzhin sgom na ni 'khor ba 'di la la bzlos te mi 'ong ba 'dug dgongs pa gcig byang gsungs/ (dge bshes sne'u zur ba sne'u zur gyi dben tsha gog po de la thog mdzo sgom sgrub tu bzhugs pa'i dus ni bod me khyi spyi lo1096 lor yin/de yang khong dang thog sku mtshams la bzhugs sa'i sa cha sne'u zur gyi dben tsha gog po zhes pa de ni da lta sne'u zur dgon pa yod sa'i ri de'i shar ngos nas kha byang la gtad de phyin na/ ri de'i rgyab tu thang cung zad cig yod pa de nas mu 145

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/mthud skar ma lnga tsam phyin pa'i sar/ ri chung nar mo zhig yod cing ri de'i sgang du da lta gyang ro 'ga' zhig mthong rgyu yod pa la/ gnas der deng skabs de ga'i yul mi rnams kyis dben pa'i sgang zhes brjod kyi yod pas de ni dge bshes sne'u zur ba thog mar sku mtshams bzhugs sa dben tsha gog po zhes pa de yin/ khong gnas der sku mtshams la bzhugs ring khong gi sku mdun la bcar mkhan slob ma rim bzhin mang du song bas dben pa'i sgang zhes pa'i sa cha de nas gnas spos kyis da lta sne'u zur dgon pa yod sa'i ri sked der spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gcig pa'i dus mjug gam dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i dus 'go tsam la dgon pa gsar du bzhengs nas thos bsam sgom gsum gyi rgyun bskyangs pa ma zad rjes 'dzin bu slob kyang mang du 〉sdo /sa grwa pa mang dus nyis stong lhag tsam byung ba'i lo rgyus kyang da ni dge bshes sne'u zur pa'i sku gsung thugs kyi yon tan dang mdzad 'phrin dag las cung zad gleng na/(1) dge bshes sne'u zur pa ni/ 'dul ba'i tshul khrims rnam par dag cing ting nge 'dzin gyi yon tan la mchog tu mnga' ba'i bla ma skyes chen dam pa zhig yin pa ni/ rje nyid kyis phyi nang gi chos thams cad sgyu ma dang rmi lam lta bur dgongs shing rtag tu shes rab kyi pha rol du phyin pa zab mo stong pa nyid la rtse gcig tu sgom nas mi lo bzhi bcu'i ring sku mtshams la bzhugs te sde pa 146

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang /de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyugadang mi nag gi them pa 'gam ma myong pa dang / yang mi zhig gis dge bshes sne'u zur pa la mdang sang rmi lam ci 'dra 'dug zhus pas/ khong gis a 'di ci zer/ gnyid med par rmi lam gang na 'ongs gsungs/ yang 'bre chung pas dge bshes lags ting nge 'dzin tshad je tsam mnga' zhus pas/ ngas ting nge 'dzin gcig la mnyam par bzhag na nyin zhag bcu bzhi tsam thub pa 'dug gsungs/ lan gcig g.yog po dar tshul bya bas thugs dam gtor ma tshar nas gzim lam du skyil krang lam gyis bcas nas na bza' gsol/ de'i steng na phar zlo re kha 'then nas bzhag ste nang par bltas tsa na spu gad tsam yang med pa yin skad na/mnyam gzhag bya ba de 'dra ba dgos pa yin/ don 'di dag la dgongs nas rje thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / zab mo ting 'dzin brtan pa'i sne'u zur pa zhes bstod pa yang mdzad/ ting nge 'dzin la shin tu brtan pas rje btsun mi la dang mtshan thos pa'i grogs po yang yin gsungs/(2)dge bshes sne'u zur ba ni yon tan rgya mtsho ltar mnga' zhing bka' khrid la thogs pa med pa'i bla ma skyes chen dam pa zhig yin pa ni/ rtag tu bu slob rnams la lam rim gyi bka' khrid mdzad cing / lam rim dbu ni dgon pa ba'i man ngag bzhin 'khor ba 'jug ldog nas mdzad/ lam rim gyi bka' khrid rgyas par gsungs pa rnams slob mas zin bris su byas pa'ang mang du yod/ de la brten nas bod 'dir sne'u zur pa'i lugs kyi lam 147

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/gyi rim pa shin tu dar ba byang / de bzhin phu chung ba'i rten 'brel de yang mkhas pa'i chod gcig mkhyen/ bslab phyogs dang pha rol du phyin pa de yang mkhas pa'i tshad gcig mkhyen/ da dung lan gcig brgyad stong 'grel chen gsungs pas/ skabs dang po gcig pu la zla ba gsum song /(3) dge bshes sne'u zur ba ni mthu stobs la 'gran zla bral ba'i bla ma skyes chen dam pa zhig yin pa ni/ dge bshes pad ma byang chub bya ba la klu'i gnod pa byung nas khong gi snang ba la sbrul gcig thod du thag pa bzhin du dkris nas sbrul mgo de dpral ba'i steng na gdengs ka bzhin yod pa mis mthong gis dogs nas bkab ste rin po che'i spyan sngar 'ongs pas de nga dang khyed rang min pa gzhan gyis mi mthong / sbed mi dgos/ da nga de'i steng du sgoms dang gsungs/ de bzhin du byas pas sbrul de gar song cha med du song / lan gcig rwa sgreng la byon pa'i tshe pha bong zhig la zhabs gtad nas zhabs sgrog bcings pas sbrul dkar po gcig pha bong 'og de nas thon te song / de na mdze bo gcig yod pa gzhan ci yang mi dgos par de gcig pus nad las thar/ yang thengs gcig glang thang du nad yams chen po zhig byung bas mi mang po'ang shi/ de nas mi ma yin pa rnams sne'u zur du 'gro bar brtsam pa na nam mkha' las de ni byang chub sems dpa' kun tu bzang po'i sprul pa yin no bya ba'i sgra byang bas mi ma yin pa rnams phyir log ste byang chub sems dpa' skun 148

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dag)phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/tu bzang po'i sprul par yang grags / de ltar skyes chen dam pa de nyid gnas der sgrub pa nyams len dang rjes 'dzin bu slob gso skyong sogs sangs rgyas bstan pa spyi dang sgos su bka' gdams bstan pa'i ring lugs 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi bya gzhag kho na la brel te dgung lo nyi shu lhag tsam bzhugs rjes re zhig gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la skul phyir dgung grangs bdun cu don bdun pa rab byang gnyis pa'i sa pho khyi spyi lo 1118lor dgongs pa gzhan zhon du gshegs/ khong sku gshegs skabs kyang ngo mtshar gyi rtags mtshan mang po byung ba ste sku gshegs par zhag bdun yod pa'i dus der byang shar gyi mtshams nas brag brdab pa 'dra ba'i sgra chen po dang / 'od dang sa g.yo ba sogs byung / de nas zhag bdun song ba na sman pa gcig dang tshul khrims 'od zer gnyis zhabs drung na yod dus skyil krang lam gyi mdzad nas thugs dam du lhan gyis song / khong gnyis kyis bltas pas zhal kong phyang gis song byang tsa na spyi bo na yar la 'od 'jag ma tsam zhig dkar nar nar༄ gyis song / phyi na yod pa kun gyis 'od sba lcag tsam zhig dkar nar nar du mthong /de je che la song nas nam mkha' la 'od rdza ma tsam zhig song skad/ des na khe khang lo tsā ba na re/ rnal 'byor pa zhig grongs pa'i bltas de las ya mtshan pa zhig rgya gar du'ang ma byung /'o skol chu bur gyi mig la de 'dra na/ lha'i mig gis rnam 'phrul dpag med du mthong ste 'ong gsungs so/ /de nas spur gang du 149

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/sbyong snyam pa la/ spur la 'ja' zhig zug pa'i sne mo shod de na zhing gcig yod pa'i steng du zug der 'od g.yul thang tsam zhig zhag gnyis gsum du byang bas/ dge bshes nyid kyis bstan pa yin snyam nas der spung sbyang pa'i dus nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus nas 'od zer zhig byung bas spur khang la nar gyis zug pas gdugs kyi yu ba 'dra ba zhig byung / nyi ma de la sprin sribs se ba zhig byung bas 'ja' tshon gdugs 'dra bas bskor ba'ang byung / spur khang gi khri'i zur bzhi la 'ja' tshon 'char ba dang 'dra ba bzhi dang / gzhan yang 'ja' tshon 'phan 'dra ba dang rgyal mtshan 'dra ba mang po'ang byung ba gda'/ de'i dus lha bka' gdams pa de zhabs tog kyang che/ ming yang che bas mang bskol zhig byas te 'di la rten khyad par can byon 'ong bas de byon na'ang bur thugs la 'dogs pa zhu zer nas spyi zhus byas/ gdung rnams gdan drangs pa'i dus su dgon pa bas phyag g.yas pa bzhag pa'i rjes kyi dbu thod de lha bka' gdams pa la phul nas dngul gyi gdung rten zhig bzhengs pa yin skad/ phyis 'bri sgang nas gdan drangs te don steng gi gdung rten chen mo'i nang na bzhugs/ phyag gnyal smad gser phye'i 'bum pa'i nang du bzhugs par grags/ gzhan yang ring bsrel dpag tu med pa byon te ring bsrel de dag kyang gzhan dang mi 'dra ba'i kha gting med par sngo sing ba/ mthong ba tsam gyi dad pa 'dren pa/ blo bde 'bol gyis 'gro bar snang zhes rin 150

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/cen sgang pa chen pos gsungs so/ de ltar dge bshes sne'u zur ba de nyid sne'u zur dgon du bzhugs ring bka' gdams bstan pa'i gdams pa ma lus thos bsam sgom gsum gyi sgo nas nyams len dang / khyab spel gyis rjes 'dzin bu slob mang du bskyangs pa las rin cen sgang pa dang / lha 'bri sgang pa/ tsha rong gi jo stan nag po/ kwa ba dar seng / mnga' ris pa dge mdzes byang chub/ gtsang smyon dang dbus smyon/ dgyer sgom chen po sogs mang du byung zhing / khong sku gshegs rjes bu slob khag gcig yul phyogs gzhan du song nas bka' gdams bstan pa dar spel gnang ba dang / bu slob khag gcig nas bla ma'i phyag bzhes mu mthud rgyun 'dzin gyis mi rabs nas mi rabs bar sne'u zur dgon pa de nyid legs par skyong bzhin pa'i dus te 1240lor hor go dan gyis blon po dor rta nag po dmag dpon du bskos nas hor dmag khri gsum lhag tsam bod la btang ba na hor dmag de rnams byang lam brgyud de bod dbus 'phan yul la slebs/ de ga'i yul mi rnams 'jigs te bros byol byas shing / ma shor bar lag zin byang ba rnams dmar gsod dang/ 'phrog bcom mang po byas/gyur sgreng dang rgyal lha khang sogs mer bsregs te brlags shing / so ston zhu ba gtsos pa'i bla btsun lnga brgya lhag tsam bgrongs pas de ga'i yul mi dang grwa pa rnams kyis gling log bya ba ste dgon sde'i nang dmag 'thab drag po byung / skabs der hor dmag gis bka' gdams pa'i 151

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/dgon pa rnams dmigs su bkar nas rtsa gtor btang ba na sne'u zur dgon pa de yang bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa snyan grags can zhig yin pas mnyam du rtsa gtor btang / dus de nas bzung sne'u zur dgon pa de nyid nyams gso zhu mkhan ma byung par bod rab byung bcu drug pa'i sa mo phag spyi lo 1959bar dgon pa phyag yul de nyid gyang ro kho nar lus shing /dgon pa'i kyang ro'i g.yon gyi nub der sngar dge bshes sne'u zur pa dang / a ma ra gcig ma / de bzhin khong gi bu slob rnams kyis bzhengs pa'i mchod rten bcu gnyis yod pa de yang rig gsar skabs gtor bshigs tshab chen phog ste mchod rten mang che ba zhabs ra tsam las mthong rgyu med par gyur/(2) rig gsar rjes dgon pa dang mchod rten sogs bskyar bzhengs ji ltar zhus pa'i skor/rig gsar rjes chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus khag rim bzhin lag bstar don 'khyol byang nas sngar gyi dgon gnas khag nyams gso dang bskyar brnongs byed chog pa'i skal bzang gi dus shig shar ba na/ sngar 'phan yul rin chen brag dgon pa'i grwa ba yin pa dge slong blo bzang chos dar gyis go skabs bzang po de dam 'dzin gyis sne'u zur dgon pa'i mchod rten nyams gso dang / dgon pa bskyar bzhengs bya rgyu'i 'dun pa thugs che bcangs shing / gong rim 'brel yod tshan par chog mchan skyabs 'jug zhus te gong rim nas chog mchan thob rjes 152

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dnganade dgagi phyaga'adeb pa po'i lorgyus/grong tsho de ga'i dad ldan mang tshogs rnams la dngos shugs brgyud gsum nas rogs ram yong ba'i re 'dun dang / slong mo zhus pa brgyud dngul sgor sum brgya lhag tsam dang / lcam shing bco lnga/ de bzhin 'bra rigs gang tsam byang ba bcas la brten nas rab byang 17parme lcags mo lug spyi kyā 1991lo'i bod zla 2nas 'asko 'dzugs kyis dgon pa bskyar bzhengs byed 'go tshugs/khong gis dgon pa'i sa thig thog mar len skabs sngar sne'u zur dgon pa chags sa'i kyang ro de dag dran rten gyi tshul du rang 'jags bzhag ste sngar gyi dgon pa chags sa'i 'og der sa cha bde 'khod snyoms pa zhig bdams nas der dgon pa bzhengs rgyu'i 'char gzhi gleng / de ltar khong gis dngul sgor sum brgya dang /lcam shing kha shas shig la brten nas dgon pa'i 'du khang dang /mgon khang / rung khang sogs 'char gzhi chen po zhig gleng ba na/skabs de'i shing bzo dang rdo bzo dbu chen gnyis nas rgyu med par lha dbu chen po bzhengs rgyu de yong thabs med ces gsungs nas 'char gzhi chung tsam byed dgos pa'i bsam 'char zhus na yang der khong gis gtan nas ma gsan par thog ma'i 'char gzhi ltar thig len dgos pa'i bka' bkod gnang ba na/shing bzo dang rdo bzo dbu chen gnyis dang khong gi bar zhal rtsod kyang shor ba byang / de ltar khong gis sangs rgyas bstan pa de nyid ma nyamazlorgyun 'dzin dang / ga nyams pa slar gso'i ched du 'bad brtson de lta bu gnang bar yul phyogs gang sa'i dad ldan 153

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/ser skya mang pos thugs che'i rgyab skyor thob pa ma zad/ lhag don sngar rin chen brag gi grwa pa yin pa dge blo bzang shes rab dang /dge ngag dbang don ldan gnyis nas kyang khong dang dpung pa mnyam gshib kyis dgon pa bskyar bsgrun nang zhugs pa dang / de bzhin gnya' ri khug gi cog skal bzang bkra shis dang / lha sa nas yin pa a cag sgrol ma/ gnam gang / lhag chung sogs kyis dngul dang lcam shing sogs gang sar shugs che'i rgyab skyor gnang ba brgyud spyi lo 1995lo'i bod zla 4nang dgon pa'i 'du khang ka ba bcu drug dang / gzim chung ka ba gnyis/bka' 'gyur lha khang ka ba bzhi/ mgon khang ka ba gnyis/rung khang ka ba gnyis bcas legs sgrub byang ba ma zad mchod rten bcu gnyis de dag kyang rim bzhin nya༄sa gso zhus te dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs rnams kyi yid kyi brtan pa dbang med du 'phrog pa'i gnas mchog cig tu bskyar bskrun legs sgrub zhus yod/ de yang dge slong blo bzang chos dar ni 'phanasal dbu ma gzhis ka rnying pa zhes pa'i gnas der yab byams pa chos 'dzoms dang / yum tshe ring chos skyid gnyis kyi sras su rab byang bcu drug pa'i shing mo phag spyi lo 1935lor sku 'khrungs/dogung lo bdun nas pha ma gnyis kyis rin chen brag dgon par grwa pa bzos/ khong ni chung ngu'i dus nas dam pa'i chos la dad pa brtan cing phyag dpe skyor sbyangs la shin tu brtson pa na dgung lo dgu nas dgon pa'i 'don bya yongs rdzogs rgyugs 'phrod de 154

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagiphyaga'adebasapa po'i lorgyus/dgung lo bcu la phebs skabs brag rgyab rin po che'i drung nas rab tu byang / dgung lo nyi shu la phebs skabs slar yang brag rgyab rirno po che'i drung du dge slong dge 'dun grangs tshang ba'i dbus nas dge slong gi sdom pa zhus/ dus de nas bzung dgung grangs nyer lnga la phebs pa spyi lo 1959bar dge slong gi 'dul khrims gtsang mar srang zhing sngon 'gro dang las rung sogs kyi nyams len gtsog bor gnang ste bzhugs/ spyi lo 1960nas rig gsar mjug ma sgril bar dgon pa'i nye 'dabs kyi grong tsho der zhing las dang / rta rdzi/ bong rdzi/ ther ge gtong mkhan sogs sdug las sna tshogs myong dgos byung yang dka' sdug gi mdun du dpa' gtan nas ma zhum par de sngon rang gi dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung nas zhus pa'i sgrub bya rnams thabs shes sna tshogs la brten nas nyin gcig kyang chad lus med par bsgrubs pa ma zad dge slong gi sdom pa yang tshul bzhin srung ste bzhugs/ spyi lo 1995lor sne'u zur dgon pa bskyar bskrun zin rjes khong gi phyag las gtso bo grwa gsar rnams la dpe cha slob gnyer dang / dgon pa'i do dam gyi 'gan 'khur/ de bzhin rang nyid rgyun du nyams len gtso bor gnang nas bzhugs kyi yod/ 'on kyang blo pham shin tu che ba zhig la dgon pa dang mchod rten nyams gso cha tshang legs sgrub zin nas lo gcig 'khor ba'i dus te khong dgung lo re gnyis la phebs pa bod me khyi spyi lo 1996lor sku tshe'i phan pa rdzogs pa'o//155

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/(3) deng skabs dgon pa'i phyi'i gzhi khyon dang / nang gi sku rten sogs ji tsam yod pa'i skor/(1) 'du khang ka ba bcu drug gi nang rten gyi gtso bo 'jim las grub pa'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang po dang / dge bshes sne'u zur pa/ rje yab sras gsum/ rje dge 'dun grub pa bcas kyi sku mi tshad ma dang / 'du khang gi nub ngos su rje tshe 'dzin ma'i stong sku dang / shar ngos su slob dpon rin po che'i 'jim sku stong dang brgyad/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma'i 'jim sku brgya dang don dgu tsam bzhugs/(2) bka' 'gyur lha khang ka ba bzhi yi nang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur cha tshang dang / rje yab sras gsum gyi gsung 'bum cha tshang bcas bzhugs/(3) mgon khang ka ba gnyis kyi nang dkyil du 'jim las grub pa'i yi dam rdo rje 'jigs byed dang / g.yon du mgon po phyag drug dang dam chen chos rgyal/ g.yas su dpal ldan dmag zor ma dang / rgyal po rnam thos sras de bzhin dgon pa 'di'i thog ma'i srung ma rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ shar ngos su khro bo mi g.yo ba dang lo gtor/ slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas kyi sku 'dra che ba gcig dang / ka ba'i ngos su bstan ma bcu gnyis kyi zhal 'bag kyang bzhugs pa bcas so/156

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyug(4) gzim chung lha khang ka gnyis kyi nang dkyil du rje yab sras gsum gyi 'jim sku dang / g.yon du rgyu gser zangs las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa'i sku brnyan rnying ma zhig dang /g.yas su rdo rje 'chang gi 'jim sku gcig de bzhin jo rngog 'brom gsum gyi thang ka rnying ma zhig kyang bzhugs pa ma zad sngar gyi sku rnying gi khrod nas nyar tshags zhus pa'i 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dang/ rje btsun 'phags ma sgrol ma/ rje tsong kha pa chen po/ rgyal dbang dge 'dun grub pa sogs kyi gser zangs kyi sku brnyan dang / shar li'i mchod rten bzhi bcas bzhugs su gsol pa'o/(5)byams khang nang rten gyi gtso bo 'jim las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa thog so nyis thog dang / de'i sku rgyab tu 'jem las grub pa'i slob dpon rin po che dang / shar ngos su dge slong blo bzazlo chos dar gyi 'dra sku zhig kyang bzhugs su gsol pa bcadri ) /de/nga skabs dgon pa'i dmigs bsal dus mchod dang cho ga phyag len sogs kyi skor/deng skabs dgon par grwa grangs nyer lnga tsam yod pa de dag gis rgyun du dgon pa'i nye 'khor gyi dad ldan mang tshogs tsho'i shi gson gyi zhabs rim khag gang thub sgrub bzhin pa ma zad dgon 'di'i dmigs bsal dus mchod khag ni lo ltar bod zla 1tshes 7 nas 15bar nyin ltar sgrol chog gi cho ga'i sgo nas 157

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/zhabs rim sgrub bzhin pa dang / bod zla 4tshes 1nas tshes 14bar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor bzhengs pa dang mchod pa gra rgyas bshams te 'jigs byed lha bcu gsum gyi sgo nas cho ga rgya che sgrub pa dang / tshes 15nyin cho ga legs sgrub byang bar bka' drin gtang rag gi ched du slar yang 'jigs byejo kyi sgo nas sbyin sreg phul/ de bzhin zla ba yang ngo'i tshes 8nyin sman bla dang /ltung bshags/ spyan ras gzigs pad ma lugs sogs gang rung dang / tshes 15nyin zhogs pa gso sbyong tshugs rjes rnam rgyal tshe mchog dang / gnas brtan phyag mchod/ rgyal ba mi 'khrugs pa sogs gang rung gi sgo nas cho ga gtong / tshes 30zhogs pa spyir btang gso sbyong dang de rjes bskang gso gtong /drug pa tshes bzhi dang / dgu pa lha babs dus chen/ dga' ldan lnga mchod bcas la yang rnam rgyal tshe chog dang / gnas brtan phyag mchod sogs gang rung gi sgo nas cho ga gang legs sgrub bzhin pa bcas so/(5) dgon pa'i nub ngos su yod pa'i mchod rten dag gi mtshan dang /lo rgyus/phan yon sogs kyi skor/gnas der khyon mchod rten bcu gnyis tsam yod pa las shar nas rtsis pa'i mchod rten dang po de ni a ma ra gcig ma'i mchod rten yin zhing / mchod rten der kla thebs skabs su mar gsur phul te skor ba bsags na kla dang bas bdag gi gnod pa rnams rang bzhin du 'joms pa'i rmithu stobs ldan zhes yul mi 158

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dbade dgagiphyaga'adebasapa po'i lorgyugakun /rdzu sdo d+ngha/na gnyis pa dge bshes gtsang smyon pa'i mchod rten/ mchod rten gsum pa dge bshes dbus smyon pa'i mchod rten/ mchod rten bzhi pa dge bshes rin cen sgang pa'i mchod rten/ mchod rten lnga pa dge bshes tsha rong pa'i mchod rten yin zhing khong gi mtshan cha tshang la tsha rong gi jo stan nag po zhes brjod/mchod rten drug pa a ma ra gcig mas chos yon rgyun ma chad pa'i rten 'brel gyi ched du bzhengs pa khang bu brtsegs pa'i mchod rten zhes pa de yin zhing mchod rten de ni mchod rten gzhan rnams las kha dog cung zad dmar ba zhig yod/ mchod rten bdun pa mchod 'khor pad ma can gyi mchod rten/ mchod rten brgyad pa kwa ba dar seng gi mchod rten yin zhing mchod rten 'di nyid nyams gso zhu skabs sngar mchod rten nang sku dmar gdung zhig bzhugs su gsol yod pa de sngar bzhin nyams pa med par bzhugs/ mchod rten dgu pa dang bcu pa bcu gcig bcas mchod rten gsum po de mchod rten gzhan rnams las cung zad chung pa yod cing mchod rten de dag ni dge bshes sne'u zur ba nyid kyis thugs ljags spyan gsum las grub pa'i mchod rten byin rlabs can zhig yin zhing dkyil gyi mchod rten de thugs kyi mchod rten dang / gzhogs g.yas g.yon gnyis po ni spyan dang ljags kyi mchod rten du grub/ mchod rten bcu gnyis pa 159

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/ —de mchod rten de dag gi khrod nas che shos de yin zhing / mchod rten de ni dge bshes sne'u zur ba sku mtshams lo bzhi bcu bzhugs ring thun mtshams so sor phyag tsha btab pa las rtso 'bum phrag gcig lhag tsam byang ba de dag rjes su mchod rten de'i rten du phul te btab pa'o mchod rten 'bum mo can zhes pa de yin/ mchod rten de'i nang stso phud da dung rje nyid kyi chos gos snam sbyar dang/phyag sen/phyag phreng sogs kyang bzhugs su gsol/gong zhus ltar hor dmag gis sne'u zur dgon pa rtsa gtor btang na yang mchod rten de dag mu mthud nyams chags med pa'i thog rjes su mchod rten 'bum mo che'i mdun du lha khang chung chung zhig kyang gsar bskrun gyis brgya mchod lha khang zhes nye 'khor gyi yul mi rnams kyis tshes bzang dus bzang la brgya mchod 'bul sa'i gnas shig tu yang gyar myong / de bzhin a ma ra gcig ma'i mchod rten gyi nye 'gram rū lo rabs lnga bcu'i dus 'gor mtshams khang zhig gsar rgyag gis mtshams pa ral pa can zhig gnas der lo mang mtshams la bzhugs/ 'on kyang rig gsar skabs mchod rten dang bcas par nyams chag chen po byung na yang rjes su dgon pa bskyar bzhengs skabs mchod rten de dag kyang rim pas nyams gso zhus te sngar yod gzungs gzhug gi rmang gzhi'i thog dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyis phul ba'i g.yu dang / byu ru/ gser dngul/ gzi/ mchong la sogs pa rtsa che'i nor bu'i rigs ha cang mang po dang / de bzhin yul 160

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dbade dgagaphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyugaphyogs gang sa nas byin rlabs che ba'i gzungs gzhug mang po thabs 'tshol dang nyo sgrub kyis mchod rten de dag sngar bzhin byin rlabs can zhig tu nyams gso zhu thub pa byang yod/ mchod rten de dag la phyag 'tshal bskor sbyongs so|sa byas na tshogs bsags sgrib sbyangs kyi phan rlabs shin tu che ba ni sngon gyi dus na khyim bdag dpal skyid ces pa phag gi skye ba blangs nas yod skabs/ yul de na mchod rten zhig yod pa la phag de khyis ded nas rang thugs kyis mchod rten la skor ba thengs gcig 'khor ba'i dge rtsas khyim bdag dpal skyid ces pa'i skye ba blangs pa lta bu'o/mchod rten de dag gi bskor tshad ni rab la chig stong brgyad rgya dang / 'bring chig stong sum rgya/ tha na rang gi lo tshad bskor na yang tshogs bsags sgrib sbyangs la phan pa tsam ma zad/ lhag don klu dang sa bdag gi gnod pa dang / gdon rigs kyi gnod pa sogs zhi bar gyar zhes chos dad pa rnams kyi gsungs rgyun du 'dug de bzhirno dgon pa'i nub ngos su yod pa'i dur sa de ni lo rgyus yun ring ldan zhing bod nang rten 'phyag gi ming thogs pa'i dur sa 'ga' zhig las med pa'i khrod kyi gcig yin zhing /mchod rten 'bum mo can gyi nyi zla'i nang 'phel gdung ha cang mang po yod pa de dag gi 'od zer rten 'phyag thog 'phrod de gshin por pho ba rang bzhin du thob skad dang / khor yug ngos gtsang zhing 'gro lam bde ba/ dge 'dun rnams kyis smon lam dus thog tu gsung pa sogs ngo sprod mdor bsdus tsam mo///161

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/bdun/ glang thang dgon dang de'i phyag 'debs pa po glang ri thang pa rdo rje seng ge/'go brjod/'phan yul glang thang dgon ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong khongs dga' chos grong brdal glang thang grong tshor chags shing dgon 'di phyag btab nas spyi lo 2008bar lo 915tsam song ba'i bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa rnying gras shig yin/ dgon 'di'i phyi'i khor yug ni nub ngos nas glang po che phred du nyal ba lta bu'i ri tshogs nar mo gnyis kyi mdun du glang thang dgon pa de nyid byin rlabs kyi tshan kha 'bar zhing gnas yod la/ dgon pa'i gzim sgo shar la gtad cing / lho phyogs su ri ma thang rgya che la/ byang phyogs su mchod rten 'bum mo che sogs thugs rten byin rlabs can mang pos brgyan pa'i gnas khyad par can zhig yin pa de sku nyid gnas der dngos su phebs na dad pa'i spu long g.yo zhing lag gnyis thal mo sbyor rgyu ni gdon mi za/de yang glang thang zhes pa'i ming de ji ltar thogs she na sngar gyi dus su da lta dgon pa chags sa'i phyogs bzhi gang sar shing glang mas yongs su gang ste glang ma'i thang chen po zhig chags yod pa na yul der glang thang zhes pa'i ming de thogs shing / phyis su yul 162

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyaga'adebasapa po'i lorgyus/ming dgon par thogs nas glang thang dgon dang / yul ming mi la thogs nas dge bshes glang thang pa zhes pa'i mtshan de thogs par snyam/ (1) dgon pa 'di thog mar phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus dang ji ltar phyag btab pa'i skor/byang chub sems kyi bdag nyid du gyur zhing bka' gdams bu chen brgyad dang dbus kyi ka chen gnyis kyi ya gyal dge bshes glang thang pa'am glang ri thang pa rdo rje seng ge ni 'phan yul gnya' gong gser ma gshongs zhes pa'i sa der (gnya' gong gser ma gshongs zhes pa'i yul de ni deng skabs lhun grub rdzong sum 'phreng shang khongs su yod cing de ga'i yul mi rnam sa kyis kha skad du gser ma'i nang zhes brjod/)yab jo bo dar ma mdo bzang gi sras su bod rab byung dang po'i shing pho rta spyi lo 1054lor sku 'khrungs/ rus shugs tshangs/ sku 'khrungs skabs grod thum gyi tshul du 'khrungs pa na yum bred de sgo rgyab la zhag 'ga' zhig 'phangs/ g.yog mo mkha' 'gro'i mtshan can des mthong ste grod pa bshags pas bu chung zhig gis mthe bong zhal la 'jibs pa'i tshul du tsog bur zil pa khrom mer bsdad yod pa na g.yog mo des pang du blangs nas yum la phul/ yum gyis thugs dgyes bzhin du nu ma phul bas zhag 'ga' zhig gi mtshams su bu chung des yum la gsungs byon/ omaṇibadz+ralhu/ a ma yul 'di na ji skad zer/ yum gyis yul 'di'i ming ma tshor zhus pas/ 4 yul 'edi'i ming la gnya 'a gong zhes tho/gso gsungs/nar son rjes kho rang 7gi zhang po bshes gnyen grog mo mkhar pa la 163

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/rab tu byang / mtshan rdo rje seng ger btags/ dgung lo nyi shu'i skams po to ba'i drung nas bsnyen rdzogs kyi sdom pa bzhes/rgyal ba 'od dpag tu med pa'i sprul par byed la/ sngon lo tsā ba ska ba dpal brtsegs su sprul nas bstan pa ches cher gsal ba mdzad cing skabs der gdul bya blo dman pa rnams kyi ngor shin tu bkren pa'i tshul mdzad de 'tsho ba dka' sdug la gnas nas sde snod gsum la sbyangs shing brjod bya'i don thams cad skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim par dril te nyams su len pa'i man ngag byang chub lam gyi rim pa la thugs rtse gcig sgril du mdzad nas bka' gdams sku mched gsum la gtugs shing gtso bo dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba chen po la bka' gdams gzhung drug gi bshad pa mtha' dag dang / lkog chos su bdag pas gzhan gces pa'i byang chub kyi sems bsgom pa'i man ngag blo sbyong don bdun ma'i khrid legs par gsan te nyams len gyi mthil du mdzad/ dge bshes sne'u zur pa las lam rim gyi khrid gsan/lo spyan snga la chos gsan dus yos sbar ba res gdan snon mdzad kyin bzhugs/ de nas bsod snyoms mdzad pa'i rnyed pa gang byang rnams / spyir dge 'dun dang / khyad par po to ba dpon sdub la drangs pas sku bsod skyes pa mdzad de grwa pa nyis stong tsam 'tshogs pa'i rgyags kho rang gis gnang zhing gnas nges med gnang / spyan snga pas lo'i mchod rten bzhengs skabs grwa ba lnga brgya khrid de mamed rten bzhe ngas pa'i zhabaso tog kyang mardzod/1yo

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyaga'adebasapa po'i lorgyugagatso bo po to ba'i rnam thar dang gsung sgros 'dzin pas po to ba gshegs khar glang thang pa la khyed gnas gcig tu ma zhugs/dngos po ci yang bdag gir ma 'dzin/ de gnyis sems la zhogs zhes gsungs/ spyan snga la dge bshes glang thang pas kho bo mi tshe hril gyi byams pa kho na sgom par zhu zhus pas/ spyan sngas dbu zhwa phud nas jo bo ba cha byad bzang gsungs te dbu dud dud mdzad/ lan gcig gi tshe tshe rabs thams cad du dge slong gi dngos po dang mi 'bral ba'i dam bca' brtan po mdzad pas/ dpal lha mo dre'u'i skad lhang nge byon nas de'i bar du ngas khyod kyi grogs bya'o gsungs/ khong nyid kyi zhal nas/ ci tsug song ngam/ srung sdom bag re yang byas/ bsam sgom bag re yang byas/ bsod nams kyi las bag re yang byas pa la/ ci 'dra'i po ti zab mo zhig zhal phye yang skyon thams cad rang gi yin/ yon tan thams cad jo bo sems can gyi yin/ de'i gnad 'gag khe dang rgyal kha thams cad gzhan la byin/ gyong dang pham kha thams cad rang gis blangs sems pa min pa go rgyu ma rnyed gsungs/zhal nas 'gro ba rigs drug gar skye cha med de/ gar skyes kyang sems can la phan 'dogs pa 'di mi brjed dam sems/ mig long yang chos mi 'chor/ rna ba 'on pa dang / mdzes khyer ba/rkang lag zha ba/ lce lkugs kyang chos mi 'chor gsungs te/ don la phyir mi ldog pa zhal gyis bzhes pa yin gsungs/ po to ba gshegs nas khang grong ltag tu gtor ma mdzad dus gtor sder 165

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/bya rog gis khyer te glang thang shar gyi ri de'u de'i khar bzhag pas der byon nas dpon shākya bya bas zhabs tog byas te lo gsum sgrub pa mdzad/ zhol du sgrub chu yang byang / nyin mtshan dbyer med du byang chub sems kyi ting nge 'dzirno sgom par mdzad/ ri de'u zhes pa'i ri chung der deng sang ri skyes dmar po'am dge 'phel ri zhes brjod/ ces dang / yang ngag sgros phal mo cher dge bshes glang thang pa 'phan po sgo la'i 'dab kyi gling rdzong dang / dog sde'i bar gyi ri 'dom gang thug pa'i brag phug tu sgrub pa mdzad nas bzhugs skabs da lta glang thang gi dge 'phel ri'i 'dabs kyi 'gul ba zhes pa'i khyim tshang de'i bu mo 'phan po sgo la brgyud lha sar 'gro ba'i zhor du bla ma mjal du song bas bla mas mngon shes kyis mkhyen nas bu mo khyed kyi gser g.yu'i rgyan cha la dmigs te dgra yong ba dogs pas re zhig 'dir bzhag na zhes gsungs/ bu mos bla ma'i bka' bzhin rgyan cha de dag bcol ba la bla mas nga dge slong gser dngul la lag pa mi 'chang ba yin pas khyed kyis nga'i gzan gsham du bcug te tshems shig ces gsungs/ bu mos kyang de ltar bslab pa bzhin du bsgrubs/ de rjes bla ma lha sar byon nas 'phan po mda' brgyud tshur phebs skabs sngar gyi bu mo de chu len du yong ba dang bla ma mjal te nyid kyi chu la mchod pa mdzad/ bu mos bla ma yin pa ngo shes shing zhabs pus la mgo gtugs nas byin rlabs zhus/ bla mas bu mo khyed rang gi gser g.yu rnams gzan gsham nas len gsungs/ bu mos dga' 166

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/bzhin du ltas pas sngon ji ltar byas pa bzhin du 'dug gser g.yu blangs te khyim du song / a mas chu phab pas gser g.yu rnams mthong ba na bu mos gser g.yu bcol ba'i lo rgyus a mar bshad/ dad pa chen po skyes nas bla ma nang du gdan 'dren du phyin/ bla ma khyim pa'i them pa spangs zin pas nang du ma byon/khang grong ltag tu zhag bdun ring zhabs tog mdzad de thugs dam gyi gtor ma btang nas bzhugs skabs bya rog gis gtor sder 'khyer ba sogs lo rgyus gong du song zin/ de ltar gnas der sgrub pa mdzad te bzhugs skabs klu mo spun gsum gyis glang thang gi gnas phul nas dge 'dun gyi sde 'dzugs par zhus/ phyis ri de'i steng nas yar 'phur te thugs phreng bskyur sar khron pa brus/ dbu zhwa bskyur sar bla brang byas te rab byung gnyis pa'i chu mo bya spyi lo 1093lor glang thang dgon pa phyag btab/ /khron pa de dus da lta yang glang thang grong gi skya ser kun gyi chu len sa byed kyi yod na yang skabs der bzhengs pa'i dgra bcom 'du khang de ni rig gsar skabs gtor bshig song ste da lta gyang ror lus/) po to pa'i mdzad pa bzhin du bka' gdams gzhung drug dang / lam sgron/ byams chos sde lnga la sogs pa gzhung rnams khrid de slob ma bskyangs/ glang thang pa zhal bzhugs ring glang thang gi lcags ri'i nang du khras byi'u mi gsod pa dang / sbyang gis lug mi gsod pa sogs srog chags rnams gcig la gcig mi 'tshe bar grags/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pas mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor la sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul pa glang ri thang pa las bsnyen pa rdzogs shig ces lung 167

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/bstan pa ltar mkhas grub khyung po rnal 'byor gyis dgung lo bdun cu la glang thang pa'i mdun du bsnyen pa rdzogs/ de dus glang thang pa dgung lo bzhi bcu yin/ lan cig po to ba klung shod na 'go na bzhugs tsa na der byon dus glang ri thang pa sku khams ma bde zhing kha ngan pas spyir rigs drug gi sdug bsngal 'di 'dra/drag shos mi yin/ de'i nang nas kyang rab tu byang ba yin te 'di 'dra ba snyam nas las 'bras dang / 'khor pa'i nyes dmigs bsam pas yid 'byang ni skyes/ lus la sdig pa sbyong ba'i nus pa ni med snyam nas po to ba skor ba mdzad pa'i lam khar na bza' gdan du btings te dge ba'i bshes gnyen pa 'dir bzhugs par zhu zhus pas ci byed nga skor ba byed gsungs nas ma gnang pa la don gal che ba zhig bdog bzhugs par zhu zhus pas po to ba stan thog tu bzhugs pa dang / glang thang pas kho bo dbyar khams ngan par byung ba dang kha yang ngan par byung / mi rtag pa dang 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sgom pas yid 'byang skyes/dge sbyor byed pa'i nus pa med pas shes pa shin tu༄ ma bde gdams ngag cig zhu 'tshal zhus pas/ po to ba'i zhal nas jo bo khams dag grang dro snyoms pa'i nyams bde ste tshe phyi ma la phan nam gsungs nas/ dgra bcom pa gnyis kyi gtam rgyud drangs pa dang / gzhan yang sdug bsngal yon tan ni/ skyo bas dregs pa sel bar byed/ 'khor ba la snying rje skye/ sdig pa 'joms shing dge la dga'/ zhes bya ba yin phar song dang nga skor ba byed 168

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dnganade dgogaphyaga'adebasapa po'i lorgyugagasungs nas bzhud/ glang thang pa de'i nub mo nas bsnyung gzhi dwangs/ spyir jo bo 'di bsod nams gsog pa la dgyes/ zwa thug nur nur ba mi gal che ba la 'dren/ lan gcig ja ni med/rtsabs re dang bcas pa'i tsha ba zhig po to ba dpon slob la drangs/bsngo ba byed tsa na kha ba thul gyis byang bas/ po to ba'i zhal nas sgom nag khyod nyi ma de ring nas bzeng dbul ba dang bral ba yin no gsungs/ yang lha sar skor ba yun ring mdzad dus dgong mo phyi se ba zhig la byon pas skad cig lhang lhang grags pa gzigs su byon pas bud med gzhon nu ma zhig bkyigs 'dug pa bkrol nas bud med de gos kyi thu bar bsnyal te khyed rang nga la pha dang jo jo'i 'du shes zhogs/ ngas khyed la ma dang sring mo'i 'du shes 'jog gsungs/ sang mo la na bza' zhig sbyin nas btang /phyis bud med des yon bdag byas te ri de'u ste dge 'phel ri'i khar sgrub khang brtsigs nas sgrub pa mdzad ces kyang 'dug/de nas gdul bya 'dul ba'i dus la babs pa na dgon pa phyag btab ste chos 'chad nyan rgya cher mdzad tshul gong zhus ltar dang /rang rgyud 'dul ba gtso bor mdzad de 'dod yon gyi 'khri ba chod pa yang mgron po gzhung mgron pa lam la 'gro kha ma cig gis ja legs pa zhig ma gang phul/ skol nas bzhes pa'i zhu ba phul nas song / yon bdag de mdo nas yar 'khor te mjal du phyin pas ja rdul khad de 'dug pa la ja ma skol lam zhus pas/ glang thang pas ngas kyang kho ma skol/ khos kyang nga ma skol gsungs/ yang 169

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/nye gnas kyis nged rang la mi rnams kyis glang ri thang pa ngo nag pa zhu yi 'dug mjal mi rnams la gsungs lan re dang zhal ngo dkar ba re mdzad na zhus pas/ de yang yin te 'khor ba'i nyes dmigs la bsam na ngo dkar sa 'dug ge 'khor ba 'di gsos dus med pa'i nad pa dang thar dus med pa'i btson du 'dug go gsungs/ khong rab tu byang nas sku tshe hril por zhal 'dzum pa lan gsum las ma byang / ༄ de ltar jo bo 'dis sgrub pa yun ring du mdzad cing ther+sha chen gyi chos mtha' dag la skad cig kyang g.yel ba med par sbyang / gzungs dang ting nge 'dzin la sogs pa sangs rgyas kyi chos grangs med pa rnams la rtse zhing /spyan dang mngon par mkhyen pa la sogs pa yon tan thams cad kyis phyug bde bar gshegs pa nam mkha'i skar tshogs tsam gyi zhal gzigs shing / spyod 'jug las/ bdag bde gzhan gyi sdug bsngal dag/yang dag brje bar ma byas na//sangs rgyas nyid du mi 'grub cing //'khor ba na yang bde ba med//ces dang bzhi brgya pa las/ dbugs kyang sems can rnams la ni//sman las kho nar yang dag dbyung //zhes pa ltar bdag gzhan brje ba'i nyams len gtong len rlung la bskyon nas bsgoms pas 'bad med lhun grub tu byung ste/ kho bo rlung tha mal du gtong ma myong gsungs/lan gcig tshogs par chos gsung pa'i tshe pang du bud med cig gis bu chung skyes ma thag cig bskyal nas 'di khyed rang gi bu yin no/ /ngas mi gsos zer nas song / de la zhal ngo 'gyur 170
