'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/ba tsam yang med par dang du blangs/ 'o ma blud mkhan btsal nas ma rgyags bu rgyags gnang / bu de cher longs pa dang sngar gyi mi tshang des bsnyen bkur byas nas de dag na re de'i gong du bu chung 'dra byung ba ma gsos/ 'di yang de bzhin ma byas na mi gsos pa mo dang rtsis la byang bas de ltar byas pa lags/ bzod pa mdzad cing bu gnang rber zhu zhus pas ci dgar gnang / 'di ni byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa bya dka' ba'i gnas la bslab pa'o// yang lan cig lha mo lung gi dgon pa na bzhugs dus dbyar cig se lcog pa'i zhing la chu'i gnod pa byang ba na/ chu bsgyur bar zhu zhus par rwa co kha bcad pa la rnol rtses mnan pa zhig bskur nas chu'i gnod pa 'ong sa'i logs la sbos gsungs/ de bzhin byas pas chu phar bsgyur/ phyis rwa co kha phye nas bltas pas 'di ltar 'dug ste/ 'di na dge slong rdo rje seng ge yod pas chu khyed phar rgyugs zer ba gcig 'dug go de ni bden pas byin gyis brlabs pas me yi phung po zhi//de ni mi ldog lung bstan yin pa rig par bya//zhes gsungs pa dang tshul mtshungs so/ dang po'i dus su glang thang pa dang / sha bo sgang pa gnyis chos phar gsan tshur gsan byed/ sha bo sgang pa'i zhal nas glang thang pa byang chub kyi sems tshan che/ ngas phan 'dogs pa la srog gtong nus/ gnod skyel ba la mi nus/khong gis gnyis ka nus gsungs/ gzhan yang mya ngan las 'da' khar sems can gyi don du dmyal bar skye bar shog ces 171

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/smon lam btab pa yin te mi 'grub pa 'dra/ dag pa'i snang ba 'ba' zhig 'char gyi 'dug gsungs nas thugs khral mdzad/dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'chad kha bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen lcags zhing pa la glang thang pa'i blo sbyong tshigs brgyad ma gsan nas thugs 'gyur ba'i tshigs brgyad ma ni/ bdag ni sems can thams cad la/ / yid bzhin nor bu las lhag pa'i/ /don mchog sgrub pa'i bsam pa yis/ /rtag tu gces par 'dzin par shog /gang du su dang 'grogs pa'i tshe/ /bdag nyid kun las dman blta zhing / /gzhan la bsam pa thag pa yis/ /mchog tu gces par 'dzin par shog/spyod lam kun tu rang rgyud la//rtog cing nyon mongs skyes ma thag/bdag gzhan ma rungs byed pas na//btsan thabs gdod nas bzlog par shog/rang bzhin ngan pa'i sems can ni//sdig sdug drag pos non mthong tshe//rin chen gter dang 'phrad pa bzhin// rnyed par dka' ba'i gces 'dzin shog/bdag la gzhan gyis phrag dog gis// gshe skur la sogs mi rigs pa'i//gyong kha rang gis len pa dang // rgyal kha gzhan la 'bul ba shog/gang la bdag gis phan gtags pa'i// re ba che ba gang zhig gis//shin tu mi rigs gnod byed na'ang //bshes gnyen dam par blta bar shog/mdor na dngos dang brgyud pa yis//phan bde ma rnams kun la 'bul//ma yi gnod dang sdug bsngal kun//gsang bas bdag la len par shog/de dag kun kyang chos brgyad kyi//rtog pa'i dri masam sbags shing //chos kun sgyu mar shes pa'i blos//zhen med 172

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/'ching ba las 'grol shog/ces dang 'dir bka' gdams kyi be'u bum phra mo'ang zer/de ltar sems dpa' chen po glang ri thang pa rdo rje seng ge zhes mtshan yongs su grags pa de nyid kyis bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad nas mthar dgung lo bdun cu bzhes pa chu mo yos spyi lo 1123lo'i bod zla bzhi pa'i tshes nyer gsum nyin spras kyi nang zhi bar gshegs zhes chos 'byung dang rnam thar mang che ba zhal mthun yang glang thang dgon pa rang du lo ltar bod zla bdun pa'i tshes nyi shu lnga la glang thang pa'i dgongs rdzogs dus chen glang thang mar khu zhes pa'i tshogs chos dmigs bsal zhig gtong srol yod pa de da lta'ang rgyun bskyangs bzhin pa der gzhigs na khong gi 'das tshes de bod zla 7tshes 25la min nam snyam/ glang thang pa zhal bzhugs skabs tshogs pa nyis stong tsam 'dus/ de rjes slob ma rnams kyis sku gdung la mchod pa'i bye brag bsam gyis mi khyab pa dang bcas zhugs 'bul zhu skabs nam mkha' la 'ja' gur gyi rim pa dang / me tog gi char/ lha'i spos kyi dri ngad ldang ba/ rab byang dang skye bo'i tshogs khri phrag 'tshogs pa la mthong snang dgacu pa dang byang chub kyi sems dang dad pa mi byed pa skyes pa phal cher la byung zhing / gdung rus lha sku dang sha ri ram dang / ring bsrel dang bcas pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa byung /lhag par tu thugs ljags spyan gsum la zhugs me ma bzhes par slob ma rnams kyis gdung rten nyi zla mar grags pa de bzhengs 173

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/nas de'i gzungs su phul ba de rig gsar skabs gdung rten gtong bshig btang na yang skabs der dge slong thub bstan bkra shis kyis nyen kha sna tshogs la ma 'dzems par nyar tshags zhus te da lta dngos su mjal rgyu yod pa'i glang thang pa'i 'dra sku'i gzungs su phul yod/ dge bshes glang thang pa'i rjes su gdan sa glang thang zhang dang mdo sde bas bskyangs/ glang thang zhang la dge bshes zhang zhung pa yang zer//de nas dge bshes gnyen dang / slob dpon sgom pa/ dge bshes mgar/ slob dpon gtsang pa rnams kyis gdan sa rim par mdzad/ des glang thang rin chen sgang sangs rgyas dbon la phul/ de rjes rim bzhin glang thang dgon 'di nyid dpal sa skya'i lugs su gyar na yang je ltar bsgyur tshul gyi khungs btsan yig cha zhigasu ma rnyed kyang spyi lo 1400g.yas g.yon du byon ba'i dpal sa skya'i lam 'bras pa chen mo theg chen chos kyi rje'i sras kyi thu bo spyan snga kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis 'di gar 'chad nyan gyi rgyun bskyangs nas dpal sa skya'i pha chos lam 'bras kyi bstan pa rgyas par spel tshul spyan snga kun dga' rdo rje dang paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan sogs kyi rnam thar las zhib par gsal ba der brtag na spyi lo'i dus rabs bco lnga pa'i nang ste spyi lo 1400g.yas g.yon du byon ba'i spyan snga kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi dus nas glang thang dgon 'di bka' gdams pa nas sa skya'i lugs su 'gyur ba rtsod med yongs grags su gyur te da bar mi lo drug brgya lhag tsam phyin pa 174

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang /de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus/ni gtan la phab chog pa'i don dngos shig yin la spyan snga kun dga' rdo rje dang / dge bshes glang thang pa'i sprul par grags pa spyan snga blo gros rgyal mtshan sogs kyis kyang dgon 'di'i 'dzin skyong spel gsum gyi thog mdzad rjes chen po bzhag gnang ba de yang bka' drin rjes dran zhu 'os pa zhig yin/ de bzhin deng skabs dgon 'dir glang thang gnas sgo grwa tshang zhes grags pa ni sngon dpal gsang phu ne'u thog gi dgon par bla khag bcu yod pa las skabs de'i gnas sgo grwa tshang gi slob dpon nam bla ma ni dpal ldan sa skya'i mkhas pa sgo drug gi ya rgyal paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan yin zhing / khong gis skabs der gsang phu'i gnas sgo grwa tshang tsam ma zad glang thang dgon 'dir yang gzigs skyong chen po gnang ste 'chad nyan gyi rgyun skyong bzhin pa na/sngar gyi mkhas pa du ma'i 'byang gnas su gyar ba gsang phu'i gdan sa de nyid rim bzhin snyams rgud kyizlo grwa tshang mang che ba gsang phu nas yul phyogs gzhan du kha gyes bzhin pa ltar gnas sgo grwa tshang 'di yang nyams rgud kyis dge 'dun pa rnams glang thang du bzhugs pa'i paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gyi drung du 'dus nas mu mthud dge sbyor la brtson par mdzad pas dus de nas bzung glang thang dgon 'dir glang thang gnas sgo grwa tshang zhes grags/ 'on kyang lo re'i bod zla 4tshes 1nas bod zla 5tshes 15bar ni gsang phu dbyar chos kyi dus chen khyad par can zhig yin pa na sngar yul lung gang sar kha gyes pa'i gsang phu'i bla khag 175

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/bcu po de dag dus tshod de'i ring gsang phur 'du 'dzoms byed dgos pa ltar glang thang dgon 'di yang gsang phu gnas sgo grwa ༵nga g+ni mtshan thog nas gsang phu dbyar chos la phebs dgos pa na (2/) spyi lo 1959lo'i gong gi dgon 'di'i phyi'i gzhi khyon bye/ /rno ṭ+wāṃ gnā k+to sbri trī bzhin phyi'i mchod rten dang rgyun mchod cho ga sngon dge bshes glang thang pa'i sku dus su bzhengs pa'i dgra bcom 'du khang gi 'og khang ka ba bzhi yi nang sku dang thugs kyi rten du dbus su byams mgon gsung byon dang / spyan snga kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi thugs dam gyi rten rdo rje 'chang thog tshad ma/ glang thang pa'i thugs dam gyi rten ras bris ma mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po dang nye sras brgyad la 'dod yon gyi lha mos bskor ba gsung byon tshul khrims kyi dri ngad dang ldan pa de gser zangs las grub pa'i thub pa'i dbang po zhal byang gzigs sku tshad thog so gcig dang ldan pa de'i thugs kur bzhugs/ gdung rten nyi zla mar grags pa der glang thang pa'i ring bsrel dang thugs ljags spyan gsum bzhugs/ gser zangs las grub pa'i gdung rten byin can spyan snga pa dang po to ba'i thugs dam rten bzhugs ma/ byang ngos kyi gdung rten nang spyan snga kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyi sku gdung hril por bzhugs shing mtha' skor la rgya gar shar li las grub pa'i gdung rten brgya phrag skor 176

'phan yulagyi bka' gdamasapa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagiphyaga'adebasapa po'i lorgyugabazhugs/ sman 'dam las grub pa'i glang thang pa'i 'dra sku byin can 'di'i thugs kur drod rta rnga tsam ma yal bar bzhugs zhes da lta'i rgad po rnams kyi gleng / gser zangs kyi jo sras mi tshad che ba tsam/ sman 'dam las grub pa'i thub dbang dang / po to ba dang spyan snga pa'i 'dra sku mi tshad ma/ chos rje dpal bzang gi sku gdung mi tshad che ba tsam/ li ma'i rgyal ba rigs lnga khru gang tsam/ dzik+ṣi las grub pa'i jo bo lo ki shwa ra dang / nye sras brgyad byis pa lo brgyad tsam/ gser zangs las grub pa'i glang thang pa'i sku nga 'dra ma byin can/ po to ba'i sku byin can/ stag lung thang pa/ 'bri gung thang pa/ li las grub pa'i thub dbang gi sku sogs sku sna tshogs brgya phrag gcig lhag bzhugs/ gzhan yang glang thang pa rdo rje seng ge zhal bzhugs skabs kyi bzhugs khri shing las grub pa byin can/ sman 'dam las grub pa'i rje yab sras gsum dang gnas brtan bcu drug bcas bzhugs pa ma zad/glang thang pa rang gi sku dus su byung ba'i bzang ngan legs nyes brtag pa'i snod mchod kong dang 'dra ba ljon gyi mtshan thub ta ming mtshan can logs na i khung yod kyang legs na chu mi zags shing nyes na chu zags pa'i srid na mthong bar dka' ba'i ya mtshan can dang / yon chab 'bulasnod ljang ting bdun tshar che chung gnyis/ hor ting bdun tshar che chung gnyis/ li ting bdun tshar lnga/4 glang thang pa'i gser kong byin can/ glang thang pa rang gi chos gos gnam lcags thog thub ma/ glang thang 177

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/pa rang gi phyag bzo rol mo cha gcig bzo skrun bgyid pa las ya gcig ji bzhin ma grub pa 'di yang 'dus byas thams cad mi rtag par mtshon pa yin zhes gsungs par grags/ de bzhin gsung gi rten du glang thang pa'i gsung rten 'bum gser chos dang /gzhan yang gser dngul 'dres ma las grub pa'i bka' 'gyur/pod bzhir bsdus pa'i yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum ya mtshan can sogs sku gsung thugs rten byin rlabs can mang dag cig bzhugs/ de nas g.yas kyi gnas bcu lha khang ka ba bzhi yi nang sman 'dam las grub pa'i thub pa gtso 'khor gsum/gnas brtan bcu drug brag ri dang bcas pa/ rigs gsum mgon po mi tshad ma/ tshe lha rnam gsum/ bla sku 'jam dbyangs rnam gsum dang / g.yon gyi ka ba bzhi yi nang slob dpon gyi 'khrungs rab gsal ba'i ldebs ris kyang bzhugs/ tshogs khang ka ba bcu drug gi nang dbus su sman 'dam las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa thog brtsegs gnyis ldan/ byams pa'i steng gi g.yas g.yon du gnas brtan bcu drug khru gang tsam byas pa cha tshang /gser zangs las grub pa'i thub dbang dang tshe lha rnam gsum/rgyal ba rigs lnga sogs bzhugs pa dang / de'i gzhogs gnyis su dus gsum sangs rgyas mi tshad ma/ li las grub pa'i rdo rje 'chang mi tshad ma/ li las grub pa'i bde mchog gi sku khru gang tsam zhig tshe lha rnam gsum mi tshad ma/ g.yon du li ma'i thub dbang mi tshad ma dang / thugs rje chen po phyag stong spyan stong mi tshad ma/178

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/sman 'dam las grub pa'i glang thang pa'i 'dra sku khru gang tsam dang /rgyal dbang lnga pa mi tshad ma/ sa paṇa mi tshad ma/ rgyal dbang bdun pa mi tshad ma/ gu ru rin po che mi tshad ma/ dbyar gnas kyi rten gtso gser zangs las grub pa'i thub dbang mi tshad chung ba tsam/ yang thub dbang gi sku phru gang byas pa zhigagaser zangs las grub pa'i rnam rgyal mchod rten che chung gnyis/li ma'i mchod rten khru gang tsam byas pa sum cu lhag tsam/ rten gtso sgrol ma gsung byon sogs dang / li ma'i ting bdun tshar bdun/ dngul ting bdun tshar gnyis/ dngul gyi mchod kong rgyun 'dzugs che ba gnyis chung ba bzhi/ de bzhin gsung gi rten du bka' 'gyur dang bstan 'gyur bris ma cha tshang / gser gyis bris pa'i mdo skal bzang / brgyad stong / grwa tog gser gsum sogs kyang bzhugs/ mgon khang ngam lcog gi nang du rten gyi gtso bo sman 'dam las grub pa'i jo 'brom yab sras gsum/li ma'i rgyal ba rigs lnga/ sman 'dam las grub pa'i mgon po zhal bzhi bram gzugs/ lha mo/ chos skyong bse khrab pa/ rnam sras/drag shul dbang po/ khro li 'dres ma las grub pa'i gnas brtan bcu drug brag ri dang bcas pa'i g.yas g.yon du nye ba'i sras chen brgyad/ gdugs dkar mi tshad tsam/ tsi'u dmar po dang yon tan dkar po'i zhal 'bag re re bcas dang / gser yig gi brgyad stong dang gzungs bsdus cha tshang re bcas bzhugs/yang mgon khang gzhan zhig yod pa der rten gyi gtso bo gur 179

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/mgon dang / zhal bzhi bram gzugs/ 'dod khams ma/ e ka dzaṭi/ 'byung 'dul/ na ro ba'i chos dung dang glang thang pa'i chos dung byin can gnyis bcas bzhugs su gsol/ phyi'i rten du da lta dgon pa chags sa'i byang ngos dang / da lta gyang ror gyur ba'i dgra bcom 'du khang gi nub ngos su bka' srung mchod rten zhes glang thang pa'i bu slob zhang zhung pa'i thugs dam rten 'di nyid gza' bdud rgyal po rwa hu la dge bshes zhang zhung pa'i pha mes kyi srung ma yin pa gza' bdud khyab 'jug rang nyid yon bdag cig tu sprul nas zhang zhung pa'i drung du byon te lag g.yas su gser bal sder gang dang / g.yon du mchod rten gyi dbyibs gzugs khyer te ma 'ongs pa'i sems can bsod nams gsog pa'i ched du mchod rten 'di 'dra zhig bzhengs su gsol/ 'di mi 'jigs pa dang rab tu gnas pa'i bdag po nged nas byed zer/ bla mas kyang zhal gyis bzhes nas mchod rten gyi thig btab ste nye gnas la bka' bkod pas nye gnas kyis 'di lta bu sgrub par dka' snyam nas phyogs re nas 'dom pa gang re bskums pas mchod rten grub mtshams nye gnas la bka' chad phog ste tshe'i dus byas/ 'di'i nang rten la sangs rgyas rab bdun gyi gdung ring bsrel yul masgoṅgā'i bre gang /jo bo rje nas glang thang pa yan gyi gdung ring bsrel dang phyag sen/rgya dkar nag dang li dang bal yul sogs nas spyan drangs pa'i sku gsung thugs rten brgya phrag gsum/ bka' 'gyur dang 180

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dbade dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyugabastan 'gyur sogs rten byin can mang du bzhugs/ 'dir skor ba stong dang sum brgya bskor na steng gdon gza' dang rgyu skar thub/'og gdon kla dang sa bdag thub pa sogs phan yon brjod las 'das/ sgro stong sogs la me 'bar ba skal ldan rnams kyis mngon sum du mthong ba yang yod/ de dus phyag skor mdzad na tshe srog rdo rje brag las sra/ phyi ma bde ba can du skye/ gza' bdud nyid kyis bka' las 'chad ces so/ de'i lho'i mchod rten zhang zhung pa'i phyi'i rten du bzhengs/ dbu thod la bde mchog dang rgyud sde bzhi'i lha tshogs kyi rang byon yod cing / dus bzang sogs la bdud rtsi phebs pa skal ldan rnams la thob/de'i lho'i mchod rten dge bshes sha bo sgang pa'i phyi'i rten sku rus la rta mgrin dang / sgal tshigs nyer gcig la sgrol ma nyer gcig gi rang byon sogs yod/ 'dir skor ba bgyid na byang chub kyi sems rnyed/ khyad par mdze nad la phan/ 'bum mo che'am bka' srang mchod rten gyi byang ngos mchod rten de spyan snga pa'i phyi'i rten sdu bzhengs/ nang rten la lho brag mar pa'i gdung rus sogs mang du bzhugs/ rab tu gnas pa'i tshe rta mgrin dngos su byon/ gdon bgegs bskrad cing me tog dngos su stor bas mtshan yang rta mgrin dngos byon du grags/ de'i byang gi mchod rten gdugs dkar mchod rten du bzhengs/ byad kha la mchog tu bsngags/ de'i byang gi mchod rten la rab tu gnas pa'i tshe nor lha tshogs dang bcas pa dngos su phebs shing 'dod 181

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/yon mchod rten du grags/ 'du khang rgyab ngos kyi glang thang pa'i thugs dam rten 'bum par grags pa 'di lha mi kun gyi mchod pa'i rten du bzhengs/ 'di yi nang rten la sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nas 'brom ston pa yan gyi gdung ring bsrel dang dbu skra/ mahwabodhi/ 'phags pa wa ti mched lnga/ lha sa/ bsam yas/ brag yer ba sogs kyi rten byin rlabs can rnams la sku khrus gsol ba'i khrus chu/ gnas chen brgyad sogs dang / rgya gar dang / rgya nag bal po la sogs kyi rten byin rlabs can dang na bza'/ glang thang pa rang gi phyag tsha 'bum ther/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung ring bsrel gyi snying po rnams mchod rten gyi nang bzhugs su gsol ba ma zad de dag la rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe/ shar phyogs nas gnas brtan yan lag 'byang gi sprul pa dge bshes po to bas thog drangs dge slong brgya sprog gsum/ lho phyogs nas spyan ras gzigs kyi sprul ba dge bshes sha ra bas thog drangs dge slong brgya phrag gsum/ nub phyogs nas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul ba glang thang pas thog drangs dge slong brgya phrag gsum/ byang phyogs nas mi g.yo ba'i sprul ba dge bshes sne'u zur bas thog drangs dge slong brgya phrag gsum bcas dus gcig tu 'dzoms nas rab gnas mdzad pa'i tshe sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa nam mkha' la byon nas me tog stor ba dang / sprin gseb nas lha'i bu dang bu mo rnams kyis lus phyed tsam lha mi rnams kyis mthong ba 182

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang/de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/byas te me tog gi char phab 'ja' 'od kha dog lnga ldan zug pa sogs ltas khyad par can byang bas mchod rten 'di nyid 'gran zla dang bral bar gyar/ skorjo ba'i tshad ni nyis stong sum brgyar mdzad/ thugs darā 'bum mo che'i lho'i mchod rten ni rgya lcags ri ba'i phyi rten dang / de'i lho'i mchod rten ni dge bshes mgar gyi phyi rten du bzhengs/ de'i byang gi mchod rten dge bshes bya yul ba'i phyi rten/ de'i byang gi mchod rten dge bshes 'bras mo ba'i phyi rten du bzhengs/ dgon pa'i lho ngos kyi mchod rten 'di la glang thang pa'i gdung thal mang du bzhugs/ rab gnas mdzad skabs glang thang pa rdo rje seng ge dngos su te ru ku'i cha byad mdzad nas nam mkhar byon te me tog stor/ bkra shis brjod pas lha mi kun gyis ngo mtshar gyi gnas su byed/ der nyin mtshan med par lha mis skor ba mdzad pas mi rnams tshe thung ba'i gnas su song / zhang zhung pa nyid kyis brtag pa mdzad pas mi grib lha la phog pa'i dbang gis tshe thung bar gzigs shing /de nas bzung tho rengs nas nyin gung bar mi yis skor ba bskor rgyu dang / de nas sros kyi bar du lha 'dres skor ba bskor rgyu zhes sgrig nan mdzad/ da lta pur khang mchod rten du grags/ de ltar dge bshes glang thang pa zhal bzhugs pa'i dus dang / de bzhin spyan snga sku mched dang / paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan gyi sku dus sogs dgon pa dar zhing rgyas pa'i skabs su da lta'i phyi'i gling skor tshun chad dgon gnas dge 'dun dang bcas pas 183

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/byar bur gtams na yang rim bzhin nyams rgyad du phyin te spyi lo )959lo'i gong du dgra bcom 'du khang dang / tshogs khang /mgon khang khag gnyis bcas dang dge 'dun zhal grangs brgyad cu gya dgu tsam yod/ dgon pa'i gling skor gyi bskor tshad sum brgya nyi shu rtsa lnga yin zhing phan yon ni gling skor gcig bskor na yang brgyad stong pa gcig klog pa dang mnyam zhes grags/gzhan yang dgra bcom 'du khang gi mdun du rnam rgyal mchod rten gcig dang / byang ngos mda' rgyang gang gi sar kuldi sgo bzhi'i mchod rten chen po zhig kyang yod pa bcas so/spyi lo 1959lo'i gong gi dgon pa'i rgyun mchod cho ga phyag len khag ni bod zla 1 tshes 1 nyin snga dro tshogs mchod dang dge bskos gsar rnying brje/ chos skyong rnams la lo gsol mdzad pa dang / tshes 2nyin lcog gam mgon khang du lha bsang gtong /tshes 14dang 15gnyis la rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga gtong / bod zla 2pa'i tshes15 dang 30gnyis la kun rig gi cho ga bod zla 3 tshes 15nyin kun rig gi cho ga tshes 16nas nyin bzhi'i ring mkhan po dang sde ba gnyis nas gtong sgo btang ste sgrol chog gtong / tshes 25nyin rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga tshes 29nyin bskang gso gtong / bod zla 4 tshes nyanas bod zla 5 tshes 15bar dge 'dun zhal grangs mi zhung ba zhig gsang phu dbyar chos su phebs/ bod zla 5 tshes 16nas yul spyi'i lo tog gi rim 'gro'i phyir 'bum dag sgrog gnang / tshes 29nyin bskang 184

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang /de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/gso/ bod zla 6tshes 4dang 15nyin kun rig tshes 16nas dbyar gnas dbu tshugs te de'i ring tshe dpag lha sku dang / rnam rgyal ma/ sgrol dkar/ tshe lha rnam gsum gyi cho ga res mos kyis gtong / tshes 29nyin bskang gso/ bod zla 7 tshes 14dgong mo ston mo zhes sde brgyad dang srung ma kun la dmigs bsal gyi bskang gso btang nas 'o phud sogs kyis mchod pa 'bul/tshes 15nyin lcog gam mgon khang nang bskang gso gtong zhing de'i nyin dbyar gsol dang dbyar 'cham mdor bsdus tsam phul cing gtso bo chos skyong gi 'khor rnams yin/ tshes 25nyin glang thang pa'i dgongs rjogs dus mchod la zhogs pa sman bla dang /nyin gung lam 'bras bla mchod/ smon lam rnam brgyad/ chos spyod khag bcas sgrub/ tshes 29nyin bskang gso dang tshes 30nyin dgag dbye btang nas dbyar gnas grol/ bod zla 8 tshes 1nas 3bar dbyar skyid chab gzhug gtong zhing / zhogs tshogs tshes 1la sman bla dang / tshes 2la sgrol chog tshes 3la lha bsangs gtong / tshes 4nas bod zla 9 tshes 21bar chos mtshams 'jog pa zhes rgyun tshogs yod pa tsam las dmigs bsal gyi cho ga med/ tshes 22 nyin kun rig dang tshes 29 nyin bskang gso/ bod zla 10 tshes 8dang tshes 15 tshes 25bcas la kun rig dang tshes 18la sgrol chog tshes 24la nyin tshogs/ tshes 29la bskang gso/ tshes 30bstan pa gso sbyong / bod zla 11pa'i tshes 5dang 6la 185

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/tshogs khang gi gtor sgrub/ tshes 8la kun rig tshes 9dang 10la mgon khang nang gtor sgrub/ tshes 25la kun rigatshes 29nyin bskang gso/ bod zla 12tshes 8nyin kun rig tshes 9dang 10 nyin rnal 'byor ma'i cho ga tshes 12dang 13 14 bcas la 'dod sgrub/ tshes 15nyin tshogs mang nas dar chen sku bzhengs dang zab gsol ngang chos skyong sku phebs zhu ba dang / skya ser kun gyis mjal kha dang bzang ngan brtag pa zhu srol yod/ tshes 25nas 29bar dgu gtor gyi bskang gso tshogs pa ma zad tshes 25nyin 'cham rgyugs dang / tshes 27gyi dgong mo ston mo zhes sde brgyad dang srung ma kun la dmigs bsal gyi bskang gso btang nas 'o phud sogs kyis mchod pa 'bul/ tshes 28dang 29nyin gnyis ring gar 'cham dngos gzhi de phul ba dang / tshes 29 snga dro khro bcu'i mjal kha dang phyi dro khro bcu'i cho ga'i sgo nas gtor rgyag tshes 30nyin gtang rag gi bskang gso gtong ba bcas so/rgyun du zhogs tshogs la chos spyod dang / smon lam/ gnas bcu sogs 'char can gyis 'don dgos pa ma zad sbyin bdag so so'i thugs 'dun ltar gyi cho ga yang sgrub dgos pa'o//(3)rig gsar rjes dgon pa dang mchod rten rnams bskyar skrun dang nyams gso ji ltar zhus pa'i skor/spyi lo 1959nas bzung dus 'gyur sna tshogs kyi rkyen pas dgon par nyams chags chen po byung ba dang / lhag don lo /86

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang /de dag giphyag 'debs pa po'i lorgyus/bcu'i zang zing khrod sngar gyi tshogs khang dang mgon khang gnyis ru khag gi 'bru khang byas te phyi'i khang pa tsam lhag pa phud de byings dgra bcom 'du khang sogs dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas pa tshang ma rtsa gtor du song nas dam pa'i chos la bar chad chen po byang / de rjes chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus khyon yongs nas zlog bstar don 'khyol byang rjes sngar dgon pa 'di ga'i grwa pa yin pa skabs der sdom stagatsang du bzhugs pa slob dpon dpal ldan chos dbyangs dang / mkhan po byams pa blo bzang / thub bstan dgra 'dul lam skar chung lags/ dpal ldan don grub lags/ sngon ma'i sku gnyer yin pa dge thub bstan bkra shis sam rgyal po lags sogs kyis ma skul dang blangs kyi sgo nas dgon pa nyams gso dang chos phyogs kyi byed sgo khag slar gso bya rgyu'i 'dun pa gcig mthun gyis gong rim 'brel yod tshan par dgon pa nyams gso dang chos phyogs kyi byed sgo khag spel chog pa'i bka' khrol chog mchan zhus pa brgyud rab byang bcu drug pa'i chu mo phag spyi lo 1983lo'i bod zla 6tshezlo 4nyin nas 'go 'dzugs kyis dgon pa nyams gso zhu 'go tshugs shing skabs der sku gnyer rgyal po lags kyis rig gsar skabs srog nyen la ma 'dzems par nyar tshags gnang ba glang thang pa'i thugs ljags spyan gsum dang / gso sbyong dang dbyar gnas kyi rten thub dbang sogs kyi sku rten khag dang /gser chos brgyad stong sogs gsung rten/ bka' gdams 187

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/mchod rten sogs thugs rten/ glang thang pa'i chos gos gnam lcags thog thub ma/ bzang ngan brtag pa zhu byed kyi khu snod/glang thang pa'i gser kong / li ting sogs sngon ma dgon pa 'di rang gi sku gsung thugs rten dang / gzhan yang gzi gyur sogs rang gi nyar tshags zhus pa thams cad dang / thub bstan dkon mchog lags kyis srog nyen la ma 'dzems par nyar tshags gnang ba'i glang thang dgon gyi rten gtso byin rlabs can sgrol ma gsung byon sogs dgon par gtsang 'bul dang / de bzhin dam pa'i chos la lhag bsam shin tu dkar ba'i ltag sgo ba dpal sgron lags dang / thub bstan dkon mchog sogs glang thang grong gi dad ldan yul mi rnams dang / grong dkyil a khu phur bu sogs lcang rgyab kyi yul mi/ brag yag grong tsho'i yul mi sogs yul phyogs gang sa nas thugs che'i rgyab skyor 'og sngar gyi tshogs khang dang / mgon khang / phyi'i mchod rten sogs shul cung zad lhag pa rnams la nyams gso zhus nas/ sku gsung thugs rten kyang gang 'tsham zhig sgrig gshom gyis dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs kyi 'dod blo skong thabs gnang / de rjes rab byang bcu bdun pa'i lcags pho rta spyi lo 1990lor sngar gyi tshorges khang gi lcam shing rnams rnying rul du gyar nas nyen kha chen po yod pa na/ dpal nā len+d+ra'i dge bsgos don grub rgyal po lags kyis mi dmangs shog sgor khri gcig zhal 'debs gnang ba dang /dad ldan ser skya mang tshogs kyi shugs che'i rgyab skyor la brten 188

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dnganade dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyuganas tshogs khang gi lcam shing rnying pa rnams nyams gso gsar brjes gnange ba sogs gang sar 'thus sgo je tshang du song ste da lta'i gzhi khyon 'di 'dra zhig chags shing deng skabs dgung grangs 78la phebs pa mkhan po byams pa blo bzang lags nas rgya gar paṇa chen shākya shri dang sa paṇa kun dga' rgyal mtshan nas brgyud pa'i dge tshul slong gi sdom rgyun rnams spel dang spel mus thog snga ma'i cho ga dang 'don rta dbyangs rnams kyang phyi rabs rnams la bslab khrid brgyud 'phrod bya dang byed mus la/ deng skabs dgon par grwa grangs nyi shu rtsa bzhi tsam yod pa de dag thugs mthun khrims gtsang ngang gnas pa ma zad dge 'dun pa khag cig bsam yas dang / nā len+d+ra/ sa skya sogs su slob gnyer la zhugs pa dang khag cig nas dgon pa'i rgyun gtan gyi chos phyogs byed sgo rnams hur brtson gyis sgrub bzhin yod/deng skabs dgon pa'i nang gsar du nyams gso dang 'bul lam zhus pa'i sku gsung thugs rten la mtshon na tshogs khang ka ba nyer bzhi yi nang dbus su 'jim las grub pa'i rgyal ba byams pa thog brtsegs gnyis ldan/ g.yas ngos su rim par dpal mar me mdzad/ rje sa paṇa/ paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ sa chen gong ma rnam lnga bcas kyi sku mi tshad ma/ de'i 'gram du sku rnying khag gcig ste sgrol ma gsung byon dang / glang thang pa'i sku nga 'dra ma/ dge bshes po to ba/ gso sbyong gi rten gtso thub dbang bcas dang / kurma zhwa nag rigs gsum mgon po/ slob 189

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/dpon pad ma 'byung gnas/ gnas brtan ma pham pa/ dus 'khor/ rdo rje phur ba/ grub chen bun+tashrī/ sangs rgyas seng ge'i nga ro/ mkhan chen zhi ba 'tsho/ rgyal ba byams pa/ ngor chen kun dga' bzang po/ mgon po phyag drug sgrol ljang /sman bla/ zhi khro'i thang ka bcas dang / mdun du gsar bzhengs zhus pa slob dpon pad ma 'byung gnas khru gang tsam dang /gser zangs kyi thub dbang khru gang tsam/ byams pa'i g.yon du rim par thub dbang dang / 'brom ston pa/ jo bo rje/ rngog legs pa'i shes rab/ dge bshes glang thang pa sku phreng gsum pa blo gros rgyal mtshan/ dge bshes tshul khrims rgyal mtshan sogs kyi 'jem sku mi tshad che ba tsam dang / sgrol dkar mi tshad ma/gsung rten du bka' 'gyur cha tshang gcig yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum cha tshang gnyis/ gzungs bsdus gnyis/ pad ma bka' thang / grwa tog gser gsum/ sangs rgyas mtshan 'bum/ bka' thang sde lnga gnyis/ kun mkhyen rong ston dang /paṇa chen shākya mchog ldan/ kun mkhyen bsod nams seng ge bcas kyi bka' 'bum cha tshang re dang sgrub thabs kun btus cha tshang gnyis/ rgyud sde kun bsdus/ mkha' spyod be'u bum/stag tshang lo tsā ba'i gsung 'bum/ thugs rten du li ma'i mchod rten byin rlabs can mang dag cig bzhugs pa dang / mgon khang ngam lcog gi nang 'jim las grub pa'i dge bshes glang thang pa'i 'dra sku mi tshad ma gzungs gzhug la glang thang pa rang gi thugs 190

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dag gi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/ljags spyan gsum phul ba de dang / slob dpon pad+ma 'byung gnas/ gur mgon/ dpal mgon bram gzugs/ lha mo 'dod khams ma/ chos srung bse khrab can/ drag shul dbang po bcas mi tshad ma dang / jo 'brom yab sras khru gang tsam/ li las grub pa'i thub dbang khru gang tsam/ gser zangs kyi tshar chen rin po che/ rgyal ba byams pa/ mgon po lce spyang / mkha' spyod ma bcas kyi thang ka rnying pa byin rlabs can/ gsung rten du 'bum cha tshang gcig gser chos brgyad stong / sngar gyi dgon pa'i dkar chag bcas bzhugs su gsol/ de bzhin tshogs khang nang sngar gyi ldebs ris rnying pa sgo'i g.yas phyogs su gur mgon/ e ka dza ti/ lha mo 'dod khams ma/ dpal mgon bram gzugs/ yum chen sring mo bzhi/ kye rdo rje/ 'byung 'dul/g.yon phyogs su bstan srung bse khrab can sprul pa rnam drug rdo rje phur ba/ rta mgrin/ rdo rje g.yu sgron ma/ gza' khyab 'jug rnam sras bcas dang / mgon khang nang g.yas nas rim par kye rdo rje/ rnal 'byor ma/ rta mgrin/ gza' khyab 'jugalha mo nyi ma gzhon nu/ chu srin gdong can/ seng ge gdong can/ma mo chen mo/ drag shul dbang po/ 'phrin las rgyal po/ tsi'u dmar po/ g.yon nas rim par gu ru mtsho skyes rdo rje/ 'byang 'dul/ gur mgon/ e ka dza ti/ lha mo 'dod khamazlo ma/dpal mgon bram gzugs/ bstan srung bse khrab can sprul pa rnam drug stobs ldan dpal 'byor/ lha mo nam mkha'i gos 191

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/can sogs byin rlabs can mang du bzhugs/ phyi'i rten du sngar mchod rten mang dag cig yod pa'i khrod nas da lta dngos su bskyar bzhengs legs sgrub byung ba sngon zhang zhung pas bzhengs pa'i mchod rten 'bum mo che'am bka' srung mchod rten zhes yongs su grags pa de dang / de'i byang du spyan snga pa'i thugs dam rten rta mgrin dngos byon ma/ lho phyogs su zhang zhung pa'i thugs dam mchod rten/ de bzhin dge slong chig stong nyis brgyas byin gyis rlabs pa'i mchod rten glang thang pa'i thugs dam 'bum par grags pa dang / glang thang pa'i gdung thal bzhugs pa pur khang mchod rten bcas mjal rgyu yod do//sko (4) dgon pa'i dus mchod dang cho ga phyag len sogs kyi ra/dge 'dun gyi 'dul khrims legs par srang nas sems can gyi don du phyag mchod dge sgrub la brtson༄ dgos pa de ni rab byang pa rnams kyi 'os 'gan bla na ma mchis pa zhig yin pa ltar sdong skabs 2008lo dgon pa'i nang grwa mang spyi thog nas sgrub dgos pa'i dus mchod dang cho ga phyag len khag ni bod zla 1 tshes 1nyin snga dro tshogs mchod dang dge bskos gsar rnying brje ba/ chos skyong rnams la lo gsol mdzad pa dang / tshes 2nyin lcog gam mgon khang du lha bsang gtong ba de sngar rgyun thog deng skabs dmigs bsal bod zla 1tshes 3nas 20bar sbyin bdag so so'i 'dod pa ltar tshogs dang cho ga rgyun mthud 192

'phanayulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/nas gtong ba dang / zla ba yang ngo'i tshes 10la mkha' spyod ma'i cho ga dang / nya stong brgyad gsum dang nyer lnga la dgon pa'i mchod chos khag gtong / zla ba bzhi par kun rig sgrub mchod tshugs/ bod zla 6pa'i tshes 4la glang thang sogs yul spyi'i lo tog gi zhabs rim khag sgrub/ tshes 8nyin sgrol chog dang tshe lha rnam gsum/ de bzhin mchod chos khag bcas kyi sgo nas nyin gang tshogs 'tshogs shing de'i nyin dge bshes glang thang pa'i chos gos gnam lcags thog thub ma dang sgrol ma gsung byon sogs sku rnying byin rlabs can rnams la mjal kha gtong /bod zla 7 tshes 14dgong mo ston mo zhes sde brgyad dang srung ma kun la dmigs bsal gyi bskang gso btang nas 'o phud sogs kyis mchod pa 'bul dgos pa yin/ tshes 15 nyin dbyar gsol zhes srang ma kun la bskang gso gtong / bod zla 7 tshes 25)na dge bshes glang thang pa'i dgongs tshogs kyi dus mchod de sngar rgyun bzhin gtong / bod zla 9tshes22dang bod zla 10tshes 24dang 25so sor lo ltar sbyin bdag so so'i thugs 'dod ltar tshogs mchod nyin 'khyongs gtong / bod zla 11tshes 1nyin mgon khang gi lo gtor brje ba dang tshes 2dang 3la gtor sgrub mdzad/ bod zla 12tshes 15nyin 'dod sgrub dang dar chen sku bzhengs gnang / tshes 25nyin dge bskos kyi gtong sgo dang 'cham rgyugs len/ tshes 27nas 29bar zhogs ltar bskang gso gtong ba dang tshes 28 nyin 193

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/gar 'cham phul/ de bzhin tshes 29zhigs pa tho rengs nas 'go 'dzugs kyis sngon zhang zhung pas bzhengs pa'i mchod rten 'bum mo che'am bka' srang mchod rten sogs la skor ba bskor ba'i dmigs bsal gyi byed sgo zhig yod pa ni sngon zing po rje khri pangs sum gyi gdan sa chags yul der zing pa rgyab ri'am zing pa bla ri zhes pa'i ri chen zhig yod pa de khyab 'jug gi bla ri yin pas lo ltar bod zla 12tshes 29zhigs pa tho rengs kyi mtshams su bla ri de las mchod rten 'bum mo che'am bka' srung mchod rten sogs la 'od 'phrod de byin rlabs 'jug par grags pas skabs der mchod rten la skor ba bskor na steng 'don gza' dang rgyu skar thub/ 'og gdon klu dang sa bdag thub pa sogs phan yon che zhes de nyin zhogs pa glang thang grong mi gtso bor gyar ba'i yul phyogs gang sa nas chos dad pa stong tsho mang po 'edzoms nas tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong gi gnas la rol bzhin pa bcas so///194

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang /de dag gi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/brgyad/ gang shar dag snang dgon dang de'i phyag 'debs pa po sha ra ba yon tan grags/'go brjod/'phan yul du yod pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dgon gnas grags can gang shar dag snang dgon bsdus ming du shar dgon pa zer//de ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong byang kha shang bkog skyid grong tsho'i byang shar gyi mtshams su chags shing lam bar du chu kha byang brgyud mdun grong lcags ri'i 'gram nas skyod dgos shing lha sa nas chu tshod gcig lhag tsam phebs na gnas der bde bar 'byor/dgon pa de ni thog mar dge bshes sha ra ba yon tan grags kyis phyag btab pa nas bzung da bar lo 890lhag tsam gyi lo rgyus ldan pa'i dgon gnas zhig chags yod/ dgon 'di'i phyi'i khor yug gi bkod pa ni rgyab ri dar dkar gyi yol ba 'dra ba'i ri 'dabs yangs shing rgya che ba zhig gi ngos su dgon pa phyag btab cing / rgyab ri'i rtse mor gnas pa'i ri bo rnam sras de ni bzo dbyibs ngo mtshar che ba ne'u li'i kha nas nor bu skyug pa lta bu dang /dgon pa'i nub kyi spo rags ri chung de ni glang chen gyen du nyal ba lta bu/ shar gyi nu steng ri de ni seng ge dkar mo gyen du nyal ba lta bu/ mdun gyi ma ṇi ri de ni dung dkar po g.yas su 'khyil 195

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/ba lta bu'i ngo mtshar bkod pas mdzes pa dang / de bzhin dus bzhir 'gyar ba med pa'i yan lag brgyad ldan gyi chu mig dang /dgon pa'i rgolas g.yon gang sar 'bras ldan ljon pa gtso bo gyar ba'i sngo ljang lo 'dab kyis brgyan pa sogs mthong na yid debang 'phrog cing thos na rang bzhin du dad pa'i dben gnas lhamakā bzang can zhig yod pa ni sku nyid gnas der phebs na sa da /ni/ dgon 'di'i ming gi thogs tshul skor la lung bstan gyi le'u las/ yon tan grags pas zab gzhung rnams//rdzogs par mdzad nas dar yul mdar//dag snang gang shar dgon pa bzhengs//de nas sha ra ba zhes grags//zhang rje rong po'i mi rigs gcig/gtan gyi don gnyer gus pas mchi//zhes pa'i tshig 'dir dpyad na dge bshes sha ra ba yon tan grags thog mar rwa sgreng dang klung shod sogs su slob gnyer dang sgom sgrub la bzhugs skabs khong gi mtshan la yon tan grags zhes brjod pa las shar ba'am sha ra ba zhes 'bod srol med kyang phyis shar dgon pa phyag btab pa'i rjes dag snang gang shar dgon pa zhes dgon pa'i mtshan cha tshang las shar zhes pa'i tshig de nyid spyad de dgon pa'i bsdus ming la shar dgon pa zhes 'bod pa dang / shar zhes pa'i tshig der bdag po'i sgra sbyar te dge bshes shar ba zhes pa'i bsdus ming de 'bod srol gyis lo mang song ba'i rgyun rim khrod rim bzhin kha skad kyi shan zhugs pa'am yi ge'i klog stangs la 'gyur ba byung ba 196

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagaphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/gang yin cha ma mchis kyang gar ltar shar zhes pa'i sha dang ra gnyis kyi bar du tsheg zhugs te dge bshes sha ra ba zhes 'bod srol chags ba las khong gi thog ma'i bsdus ming la dge bshes lhar ba zhes 'bod kyi yod pa ni gong gi rgyun mtshan de dag las sa (staX sod/ gon pa 'di thog mar phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus dang ji ltar phyag btab pa'i skor/rnam dpyod 'gran zla bral ba'i sha ra ba zhes bsngags pa/byang phyogs gangs ri'i khrod 'dir sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa'i snying po jo bo yab sras kyi man ngag byang chub lam gyi rim pa spel ba'i slad du bsam bzhin du byon pa sems dpa' chen po sha ra ba gang du 'khrungs pa'i yul ni/ byang rwa sgreng nas ya tshad phyin pa'i yul rom po deng skabs lhun grub rdzong thang mgo shang khongs gtsang gzhung zhes pa'i sa der yod/zhes pa der yin la/ gnas der pa tshab rom po'i rgyud du lcags pho khyi spyi lo 1070lor yum phyugs ma skyong ba'i phyir rdo leb chen po zhig gi steng na bzhugs pa'i dus su 'khrungs/phyis de la sha ra ba bltams sa zhes grags shing de'i steng na sha ra ba 'khrungs nas zhabs brkyangs pa'i shul rdo la zhabs rjes kyang yod ces rje btsun bla ma blo bzang ye shes kyis gsungs/ gnas de da lta kun gyis phyag mchod kyi gnas su byed/ dgung lo bco brgyad kyi bar yab yum gnyis kyis bskyangs shing khyim du bzhugs/der bzhugs ring byis pa'i spyod pa mtha' dag las ngang gis 197

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/log sngar yun ring po nas goms pa'i bag chags brtas pas yi ge 'bri klog sogs ni tshegs med par mkhyen/ dkon mchog mchod pa sogs dge ba'i las ni ngang gis 'jug skal ba mnyam pa'i sems can gzhan dag mthong na byams pa'i mig gis blta zhing brtse ba'i 'dzum gyis bsu ba las gzhan la khro ba dang skyon brjod pa sogs sgo gsum nyes par spyod pa la ni ngo tshar bltas te 'jug pa'i skabs med/ gzhan du na bsam pa 'di lta bu dag 'khrungs par nges te/ skyes rabs las/ btson ra 'dra ba'i khyim la ni//nam yang bde bar ma sems shig/phyug gam yang na dbul yang rung // khyim na gnas pa nad du che// gcig ni bsrung bas nyon mongs la//gnyis pa 'tshol bas sha thang ngo //phyug gam yang na dbul yang rung // gang na bde ba med gyur pa// de la dga' bar rmongs pa ni// sdig pa'i 'bras bu smin pa nyid// ces gsungs pa ltar/ khyim na gnas pa ni nyon mongs pa dang /nyes par spyod pa dang sdug bsngal du ma'i 'byang gnas su rig nas bdag nam zhig na btson dong dang 'dra pa'i khyim gyi gnas 'di nas thar te rgyal ba'i bstan pa la zhugs nas thos bsam sgom gsum la 'bad pa zhig nam 'ong snyam du de 'ba' zhig bsam zhing mdo sngags kyi gsung rab rnams la yang dang yang du blta ba lhur len par byed/ de nas pha ma dang nye du rnams kyis bag ma len pa'i sbyor ba bshams pa na rang yul nye du nor longs spyod gang la'ang ma chags par mchil snabs bzhin du dor te 198

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang /de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lorgyus/dgung lo bco brgyad pa'i dpyid klung shod chor ba zhes par bros nas rab tu byung / mtshan yon tan grags su btags/der yang nye du rnams kyis 'dzin mi byang dogs nas klung shod phyur bu zhes bya ba na dge ba'i bshes staganyen spyan snga pa chen po mtshams dam par bcad pa'i sar byon/ spyan snga pa chen pos kyang bka' gdams bstan 'dzin chen po zhig tu 'gyur bar gzigs nas/ dgyes bzhin du rjes su bzung ste gdams pa dang rjes su bstan pa mang du stsal/ de'i tshe sha ra ba yon tan grags kyi thugs dgongs la bka' gdams sku mched gsum po la jo bo rje'i man ngag zhus nas gtsang phyogs su gsang sngags kyi chos mang po zhig zhu bar 'byon bzhed nar mar 'khrungs te/ dus de'i tshe gtsang na 'brog mi lo tsā ba dang rje 'gos lo chen po bzhugs te gsang sngags rgyud sde bzhi'i 'chad nyan shin tu dar ba yod pas rdo rje 'dzin pa chen po de dag gi zhabs la gtugs te rgyud sde bzhi ga dang / khyad par gsang sngags bla med kyi man ngag rnams zhus te sngags lam sgom pa zhig gtso bor byed dgongs pa byang / de nas de ga'i dbyar dus dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to rbe chen po stag lung thang na bzhugs pa'i spyan sngar byon/chos kyi gsol ba btab pa na dge bshes po to ba chen pos kyang rang gi sras kyi thu bo bstan pa'i bdag por 'gyur bar gzigs nas spyan gyi 'bras bu ltar bskyangs te dus gsum gyi rgyal ba thams cad gang nas gshegs pa'i lam po che/ rgyal bas 199

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/gsungs pa'i chos phung brgyad khri bzhi stong po thams cad nyams len gyi lus gcig tu dril ba byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid gnang ste/ thog mar gang nyams su blang bar bya ba de nas bzung ste mthar 'bras bu 'grub pa'i bar gyi lam gyi grangs dang go rim lam so so'i ngo bo rnams rgyal ba'i bka' dang shing rta chen po'i gzhung nas 'byang ba'i dri ma med pa'i rigs pas ches zhib par mig la mngon༄ sum du snang ba'i dpe dang bcas khrid par mdzad pa na sha ra ba chen po sngon yun ring po nas lam la sbyangs pa'i bag chags sad de lam gyi grangs dang go rim la ldog tu med pa'i dad pa dang / tshig tsam min par rigs pa'i lam nas drangs pa'i nges shes brtan po rnyed nas re shig sngags lam mthon po la 'jug pa'i re ba mi 'dug snyam nas gtsang du 'gro ba'i 'dun pa log lam ma nor bar ston pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen 'di lta bu dang lan cig mjal ba 'di ga la 'dor snyam du skad cig gcig kyang 'bral mi phod par dang por mjal ba de nas bzung mthar dge bshes po to ba chen po zhing gshegs kyi bar nam yang ma bral bar bsam sbyor gnyis kyis tshul bzhin du bsten te lam gyi rim pa'i gdams ngag ma lus pa bum pa gang byor gsan/ bar skabs shig nye du rnams dang yul gyi mi mang po zhig gis rang gi khu bo'i gnas rom po re zhes pa'i dgon gnas zhig gi chos dpon du 'byon dgos par bskul ba na slar zhig 'byon nam snyam du dgongs pa byung ba la dge bshes po to ba chen 200

'phanayulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dbade dgagiphyaga'adebasapa po'i lorgyus/pos bslab btus gsung ba'i skabs byang sems lam bgrod pa'i bar chad gnod 'gyur rnams gsung ba'i tshe zhal ta pa'i gnod pa zhib tu gsungs pas thugs nges brtan po 'khrungs te/ de nas chos dpon du 'gro ba'i spros pa chod gsungs/ thog mar dge bshes po to ba'i grwa pa bying gras lo dgu mdzad/ de nas dge bshes po to ba chen po thugs shin tu mnyes pas sku 'khor nang ma lo dgu mdzad de khyon dge bshes po to ba chen po lo bco brgyad bsten zhing de'i ring la byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid mtha' chod pa gsan/ de yang rje btsun byams pas mdzad pa'i mngon par rtogs pa'i rgyan byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i rtsa ba man ngag tu byas/ de'i steng du mdo sde rgyan dang / slob dpon dpa' bos mdzad pa'i skye rabs so bzhi pa dang / rgyal sras zhi ba lhas mdzad pa'i spyod 'jug dang bslab btus gnyis dang ched du brjod pa'i tshoms dang / byang sa ste bka' gdams gzhung drug gung bsgrigs te byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i man ngag rnams dmigs skor re re nas gzhung drug po de dag gang rigs nas rgyas par bshad/ gzhan yang slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub kyis mdzad pa mdo sde kun las btus pa dang / rin chen phreng ba dang rtsa shes la sogs pa'i rigs tshogs rnams dang slob dpon ka ma la shi las mdzad pa'i sgorme rim gsum la sogs pa gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa thams cad byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i gdams ngag tu ngo sprad nas ston par mdzad 201

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/pas rgyal ba'i gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa 'chad pa la mi 'jigs pa'i spobs pa thob/ rang dang gzhan gyi grub mtha' rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu son/ sde snod gsum dang shing rta chen po'i gzhung rnams phal cher thugs la gzung ste skal ba dang ldan pa gzhan dag la gsung rab dgongs 'grel dang bcas pa mtha' dag byang chub lam gyi rim par 'dus nas 'doms pa la dbang 'byor bas bod du skyes pa'i mi zhig la sha ra ba chen po las mkhyen rab rlabs che ba med ces bka' gdams gong ma'i gsung sgros las 'byung / don 'di dag la dgongs nas rje thams cad mkhyen pas kyang / rnam dpyod 'gran zla bral ba'i sha ra ba//zhes bsngags pa mdzad/ sha ra ba chen po nyid kyi zhal nas/deng dus chos byed kun chos 'chad pa po gang na yod zer ba thams cad kyi rtsar 'gro ste/ ston pa rin po che yab sras kyi lugs de min/ dge bshes ston pas sku tshe de la bla ma lnga las ma bsten gsungs/ dge bshes po to ba chen pos kyang khyim du bzhugs skabs sba sgom la bsnyen gnas kyi sdom pa zhig zhus pa'i bla ma de dang / dge tshul gyi sdom pa'i mkhan slob dang / mtshan nyid la bslab sbyong mdzad pa'i skabs kyi slob dpon dang / 'brom rin po che ma gtogs bla ma ma bsten/ kho bos kyang bka' gdams sku mched rin po che gsum la bsten cing de'i nang nas kyang dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba chen po nyid la bsten/gzhan dag dge tshul gyi mkhan slob ma gtogs bla ma gzhan ma 202

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang/de dag gi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/bsten/ dge bshes po to ba chen po ni lo bco brgyad kyi bar du bsten te mi mnyes pa skad cig kyang byed ma myong gsungs /mthar dge bshes po to ba zhing gshegs nas dge bshes po to ba'i slob ma phal che ba sha ra ba'i rjes su 'brangs te 'khor brgya phrag mang po dang bcas klang shod du byon nas tshogs bsdus/yo byad gang byang thams cajo dge 'dun la bsngos/ de nas yun ring ma song rā rab byang gnyis pa'i spyi lo 1110g.yas g.yon du 'phan yul gang sgor dag snang dgon pa phyag btab cing rten gyi gtso bo thugs dam zhal bcu gcig pa de bzhengs par gda'/'phags pa'i dge 'dun mang du 'dus nas snyan pa'i grags pas 'dzin ma'i khyon kun khyab ste byang chub lam gyi rim pa rgya cher bshad pas chos gsan pa mang dus sum stong lhag 'dus pa byung /phal cher nyis stong lhag tsam rgyun du 'dus/ de thams cad kyang dge bshes sha ra ba chen po nyid kyi rnam thar rjes skyong ba sha stag byang ste/ sha ra ba chen po nyid kyi rang gi 'khor du 'dus pa'i 'edul bya thams cad tshul khrims rnam par dag pa gzhir bzung nas skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa sgom pa la sbyar/lam gyi rim pa'i yang rtsa ba bshes gnyen bsten tshul rnam par dag pa zhig dgos zhes 'doms par mdzad/ sha ra ba nyid kyi zhal nas theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rtsa ba dge ba'i bshes gnyen yin/dge ba'i bshes gnyen la ma bsten par lam gang yang skye ba mi srid pa yin/ sa bcu'i byang chub sems dpa' bskal ba grangs 203

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/med gsum du tshogs bsags pa la yang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis phyag g.yas pa dbu thog tu bzhag nas byin gyis ma rlabs par rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin thob mi srid pas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag gnas skabs de na dge ba'i bshes gnyen bya bar 'dod pa yin/ dge bshes sha ra ba chen po de/dge bshes po to ba'i rnam thar skyong ba ma gtogs su la'ang mi 'dud su dang yang mi 'khon/ gang du 'dug kyang dma' sa 'dzin rkyen bzang ngan gang byang yang byang chub lam gyi rim pa sgom pa kho na las thabs gzhar+sha gang yang mi mdzad/ sku mthong ba dang gsung thos pa thams cad dad pa rang dbang med par skye/ dad rdzas dang gshin rdzas gang byang yang dkon mchog gi mchod pa dang / dge 'dun gyi bsnyeno bkur kho na la gtong ba las mi dgos pa'i sar ye nas mi gtong / ma dag pa'i rdzas la ye mi 'chang / gzhan gyis zhing dang khang khyim dang phyugs la sogs phul yang gtan nas mi bzhes/ lan cig sbyin bdag cig gis zhing brngas pa'i thog cig phul ba na dge 'dun la phul nga la mi dgos rtswa sog chur skyol grwa pa rnams kyi rgyags skyel mi'i khal ma la phan 'gro gsungs / dge bshes po to ba dang sha ra ba gnyis pos thabs gto bcos gang yang ma mdzad par lam rim kho na sgom par mdzad pas rang dang slob ma rnams la nad gdon gyi 'tshe ba zhung / lha 'dre mi gsum byams/ tshe ring ba byung /sha ra ba nyid kyi zhal nas spyir legs nyes ci byung chos la brten pa/2slo

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/de'i nang nas kyang 'dul ba la brten na ldab kyang mi dgos/zhe gtsang ba/ rtag thub pa/ nyams dga' ba/ mtha' bzang ba yin gsungs/ yang zhal nas rten dang srung ba mi dgos pa'i gang zag gsum yin/ dge slong chos gos rnam gsum las yongs su bzung ba thams cad spangs te nyes pa phra zhing phra bas kyang ma gos pa zhig byang na rten de nyid mchod gnas yin pas mi dgos/byang chub kyi thoms smon 'jug gnyis rnal mar yod pa de sems can thams cad kyi mchod gnas yin pas mi dgos/ sngags pa mtshan nyid dang ldan pa snang ba thams cad lha dang lha mor shes pa la mi dgos gsungs/ bka' rgyud zam mi chad pa'i gdams pa la brten nas shes bzhin chen pos thams cad mig 'og tu chud par byas te/ spyod lam rnam bzhir ci byed thams cad thar pa'i rgyur dkar lam gyis gtong shes pa zhig dgos gsungs/ po to ba'i bka' rgyud 'di bstan pa rin po che khas blangs kyi chos kho na las span spun ye mi mdzad de/ 'tshe ba nyung / mi byams/ sku tshe ring bar byang ste/ kho bos ni man ngag de mngon sum du go bar byang rgosungs/ lan cig sha ra ba chen po la slob ma rnams kyis phyogs gzhan zhig tu 'byon par zhus pa na chos 'phel na gang du phyin kyang chog gnyen nye du la chags pa'ang med/ gnas gzhi sde dgon la chags pa'ang med/ kho bo'i steng na dbang che ba gzhan ngo srung dgos pa'ang su yang med gsungs/ sha ra ba chen po thugs bskyed shin tu bzang bas 205

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/'khor sum stong tsam 'dus pa de thams cad kyang thos bsam sgom pas dus 'da'/ zas gos gnas mal dang sde dgon la chags pa spangs pa sha stag bzhugs/ chos gnang ba thams cad kyang skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa nyid la skor nas de'i thog tu 'bab pa kho na mdzad/ tshong dang bun bskyed kyis nor bsgrubs nas dkon mchog mchod pa dang dbul phongs la sbyin gtong byed pa byang na nga ni khyed la gtong ba'i phan yon mi brjod kyis 'dzin pa'o nyes dmigs brjod pa yin gsungs nas mi dgyes/ dben pa'i ri sul du tshul khrims rnam par dag pa la gnas pa byung na shin tu dgyes te dben pa'i ri sul du drang srong gi spyod tshul gyis gnas pa zhig byung na da gzod phas bu gsos bya ba yin gsungs/ rab tu byang ba zhing las byed pa gzigs na shin tu mi dgyes te/ sha ra dro nyid kyi zhal nas rab tu byang ba bya ba so nam rnam bzhi spangs pa zhig la zer ba yin/ dargo slong bya ba 'dod pa spangs pa zhig la zer ba yin/ byang chub sems dpa' bya ba rang don spangs pa zhig la zer ba yin/ sgom chen bya ba 'du 'dzi spangs pa zhig la zer ba yin gsungs/ sems dpa' chen po 'di ni jo bo rjes/ 'phral la zas 'tshol bya dang 'dra//khag ste langs pas gzhis rdzogs pa// byar med de ni bstan yul yin//zhes gsungs pa ltar jo bo yab sras kyi rnam thar gtsang ma gzhan 'dres med par skyong ba/ phyi rabs kyi gdul bya kun gyi smon gnas su 'os pa zhig byung / bod snga rabs su byon pa'i 206

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang /de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/bshes gnyen rnams la spyod pa rnam par dag pa jo bo yab sras kyi dgongs pa ltar byed pa mang bar byang na'ang lta ba rnam par dag pa jo bo yab sras kyi dgongs pa stor 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dbu ma rigs tshogs kyi don slob dpon sangs rgyas bskyangs dang slob dpon zla ba grags pas bkral ba'i dbu ma'i lta ba mthar thug pa rtogs pa dkon par byang 'dug pa na sems dpa' chen po sha ra ba 'di bzhugs pa'i sdus su pa tshab lo tsā bas rgya gar du byon te slob dpon zla ba grags pa la gsol ba thugs drag la rgyun ring ba btab pas slob dpon zla ba grags pas dngos su zhal bstan te byin gyis brlabs pas dbu ma'i lta ba thun mong ma yin pa rtogs/ bod du 'phags pa kla sgrub kyi lta ba thun mong ma yin pa de dar na ci ma rung snyam sdu dgongs nas dbu ma la 'jug pa bsgyur/ bod du lugs bzang de spel ba'i 'phrin las mdzad pa na blun po rmongs pa'i khyu dag gis chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ma grub pa btags yod ming rkyang tsam gyi tshul de thos pa na/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis med par lta ba ni chad lta'o zhes smras nas kla sgrub lugs bzang spel ba'i 'phrin las bkag pa na dge dro'i bshes gnyen sha ra bas kla sgrub yab sras kyi dgongs pa yin min ngas shes gsungs nas the tshab lo tsā ba la dbu ma'i lugs kyi gzhi lam 'bras gsum gyi rnam gzhag ji ltar yin dang / dbu ma'i lta ba'i dgag bya gang yin dang / de 'gog byed rigs pa'i gtso bo gang la byed dang / dbu 207

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/ma'i lta ba sgom pa'i tshe sbyor dngos rjes gsum du je ltar byed ces dri ba zhib tu bskur nas grwa gzhon shes rab can gnyis pa tshab lo tsā ba'i sar btang bas/ pa tshab lo tsā bas de'i lan du 'phags pa klu sgrub kyi dgongs pa slob dpon zla ba grags pas bkral ba'i dbu ma'i lta ba mthar thug 'di yin dang / de sgom pa'i tshe sbyor dngos rjes gsum du ji ltar bya ba 'phags pa klu sgrub yab sras kyi man ngag 'di ltar yod ces lan zhib tu phul ba dge bshes sha ra ba chen po dge 'dun sum stong la nye ba'i tshogs dbur bzhugs nas bur ston zhig gsol la khad du yod pa'i thog tu slebs pas tshogs dbu'i sa de khar legs par gzigs pas spyan chab mang po byon zhing bu ram phyag gis gang lcogs shig gnam du stor nas klu sgrub yab sras mchod/ pa tshab lo tsā ba mchod/ chos 'di 'dra zhig gis 'khor 'das kyi shan 'byed pa yin/ sher phyin gyi mdo sde rin po che'i dgongs pa 'di yin gsungs nas btsun chung lnga bcu tsam zhig pa tshab lo tsā ba la dbu ma mnyan du btang / dbu ma'i lugs bzang spel ba la mthun pa'i rkyen zang zing mang po bskur/ pa tshab lo tsā ba la bsngags brjod che bar mdzad pas log par rtog pa'i smra ba ngan pa rnams rang shugs kyis 'gags/pa tshab lo tsā ba la 'phrin las cher 'phel bar gyar/ de dus pa tshab lo tsā bas rang nyid kyis bsgyur ba'i dbu rmo 'jug pa dge bshes sha ra ba la gzigs su phul bas/ sha ra ba chen pos legs par gzigs te/ 'di la 'di ltar 'ong thang zhes sgyur 208

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/skyon gang byang thams cad bris nas rgya dpe la ltos zhes bskur ba na pa tshabasta lo tsā bas rgya dpe la gzigs pas sha ra bas gang gsung ba de kho na bzhin du byung bas dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha ra ba la rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyar ro cog thugs la mnga'o zhes grags pa byang / dge bshes | ra ba 'di nyid bka' gdams glegs bzlo las gsal bar lung bstan pa yin te/ dad pa rab tu brtan pa'i 'khrungs rabs las/ des na rgyal po dge ba dpal//khyod kyi sras kyi srol 'dzin pa// sha ra ba zhes yul las grags//zhes dang / lung bstan gyi le'u las/ yon tan grags pas zab gzhung rnams// rdzogs par mdzad nas dar yul mdar// dag snang gang shar dgon pa bzhengs// de nas sha ra ba zhes grags// zhang rje rong po'i mi rigs gcig/ gtan gyi don gnyer gus pas mchi//zhes gsungs so// de ltar sems dpa' chen po sha ra bas bstan 'gro'i don rgya cher mdzad nas ma 'ongs pa'i gdul bya rnams kyi don du byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i khrid yig che chung gnyis dang dge ba'i bshes gnyen po to ba'i rnam thar tshigs bcad ma zhig kyang mdzad/ dge bshes sha ra ba 'dis byang chub lam gyi sgron me 'chad skabs ji ltar gsungs pa rnams zin bris su bkod pa lam sgron gyi 'grel pa rgyas shing ngo mtshar rmad du byang ba zhig kyang snang / bdag nyid chen po 'dis lo sum cu so rtsog tu tshogs pa bskyangs te klung shod des sam/ gzhong / dge gong / cong lung /g.ya' phos te/ nyang po/ grab/ shar ba/ stag dur/ dpe 209

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/rnams kyi bas mthar bstan pa'i bya ba rgya cher mdzad cing / de yang jo bo rje dpal ldan a ti sha'i man ngag skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa kho nas gdul bya'i don mdzad cing / rgyal ba'i bka' dang shing rta chen po'i gzhung thams cad skyes bu gsum gyi lam rim pa kho na'i steng du 'bab par mdzad/ rkyen bzang ngan gang byung yang tshul khrims rnam par dag pa bsrung ba gzhir bzhag nas byang chub lam gyi rim pa sgom pa nyid mdzad pa las rang nyid dang slob ma su la'ang mo bon gyi bcos ka sogs tsab tsub ye nas mi mdzad/ dge 'dun sum stong 'dus te de thams cad rgyal ba rang nyid kyis je ltar gsungs pa'i tshul khrims rnam par dag pa dang lam rnam par dag pa sgom pa la sbyar te thams cad rnam thar gtsang ma rgyal ba rang nyid dngos su bzhugs pa'i dus kyi mdzad pa rnam thar ji bzhin du skyong bar mdzad/ de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha ra ba chen pos bstan pa'i don rgya cher mdzad nas dgung lo bdun cu don gnyis pa lcags mo bya spyi lo 1141rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes nyer drug la dper zhi bar gshegs so/ / de nas der tshogs pa'i dge 'dun rnams kyis zla ba phyed kyi bar sku gdung ril por bzhugs pa'i mdun du rgyal ba'i yum bsgrags shing mchod pa rgya cher phul/ de nas pur sbyangs te gdung dang ring bsrel na bza' rnams dge 'dun stong dang bdun brgyar bgos nas phyogs phyogs su phyag dang mchod pa'i rten du bzhugs shing / slob ma rnams kyis bdag 310

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/nyid chen po'i gsung ltar phyogs phyogs su sgrub pa'i rgyal mtshan btsugs te dgongs pa yongs su rdzogs par mdzad/ de ltar dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha ra ba chen po la slob ma stong phrag mang po 'dus pa'i nang nas gtso bo byang chub sems kyi bka' babs 'chad kha pa dang / rnam thar gyi bka' babs nyi ma 'dul 'dzin/ gzhung bshad kyi bka' babs stabs ka ba/ rtogs pa'i bka' babs rong ston shes 'od/ 'phrin las kyi bka' babs gtum ston blo gros/ longs spyod kyi bka' babs rnal 'byor ba shes rab rdo rje ste bka' babs drug byang / de yang dge bshes sha ra bas phyag btab pa'i dag snang spong shar dgon 'di nyid khong zhi bar gshegs pa'i lo ste spyi lo 1141nas spyi lo 1240bar lo brgya phrag gcig gi ring khong gi rjes 'dzin slob ma rnams kyis bka' gdams pa'i chos rgyun zab mo mu mthud legs par bskyangs na yang spyi lo 1240 lor hor dmag bod du slebs pa nas bzung bka' gdams dgon pa spyi dang 'dra bar dgon pa 'dir yang gtor skyon phog ste rjes su nyams gso byed skabs btsun ma'i dgon par gyar ba 'dra yang de'i dus kyi lo rgyus kha gsal 'khod pa'i yig cha donag da bar lag son dka'/'on kyang phyis su rgyal dbang lnga ba'i dus nas dge lugs pa'i btsun ma'i dgon pa che gras shig tu gyar nas 'bras spungs bde yangs grwa tshang gis dgon bdag byazlo te lo gsum re'i mtshams su bla ma las thog re mngags gtong gis spyi lo 1959lo'i gong 211

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/bla ma rgyal mtshan dpal ldan dang / bshes gnyen bkra shis/chos 'phel 'jam dbyangs sogs kyis rim par gnang ba bcas so//(2) spyi lo 1959lo'i gong gi dgon 'di'i phyi'i gzhi khyon byi( nang gi sku rten/ de bzhin rgyun mchod cho ga phyag len sogs ṭ+wāṃ /lo 1959lo'i gong du dgon 'dir 'du khang ka ba bcu gnyis kyi nang rten gyi gtso bo gser zangs kyi dge bshes sha ra ba'i 'dra sku rang byon mtho gang lhag tsam zhig yod pa de chu mig yan lag brgyad ldan gyi mdun ngos su pha bong zhig la nam mkha' nas thog 'phen pas kha bshags te de'i nang nas byon pa dang /de sngon pha bong de mjal rgyu yod kyang rig gsar skabs gtor skyon phog ste mthong rgyu med par gyar/ de bzhin rdo'i a rang byon dang / lhor phu chung ba dang / gzur gling pa sogs bla chen bdun gyi 'jim sku mi tshad ma/ rje tsong kha ba'i zhabs rjes/ sha ra ba'i mdun zur na yig drug rang byon/ nub byang mtshams na yi ge 'bru gsum gyi rang byon/ gsung gi rten du bka' 'gyur dang yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum/ thugs kyi rten du rdo rje 'chang dngos grub rgya mtsho'i dngos slob mtshan phyed phur khur grags pas gnas 'dir phyur khus dka' thub mdzad nas rtogs pa mthon por phebs pa'i sbas pa'i rnal 'byor pa dgung lo 110bzhugs pa de'i sku gdung hril po dang / phyag phreng /212

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang/de danagaphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/mchod bshams/ phyag skor yi ge drug ma dang bcas pa bzhugs pa'i mchod rten dang shar li'i mchod rten/ srang ma'i gtso bo byang phyogs 'phrin las rgyal po dang / gzhogs ldaga' chos skyong /rgyal po sku lnga sogs sku gsungs thugs rten mang du bzhugs yod/de bzhin dgon pa'i nub tu dge bshes sha ra ba'i gdung rten mchod rten rgya phibs ma gtso bor gyar ba'i mchod rten sna tshogs brgya lhag tsam dang / mchod snyan gyi skor lam du yod pa'i bka' 'gyur lha khang nang rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur dang / sgrol ma stong sku/ grub thob stong sku bcas bzhugs su gsol/ brgya mchod lha khang nang dmigs bsal gyi sku rten med kyang gtso bo chos phyogs kyi dus chen khag tu mchod me dang yon chab sogs kyi brgya mchod dang stong mchod 'bul sa byed kyi yod/ mchod rten rnams kyi shar du dur khrod bde chen rngam pa nas phebs pa'i dur khrod kyi rang byon/ mkha' 'gro'i do rar tsā ri'i zhing skyong gi zhal 'bag rang byon/ mkha' 'gro'i brda yig rje bsod nams rgya mtsho'i zhabs rjes/ steng du mgon po phyag bzhi ba'i rang byon/rje mi la'i rang byon/ dung dkar rang byon/ mkha' spyod ma rang byon/ phyag rdor ye shes khyung khra rang byon/ stag lung pa'i phyag rjes/ sgrol ma nyer gcig rang byon sogs sku gsung thugs rten mang du yod kyang khag gcig rig gsar skabs gtor skyon phog ste da lta mthong rgyu med par gyar/ de lta bu'i gzhi khyon ldan pa'i dgon gnas 'dir zlotsun ma zhal grangs 120lhag 213

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/tsam yod pa de dag gis lo 'khor gcig nang sgrub dgos pa'i dmigs bsal dus mchod dang cho ga phyag len khag ni bod zla 1 tshes 15nyin dgon 'dir btsun ma'i dgon pa thog mar gsar 'dzugs dang bskyar bzhengs kyi dus skabs yin pas de'i nyin 'dzugs gtong zhes btsun ma rnams nas sgrol chog gi cho ga gtong zhing smon lam gang mang gsog sgrub zhu ba dang / yul phyogs gang sa'i dad ldan pa brgya phrag mang po gnas 'dir 'dzoms nas snga dro chos mjal dang mchod rten la skor ba gsog pa dang / phyi dro mkha' 'gro'i bro rar rkang bro glu gzhas la rol ba sogs dmigs bsal dus mchod cig tu srung brtsi zhu ba dang /bod zla 3tshes 30nas bod zla 4tshes 16bar btsun ma rnams nas smyung gnas dkar po cha brgyad kyi sgo nas tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong la zhugs pa dang / bod zla 4tshes 15nyin skabs de'i ar po ba rnams la gsol ras stsal te sa zla'i dus chen dga' gtong gnang bar dran gso'i phyir bar gtong zhes yul phyogs gang sa nas dad ldan pa brgya phrag mang po gnas 'dir 'dzoms nas snga dro chos mjal dang mchod rten la skor ba gsog pa dang / phyi dro mkha' 'gro'i bro rar rkang bro glu gzhas kyis dga' spro'i dpal la rol/ bod zla 4tshes 18nyin bco brgyad gtong rtsa zhes sman bla'i sgo nas cho ga rgya che sgrub pa dang / bod zla 6pa'i nang shar chen mo zhes tshes 2nas tshes 13bar bka' 'gyar dag thong ljags klog zhu ba/ tshes 14nyin gtang rag rkyo bla ma mchod 214

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagi phyaga'adebasapa po'i lorgyus/pa'i cho ga'i sgo nas gsol tshogs phul/ tshes 15nyin sngon btsun ma'i dgon pa gsar bzhengs legs sgrub zin pa'i mtshon don du grol gtong dmangs khrod du shar dus chen zer/zhes dus chen dmigs bsal zhig srung brtsi zhus nas tshes 14nyin lhun grub rdzong gi rdzong dpon sku 'khor dang bcas pa dgon par zhabs sor 'khod cing de nyin zhogs pa dgon pa'i bla ma dge bskos sogs las sne rnams kyis dgon pa'i 'dabs su spos sne dang bcas rdzong dpon gyi bsu bar bcar dgos pa dang / rdzong dpon dgon par 'byor ba nas nyin gsum ring dgon pa'i sgrig khrims kyi bdag po rdzong nas gnang zhing de'i ring khrims 'gal lugs dkrug gi bya ngan byed mkhan dag la khrims gcod nan po gtong gi yod pa dper na sngar 'phan yul gyi gzhas pa skad grags can jo lags mi 'gyur zhes pa de shar dus chen la phebs te mkha' 'gro'i bro rar sgor gzhas skyon nas bzhugs skabs byang phyogs 'brog sa nas yin pa'i 'brog pa sna sho zhig gis ra bzi nas don med mi la ra bzi bshad de nyes rdung btang ba na rdzong dpon gyis bka' btang ste kho pa dgon pa'i dar chen la btags pas gzhas pa jo lags mi 'gyur gyis tshul de mthong ma thag 'phan po lhun grub rdzong de//sku dbang btsan rang drag nas//ri bong ri la sdod mkhan//dar po che la btags zhag/ces rang rtsom rang 'khrab kyis sgor gzhas de skul bas de ga'i gzhas rogs rnams ha las hang sang du gyur ba'i lo rgyus kyang yod/215

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/tshes 15nyin rdzong nas mang ja dang / sku 'gyed/ brgya mchod sogs phul zhing dgon pa'i btsun ma rnams kyis gnas brtan phyag mchod kyi sgo nas cho ga rgya che sgrub pa dang / rdzong dpon 'khor dang bcas pa mkha' 'gro'i bro rar phebs te sgor gzhas la gzigs gnang gi yod/ de'i nyin dad ldan mang tshogs stong la nye ba gnas 'dir 'du 'dzoms kyis snga dro chos mjal dang mchod rten la skor ba gsog pa dang / khrom sa khag nas rang rang gi mkho ched nyo sgrub byed pa/ phyi dro dgon bdag nyan po bar gzhi chu 'khor gyi mi ser khrod nas bu mo kha 'bras mtshar ba gnyis la pho chas spras te sbyin bdag nas gzhas chen gtong bzhin gzhas ma rnams mkha' 'gro'i bro ra'i nang khrid phebs te sgor gzhas 'go 'dzugs zhu ba dang / de nyin sbyin bdag dang sbyin bdag dbar gzhas dang gos sna 'gran res dang / mi ser dang mi ser dbar gzhas dang gos sna 'gran res kyis skabs re tshes 16gi tho rangs la yang sgor gzhas 'gran bsdur thag ma chod pa de 'dra yong gi yod/ tshes 17nyin rdzong dpon phyir log phebs rjes grol gtong ngam shar dus chen gyi mdzad sgo yongs rdzogs mjug sgril/ bod zla 9 tshes 22nas 'go 'dzugs kyis nyin gsum ring sman bla dang gnas brtan phyag mchod sogs res mos kyis cho ga gtong / bod zla 10tshes 23nyin bka' 'gyar lha khang nang mchod me dang mchod 'bra yon chab sogs stonge tshar gyi mchod pa phul zhing gnas brtarno 216

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/phyag mchod kyi cho ga gtong / tshes 24nyin sman bla'i lha khang nang gong bzhin stong tshar gyi mchod pa bshams nas sman bla'i cho ga gtong / tshes 25nyin brgya mchod lha khang nang gong bzhin stong tshar gyi mchod pa bshams nas bla ma mchod pa'i cho ga gtong /bod zla 11tshes 1nas 15bar spyan ras gzigs kyi cho ga'i sgo nas ma ṇi gsog sgrub byed/ bod zla 12tshes 8nas 15bar rwa sgreng gtong rtsa zhes sgrol chog dang sman bla'i sgo nas cho ga gtong /de bzhin zla re'i nya stong brgyad gsum la sman bla dang / bla ma mchod pa/ spyan ras gzigs/ sbyor chos/ ltung bshags gang rung gi sgo nas cho ga gtong ba sogs spyi lo 1959lo'i gong bar de ltar rgyun skyong bzhin pa'o//(3)rig gsar rjes dgon pa'i phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rten sogs ji tsam bskyar bzhengs zhus yod pa'i skor/rig gsar rjes chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus khag rim bzhin lag len don 'khyol byang rjes byang kha shang khongs dkar po'i mthil nas yin pa narno bstan 'dzin legs bshad dang shing bzo ba tshe ring lo yag gnyis nas 'gan 'khur gtso bzhes thog sngar shar dgon pa'i btsun ma yin pa khag gcig dang de bzhin yul phyogs gang sa'i dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyis thugs che'i rgyab skyor dang / slong mor skyod pa sogs thabs shes gang yong gis ma dngul gang tsam grab gsog thub nas rgan bstan 'dzin legs bshad kyis gtso skyong 'og shing bzo dang rdo 217

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/bzo dbu chen rnams pas gros bsdur gang mang byas pa brgyud mthar sngar gyi dgon pa'i 'du khang gi gya nga ro rnams rang sor bzhag nas de'i g.yas phyogs su dgon pa'i 'du khang gsar bzhengs bya rgyu'i thugs mthun gyis rab byang bcu drug pa'i chu mo phag spyi lo 1983lo'i bod zla 1tshes 1|nyin gza' skar 'phrod sbyor shin tu legs pa dang stabs bstun nas ar po'i las grwa 'go tshugs/ lo de ga'i bod zla 4tshes 16nyin dgon pa'i 'du khang dang rung khang bcas pa gsar bzhengs legs sgrub kyis rten 'brel gyi cho ga gzab rgyas bshams shing / de'i nyin sde drug rin po che gtso bor 'gyur ba'i dge 'dun pa mi nyung ba zhig dgon par dngos su zhabs bcags nas khrus gsol rab gnas kyi cho ga gang legs gnang ba dang / dad ldan ser skya mang por yang bla ma'i zhal mjal gsung thos kyi skal bzang dga' ston gyi nyin mo zhig longs su spyod thub pa byung / dus de nas bzung mu mthud lha sa ba rgan chos rgyal nyi ma gtso bor 'gyar ba'i dad ldan ser skya mang po'i shugs che'i rgyab skyor dang༄ / dgon 'di'i btsun ma rnams nas bsod snyoms su skyod pa sogs sangs rgyas bstan pa nyams pa slar gso dang / mi nyams rgyun 'dzin gyi ched du 'bad rtson hur thag zhus pa brgyud da lta 2008lor slebs dus dgon pa'i nang khyon lha khang che chung lnga dang /mchod rten che chung sna tshogs nyis brgya lhag tsam bskyar skrun legs sgrub zhu thub pa byung yod/ gong gsal lha khang lnga po de 218

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/dag gi phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rten sogs ji tsam yod ce na/(1)'du khang ka ba brgyad kyi nang dkyil du 'jim las grub pa'i dge bshes sha ra ba'i 'dra sku mi tshad ma/ de'i g.yas su sngon gyi rten rnying a rang byon/ 'jim las grub pa'i slob dpon gyi sku mi tshad ma dang sgrol ma'i sku khru tshad ma/ g.yon phyogs su 'jim las grub pa'i rigs gsum mgon po dang / rnal 'byor ma'i sku mi tshad ma/ sgrol ma dang / phyag rdor gyi sku khru tshad ma/ de bzhin shar nub ngos gnyis su 'jim las grub pa'i sgrol ma 'jigs brgyad mi tshad ma/ dkyil du bla ma'i bzhugs khri zhig kyang yod la/da dung 'du khang gi nub der dgon pa'i srang ma'i gtso bo gzhogs dga' chos skyong dang /byang phyogs 'khron las rgyal po gnyis kyang bzhugs su gsol ba bcas so// (2) thugs rje lha khang ka ba bzhi yi nang rten gyi gtso bo 'jim las grub pa'i spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong nyis thog can dang / de'i g.yas su thub dbang dang sgrol ma'i 'jim sku mi tshad ma/ g.yon du dge bshes sha ra ba'i 'jim sku khru tshad ma/ gser zangs las grub pa'i rdo rje sems dpa'/ 'jem las grub pa'i slob dpon dang rje tsong kha ba mi tshad ma/ dkyil du bla ma'i bzhugs khri dang /shar phyogs su rje yab sras gsum dang / nor lha/ sgrol ma bcas kyi 'jim sku khru tshad ma/ rgyan drug mchog gnyis kyi thang ga bcas so// (3) mchod rten gyi skor lam du bka' 'gyur lha khang ka ba 219

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/gnyis kyi nang dkyil du thub dbang gi 'jim sku mi tshad ma dang / rgyal ba'i bka' 'gyur/ rje yab sras gsum gyi 'jim sku khru tshad ma/ phyag rdor dang / sgrol ma/ gu ru rin po che bcas kyi 'jim sku mi tshad ma/grub thob thang stong rgyal po bcas so/ (4) ma ṇi lha khang ka ba gcig gi nang 'jam dbyangs dang / phyag rdor/ tshe dpag med/ sgrol ma bcas kyi 'jim sku mi tshad ma dang / thub dbang gi sku khru tshad ma/ steng du spyan ras gzigs phyag bzhi pa khru tshad ma/ thugs rten byang chub mchod rten/srung ma dpal ldan lha mo dang / gnas chung chos skyong bcas so/(5)brgya mchod lha khang ka ba gcig gi nang grub thob kyi sku brgya tshar dang / thang ka bcas bzhugs su gsol/de ltar dgon pa'i phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rten sogs de tsam du grub pa ma zad dgon pa'i nub ngos su bka' gdams gong ma rnams kyis thugs rten du bzhengs pa'i mchod rten brgya phrag mang po yod pa de dag rig gsar skabs gtor skyon chen po phog na yang dgon pa bskyar skrun zin pa'i rjes rim pas nyams gso bskyar skrun zhus yod pa ni dang po dge ba'i bshes gnyen sha ra ba'i gdung rten mchon rten rgya phibs ma 'di'i nang sha ra ba chen po'i 'dra sku gser zangs las grub pa bu chung lo brgyad tsam gyi thugs kur de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel dkar yol 'brag khra ma gang dang sha ra ba chen po'i phyag g.yas pa/ gzhan yarngo bla ma gong ma mang po'i rten ring bsrel byin rlabs can du ma dang / shākya thub pa'i gser sku/ spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol ma/220

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/mi g.yo ba ste bka' gdams lha bzhi brgya dang brgyad re bzhugs/bum pa'i phyogs bzhir sha ra ba chen po'i thugs dam gyi rten brgyad stong pa pod re re bzhugs/ lte ba'i 'og gi cha la dgos 'dod 'byung ba'i yid bzhin gyi nor bu bzhugs pas mchod rten 'di'i mdun du smon lam gang btab 'grub par grags/de'i mdun gyi mchod rten 'di'i nang mchod pa sna lnga tshang bar bzhugs pas kha ba mi chags/ sha ra ba'i g.yon gyi mchod rten 'di'i nang sha ra ba'i lcam sring a ma ra gcig mar grags pa des ra gcig gis zhos dge 'dun stong phrag brgyad la zho ston 'dren pa de'i sku gdung dang zho khog lhan du bzhugs/ de'i shar gyi mchod rten che ba 'di nyid mkha' 'gro ma nam mkha' 'bum dang shes rab 'bum gnyis kyis sha ra ba chen po snyun pa'i dus su rgya gar nas a ru ra gser mdog rnam rgyal gsos pa ma nyams pa bdun phyi dro gcig la blangs nas/ gcig sha ra bar phul bas stun las dwangs/ gzhan rnams rjes 'jug la nad kyi gnyen por mkha' 'gro rnam gnyis kyi gdung dang mnyam du gsum gsum bzhugs/ de'i shar gyi mchod rten 'di'i nang du khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gi sku gdung zhugs la phul ba'i sku rus la mi g.yo ba brgya dang brgyad byon pa'i nang nas sum cu 'dir bzhugs/ de'i shar gyi mchod rten 'di'i nang jo gdan bzod pa zhes pa sku tshe blos btang zhing chos mthar phyin pa de'i sku gdung bzhugs/ de'i shar gyi mchod rten che ba 'di'i 221

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/nang dam pa sangs rgyas kyi sprul ba kun mkhyen rong po'i tshems dang ring bsrel bzhugs/ 'di na len+d+ra phyag 'debs pa po yin par grags kyang don du sha ra ba chen po'i bu chen bka' babs drug gi nang nas rtogs pa'i bka' babs rong ston sher 'od kyi tshems yin par nges/ de'i rgyab byang shar gyi mchod rten legs pa 'di'i nang sangs rgyas snang ba mtha' yas kyi sprul pa glang ri thang pa rdo rje seng ge'i thugs dam thang sku phyag nas ma byin can dang na bza' bcas bzhugs/ de'i nub kyi mchod rten chung ba 'di'i nang du po to ba chen po'i dngos slob zab mo stong pa nyid kyi bka' babs ram ldings ma 'byang gnas rdo rje'i ring bsrel bzhugs/ 'di la mkha' 'gro rmo rnams kyis zhabs skor sger du mdzad pas lam dod pa dang / kha ba babs kyang mi chags pa/chags kyang nges par srab pa yod pas bskal ba'i mar me yod pa'i rtags yin par grags/ 'dis ram ldings ma btab/de'i shar gyi mchod rten bzhi po 'di sha ra ba chen po'i sku rim brtan bzhugs la bzhengs shing dge slong rnam dag brgyad kyis rab gnas mdzad pa dang/ 'di'i mtshan la sku rim mched bzhir grags/ de rnams kyi shar lho na/ chu sku mched gnyis zhes pa chu'i dka' thub la brten nas mchog gi dngos grub thob pa gnyis kyi sku gdung hril po bzhugs/ sku rim mched bzhi'i shar na mchod rten yod pa de'i lho ma'i nang du grub thob dbus smyon pa kun dga' bzang po'i gdung rus bzhugs/ byang ma'i nang du 222

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dnganade dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/kun mkhyen rgyal ba chen po'i gdung rus bzhugs/ de'i byang gi mchod rten chung ba 'di'i nang po to ba'i ma shad nam mkha' 'phur nus zhes pa gnag bshad gcig bsnams nas nam mkha' la 'phur ba de'i gdung rus bzhugs/ sku rim mched bzhi'i byang shar gyi mchod rten 'di rgya gar gyi sa sna rdo sna las grub pa'i rang byon 'bum par grags/ de'i byang shar gyi mchod rten che ba 'di po to ba chen po'i dgongs rdzogs la sha ra bas bzhengs pa 'di'i nang po to ba'i sku gdung zhugs la 'bul skabs thugs bdun byon pa'i gcig dang / dpal nā ro ba'i gsol lhung baiḍār+ya las grub pa'i nang du mnyam med shākya'i rgyal po'i ring bsrel bre gang dang dpal nā ro ba'i dbu lo/ phyag dpe/ sa ra ha/ klu sgrub la sogs pa'i rgya gar gyi paṇa grub du ma'i dbu lo dang phyag sen/ gdung rus/ sku sha/ phyag phreng / ring bsrel sogs ma bzhugs pa med cing / bod kyi mchod rten zhig la 'di las byin rlabs che ba med pa lta bu yin/ de'i mdun na po to ba chen po'i nye gnas grub pa thob pa gsum gyi mchod rten yin/de'i byang shar du po to ba chen po'i dngos slob mchod pa'i bka' babs brag dmar stag rtse ba'i mchod rten yin/ 'di dang khri sbrel ba'i mchod rten 'di bal chos bshes gnyen gyi mchod rten yin/ rna ra ba dang/ sman rtsa ba/ lcags khyim pa/ ko khyim pa bcas bzhi'i sku gdung / phyag dpe/ phyag phreng sogs byin rlabs can mang po bzhugs/ byang shar gyi mchod rten 'di'i 223

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/nang du po to ba yab sras kyi phyag dpe/ gzim khri/ gzim gur bcas bzhugs pa'i gur khang mchod rten du grags/ de'i mdun dang sbrel ba mnyam med dwags po lha rje'i bla ma rgya lcags ri gong kha ba chen pos chos khri'i thog tu sku mya ngan las 'das pa'i sku gdung hril po gra ma nyams par bzhugs zhes gsal yang lcags ri dgon rang du yang dge bshes rgya lcags ri ba'i sku gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten zhig yod pa yongs grags yin pas brtag dgos par 'dug 'dis sgrol dkar gyi grub pa thob pas dgung lo brgya dang brgyad bzhugs pa de'i thugs rje dang rten 'brel las yan lag dang nying lag chad pa/ nad gdon gyis btab pa rnams gnas 'dir mchod rten 'di nyid la nyin bdun skor ba byas na sngon gyi rnam par smin pa ma gtogs pas de min thams cad nges par du gsos pa yin pas tshe sgrub 'bum pa 'di las zab pa med/ de'i mdun gyi mchod rten 'di'i nang du po to ba dang sha ra ba gnyis kyi dngos slob 'phrin las kyi bka' babs gtum ston blo gros grags kyi ring bsrel bzhugs/'di snar thang phyag 'debs pa po yin/ de'i nub tu brag ri lco ba'i mchod rten/ de'i nub tu bla ma brag nag pa'i mchod rten/de'i lho na bla ma mnga' ris pa'i mchod rten/ de'i nub na bla ma dge chos pa'i mchod rten/ de'i nub na bla ma dag chas pa'i mchod rten/ snar thang pa'i lho'i mchod rten che ba 'di'i nang du gser gling pa chos kyi grags pa'i thugs dang 'brom ston pa'i 224

'phan yul rdzibaka' gdamasapa'i dgon pa brgyad dang/de dag gi phyag 'debs pa po'i lorgyus/gdung khang / dbu lo/ phyag sen/ gzhan yang bka' gdams gong ma mang po'i gdung ring bsrel/ dwags po bka' rgyud kyi rten byin can sogs bzhugs/ mchod rten 'di 'chad kha ba/phu chung ba/ sne'u zur ba gsum gyis bzhengs pa yin/ de'i lho'i mchod rten 'di'i nang du sne'u zur ba ye shes 'bar ba'i ring bsrel sku gdung la mi g.yo ba dkar po'i sku lnga bcu nga bzhi byon pa dang / gzhan yang spyan snga pa/ po to ba/ phu chung pa gsum gyi rten mang po bzhugs/ de'i nub kyi mchod rten che ba 'di'i nang phu chung ba chen po'i dbu lo/ phyag phreng / rten ring bsrel mang po bzhugs/ de'i nub zur chos dbyings rang grol bla ma'i mchod rten/ de'i nub tu chos rje bka' brgyad pa'i mchod rten/'chad kha ba'i lho'i mchod rten che ba gsum po 'di mkha' 'gro ma gsum gyis bzhengs nas so sor thim pa'i sman mo spun gsum zer/sman mo span gsum gyi mchod rten che legs 'di'i nang du spyan snga pa'i gartsong ring bsrel mang po bzhugs/ de'i shar na zings pa stag mgo ba'i mchod rten/ 'dis pad ma gling pa'i gter kha 'dzin/ dbus nub na paṇa chen rdor rgyal ba'i mchod rten/ 'di paṇa chen shākya mchog gi dngos slob yin/ sna mkhar dgon pa btab/ de'i nub kyi mchod rten 'di'i nang du kha rag sgom chung pa dbang phyug blo gros kyi ring bsrel dang tshems bzhugs/ de dang sbrel ba 'di rngog legs pa'i shes rab kyi mchon rten/ kha rag sgom chung gi nub kyi mchod rten 'di'i nang du 'gro mgon 225

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/chos rgyal 'phags pa'i gdung ring bsrel bzhugs/ kun mkhyen rong po'i lho nub tu rim bzhin gnas brtan dka'u ba'i mchod rten/ de'i nub tu mtshungs med chos rje'i mchod rten/de'i g.yas zur na bla ma ban rogs pa'i mchod rten/ 'di'i bar 'brag la rog de'i nub tu bla ma gnyen po ba'i mchod rten/de'i nut+pa tu drung gnas kun dga' bsam gtan pa'i mchon rten/kun mkhyen rong po'i rgyab shar na bya btang tshe gcig sreb pa'i mchod rten/ de'i byang na bya bzang ba'i mchod rten/ dbus ras pa'i mchod rten/ mkhyen rab mchog grub bzang po'i mchod rten/ shākya 'od mchog mchod rten/ dben shar snga ma'i mchod rten/ bya bzang 'gram du zhol rgyal ba'i mchod rten/drung gnas kun dga' bsam pa'i nub na khun po bsam grub rgyal mtshan pa'i mchod rten/ de'i lho nub na dge bshes bya yul ba'i mchod rten/ de'i nub kyi mchod rten chung ba 'di dge bshes blo bzang dar rgyas kyi yin/ de'i nub dbus ma brag dkar stag rtse zhes po to ba'i dngos slob dpe chos rin chen spungs pa phyogs bsgrigs mdzad pa po thar pa dpal brtsegs kyi mchod rten/de'i rgyab nub tu 'gro mgon rdo rje ba'i mchod rten/ de'i mtha' gnyis la brag rgyab kun spangs pa'i mchod rten/ 'dis zhi byed pa'i chos skor 'dzin/ bya yul pa'i nub byang gi mchod rten che ba 'di'i nang du bskal ba'i mar me dang bla chen shākya rgyal mtshan zhes pa 'bras rtags pa'i mkhan po de'i dbu lo/ tshems/ phyag 226
