'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang /de dag gi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/sen ring bsrel sogs rten mang tsam yod/ 'di sras rin chen grags pas btab/ ko khyim pa'i rgyab gur khang mchod rten byang du grub thob ḍa ma ru ba'i gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten 'di la rkang pa ya gcig gis ngal ma gsos par skor ba lan bdun thebs na rkang nad yod pa rnams byang pa dang med pa rnams la rkang mgyogs kyi dngos grub thob/ ngag rgyun la grub thob 'di rig pa'i gnas lnga dang / lhag par gso dpyad rkang nad gso ba'i bka' babs yod pa'i rten 'brel gyis yin par gsungs/gong gsal gyi mchod rten de dag tsam ma zad da dung bcom ldan 'das sku gdung cha brgyad kyi mchod rten 150lhag tsam gsar bzhengs zhus yod pa bcas so/(4) deng skabs dgon pa'i dmigs bsal dus mchod dang cho ga phyag len sogs kyi skor/deng skabs dgon par btsun ma 67tsam yod pa de dag gis rgyun du dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi bka' bzhin phyag dpe skyor sbyang dang / sgom sgrub nyams len gyis dge ba'i las la brtson pa hur len dang / dad ldan mang tshogs rnams kyi shi gson la sman pa'i zhabs rim khag bsgrubs dang sgrub mus thog lo gcig nang dmigs bsal gyi dus mchod dang cho ga phyag len khag ni bod zla 1tshes 7nas 16bar smon lam 'tshogs shing gtso bo sgrol ma 'bum ther gsog pa dang / tshes 13nyin dgon pa bskyar bzhengs kyi thog ma'i nyin mor song de'i nyin dmigs 227

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/bsal rten 'brel gyi ched du ltung bshags kyi sgo nas cho ga zab rgyas dang / tshes 15nyin yul phyogs gang sa'i dad ldan pa brgya phrag mang po dang lhag par byang phyogs kyi 'brog sa khag nas 'brog pa pho mo ha cang mang po gnas 'dir phebs te snga dro chos mjal dang mchod rten la skor ba gsog pa dang / phyi dro mkha' 'gro'i bro rar rkang bro glu gzhas kyis dga' spro'i dpal la rol nas char chu dus su babs pa dang / lo chu rtag tu legs pa'i smon 'dun gang legs mtshon par byed kyi yod la gzhon nu pho mo bar dgun dus gos sna 'gran res kyi rnam pa zhig kyang rang bzhin du mngon/ bod zla 3tshes 30nas bod zla 4tshes 16bar btsun ma rnams nas smyung gnas dkar po cha brgyad kyi sgo nas tshogs gsog sgrib sbyong dang / tshes 15nyin yul phyogs gang sa'i dad ldan pa brgya phrag mang po 'du 'dzoms kyis snga dro chos mjal dang mchod rten la skor ba gsog pa dang / phyi dro mkha' 'gro'i bro rar rkang bro glu gzhas kyis dga' spro'i dpal la rol/ bod zla 6tshes 1nas 16bar btsun ma rnams nas bka' 'gyar dag thong ljags klog zhu ba dang / tshes 15nyin shar duzlo chen zhes dgon 'di'i lo 'khor gcig gi dmigs bsal dus chen rgyas shos shig yin pa na de'i nyin btsun ma rnams nas gnas brtan phyag mchod kyi cho ga gtong ba dang / yul phyogs gang sa'i dad ldan pa stong la nye ba gnas 'dir 'du 'dzoms kyis snga dro chos mjal dang mchod rten la skor ba gsog pa dang /228

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang /de dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/phyi dro mkha' 'gro'i bro rar rkangadzi bro glu gzhas kyis yul phyogs phan tshun sgor gzhas 'gran bsdur dang chabs cig gzhon nu pho mo rnams dbyar dus kyi gos sna 'gran res dang tshong pa che chung sna tshogs gnas 'dir tshong gnyer la zhugs te dbyar dus kyi khrom ra chen po zhig tu yang 'gyar/ bod zla 9tshes 22nyin sman bla'i cho ga gtong ba dang / snobod zla 10tshes 25nyin bla ma mchod pa'i sgo nas tshogs mchod phul ba/ bod zla 11tshes 8nas 15bar spyan ras gzigs kyi cho ga'i sgo nas ma ṇi gsog sgrub dang /bod zla 12pa'i tshes 1nas tshes 25bar yig ra 'tshogs pa zhes btsun ma gsar pa rnams la phyag dpe slob khrid dang / skyor sbyang / rgyugs len sogs byed pa'i dmigs bsal dus tshod cig tu gtan 'khel gyis btsun ma'i shes yon gong mthor gtong rgyur mthun rkyen gang legs skrun bzhin pa bcas so///229

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/dgu/ lcags ri dgon dang de'i phyag 'debs pa po rgya lcags ri ba byang chub dpal/'go brjod/'phan yul lcags ri dgon zhes pa de ni 'phan po lhun grub rdzong dga' chos grong brdal gyi sa khongs su yod cing glang thang dgon nas zhal lho shar ngos su phyogs te ri lam gang tsam brgyud rjes gnas der slebs/ dgon pa de ni sngar dge bshes rgya lcags ri ba byang chub dpal la sgrol ma nyer gcig gis lung bstan pa ltar sgrol ma'i gnas ri'am rgyab ri chos nyid rtse'i g.yas su byin rlabs can gyi mchod rten gyis bskor ba dang / sku pang du dgon pa'i tshogs khang dang / mgon khang / btsun ma'i shag bcas zhal lho la phyogs te dben pa'i gnas kyi nyams bzang mngon par byas pa na gnas skor ba kun la dad pa'i spa longs shig rang bzhin du g.yo bar byed cing dgon 'di phyarge btab nas spyi lo 2008bar lo 900lhag tsam song zin/da ni lcags ri dgon zhes dgon pa'i mtshan 'di nyid je ltar thogs she na sngar dgon pa 'di ma bzhengs gong dge bshes byang chub dpal khong jo bo'i slob ma bshes gnyen bal po bas phyag btab pa'i lcags ri gong khar bzhugs pas de nas bzung khong 230

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang de dgagaphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/la rgya lcags ri ba zhes 'bod pa na rjes su bla ma'i mtshan dgon par thogs te lcags ri dgon zhes grags so/(1) dgon pa 'di thog mar phyag 'debs pa po'i lo rgyus dang ji ltar phyag btab pa'i skor/dgon pa 'di thog mar phyag 'debs pa po dge bshes rgya lcags ri ba byang chub dpal ni rab byang dang po'i smad tsam la 'khrungs shing khong gi 'khrungs yul sno rwa lo tsā ba'i rnam thar bzhin byas na 'phan yul smyug rum zhes 'phan po lhun grub rdzong gi byang phyogs ngar nang shang gi khongs su yod pa'i smyug rum zhes pa'i yul der yin zhing deng skabs de ga'i yul mi rnams kyis smyong gi nang zhes brjod/ rjes su pha tshe las 'das rjes ma bu gnyis khams su phyin pa'ang yin srid/ gang ltar dge bshes glang thang pa'i sku mdun du ma bcar gong khong khams su bzhugs yod pa ni bka' gdams chos 'byung gsal ba'i sgrol me yi shog grangs 449yi nang khams su glang ri thang pa'i snyan pa thos pas/ dbus su chos la 'byon pa'i 'dun pa yod pa la/ srin mo gcig gis gnod pas pho bo drug 'das/ khong rang yang sngags kyis bcings te khyi'i lus su bsgyur kyang /glang ri thang pa mjal bar mgron po'i phyi la yong / srin mos mnan du slebs pa na/ glang ri thang pas mkhyen nas der byon/ bgegs bskrad gtor mas byin gyis brlabs pas mi'i lus su gyar/ stong nyid snying rje thugs su chud de slob ma'i mchog tu gyurab/ jo bo slob ma bshes gnyen bal po 231

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/bas btab pa'i lcags ri gong khar bzhugs pas rgya lcags ri bar grags/ zhes gsal ba dang / de bzhin rwa lo'i rnam thar du ma phra men ma yin pas rtag par gson 'dre'i tshogs su 'gro tshul dang / bus ma phra men ma yin pa shes pa'i rkyen gyis bu la yang gnod 'tshe btang nas khyi lus su bsgyur tshul sogs kyi gtam rgyud mang dag cig 'dug kyang 'dir yig tshogs la 'jigs te ma bris pas gzigs par 'dod na rwa lo'i rnam thar shog grangs 318nang gzigs par 'tshal/ gang ltar bgegs bskrad gtor mas byin gyis brlabs te khyi lus mi lus su bsgyur mkhan de rwa lo'i rnam thar nang rwa lo tsā ba yin tshul dang /bka' gdams chos 'byung dang dmangs khrod ngag rgyun du dge bshes glang thang pa yin tshul gyi bshad srol rigs mi 'dra gnyis byang na yang sngon glang thang dgon gyi byang ngos grong tsho'i nye 'odabs su dge bshes glang thang pa'am yang na khong gi nye gnas kyis bgegs gtor khyi mgor brgyab sa'i sa der khyi mo 'bum pa zhes 'bum pa chung chung zhig spyi lo 1959lo'i gong bar yod pa da lta'i rgan rabs rnams kyi gsung rgyun du 'dug pas khyi lus mi lus su bsgyur mkhan de dge bshes glang thang pa yin pa'i lo rgyus de cung zad khungs btsan par 'dug khyi lus mi lus su bsgyur rjes bla mas da dung khyod la chags pa cher yod pas bya ba ci byas kyang nga la ma zhu ba ma byed gsungs/ de nas glang thang pa'i sku mdun du dam pa'i chos la brtson bzhin pa ma yis thos 232

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa brgyad dang /de dag gi phyag 'debasapa po'i lo rgyus/pas bar chad byed par 'dod de shing gi sgrom bu gcig la phra man ma'i rigs sngags kyis btab nas glang ri thang pa mjal bar 'gro mkhan tshan gcig la bskur te nga'i bu de glang thang pa chen po'i spyan sngar chos la yod pas 'di 'tsho ba'i cha rkyen yin gyis kho la sprod cig zer/ der mi rnams kyis bla ma mjal bar phyin nas zhor la sgrom bu sprad pas ljid kyis lag pa sa la reg pa 'dug pas 'di'i nang na ci yod snyam nas kha phye la khad du bla ma'i gsung dran nas glang thang pa la zhus pas bla mas khong rang gi sku chos de sprad de khyod rang 'di gyon gsungs pa dang lhan du mdun gyi ri de'i logs su spang ljongs zhig bstan nas de la song ste kha phyes shig gsungs/ ( skabs der glang thang pas gnang ba'i sku chos de rig gsar skabs su yang nyar tshags legs par byed thub ste da lta glang thang pa'i chos gos gnam lcags thog thub ma zhes gna' rdzas byin rlabs can zhig tu brtsis nas glang thang dgon pa'i rten gtso'i gras su dngos su mjal rgyu yod//de ltar bla mas gsungs pa bzhin byas pas sgrom bu'i nang nas thog shugs drag can zhig byung nas ri 'debs kyi spangs ljongs thal bar brlags te brag rdo lta bur gyur/ /spang ljongs kyi ngos su thog khung zhes brag gzhig ral du song ba da lta'ang dngos su mthong rgyu yod// 'on kyang khong rang gi lus la bla ma'i sku chos yod pas gnod pa ma byung yang de'i mthus da lta dgon pa yod sa'i mdun ngos bar 'phur zhing de na bud med nyer gcig gis bro 'khrab pa mngon sum du gzigs te der thugs yengs nas bzhugs skabs (skabs der khong rang bzhugs sa'i rdo'i bzhugs khri de da lta'ang dngos su mjal rgyu yod//mthar bud med de dag gcig la gcig 233

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/thim ste bud med gcig rang du 'gyar ba de yang 'ja' ltar yal song ba la nyi ma yang phyi dror song zlos log yong ba dang / bla mas ci 'dug gsungs bas gong gi lo rgyus rnams zhus pas bla ma'i zhal nas de rnams ni sgrol ma'i rnam 'phral yin pas khyod bar chad las skyob phyir bud med du sprul ba sgron/ da khyod bar chad las grol ba yin pas chos la brtson pa gyis shig gsungs/de nas chos la thos bsam sgom sogs nyams su blangs tshul ni glang thang pa rdo rje seng ge dang / 'dzeng dgon pa ba sogs bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen ji snyed cig las bka' gdams pa'i chos rgyun ma lus pa zhus shing thos pa tsam du ma bzhag par thugs nyams su bzhes pa dang / de bzhin rwa lo rdo rje grags las 'jigs byed sogs kyi dbang ji snyed cig zhus shing nyams su blangs/ khyad par du glang thang pa rdo rje seng ge rang gi mdzad pa'i bka' gdams kyi be'u bum phra mo zhes yongs su grags pa deng dus blo sbyong tshig brgyad ma'am bdag gzhan ma zhes pa de la nyams len rtse gcig tu gnang bas mkhas grub kyi go 'phang brnyes pa ma zad dge bshes glang thang pa dang dgon pa ba gnyis kyi thugs sras su gyar/ de nas mi ring bar bla ma'i bka' bzhin rab byang rgonyis pa'i stod tsam ste spyi lo 1100yas mas su lcags khro dgon pa phyag btab ste slob ma'i tshogs mang du bskyangs shing mnyam med dwags po lha rje yang shing pho sprel spyi lo 1104 lor dge bshes rgya lcags ri ba'i sar byon nas 234

'phan yulagyi bka' gdamasapa'i dgonapa brgyad dbade dag)phyag 'deb pa po'i lorgyus/byang chub lam gyi rim pa'i man ngag rdzogs par gsan te nyams bzhes mthar phyin pa mdzad cing / rje mi la'i zhabs drung nas na ro chos drug dang phyag rgya chen po gsan te nyams rtogs phul phyin 'khrungs nas skal ba dang ldan pa mtha' yas pa la jo bo'i man ngag byang chub lam rim dang / rje mi la nas brgyud pa'i man ngag rnams zung 'brel du 'doms par mdzad pas sgam po ba la bka' phyag chu bo gnyis 'dres zhes grags pa rgyu mtshan de ltar yin/ de ltar lcags ri ba 'di nyid skyes bu gsum gyi lam gyi rim pa la rtsal thon/ yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs/ mngon par shes pa rgya chen po dang ldan pa zhig byang ste lam gyi rim pa rgya cher spel bar mdzad nas slob ma'i :gas mang du bskyangs/phyis rab byung gnyis pa'i smad tsam la gdul bya rtag 'dzin can rnams chos la bskul phyir gzugs sku'i bkod pa chos dbyings su thims so/ de yang khong gi 'khrungs 'das skor gyi lo rgyus khungs btsan pa zhig da bar lag tu ma son pas khong dang dus mnyam pa'i bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes rnams kyi 'khrungs 'das la gzhi bcol te re zhig 'di 'dra zhig la mi 'jog thabs med lags/ khong sku gshegs rjes slob ma'i tshogs rnams kyis khong gi sku gdung rin po che phyi rabs gdul bya rnams kyi dad rten du 'gyar phyir gdung rten bzhengs te de'i nang bzhugs su gsol yange lo bcu'i zang zing skabs lcags ri ba'i sku gdung byin can ril bur bzhugs pa de blo rmongs can 'ga' zhig gis 235

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/gdung rten las bton te grog rong nang 'phangs pa rgan rabs 'ga' zhig gis mig mthong lag zin byung ba las thos so/dgon pa 'di nyid thog mar phyag btab pa nas rab byung bdun pa'i bar bka' gdams pa'i grub mtha' 'ba' zhig dar zhing rgyas pa dang / rab byung bdun pa nas 'go tshugs te bka' gdams pa'i dgon pa phal che ba bka' gdams gsar ma ste dge lugs su gyur na yang dgon pa 'di ni skabs der dpal nā len+d+ra'i dgon dang glang thang dgon gnyis dang 'brel ba shin tu zab pas sa lugs su gyur bar snyam/ gang ltar dus de nas bzung spyi lo 1959lo bar sa skya'i lugs gtso bor 'dzin te ༵ kā phyag len khag kyang sa lugs kyi sgo nas gnang mus su ma the )/spyi/ lo 1959lo'i gong gi dgon 'di'i phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku gsung thugs rten de bzhin btsun ma'i grangs dang /dus mchod cho ga phyag len sogs ji ltar yod pa'i skor/spyi lo 1959lo'i gong dgon pa 'dir 'du khang ka ba drug yod pa de'i nang rten gyi gtso bo spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong dang / sgrol dkar sogs kyi sku rten byin rlabs can mang dag cig yod na'ang da lta sngar gyi dgon pa'i dkar chag dang btsun ma rgan pa gcig kyang mjal rgyu med pas 'dir zhib par 'bri ba'i spobs pa bral/ de bzhin mgon khang nang srung ma'i gtso bo mgon po gur dang / lha mo g.yu sgron ma/ tsi'u 236

'phan yul gyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang/de dgagi phyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/dmar po/ drag shul dbang po/ ma mo chen mo sogs bzhugs shing / dgon pa'i rgyab ri chos nyid rtse'i g.yas su dge bshes sha ra ba'i phyag g.yon ma gzungs bzhug su phul ba'i rnam rgyal mchod rten/ dge bshes rgya lcags ri ba'i sku gdung bzhugs pa'i mchod rten sogs byin rlabs can gyi mchon rten bcu phrag cig lhag bzhugs su gsol/ skabs der dgon pa'i nang btsun ma zhal grangs lnga bcu lhag tsam yod pa de dag gis zla ba so so'i nya stong brgyad gsum la spyan ras gzigs kyi cho ga dang /sgrol chog sgrol dkar tshe chog sogs sgrub dgos pa ma zad bod zla 1tshes 5nas tshes 17 bar spyan ras gzigs kyi ma ṇi ril sgrub kyi cho ga nyin bcu gsum dang / tshes 18nyin cho ga legs sgrub kyi gtang rag tu yul phyogs gang sa nas phebs pa'i dad ldan pa brgya phrag mang por dpal nā len+d+ra'i bco brgyad khri chen dang / gzim 'og rdo rje 'chang gang rung res mos su phebs te bco brgyad bka' dbang zhes dbang bskur rab gnas mdzad pa dang / tshes 19dang 20la bskang gso gtong ba ma zad lo gsol gyi lha tsi'u dmar po dang / drag shul dbang po zhu gsol yod la skabs re dad sbyin rnams kyis 'dod pa ltar sgrol chog dang / sgrol dkar tshe chog sogs zhabs rim khag sgrub dgos la skabs re gsang dbye'i tshogs skong yang gtong srol yod/bod zla 10tshes 25nas bod zla 12pa'i tshes 25bar rgyun tshogs zhes smon lam dang / gnas bcu/ gdugs dkar 237

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/sogs kyi sgo nas tshogs chos khag sgrub dgos pa bcas so//(3) rig gsar rjes dgon pa dang mchod rten rnams bskyar skrun ji ltar zhus pa'i skor/rig gsar rjes chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus khag rim bzhin don 'khyol byang nas bod kyi sa phyogs gang sar dgon pa dang mchod rten so|sa gna' shul rnams nyams gso bskyar skrun byed pa'i dus te rab byang bcu drug pa'i shing pho byi spyi lo 1984lor sngar dgon pa de r+sha'i btsun ma yin pa rnam rgyal chos sgron dang skal bzang sgrol dkar gnyis nas ma skul dang bas blangs te da lta dgon pa yod sa'i rgyab ri chos nyid rtse'i g.yas su mchod rten che ba gcig dang 'bum pa gnyis bskyar bzhengs bya rgyu'i gra sgrog la zhugs te glang thang grong tsho'i rdo bzo chen mo ba drung tog gis gtso bo'i 'gan khur ba dang / bag gro dang lha tog sogs dad ldan yul mi rnams dang / de bzhin lcang rgyab sogs yul phyogs gang sa nas dad ldan mang tshogs kyis thugs che'i rgyab skyor thob pa na zla ba gcig tsam yang ma 'gor par mchod rten legs par bzhengs grub pa ma zad sngon glang thang dgon pa dang dpal nā len+d+ra'i grwa ba yin pa skabs der sdom gtsang du gnas pa dge slong rin chen grub pa dang / pad ma chos dbyangs/ byams pa blo bzang / thub bstan dgra 'dul sogs kyis dga' dad spro gsum gyi sgo nas gnas der phebs te mchod rten la rab gnas khrus gsol legs pa gnang / de nas yun ring ma song bar rab 238

'phan yulagyi bka' gdams pa'i dgonapa brgyad dang de dag)phyaga'adebasapa po'i lorgyus/byang bcu bdun pa'i lcags pho rta spyi lo 1990lor gong rim rnos dgon pa bzhengs chog pa'i chog mchan bka' khrol byang ba ltar gong zhus btsun ma rnam rgyal chos sgron dang mi skya | tog lags gnyis nas 'gan khur gtso bzhes thog sa phyogs gang sa'i dad ldan pa rnams kyis mu mthud thugs che'i rgyab skyor gnang ste sngar gyi 'du khang gzhigs ro de dag sa gsal rdo gsal gyis 'du khang ka ba drug dang / khyams ra/ gzim chung sogs legs par bskyar bzhengs thub nas bka' gdams bstan pa'i mes po dge bshes rgya lcags ri ba'i dgon pa 'di nyid slar yang dad ldan ser skya mang po'i 'di phyi'i dge tshogs gsog pa'i gnas zhig tu gyar/ de nas yun ring ma song ba'i dus te spyi lo 1993los bod zla 4 tshes 20nyin nang pa'i bstan pa spyi dang lhag par sa lugs dang sman rtsis rig gnas kyi shes byar 'gran pa'i zla dang bral ba bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan mchog dngos su lcags ri dgon du zhabs bcags nas dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas pa la khrus gsol rab gnas rgya che gnang ba ma zad btsun ma yongs la legs nyes blang dor gyi bka' slob zab mo phebs te skal bzang dga' ston gyi nyin mo zhig kyang shar/ de rjes spyi lo 1996lor mgon khang ka ba gnyis kyang legs sgrub thub pa byung / de ltar phyogs gcig nas btsun ma gsar zhugs rnams la dgon pa'i cho ga phyag len sogs dam pa'i chos kyi shes bya slob gnyer dang / dad ldan 239

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/mang tshogs kyi re 'dod ltar zhabs rim khag sgrub pa dang /phyogs gzhan zhig nas ma dngul grab gsog gis rgyab ri chos nyid rtse'i g.yas su slar yang mchod rten gsum gsar bzhengs dang / 'du khang dang mgon khang sogs kyi nang sku gsung thugs rten gsar bzhengs dang blu sgrub/ btsun ma'i sdod shag gsar rgyag sogs sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa nyams pa slar gso dang mi nyams rgyun 'dzin gyi slad du 'bad pa du ma zhig byas pa las dgon pa'i rten dang brten pa bcas pa da lta'i gzhi khyon 'di 'dra zhig tu gyar thub pa byang ngo /(4) deng snabs dgorno pa'i phyi'i gzhi khyon dang nang gi sku rten sogs ji tsam yod pa dang de bzhin dmigs bsal dus mchod dang cho ga phyag len sogs kyi skor/deng skabs dgon pa'i nang 'du khang ka ba drug yod pa'i nang rten gyi gtso bo dbus su 'jim las grub pa'i ston pa thub pa'i dbang po dang / de'i g.yas su gu ru snang srid zil gnon/spyan ras gzigs phyag stong spyan stong / jo bo dpal ldan a ti sha sogs mi tshad ma dang / g.yon du sgrol dkar mi tshad ma dang /thub dbang / rdo rje sems dpa'/ sgrol dkar bcas kyi sku khru gang tsam byas pa dang thang ka sogs bzhugs su gsol ba dang /thog khar gzim chung ka ba gcig nang bla ma tshul khrims rgyal mtshan gyi 'dra sku byin rlabs can dang / gser zangs kyi byang chub mchod rten sogs bzhugs/ mgon khang nang srung ma'i gtso 240

'phanayulagyi bka' gdamasapa'i dgonapa brgyad dbade dgagiphyag 'debasapa po'i lorgyus/bo mgon po gur dang / lha mo g.yu sgron ma/ lha mo nyi ma gzhon nu/ma mo chen mo/ tsi'u dmar po/ 'jem las grub pa'i slob dpon gyi sku chung ba sum cu/ sgrol dkar gyi sku chung ba brgya tshar gcig de bzhin gsung gi rten du yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum cha tshang gnyis/ bka' 'gyur cha tshang gcig kun mkhyen rong ston pa'i gsung 'bum/ mkha' spyod be'u 'bum/ rgyud sde kun btus dang / sgrub thabs kun btus/ bcas bzhugs su gsol ba dang / de bzhin dgon pa'i dmigs bsal dus mchod khag ni zla ba so so'i nya stong brgyad gsum la rnal 'byor ma dang / spyan ras gzigs/ sgrol chog sgrol dkar tshe chogasman bla/ kun rig gnas bcu sogs kyi sgo nas tshogs dang zhabs rim khag sgrub mus dang / tshes bcu nyer lnga la mkha' spyod ma'i cho ga sa ga zla ba dang / 'dzam gling spyi bsang/ drug pa tshes bzhi/ dga' ldan lnga mchod sogs la yum rgyas 'bring bsdus gsum dag klog dang / bka' 'gyur zhal 'byed sogs zhabs rim khag bsgrubs dang sgrub mus su mchis pa ma zad/ sngar gyi dgon pa'i dus mchod khyad par can bco brgyad bka' dbang zhes pa de yang spyi lo 2007 lo nas slar gso byang ste bod zla 1tshes 8nas 17bar btsun ma yongs nas ma ṇi khrol sgrub dang /tshes 18nyin glang thang dgon gyi mkhan po byams pa blo bzang dang /dpal nā len+d+ra'i mtshan nyid slob grwa'i dge zla ba rgyal mtshan gnyis nas cho ga legs sgrub byung ba'i gtang rag tu yul phyogs 241

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/gang sa nas phebs pa'i dad ldan ser skya brgya phrag mang por dbang bskur dang rab gnas kyi cho ga rgya che mdzad de skal bzang dga' ston gyi nyin mo de yang bskyar longs su spyod bzhin pa ma zad bod zla 1tshes 20nyin lo gsol dang / tshes 22nyin dge bskos gsar rnying brje ba/ bod zla 6tshes 10nas 17bar mkha' spyod sgrub chos tshugs pa dang tshes 18nyin gtang rag gi tshul du bka' dbang gnang ba bcas so/ / deng skabs dgon par btsun ma nyi shu lhag tsam yod pa de dag gis gong gsal dgon pa'i cho ga phyag len sogs sems can spyi la phan pa'i zhabs rim rnams legs par sgrub mus thog bla ma rdo rje 'chang tshul khrims rgyal mtshan dang / 'jam dbyangs seng ge mtshan nyid slob grwa'i dge zla ba rgyal mtshan sogs kyi drung nas dbang lung khrid gsum gyi gdams pa zab mo thob pa dag tshul bzhin nyams len gyis sngon 'gror skyabs 'gro sogs 'bum ther dang / dngos gzhi sgrol dkar dang mkha' spyod ma sogs kyi mtshams bsnyen sgrub dag gzhung nas gsungs ba bzhin sgom sgrub la bzhugs mkhan yang mang dag cig yod pa'o//242

mjug bsdu'i gtam/gsum pa/ mjug bsdu'i gtam/gong gsal bla ma skyes chen dam pa de rnams kyi mdzad pa dang rnam thar de dag las jo bo bka' gdams pa'i lugs 'di ni bdag cag gi ston pa bcom ldan 'das yang dag pa rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi dgongs pa dri ma med pa de nyid 'gro ba'i rgyud la skye bar byed pa'i lam khyad par can zhig dang / bstan pa phyi dar gyi thog ma'i dus su bod gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir rgya gar sogs phyi'i yul gru gang sa nas mkhas par rlom pa'i gser 'tshol ba mang po yong ste sngags la snyad btags nas rtsing spyod dang chos log mi nyung ba zhig spel ba las gangs can pa rnams chos log gi mun pas sgrib ste theg pa chen po'i lam gyi rim pa la nyams su len mkhan lta zhog der go ba tsam yang chags pa ha cang nyung ba'i dus der lha bla ma ye shes 'od sogs kyis jo bo rje bod la gdan drangs te jo bos byang chub lam gyi sgron me brtsams gnang ba sogs dam pa'i chos la dag ther gyi phyir mdzad bzang ji snyed cig bskyangs gnang ba las ston pa sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi dgongs pa phyi gtsang nang gtsang pad+ma'i sbubs 'dra ba de nyid slar yang gangs can gyi ljongs 'dir dar rgyur mdzad pa rlabs chen 'jog mkhan gyi grub mtha' khyad par can 243

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/zhig yin pa ma zad/ chu 'go gangs la thug pa bzhin phyis kyi grub mtha' smra ba thams cad kyi khungs gtugs sa dang / gzhi bcol sa zhig kyang yin pa ni shel phreng shog grangs 364las jo bo rje bod la phebs nas khong gi bzhed srol la skabs de'i bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyis slob sbyong gnang ba dper na /bka' rgyud kyi mes po mar pa lo tsā ba chos kyi blo gros dang / 'gro mgon phag mo grub pa / 'bri gung skyob pa 'jig rten mgon po/sa skya paṇ+ḍita/ lhag par rje btsun tsong kha pa chen po sogs kyis jo bo rje dang/ khong gi dngos rgyud kyi slob ma rnams nas bka' gdams gsan sbyong gnang thog de dag gi nying khu rang rang gi bzhed pa dang sbyar te gzhan la rgya cher ston gnang mdzad pas phyis kyi grub mtha' thams cad kyi phyi mo lta bur gyur zhes gsungs pa de las ra sprod thub cing / de lta bu'i bstan pa nyag phra'i dus su bstan pa slar gso'i phyir mdzad rjes de lta bu 'jog gnang mdzad pa de ni rang cag nang pa sangs rgyas pa kun gyis sngar nas da bar dran gso dang bsngags brjod zhu sa zhig tu gyar yod/de ltar sde snod gsum gyi snying po skyes bu gsuzlo gyi lam gyi rim pa la yang dag par 'jug par byed pa'i bka' gdams pa'i chos rgyun zab mo 'di nyid deng gi chos dad pa spyi dang / lhag par grwa btsun pho mo kun gyis hur brtson chen pos slob sbyong zhu dgos pa ma zad slob sbyong gi khrod du thob pa'i shes bya rnams rang nyid kyi rgyun gtan 'tsho ba'i khrod du don 'khyol gyis bslab 2slo

mjug bsdu'i gtam gdams de tsho las mi 'gal ba zhig gnang dgos pa de ni shin tu gal cher mthong zhing / sngar jo bo bka' gdams pa'i lugs kyi skyes chen dam pa 'brom ston pa dang/ khong gi slob ma sku mched gsum sogs mkhas shing grub ba thob pa je snyed cig byung ba de dag thams cad kyis kyang dang thog bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung nas dam pa'i chos la slob gnyer tshul bzhin du gnang ba dang/ slob gnyer las thob pa'i shes bya rnams gzhan la bshad chos tsam du ma bzhag par sgrub pa nyams len gtso bor gyar ba'i don dngos kyi lag len thog 'khyol ba gnang ste jo bo rjes bstan gnang ba'i lam gyi rim pa la skad cig kyang g.yeng ba med par 'jug cing rgyun gtan gyi bya spyod mtha' dag 'jig rten chos brgyad las yongs su bral ba ste/ pha chos nor bu'i phreng bar jo bo'i zhal nas/ mi gral nas bud ri dwags 'dra//'phral la zas 'tshol bya dang 'dra// khag ste langs pas gzhis rdzogs pa//byar med de ni bstan yul yin zhes dang / yang dge bshes sha ra bas/ rab tu byang ba bya ba so nam rnam bzhi spangs pa zhig la zer ba yin/ sgormo chen bya ba 'du 'dzi spangs pa zhig la zer ba yin/ dge slong bya ba 'dod pa spangs pa zhig la zer ba yin/ byang chub sems dpa' bya ba rang don spangs pa zhig la zer ba yin zhes gsungs pa ltar rab byang pa zhig gi thun mong ma yin pa'i mdzad bzang de nyid legs ther bskyangs gnang ba na bden pa'i las 'bras mthu btsan pas skabs der jo bo bka' 45

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/dmas pa zhes snyan grags gang sar khyab pa ma zad rjes 'dzin bu slob kyang mkha' dbyings kyi rgyu skar bzhin thon nas khong rnams kyi mdzad pa rnam thar de rnams la dus da lta'ang nang chos la dad pa'i skye 'gro kun gyis slob sbyong dang gus bkur zhu sa zhig tu gyar ba ma zad dus rabs gsar pa'i mi chos kun spyod kyi bslab bzhi gal chen zhig tu'ang gyar yod/des na rab byadro pho mo rgan gzhon tshang mas dang thog rang nyid sngar skyes cherno dam pa de rnams kyis phyag btab pa'i dgon gnas snyan grags can de lta bu zhig gi nang chos zhugs bya rgyu byang ba der snying thag pa nas dga' ba sgom ste spro snang 'phel dgozlo pa ma zad khong rnam pa'i mdzad 'phrin de dag la dus rtag tu slob sbyong dang/ nyams len gyis byang chub kyi sems rlabs po che rgyud la skyes shing las 'bras la yid ches gtsang mar gnang ste rang gi bya spyod dngos kyi thog nas ston pa thub pa'i dbang po'i rjes 'jug pa zhig gi mdzad spyod bzang po de dag mngon par bya rgyu de ni shin tu gal che/ de lta bu'i ston pa'i rjes 'jug pa zhig gi mdzad spyod bzang po de dag legs par mngon thub pa zhig dgos na chung dus nas bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung nas shes bya rig pa'i gnas spyi dang lhag par dam pa'i chos la slob gnyer tshul bzhin du zhus nas slob gnyer las thob pa'i shes bya de dag la bsam zhib yang yang dang / sgom sgrub nyams len gyis rang gi rgyud la sbyar te thar pa'i gegs su gyur ba'i nyon 246

mjug bsdu'i gtam/mongs dug gsum las rnam par rgyal nas bya spyod mtha' dag dam pa'i chos kyi bslab bya dang mi 'gal ba zhig gnang dgos pa de gal cher mthong yang deng skabs dgon sde mi nyung ba zhig gi nang skyabs dkon mchog gsum dang / las rgyu 'bras/ tshe snga phyi/'khor ba'i nyes dmigs sogs dam pa'i chos kyi bslab bya zab mo rnams la slob gnyer bya rgyu lhod g.yengs su btang ste dgon pa'i 'don kha gral dang cho ga phyag len gyi rnam grangs re gnyis shes pa tsam gyi rang nyid yon tan can zhig tu ngos 'dzin gyis nyin ltar lha dang mo rtsis gsum gyis gtan la phab pa'i lha gsol kla gsol la dbu 'khor te zhal nas chos brgyad spangs pas dal 'ebyor don yod byas zhes skyor na yang lag len mi nyung ba zhig chos brgyad kho na'i dbang du song ste bstan dang 'gro la phan pa'i mdzad spyod cig skyong mi thub pa dang / lhag don deng skabs btsun ming 'dzin pa 'ga' zhig 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi gzhan dbang du gyar pa'i grong chog tsam la yang 'gro ma skyid par sho sbag rgyan rtsed thegs 'jig rten pa'i bya ba sna chogs la rol ba/yang 'ga' zhig dgon pa'i sgrig tsam 'dzin pa las don du khyim 'dzin a ma zhig las kyang lod pa'i 'jig rten khyim pa'i bya ba sna tshogs nang zhugs pa dang / the jus byed pa sogs ston pa'i bslab bya dang 'gal zhing jo bo bka' gdams pa'i mdzad spyod dang yongs su tha dad du gyar ba na 'jig rten 'khor bar 'khyams pa'i lha 'dre gdorno 'gegs rnams stobs rgyas shing /247

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/dkar phyogs kyi srung ma rnams thugs pham nas dgon pa'i grwa dmangs rnams thugs mthun khrims gtsang du gnas mi thub pa dang / dam pa'i chos la bar chad che ba/ grwa btsun re gnyis kyi byed spyod thabs rdugs pas 'jig rten khyim pas rab byang par kha btang ste gnyis kur las ngan gsog pa sogs rkyerno ngan mi zhung ba zhig rang nyid kyis bsags pa'i las kyi 'bras bu las phyir mngon bzhin pa na de'i mjug 'bras kyis sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa yun ring du gnas rgyur yang 'gal rkyen chen po zhig bzo bzhin pa ni mthong chos su grub bo/ de lta bu'i 'gal rkyen dang bar chad las sgrol dgos na thabs lam bzang shos ni da lta'i grwa btsun rnams kyis rang gi bya spyod thams cad 'jig rten chos brgyad kyi gzhan dbang du ma song bar ston pa bka' drin can gyis/ thub rnams sdig pa chu yis mi 'khru zhing //'gro ba'i sdug bsngal phyag gis mi sel la//nyid kyi rtogs pa gzhan du spo min te//chos nyid bden pa bstan pas grol bar gyar//zhes gsungs pa ltar skyes bu rang nyid kyi 'bad rtson la brjerno nas chos rnams kyi ngo bo mthar thug pa de yang dag par rtogs pa bya rgyu de yin zhing /de lta bu'i chos nyid bden pa rtogs par byed pa la bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi drung nas dam pa'i chos la slob gnyer gyis rang cag nang pa sangs rgyas pa'i lta sgrub kyi snying po ste lta ba rten 'byang dang/ spyod ba 'tshe ba med pa'i gnas lugs ngo ma de dang tho'e rang nyid kyis shes pa dang / shes pa rnams lag len du 248

mjug bsdu'i gtam/'khyol ba zhig dgos shing / gal te rang nyid kyi nye 'khor du bla ma dge ba'i bshes gnyen mtshan nyid tshang ba zhig med na rgyal ba 'brom ston pas dge bshes po to ba la/ bshes gnyen mdo sde la byed gsungs pa ltar bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams dang / rje tsong kha pa/ sa paṇa/ mnyam med dwags po lha rje/ rdza dpal sprul sogs ris su ma mchis ba'i skyes chen dam pa rnams kyis mdzad pa'i bslab bya dang gdams ngag mtha' yas pa las rang gis gang nus hur brtson chen pos slob sbyong dang/ nyams len gyis/ sdig pa ci yang mi bya zhing //dge ba phun sum tshogs par spyad//rang gi sems ni yongs su 'dul//'di ni sangs rgyas bstan pa yin//zhes ston pa'i bslab bya de nyid lag len du 'khyol thub pa zhig bya rgyu de ni rang nyid dngos 'brel 'khor ba'i btson ra las thar te ming don mtshungs pa'i grwa btsun zhig chags par byed pa'i thabs lam bzang shos de yin pas grwa btsun pho mo rgan gzhon bar gsum gyis dus rtag tu slob gnyer la 'bad dgos pa de ni bslab bya thams cad kyi snying po gcig tu bsdus pa de yin no//249

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/jo bo bka' gdams pa'i lugs kyi ched spyod ming tshig 'ga' zhig gi 'grel ba/(1) bka' gdams pa/ rgyal ba'i bka' las yi ge na gcig kyang gzhag tu med par gdams ngag du go ba na bka' gdams pa zhes zer ba dang / yang rgyal ba 'brom ston pas jo bo'i bka' bzhin lha bzhi chos gsum ste lha chos bdun ldan du gdams nga mdzad pas bka' gdams pa bya ba yin zhes kyang gsungs so/(2) bka' gdams gzhung drug bka' gdams gzhung drug ni skyes tshoms dang / bslab spyod/ sa rgyan bcas drug la zer zhing skyes rabs so bzhi pa dang ched du brjod pa'i tshoms ni dad pa'i gzhung dang / bslab btus dang spyod 'jug ni spyod pa'i gzhung / byang sa dang mdo sde rgyan ni ting nge 'dzin gyi gzhung bcas yin/(3) bka' gdams gzhung pa/ 'brom ston pa rgyal ba'i 'byang gnas kyi dngos slob dge bshes po to ba dang de'i slob ma da| bshes sha ra ba sogs nas gnyal grwa skor mkhan chen chos skyabs bzang po'i bar rim bzhin brgyud pa'i khrid srol de la sdu/'a gdams gzhung pa zhes zer/ de la bka' gdams gzhung

mjug bsdu'i gtam/pa zhes brjod pa'i rgyu mtshan ni lam sgron gzhir byas pa'i thog bka' gdams gzhung drug dang sbyar nas slob khrid gnang srol yod pas mtshan de ltar thogs/(4) bka' gdams gdams ngag pa/ jo bo rje a ti sha dang 'brom ston pa gnyis nas dge bshes spyan snga tshul khrims 'bar la brgyud pa'i bka' gdams kyi rgyud pa ste 'brom ston pas jo bo'i sngags kyi man ngag rnams dge bshes spyan snga la gnang zhing gzhung gi bshad pa rgya chen po'i spros pa mi mdzad par/jo bo rje a ti shas mdzad pa'i rten 'brel dang / bden gnyis kyi snrod la brten nas slob ma skyong bar mdzad pas mtshan de ltar gas/) bka' gdams man ngag pa/ bka' gdams lha chos bdun ldan snying gi thig le'i man ngag yongs su rdzogs pa dge bshes phu chung ba nyid yin pas de nas brgyud pa rnams la bka' gdams man ngag pa zhes zer/(6) bka' gdams pha chos bu chos/ pha 'brom ston pas zhus pa la bka' gdams pha chos dang / bu rngog legs pa'i shes rab dang / khu ston brtson 'grus g.yung drung gnyis kyis zhus pa la bka' gdams bu chos su grags/(7)lha chos bdun ldan/ lha bzhi dang chos bdun la lha chos bdun ldanazer/ lha bzhi ni bstan pa'i bdag po ston pa shākya thub pa/ bod khams kyi lha thugs rje can spyan ras gzigs/251

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/bdud las rnam par rgyal ba'i jo bo mi g.yo ba/ jo bo'i thugs dam 'phrin las kyi lha jo mo sgrol ma bcas dang / chos gsum ni sde snod gsum ste spyod pa tshul khrims kyi skor rgyas par ston pa 'dul ba'i sde snod/ sgom pa ting nge 'dzin gyi skor rgyas par stoshā sna /do sde'i sde snod/ lta ba'i skor rgyas par ston pa mngon pa 'a pha/ /yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod ces pa'i deb chung 'di 'dra zhig 'bri ba'i dmigs yul ni 'phan yul 'di nyid jo bo bka' gdams pa'i lugs kyi lam srol thog mar dar zhing rgyas par byed pa'i gnas khyad par can zhig yin na'ang / de dag gi byang rim lo rgyus gcig tu bsdus pa'i deb ther zhig da bar mthong dkon zhing / lhag don dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs brgyad cu nas 'go 'dzugs kyis chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus khag lag len don 'khyol byang nas jo bo bka' gdams pa'i lam srol thog mar dar sa'i rgodan sa de dag nyams gso bskyar sgrun byed chog pa'i go skabs bzang po zhig thob na yang skabs der dgon pa bskyar sgrun byed pa'i dus tshod dang/ gtso 'gan mi sna/ de bzhin ma dngul grab gsog dang mthun 'gyar rogs ram ji ltar byang ba/ da lta dgon pa'i phyi'i gzhi khyon ldang nang gi sku gsung thurgos rten/ rgyun mchod cho ga phyag len sogs ji ltar yin lugs kyi lo rgyus 'khod pa'i deb ther zhig de bas kyang mthong rgyu dkon la/ dgon pa thog mar 252

mjug bsdu'i gtam/bskyar bzhengs dus kyi mi sna mang che ba da lta tshe 'das su 'gyur bzhin pa bcas rgyu mtshan de dag las 'di lta bu'i sngar song lo rgyus kyi byang rim zhig bris nas rang cag gi mi rabs rjes ma rnams zlo brgyud sprod byed dgos pa de ni kha tsha dgos gtugs su gyur ba na rang yul rang gces kyi bsam pas kun nas blangs te dka' ngal sna tshogs khyad du bsad nas bka' gdams chos 'byung dang 'brel ba'i rnam thar dang lo rgyus dag la blta klog nan tan dang / sa yul dngos la bskyod de rtogs zhib 'dri rtsad kyis khungs btsan gyi dpyad gzhi gang mang bsdu rub dang /rang gi rig pa'i rtsal la brten nas gnas bshad kyi deb chung 'di 'dra zhig bris khul lags kyang rang nyid shes rgya chung ba dang /dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs rnyed dka' ba sogs mthun rkyen mang po zhig ma tshang bas tshig skyon dang don skyon mi nyung ba zhig mchis srid pa la rgya che'i gzigs pa po rnams kyis lhag bsam bzang pos kun nas blangs te rtsa che'i dgongs 'char lhug stsol yong bar mkhyen/mjug tu deb ther 'di nyid 'bri rtsom par skrun byed pa'i rgyun rim nang kun phan theb rtsa tshogs pas ma dngul gyi rogs ram gnang bar gus pas snying thag pa nas thugs rje che zhes zhu rgyu ma zad khyed rnam pa'i kun phan gyi bya bzang de nyid yar ngo'i zla ltar 'phel ba'i bkra shis smon 'dun yang zhu rgyu yin/253

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/zhar byung du/bka' gdams dge bshes 'chad kha pa dang 'chad kha dgon pa'i lo rgyus la cung zad dpyad pa/bka' gdams dge bshes 'chad kha chen po dang /'phan yul 'jog po'i mda' yi 'chad kha dgon//lo rgyus me long ngos su gcig min yang /'phan po'i yul 'dir kun gyis gcig tu 'dzin//des na bdag gis dpyad zhib ral gri yis/mi dang dgon ming gcig tu 'dzin pa yi/rmongs pa'i dra ba yongs su gsal byas nas/bden pa'i lo rgyus kun gyi snyan du gsol//zhes bka' gdams dge bshes 'chad kha pa dang /'phan yul 'jog po'i mda' ru chags pa'i 'chad kha dgon pa gnyis kyi lo rgyus las 'phros te mi dang dgon ming gcig tu 'dzin pa'i nor 'khrul gyi lta bar gsal 'grel cung zad zhu ba la/(1) bka' gdams pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rnams kyi ya rgyal dge bshes 'chad kha pa ye shes rdo rje ni dge ba'i bshes gnyen chen po sha ra ba la bu slob mang du byang ba'i nang gi slob ma mchog tu gyar ba zhig yin zhing khong rab ༄byang gnyis pa'i lcags mo sbrul spyi ༄lo 1101lor yab 'phags rā skyabs dang / yum bsod nams skyid gnyis kyi sras su yul lung ra ru sku 'khrungs/254

mjug bsdu'i gtam/chung ngu'i dus nas lo ro ras chung pa dang sha ra ba sogs bla ma mang du bsten nas bka' gdams pa'i gzhung chen dag la mkhas par sbyangs/ de rjes mal gror byon te 'chad kha dgon pa btab nas gnas der lo bcu gnyis tsam 'gro don mdzad de tshogs pa dgu brgya lhag tsam 'dus/ de nas mtha' phur zla ba brgyad tsam bzhugs te dgung lo don lnga pa shing mo lug spyi lo 1175lor zhi bar gshegs/ khong bshegs rjes dgon pa de nyid khong gi slob ma dang yang slob sogs skyes chen dam pa mang pos rim pas bskyangs dang skyong bzhin pa la rjes su rig gsar skabs rtsa gtor du song yang / rig gsar gyi rjes chos dad rang mos kyi srid jus lag bstar don 'khyol byang ste gong rim nas chog mchan thob pa brgyud spyi lo 1985long dgon pa slar yang nyams gso zhus nas da lta grwa grangs brgyad tsam yod pa de dag gis 'dzin skyong zhu bzhin pa'i thog dgon pa'i srid 'dzin sa ༵ngalha ni mal gro gung dkar rdzong bkris sgang shang gi khongs su na (2/ ) 'phan yul 'jog po'i mda' ru chags pa'i 'chad kha dgon pa de ni bka' brgyud pa la rigs 'ga' zhig byang ba las shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bla rabs dang po dge bsgos khyung po rnal 'byor gyis spyi lo'i dus rabs bcu gnyis pa'i nang phyag btab pa zhig yin zhing / khong ni yab khyung po stag skyes dang yum bkra shis skyid gnyis kyi sras su bod sa stag spyi lo 978lor 255

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/snye mor 'khrungs zhes dang 990lor 'khrungs zhes gsungs tshul mi 'dra gnyis mchis/ sku gzhon nu'i dus su bon chos la sbyangs pa mdzad/ de rjes rdzogs chen 'byang gnas seng ge las rdzogs pa chen po gsan/ snga rjes rū rgya bal bod gsum gang sar byon zhus mdzad de bla ma rdo rje gdan pa chen po sogs mkhas pa grub pa thob pa brgya dang lnga bcu tsam bsten nas mdo sngags gzhung dang man ngag mtha' yas pa thugs su chud/ bod du byon te glang ri thang pa las bsnyen pa rdzogs/ 'phan yul gyi 'chad kha dgon pa dang / zhong shong sogs dgon pa brgya rtsa brgyad btab cing skabs der zhong shong du dge 'dun khri tsho brgyad tsam 'dus shing 'gro don rgya cher bskyangs nas shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi srol yang phye/ khong mi yul du dgung grangs brgya dang lnga bcu tsam bzhugs par grags/ khong gis phyag btab gnang ba'i 'phan yul 'jog po'i mda' yi 'chad kha dgon pa de nyid sog po'i rgyal po go dan gyi dmag thugs bod la 'byor skabs rtsa gtor phyin pa nas bzung da bar slar gso byed mkhan ma byung zhing dus rabs nyi shu'i lo rabs dgu bcu'i nang dgon pa'i gyang ro yod sa der byang chub mchod rten zhig gsar bzhengs thog da lta mi rnams kyi dad pa'i rten du gyar ba lags/gong gsal gyi lo rgyus de dag lazlo 'phan yul 'jog po'i mda' yi 'chad kha dgon pa ni bka' gdams pa'i dge bshes 'chad kha pa ye shes rdo rje'i gdan sa ma yin par shangs pa bka' 256

mjug bsdu'i gtam/brgyud kyi bla rabs dang po dge bshes khyung po rnal 'byor gyi gdan sa yin pa gsal rtogs gang legs thub rgyu yin la sngar 'chad kha dgon pa chags sa'i sa cha dngos kyi gyang ro'i jig ldebs su gsal ba'i rdo brkos yi ge dag 'dir 'dra bshus byas na 'di ltar te/ mkhas shing grub pa'i gtsug rgyan dam pa khyung po rnal 'byor la na mo/ dpal phyogs thams cad las rnam par rgyas pa shangs pa bka' brgyud la na mo/ zhes gsal ba las 'phan yul 'jog po'i mda' yi 'chad kha dgon pa ni shangs pa bka' brgyud kyi bla rabs dang po dge bshes khyung po rnal 'byor gyi gdan sa yin pa dpang rtags khungs btsan 'dug gong gsal dge bshes 'chad kha pa dang / 'chad kha dgon pa'i lo rgyus de gnyis las mi'i ming dang dgon pa'i ming gnyis ni dus rabs dang lo rgyus gang du dpyad kyang yongs su tha dad pa yin pa gas la rtogs thub rgyu yin kyang rang cag 'phan po'i yul 'dir sngar nas da bar rgan rabs tshang mas 'phan yul 'jog po'i mda' yi 'chad kha dgon pa ni dge bshes 'chad kha pa ye shes rdo rje'i gdan sa yin pa gcig gyar gyis ngos 'dzin thog 'phan gnas la bskyod skabs gnas skyo dang po dge bshes 'chad kha pa'i gdan sa nas 'go 'dzugs kyis bskyod dgos zhes ma dag rgyun 'byams kyi 'grel bshad de da dung yang gnas mus su mchis/ des na rang nyid kyis dpyad gzhi'i yig rigs dang sa cha dngos kyi dpang rtags las dge bshes 'chad 257

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/kha pa dang / 'phan yul 'jog po'i mda' yi 'chad kha dgon pa'i lo rgyus rnams klog pa po'i spyan lam du phul nas ma dag rgyun 'byams kyi bshad tshul de dag yongs su bkag ste lo rgyus kyi dngos don ji ma je bzhin gsal rtogs yong ba'i 'dun pa thugs che bcangs bzhin pa'o//'di ltar bgyis pa'i rnam dkar dge ba yis// bka' gdams mes po'i mdzad 'phrin legs rtogs nas// tshe 'di don /nākā ༵༵ /// yongs spangs te//bshad sgrub gnyis kyi bstan deb 'di'i dpyad gzhi'i yig cha/'gos lo gzhon nu dpal gyis brtsams pa'i deb ther sngon po/si khron mi rigs dpe sgrun khang / dpa' bo gtsug lag phreng bas brtsams pa'i chos byung mkhas pa'i dga' ston/ mi rigs dpe sgrun khang / thu'u bkun blo bzang chos kyi nyi mas brtsams pa'i thu'u bkun grub mtha'/ kun su'u mi rigs dpe sgrun khang /las chen kun dga' rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams pa'i bka' gdams chos 'byang gsal ba'i sgron me/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrujo khang / yongs 'dzin ye shes rgyal mtshan gyis brtsams pa'i lam rim bla ma brgyud pa'i rnam thar/ ser gtsug nang bstan dpe rnying 'tshol bsdu phyogs sgrig khang / sde srid 258

mjug bsdu'i gtam/sangs rgyas rgya mtshos brtsams pa'i dge ldan chos 'byang / krang go bod kyi shes rig dpe skrun khang / ser smad doge ye 'os dbang phyug gis brtsams pa'i grub mtha'i byung ba brjod pa/bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang / byung dkar blo bzang 'phrin las kyis brtsams pa'i dung dkar tshig mdzod/ krang go bod rig pa dpe skrun khang / nor brang o rgyan gyis bzloms pa'i bod sil po'i byang ba brjod pa shel dkar phreng ba/ bod ljongs mi dmangs 〈pe skrun khang /rwa ye shes seng ges brtsams pa'i rwa lo'i rnam thar/mtsho sngon mi rigs dpe skrun khang / rgan don rdor dang bstan chos gnyis kyis phyogs sgrig zhus pa'i gangs ljongs lo rgyus thog gi grags can mi sna/ bod ljongs mi dmangs dpe skrun khang / rgyal mo 'brag pas brtsams pa'i bod kyi lo rgyus gleng ba'i gtam/ mi rigs dpe skrun khang /

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/nidrog 'grel/(1) dkor nor/ nor rdzas/zhe (2) shar li/ rgya gar shar phyogs nas thon pa'i li la shar li sa (//sman 'dam/ sa dmar tshi can gyi nang du bdud rtsi chos sman dang sa tshi can phran bu mnyam du bsres nas bzhengs pa'i sku brnyan la sman 'dam zhes zer/(4) tshig spyod rnal du dbab/ spyir rnal du dbab zhes pa blo bde mo byung bar go na'ang 'dir ngag gi skad cha dang don /ngor+sha kyi bya spyod gnyis gcig tu 'bab pa zhig dgos zhes pa'i na (5)//dzik+ṣa/ rgya nag skad du dzi cin zer zhing gser dmar po 'am smug po la zer/(6) 'jim sku/ sa dmar tshi can nang bod shog bsres nas bzhengs pa'i sku brnyan la 'jim sku zhes zer/ 'on kyang deng skabs 'jim sku bzhengs skabs kyang bdud rtsi chos sman sogs ༵༵ sbya sdo kyā ṭā sdo sdo sman 'dam dang 'jim sku'i bar khyad par de (7) paṇ+ḍi ta/ legs sbyar gyi skad bod skad du rig pa'i gnas lnga shes pa'i mkhas pa/260

mjug bsdu'i gtam/(8) rlom pa/ ham pa'am nga rgyal byed pa ste rang nyid paṇ+ḍi ta ma yin kyang yin khul byed pa/(9) dmu rgod/ rgyud gyong po ste zhi zhing dul ba ma yin pa/(10) 'phro bshol/ mtshams zhogs zhes pa'i don/( ) gdung 'tshob/ rigs dang lugs kyi rgyud 'dzin mkhan/( 2) spur sbyangs/ phung po zhugs 'bul byas pa/( 3) zho bshal/ zho blug sa'i snod bshal bshal btang ba'i chu/(14) dben pa'i gnas/ ri khrod lta bu khu sim pa'i gnas/(15) gsha' garnam dag gam yang dag pa/(16) bkur sti/ brtsi bkur ram bsnyen bkur/(17) btub btub/ thub thub ces pa'i don/(18) sdom gsum/ so thar/ byang sems/ gsang sngags/(19) phyam tshe/ zha thul lam zla gam ste ser mo ba'i rgyun gos dang / skya bo bas kyang nang la sdod skabs spyod/(20) bla gos/ chos gos rnam gsum gyi ya gyal te dge tshul slong gnyis kus gyon pa'i stod gos ser po/ deng skabs yongs grags su chos gos zer/(21) ka ba li/ dpe cha'i snod sho ka li'i ming /(22) 'khra sa/ btsan sa'am yib sa/(23) bza' pa/ bza' pa zhes pa yul skad yin zhing gnyer pa la go/(24) 'khri ba/ zhen chags sam chags pa/261

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/(25) sha gzug rang za/ sha gzug rang za zhes pa ni sha gzug ces pa sha khog gcig gi don yin zhing sha khog gcig pu de rang nas za zhes dpe tsam ston pa las don du sgrub pa nyams len kho na bya zhes pa'i don no/(26) 'du 'dzi/ mi mang po 'dus pa'i zang zing /(27) snang shas/ gnas skabs tsam gyi 'dod bde la sred pa'i zhen chags/'dzirno 2/sdo/rtag 'dzin/ mi rtag pa rtag par 'dzin pa la rtag (29) skyo sun/ skyo ma sun tsam ste rtsam pa'i nang ja blugs nas ltogs sun tsam mchod pa'i don/(30) ting nge 'dzin/ yang dag par 'dzin pa ste dmigs pa la sems rtse gcig tu gnas pa/(31) mdos/ mchod sbyin gyi tshab bam glud rdzas 'di la gnyis dbye rgyu yod pa'i yas stags ni lha la mchod pa 'bul rgyu zlorno / mas stags ni gdon bgegs rnams la sbyin pa gtong rgyu gyi cho lha rji/nga chog sdig sgrib sbyang pa dang rnam shes gnas spor (33) sor bshag sta gon nam gra sgrig gi don yin kyang yul de'i dmangs khrod du sor bshag ces zer/(34) lha zhol/tshe thar du btang ba'i lha g.yag gam khyu/262

mjug bsdu'i gtam/(35) sbungs tho/ sa rdo sogs phyogs gcig tu rang bzhin gyis rub rub chags pa lta bu/(36) tal gyis 'gro/ shar rgyag 'gro ba ste 'khon 'khon thogs thogs med pa'i don/(37)dro btab/tsha phogs brgyab pa/(38) snyan phra/ go rim la dbye sbyor byed pa/(39) la bzlos/ thag chod pa ste 'khor ba las thar ba'i don/(7) re kha/ ri mo/(41) gdengs ku klu rgyal gyi mgor skyes pa'i rgyan lta bu/(42) ring bsrel/ sku gdung sogs las babs pa'i ril bu khyad par can/(43) bsod snyoms/ sbyin par byas pa'i zas nor/(4) mi 'chor/mi shor zhes pa'i don/(45) rtsabs re/ zhi'i ru rtsi/(46) sha thang / dka' ngal che ba/(47) span spun/ span spun zhes pa skabs 'dir res mos kyi don la go zhing po to ba'i bka' rgyud 'di la chos dang 'jig rten res mos kyis byed pa'i srol med ces pa'i don no/(48) bkral ba/ 'grel pa'i dus 'das pa/(49) bas mthar/ sa mtha'am yul mtha'/(50) tsab tsub/ tsab be tsub be ste blo bag mi phebs pa'i rnam 'gyur/263

'phan yul gyi gnas bshad ngo mtshar rig gnas kyi bang mdzod/(51) pho bo/ bu span rgan pa a jo'i ming ste phu bo dang mtshungs/(52) phra man ma/༄ mir rdzus pa'i 'dre mo/(53) sgrom bu/ sgrom bu zhes pa skabs 'dir sgam chung la gospyi lo2009lo'i zla ba 3tshes 11nyin 'phan yul du yongs su rdzogs pa bris zin to//

sbyamani/'gaḥ.azlo / ṭ+wāstana'adzin/naspyag༄cu// 'dzor+sha /sna ñcha k+ta ཿswā zloshāt+na ngo mtshar /khro/ bye bye// ཿkha/na/ khrokhroXbye snroḥ// spyamigasgrol//rdo treḥ/spra /snan// rnyiXkyi〉〉miḥsgo smosadape cha tswa|snro lha/bas mkhan/ bye 51sdu sta'i ༵ ༵༵sportasadayogibye/ /sdi/// thig thengs/ ༷༷gau 36) ༵ zlosditā tshimik+ta po brgyagabye/sang938/—7—054—80327—075 864 bod35
